jobs.title: Design and Product Engineering
jobs.description: **About OuterSignal** --------------------- We are building the customer intelligence and personalization layer for consumer businesses. Every business knows when an order comes in or a user signs up, but they only see 5% of the real story. We show them the other 95%: not just who’s buying, but who that person actually is. That includes the execs, influencers, journalists, retail buyers, investors, and everyday customers who become a brand’s best evangelists. Our platform enriches every customer in real time with professional and personal signals, builds personas, and powers everything from surprise\-and\-delight outreach to smarter email flows, analytics, and BD leads. We’re a small, high\-performing team building the category\-defining platform for customer intelligence, backed by a world\-class investor base. **About the Role** ------------------ Most software is built by people who stopped looking at it. We make everything a merchant sees in OuterSignal: the app, the agents, the emails they write on a merchant's behalf. Underneath all of it is one idea. Every order comes from a specific person, and once you actually know who that person is, you can work out what to show them next, where, and when. Where this ends up is something a merchant turns on and stops thinking about. It works out who each customer is, decides what they should see next and where they should see it, in their inbox, in an ad, on the product page, and the sales show up. Nobody has to understand how it got there. Parts of it are running today. Most of it hasn't been built yet. You'd design it and build it. There's no designer handing mocks to an engineer here. It's the same person, and honestly that's how most of our best stuff has shipped. Part of the roadmap is vision: things merchants haven't asked for because they don't know they're possible yet. The rest comes from watching what merchants actually do, on CX calls and in the app, and working out what's driving it. We keep both going. And we don't hold things back to polish them. We ship, watch what merchants pick up, and build on what sticks. We ship to production weekly, often daily. Taste without shipping is a mood board. Shipping without taste is a backlog. **What You'll Work On** ----------------------- * Design and build product surfaces end to end, from the first sketch to the deployed page, in light and dark. * Sit with what customer success hears and what merchants actually do in the product. Let that decide what gets built. * Build with agents. Our team runs fleets of coding agents through Mission Control, our own engineering environment. You'll direct them, review them, and hold their output to your standard. * Make the thing that explains the thing: demo flows, motion, launch films. If a feature can't be shown, it isn't finished. * Ship and watch. Put work in front of merchants early, see what they actually use, and push further on what sticks. * Set the bar for taste and craft across the team. * Push the boundaries of human creativity and machine intelligence. **What You'll Shape** --------------------- * **The OuterSignal app:** personas, the signal feed, product intelligence, segments and playbooks. The place merchants come to understand their customers. * **Mission Control:** the OuterSignal research \& development environment * **Sonar:** the agent merchants talk to, on the web and on iOS. It answers questions about their customers and drafts what to do next. * **Creative Studio:** where merchants make emails * **Merchant’s storefronts:** what a merchant's shoppers see. Product pages, proof and offers that change with who is looking, starting with the social\-proof badge already live on merchant stores. * **Merchant’s Advertisements:** make the machines think like Don Draper Some of our stack: TypeScript, React and Next.js, Tailwind, Postgres, ClickHouse, SwiftUI for iOS, Blender, Seedance, ElevenLabs. **Who You Are** --------------- * You have shipped work you're still proud of. You can point to it. * You design and you code, and you don't think of them as separate skills. * You've led a product surface from idea to launch: made the calls, brought people along, and lived with the result in production. * You notice when a page is two pixels off, and you also notice when the whole page shouldn't exist. * You listen to customers. You can tell the difference between what they ask for and what they need. * You work with AI as an instrument, not a shortcut. You know when to let the agent run and when to put your hands on it. * You'd rather make one thing that's right than five that are fine. * You care about the people around you getting better, and you help them do it. **Why Join Now** ---------------- * **Meaningful equity:** you're joining a venture\-backed company early, while it defines a new category in commerce intelligence. What you make will show up in what you own. * **Nothing between you and the work:** you'll work directly with our founder and CEO, our Head of Product and our VP of Customer Success. No layers, no committees. * **It's real:** our product runs in production for real brands. Their customers see what you ship. * **The inflection point:** coding agents just got good enough that one engineer with taste can do the work of a team. The bottleneck has moved from typing code to knowing what's worth making. Right now, in a place that moves this fast, a creative engineer is more dangerous than they have ever been. * **In the room:** we work together in person in NYC because building with AI moves fast and the best decisions happen at a whiteboard, not in a thread. * **The canvas is still mostly blank:** we're past prototype with strong product\-market fit, and most of what this product will become hasn't been made yet. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Healthcare
jobs.description: **Company** ----------- Pramaana Labs is a frontier AI lab building the verification layer for AI. Founded in 2025 and headquartered in Palo Alto, we turn complex human knowledge, including tax codes, legal rules, clinical guidelines and security protocols, into formal representations so AI answers can be traced, challenged and proved. Our architecture pairs foundation models trained to formalize and reason with a symbolic world model encoded in Lean 4\. Pramaana was founded by a team from Google, DeepMind and Glean, bringing together frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts. Our commercial team is building the go\-to\-market motion to bring this technology to enterprises where correctness matters most. **The Role** ------------ Healthcare organizations are adopting AI across care delivery, coverage decisions, pharmacy benefits and operational workflows where errors can affect patients, costs and regulatory compliance. Pramaana brings machine\-checkable verification to rule\-intensive decisions, allowing teams to distinguish what has been proved from what has merely been asserted. We are hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to build our business across healthcare providers, payers, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) and healthcare technology platforms. You will own a focused book of strategic accounts spanning health systems, physician groups, hospitals and other care providers; commercial and government health plans; PBMs; and healthcare technology companies. This is a quota\-carrying, zero\-to\-one role: open senior relationships, identify consequential and technically tractable workflows, build measurable paid pilots and convert early proof of value into durable revenue. You will help define distinct sales plays for each customer segment. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and execute a named\-account strategy across hospital systems, physician networks and provider groups, health insurers and health plans, PBMs, pharmacy services organizations and healthcare technology platforms; prioritize accounts by urgency, buyer access, verified use\-case fit and potential value. * Develop trusted, multi\-threaded relationships with CIOs, CTOs, heads of AI, provider clinical and administrative leadership, revenue cycle and operations executives, health plan leaders in claims and utilization management, and PBM executives in pharmacy benefits, clinical programs and operations. * Lead deep discovery in policy\-driven workflows across provider operations (coding, billing, revenue cycle, documentation and care pathways), payer operations (eligibility, coverage policies, prior authorization and claims) and PBM operations (formularies, pharmacy benefit rules, utilization management and adjudication). Identify authoritative rules, exceptions, error costs and technical and regulatory constraints. * Own the revenue target and full enterprise sales cycle, from account creation and executive discovery through paid pilots, privacy/security and regulatory reviews, legal, procurement, commercial negotiation, close and expansion across business units. * Co\-design paid pilots with product, research and Forward Deployed Engineers, tailoring scope to provider, payer or PBM workflows and agreeing on source rules, assumptions, verification boundaries, quality measures, ROI and a credible path to deployment. * Build compelling business cases for provider, payer and PBM stakeholders, quantifying reduced rework, more consistent rule application, faster decisions and improved auditability without overstating verification guarantees or implying that Pramaana replaces clinical judgment. * Maintain rigorous pipeline, next\-step and forecast discipline, while translating provider, payer and PBM feedback into differentiated use cases, reusable sales plays and product priorities. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** -------------------------------------------- * Proven success personally selling complex enterprise technology into major healthcare providers, health plans, PBMs or healthcare platforms, with quota ownership, meaningful closed deals and demonstrated buyer relationships in at least one of these segments. * Fluency in healthcare buying committees, budgets and procurement, including the distinct operating realities of hospital and physician organizations, insurance plans, and pharmacy benefit management. * Ability to build senior relationships and create demand rather than only manage an inherited book or respond to inbound leads. * Consultative discovery and technical credibility with CIOs, technology teams, provider operations leaders, health plan executives and pharmacy benefits stakeholders. * Experience quantifying customer value, structuring pilots, navigating privacy/security review and growing initial use cases into strategic accounts. * High agency, careful judgment and genuine interest in precise, trustworthy AI for consequential work. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** ---------------------------------------------- * Deep relationships in health systems, physician groups, health insurers, PBMs, specialty pharmacy services, care administration or healthcare software. * Experience selling AI, cloud, developer infrastructure, EHR or revenue\-cycle technology, payer administration, pharmacy benefits, clinical/administrative software or compliance platforms. * Built a new vertical sales motion and codified early wins into repeatable plays.

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: **Location:** Palo Alto, CA (5 days/week in office) · **Type:** Full\-time · **YOE:** 2yr\+ FDE experiences. (Bonus) technical sales, technical consultant or AI/SaaS founder experience · **Compensation:** competitive base \+ equity **About us** ------------ We're building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab. Goaly is an early\-stage AI startup founded by ex\-Meta Superintelligence Labs engineers and researchers. Our founders built the Llama Research Platform that every Llama post\-training run landed on, and led post\-training efficiency on Meta's Superintelligence team. Our mission is to dramatically lower the cost, time, and talent barriers to building proprietary AI — and make each generation of models faster and cheaper to build than the last. Goaly is the autonomous performance layer for AI training. It watches every job across a GPU fleet, catches the runs that are wasting compute, reallocates what it frees up, and shows teams what each model improvement actually costs. It runs on\-prem, telemetry\-only, and starts read\-only. Backed by leading AI investors and endorsed by frontier AI researchers and builders, we're looking for an engineer who can walk into a prospect's GPU cluster, get Goaly running, and prove its value fast enough that the pilot becomes a contract. We’re building toward a world where every company can become its own AI lab. Goaly is a stealth AI startup founded by ex\-Meta MSL engineers and researchers. Our mission is to dramatically lower the cost, time, and talent barriers to building proprietary AI — and make each generation of models faster and cheaper to build than the last. Backed by leading AI investors and endorsed by frontier AI researchers and builders, we’re looking for exceptional new grads who want to work on hard, foundational AI systems problems with outsized ownership from day one. **About the role** ------------------ You will be one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, working directly with the founding team. Your job is to shorten the path from "interesting first call" to "signed customer." You will own three things: * **Run technical evaluations that close.** Scope, deploy, and run Goaly pilots inside prospect environments, and turn each one into a clear, numbers\-backed result the buyer can take to their leadership. * **Be the technical voice in the deal.** Join discovery and evaluation calls, answer the hard infrastructure and security questions on the spot, and remove the blockers that stall deals. * **Bring the field back into the product.** Turn what you see in real clusters into integrations, fixes, and product changes, so every next deployment is faster than the last. You need strong systems engineering skills, because you will work inside other people's infrastructure with limited access and real constraints. You need customer instincts, because the job is to make the prospect successful first and Goaly successful as a result. You do not need a background in model research. This is a founding role. There is no playbook yet; you help write it, and the deployment process you build becomes how Goaly scales to every customer after you. **What you'll do** ------------------ ### **Deploy Goaly in prospect environments** * Scope each pilot with the prospect: which clusters, which workloads, what success looks like, and how we will measure it. * Install and configure Goaly on\-prem across the stacks our customers run (Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and in\-house schedulers), in read\-only, telemetry\-only mode. * Work through security reviews, network constraints, and access approvals with the prospect's platform and security teams. * Debug what breaks in real environments: odd scheduler setups, missing metrics, custom training stacks. ### **Prove the value and convert** * Turn pilot data into a clear business case: compute wasted, compute recovered, and the cost of each model improvement. * Present results to ML leads, infra leads, and the executives who sign. * Partner with GTM on deal strategy, technical objections, and the path from pilot to paid deployment. * Keep each evaluation on a tight timeline, and flag early when a deal is at risk. ### **Build what the field needs** * Write the integrations, scripts, and connectors that a deployment needs, and push the reusable ones back into the product. * Build and maintain demo environments and reference deployments for sales calls. * Turn repeated questions into docs, runbooks, and install guides, so time\-to\-value drops with every customer. ### **Feed the roadmap** * Bring precise, prioritized field feedback to engineering and the founders: what customers need, what blocks adoption, and what wins deals. * Reproduce customer issues and work with engineering until they ship a fix. **What a typical week looks like** ---------------------------------- * Two days on active pilots: on\-site or remote in a prospect's cluster, installing, debugging, and pulling results. * A day on deal calls: discovery, technical deep dives, security reviews, and results readouts. * A day building: an integration a prospect needs, a better install path, or a demo environment. * A day with the team: engineering sync on field feedback, GTM sync on pipeline, and founder time on what we learned. * \[Roughly X percent travel] for on\-site deployments and customer visits. **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * **A strong engineering background:** \[2–5] years as a software, infrastructure, or ML engineer. You write production\-quality code (Python required; Go or Rust a plus). * **Hands\-on infra experience:** you have run or debugged workloads on Kubernetes, Slurm, or Ray, and you are comfortable on Linux, in cloud and on\-prem environments. * **Customer\-facing technical experience:** as an FDE, solutions engineer, sales engineer, or similar. You have taken a customer from a blank page to a working result. * **Clear communication:** you can explain a technical result to an engineer in the morning and to a VP in the afternoon. * **Ownership under ambiguity:** you drive a deployment to the finish line without a detailed spec or someone checking in. **Strong pluses** ----------------- * Experience with GPU clusters and distributed training (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron, or similar). * Experience with observability and telemetry (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, OpenTelemetry). * Experience at an AI infra, MLOps, or developer\-tools company with an enterprise sales motion. * Experience with enterprise security reviews and on\-prem software deployments. * Startup or founder experience. **Reasons to take this job** ---------------------------- * You work on the most compute\-intensive workloads in the industry, inside the clusters of the teams that run them. * You see the direct impact of your work: every pilot you run is a deal that closes or doesn't. * Your feedback goes straight into the roadmap, with no layers between you and the founders who built post\-training infra at Llama scale. * You build the FDE function from 0 to 1, with a clear path to leading it as it grows. * Great vibe: a strong (and fun) team who worked at the frontier before, substantial GPU capacity to test ideas, and real customers to build with. **Reasons to not take this job** -------------------------------- * You want to work only on the core product, not inside customer environments. * You don't want to be on calls with customers, or to travel for on\-site deployments. * You want a narrow scope. This role moves between engineering, deals, and product every week. * You want a playbook. There isn't one yet. **Location, visa sponsorship \& benefits** ------------------------------------------ * **Hybrid in Palo Alto:** 4\+ days/week in office. * **Visa sponsorship:** H\-1B and OPT/CPT support available, with immigration counsel. * **Meals \& perks:** Complimentary lunch, dinner, snacks, and drinks. **How to apply** ---------------- **Send us 2 links or short write\-ups to start:** something you built or deployed in a customer environment, and a technical problem you solved under real constraints (limited access, a deadline, an unhappy customer). If you can't share details, tell us in a paragraph how you would run a 2\-week Goaly pilot on a prospect's 500\-GPU cluster. **A note on qualifications.** We value exceptional ability over perfect keyword matches. If the work excites you and you can show strong technical ability, customer instinct, and ownership, we encourage you to apply. **Equal opportunity** --------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates who need them during the hiring process.

jobs.title: IT & Security Manager
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ In a little over a year and a half, Blank Metal has more than doubled in size. The IT, security, and compliance work that comes with that growth has been handled by whoever had time, including the COO. That worked for 12 people. It doesn’t at 50, and it won’t at 100\. Our clients now hand us security addendums before kickoff, expect SOC 2 reports and annual risk questionnaires, write US\-only data processing into their contracts, and audit us as a delegated entity under Medicare rules. Meanwhile our own engineers are running two laptops each, model\-provider API keys are managed by hand, and nobody can tell you where every machine is. You will own all of it: the help queue, the device fleet, the security program, the compliance evidence, and the operational side of the AI stack that runs our business. This is a build role and a player\-coach role. You’ll write the policy and ship the laptop in the same afternoon. The mandate is right\-sized: we scope controls to the obligations we actually have and add more when a contract or an audit finding says to, not because a framework says we might need it someday. Success in the first year looks like a clear device baseline, a passed SOC 2 Type I with Type II underway, security questionnaires answered in days instead of weeks, and a picture of what we spend on models and why. **What You Get To Do** ---------------------- ### ***Run the shop*** * Own the internal help queue end to end. Blank Metal engineers are fast and impatient; you’ll keep them that way by making account setup, access, and troubleshooting a same\-day thing. * Build the device lifecycle we don’t have yet: procurement and vendor relationships, imaging, mobile device management, inventory, loaners, repairs, and retirement. You’ll know where every laptop is and whose it is. * Make onboarding and offboarding a checklist that runs in hours for employees and contractors alike, including the client\-issued machines and accounts that come with each engagement. * Administer the core stack (Google Workspace, 1Password, Slack, Zoom, GitHub) with sane access policies, and be the person who says no to the fourth note\-taking app. * Own the hardware and software budget and get us to a standard kit, with spares on the shelf, without overspending. ### ***Make security something we can prove*** * Take Blank Metal through SOC 2: pick the compliance automation platform, scope the controls to our real obligations, run the audit, and keep the evidence current. * Be the standing answer to client security questionnaires, security addendums, and data protection exhibits, working alongside our outside counsel so what we commit to is what we can actually do. * Write and own the policies that are missing today (access control, data retention and destruction, acceptable use, device, incident response) and make them short enough that people follow them. * Serve as the technical counterpart to our healthcare compliance program, translating Medicare\- and HIPAA\-regulated requirements into controls engineers can live with. * Review the tools we adopt (AI note\-takers, browser extensions, SaaS) against what our client contracts allow, before someone connects them. ### ***Keep the AI stack accountable*** * Own the accounts, API keys, and access to our model providers and cloud environments, with rotation, scoping, and attribution by client and project. * Stand up usage and cost observability for model spend so leadership can see token cost by engagement, tie it to margin, and catch surprises before the invoice does. * Enforce data residency and handling rules for AI workloads, including US\-only processing, no\-training clauses, and environment isolation for client data. * Provision secure, repeatable working environments for engineers and contractors, so a new team member is productive on day one without a security exception. * Contribute to large client engagements that need infrastructure stood up: cloud accounts, model hosting, access patterns, audit logging. You set the pattern; delivery teams carry it. **What Will Help You Succeed** ------------------------------ * 5\+ years running IT and security at a company under 200 people, ideally one that handles regulated data. You’ve been the one who answered the questionnaire and sat with the auditor. * You’ve taken a company through SOC 2 from nothing (HITRUST or a HIPAA program is a plus) and know what auditors actually look at versus what the platform dashboard says. * Hands\-on with a Mac fleet: Google Workspace admin, MDM (Jamf, Kandji, or similar), SSO and identity, password management. You don’t need a ticket to fix a ticket. * Comfortable in at least one major cloud and with the LLM provider ecosystem. You’ve managed API keys and quotas, set up a gateway or proxy, and can read a token bill and explain it to a CFO. * You can read a security addendum and tell a lawyer, in plain English, which clauses we can sign and which we can’t. * A right\-sizer by instinct. You scope controls to real obligations, say when something is over\-built, and sequence investment on evidence rather than fear. * You write clearly. Policies, questionnaire answers, and Slack replies that people actually read and act on. * Patient with the help queue and unbothered by it. Reimaging a laptop is not beneath you, and neither is presenting to leadership. **Why You’ll Love It Here** --------------------------- * Build AI that ships: every project ends in a live deployment, not a slide deck * Craft meets velocity: we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed * Outcome\-driven model: our work aligns with client success, not billable hours * AI\-native culture: you’ll work with peers who deeply understand modern AI’s potential and limits * Real collaboration: open conversations, shared ownership, and space to bring your voice **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Compensation: base salary of $155,000 to $190,000, depending on experience. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, with a guideline of 10% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed. We also offer comprehensive health coverage, 401(k) with match, flexible time off, and support for professional development. This role is based in Minneapolis and works from our office a minimum of three days a week. **About Blank Metal** --------------------- Blank Metal is an AI\-native engineering company that partners with enterprises to deliver production AI fast. We blend strategic insight with hands\-on execution, shipping high\-impact systems that turn AI initiatives into measurable business results. We’re builders, not theorists. Our team of seasoned engineers, designers, and strategists work across industries to create AI applications that actually get used and make a difference. *Blank Metal is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all backgrounds and perspectives. Diversity makes our work better and our team stronger.* blankmetal.ai

jobs.title: Industrial Automation Reliability Engineer — Conveyors & Sortation
jobs.description: **Can you turn breakdowns into breakthroughs?** ----------------------------------------------- If you love fast\-paced environments, hands\-on troubleshooting, and optimizing complex automation, this role puts you at the epicenter of reliability for modern material handling systems. You’ll enhance—not just maintain—technologies like conveyors, sorters, PLCs, scanners, vision, print‑and‑apply, and SCADA to drive uptime, safety, and operational excellence. **Schedule:** 8 AM\-5 PM Monday\- Friday \+ on call on weekends ### **Your impact** * Keep people and equipment safe by following all codes, regulations, and company safety directives. * Diagnose and refine PLC/PC control software using Allen Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix and RSLogix 5000\. * Be the first call for on\-site and remote controls issues, during and after business hours; respond rapidly to emergencies. * Verify systems operate within design limits and meet client\-defined performance conditions. * Direct external contractor work: scope, request initiation, scheduling, and inspection for proprietary tasks, licensed installs, upgrades, and specialized maintenance/inspections. * Design and implement reliability and process improvements from concept through network deployment. * Monitor industrial networks (Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS‑I), motor control systems, servo and frequency drives, and electrical distribution. * Analyze equipment metrics and partner with site teams to eliminate electrical causes of performance loss. * Communicate early and often with leadership, operations, and maintenance on technical risks, timelines, and production impacts. * Lead failure reviews; recommend improvements or retraining to prevent repeat incidents. * Perform controls assessments to protect and improve reliability. * Foster strong relationships with the Client and Operations Maintenance teams. * Pitch in with other related duties as needed. ### **Must\-have background** * Bachelor's Degree preferred and 2–5 years’ relevant experience; equivalent experience/education combinations considered. * Experience across at least two engineering design cycles (specification, component selection, programming). * 2\+ years in PLC programming, robotics components/controls, and SCADA\-based control/monitoring. * Willingness to adjust to flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and holidays. * Ability to work independently, interpreting general instructions with little oversight. * Physical readiness: stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and lifting/carrying 50\+ lbs. * Ability to handle sensitive, complex communications and set/hold performance expectations. ### **Preferred extras** * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent in control systems troubleshooting/programming. * Experience with multiple conveyor and sortation platforms. * Hands\-on robotics maintenance. * Fluency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). * Strong organization and curiosity\-driven problem solving. * Advanced math skills (percentages, fractions, and financial\-related calculations). ### **You should be proficient in** * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience ### **Tech stack** * SCADA * Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) (Allen Bradley) ### **Compliance (verbatim)** Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

jobs.title: Live Sports Data Analyst

This position may require evening and weekend work aligned with live sports schedules. **Qualifications** * Strong Data Collection skills with attention to detail and accuracy in fast\-paced, real\-time environments. * Analytical Skills to interpret game situations, validate data, and recognize patterns or inconsistencies. * Clear Communication skills to coordinate with team members, report issues, and follow operational guidelines. * Experience with Training and Research to learn new tools quickly, apply standardized methods, and contribute to process improvements. * Knowledge of major sports (rules, terminology, game flow) and enthusiasm for live sporting events. * Comfort with technology, including mobile apps, data entry interfaces, and basic troubleshooting. * Ability to work on\-site in the Indianapolis area, including evenings and weekends as available. * Previous experience in sports statistics, live event operations, or a related data\-focused field is beneficial; relevant education in fields such as sports management, statistics, or computer science is a plus. **Pay** This role is primarily looking for someone to do Pacers games, but Colts games as well as CFB/CBB opportunities will be periodically available. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Control Systems)
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * Paid time off * 401(k) * Competitive salary * Opportunity for advancement * Stock options plan **About the Role:** Radiant Robotics is looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on Controls Systems to join our innovative development team in San Leandro, CA. This is an exciting opportunity to apply advanced control strategies to magnetic levitation systems, helping to shape the future of intelligent automation and robotics. If you're passionate about building smart, data\-driven physical AI systems with real\-world impact, we want to hear from you. **Responsibilities:** * Design control strategies including PID, model predictive control and learned policies, and recommend which to deploy. * Develop and optimize control algorithms using ML techniques such as reinforcement learning and predictive modeling. * Design, develop, and deploy ML models and apply in areas where they add value, including disturbance modeling, and trajectory optimization. * Build and maintain simulation models of dynamic magnetic forces, moving payloads, and the sensing chain, and validate them against bench measurements * Build and validate simulations of various control strategies by running comparative experiments. * Define performance metrics for the magnetic levitation system, such as positional error and report results against them. * Document models, assumptions, and results for analysis and improvement, and so that other engineers can reproduce and extend the work. * Work with firmware and electronics engineers to move proven strategies from simulation onto the real hardware and tune them in the loop. **Requirements:** * Master's degree or higher in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field. * Working knowledge of control theory, including PID design and tuning, state\-space methods, and model predictive control (MPC). You can derive a plant model, linearize it, and explain the tradeoffs of each approach. * Applied machine learning experience, with at least one project where a learned model or policy improved a physical or simulated system. * Experience building dynamic simulations of physical systems and checking them against real measurements. * Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, or MATLAB/Simulink for controls and ML development * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain controller behavior to engineers outside the controls discipline. * Comfort using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or similar for simulations development. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying controllers on embedded targets such as microcontrollers or real\-time Linux, and tuning them with hardware in the loop. * Experience with multi\-physics or finite element modeling of magnetic fields, for example with FEMM or COMSOL. Experience with designing, analyzing, or fabricating systems that generate or manipulate magnetic fields. * **About Us:** Radiant Robotics is an innovator and leader in magnetic levitation solutions, with a focus on warehousing and logistics applications. Radiant’s mission is to unify all materials handling workflows for warehousing and manufacturing into a single, simple intelligent automation platform. In this role, you will be an integral part of our close\-knit bay area R\&D team striving to introduce novel automation and robotics solutions that will revolutionize the material handling industry.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – LLM Evaluations (Evals)
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Machine Learning Engineer – LLM Evaluations (Evals) **Location:** New York, NY (On\-site – 5 days/week) **Compensation:** $220,000 – $300,000/year \+ Competitive Equity **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Work Authorization:** U.S. Citizens or Green Card holders only (visa sponsorship is not available) **About the Opportunity** We are partnering with a well\-funded, research\-driven AI startup in New York City building the memory and identity layer for autonomous agents. We are looking for a **Machine Learning Engineer (Evals)** to own our end\-to\-end evaluation infrastructure from the ground up. In a complex multi\-agent environment with black\-box behavior, standard benchmarks aren't enough. You will define what "better" looks like for dynamic entity representations that evolve over time—without relying on pre\-existing ground truth—and build the scalable machinery to measure, test, and improve them. If you thrive on designing evaluation frameworks from scratch, digging into execution traces to uncover root causes, and shipping fixes directly, this role is built for you. **Key Responsibilities** * **Design Novel Evaluations:** Define scoring metrics and establish what "better" means for evolving entity representations, continuously updating frameworks as models and methods advance. * **Build End\-to\-End Pipelines \& Harnesses:** Architect the data ingestion, labeling, versioning, rerun, and LLM\-as\-a\-judge infrastructure that enables rapid weekly experimentation. * **Analyze Traces \& Drive Improvements:** Deep\-dive into model traces and evaluation outputs to uncover subtle failure modes—not just surface metrics—and propose concrete fixes to improve representation fidelity. * Qualifications** * **3\+ years of hands\-on experience** designing, building, and running end\-to\-end evaluation systems for Large Language Models (LLMs). * Proven track record of **creating novel cadence). * Strong proficiency with **PyTorch**, **Hugging Face**, and **Weights \& Biases (W\&B)**. * Demonstrated **research background**, evidenced by first/co\-authored publications at top\-tier venues (NeurIPS,ICML, ICLR, or equivalent) **OR** significant, self\-published open\-source research work. * Ability to work **on\-site 5 days a week in New York, NY** (or willingness to relocate). * evaluation, or agentic optimization. * Experience with data pipeline and orchestration tooling such as **Hydra, Kafka, or SQL**. * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - Owner/Investor
jobs.description: AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves. **Hi, We're AppFolio.** ----------------------- We're innovators, changemakers, and collaborators. We're more than just a software company; we're a cloud\-based powerhouse that creates products to make our customers' lives easier. We are an AI\-first engineering organization, revolutionizing how people do business. We want your ideas, enthusiasm, and passion to help us keep innovating at the speed of the modern market. **Who we are looking for** -------------------------- We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead two teams in our Investor/Owner segment: **Owner Growth** and **Owner Actions**. Together, these teams shape how property owners engage with AppFolio, from how they discover and adopt the experience to the actions they take to manage and improve the performance of their real estate. You'll own the success of both teams: their people, their delivery, and their outcomes. You'll also share ownership of strategy and delivery with your Product partners. The right candidate is a technically credible leader who builds high\-trust, high\-performing teams, keeps a sharp eye on customer value, and helps their teams use the latest AI\-assisted techniques to build software for our large and growing audience of property managers and owners. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. That doesn't mean writing code. It means staying close to the technical work day to day, weighing in on architecture and quality decisions, and having real skin in the game on how our systems get built. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead and grow two teams across Owner Growth and Owner Actions, 8–10 experienced engineers in total, all reporting directly to you. You'll own all aspects of people management: hiring, onboarding, goal setting, feedback, performance, and career growth. * Share ownership of strategy and delivery for both teams with Product. Turn Investor/Owner segment plans into team roadmaps and an operating rhythm that delivers results within the year. * Drive execution across both teams: organize work, set clear goals, manage dependencies between the teams, adjust pace to match criticality and risk, and hold the teams accountable for outcomes. * Stay close to the technical work. Take part in architectural discussions, and lead them when needed. Make informed trade\-offs on service boundaries, APIs, and modularization that fit the segment's technical strategy. * Own quality: make sure the systems your teams own are maintainable, tested, secure, performant, observable, and ready to scale with our growth. Balance investment in technical health with net\-new development. * Use engineering and product metrics, including growth and engagement metrics, to measure delivered value, track team health, and drive continuous improvement. * Work with Product, Design, and Machine Learning to bridge the gap between "what's possible" with AI and "what's valuable" for owners. Stay close to customers through calls, feedback, and usage data. * Build a culture of trust, ownership, and psychological safety. Coach engineers with direct feedback, address underperformance quickly, and give emerging leaders stretch opportunities. * Champion AI\-first ways of working. Help your teams evaluate, adopt, and validate AI tooling and new patterns that improve quality and speed up delivery. * Attract top talent: assess candidates rigorously, work closely with Recruiting, and build an inclusive hiring pipeline. **You know you're the right fit if...** --------------------------------------- * You have 7\+ years of experience building and scaling web applications, preferably in SaaS, including 2\+ years directly managing software engineers. Experience leading more than one team is a strong plus. * You've led teams from early ambiguity to a successful launch. Along the way you aligned stakeholders, made tough trade\-offs, and protected long\-term system health. * You're technically credible. You can go deep on system design and code quality, and you stay close enough to the work to make good technical calls with your teams. * You've worked on growth, engagement, or workflow\-heavy product areas and know how to connect engineering work to measurable customer outcomes. * You set clear expectations, give specific and actionable feedback, and handle conflict and underperformance with empathy and accountability. * You delegate to grow others, even when you could do it faster yourself, a understand the business, not just the code. You can explain how your teams' work connects to customer outcomes and company goals. * You've built AI tooling into your own workflow and your teams'. You know how to prompt, iterate, and validate AI\-generated output, and you set the bar for doing it well. * You're pragmatic about technology. You adopt new tools where they add value, stick with proven ones when they get the job done, and push for refactoring and clean architecture where it pays off. * You balance intensity and sustainability. You'll put in the extra hour when needed, but you model healthy work\-life balance for your teams. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline. * Experience with technologies in our stack, such as Ruby on Rails, Golang, React, AWS, or service\-oriented architectures. **Notes for TA** ---------------- * **Level calibration:** Built from the Manager, Software Engineering column of the EM competency matrix. Two teams with 8–10 direct\-report engineers is still Manager scope; there are no managers reporting into this role. * **To confirm before posting:** location/remote policy, pay band (pay transparency rules apply in CA, CO, NY, WA, and others), EEO statement, and years of experience (7\+ / 2\+ is my proposal; the matrix doesn't specify). * **Candidate screening note:** Some early candidates are targeting manager\-of\-managers roles. Please screen for fit on scope early. **About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com. **Why AppFolio** **Grow** \| We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves. **Learn** \| We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best\-in\-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills. **Impact** \| We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities. **Connect** \| We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed. **Paddle as One.** Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers ***Statement of Equal Opportunity*** At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. That’s why we’re a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, and we believe that our products, our teams, and our business are stronger because of it. This means that no matter what race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by law, you’re always welcome at AppFolio. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process for a disability, pregnancy\-related condition, or religious practice, please contact us at peopleoperations@appfolio.com or (805\) 284\-0834\. You do not need to use any particular wording. Compensation Range: $167\.2K \- $229\.9K

jobs.title: Principal Electrical Systems Engineer, Packaging Operations

-------------------------------- * Own capital equipment and facilities projects end\-to\-end: concept, design, installation, commissioning, qualification, and turnover. * Produce electrical designs, specifications, scopes of work, estimates, schedules, and implementation plans that meet business, safety, operational, and regulatory needs. * Provide senior electrical engineering oversight, conduct design reviews, and mentor engineers and project managers. * Evaluate vendor/OEM electrical drawings, calculations, equipment specs, and submittals for quality, code compliance, maintainability, and Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The Rights \& Accounting fleet oversees products and optimizes workflows that enable TWDC to monetize content including content rights and avails management, content sales and content protection, content accounting, and talent payments. **Job Summary:** As a Product Software Engineer II, you will play a meaningful role working across Rights Management supply chain applications, building and supporting capabilities, and taking ownership of the technical design and implementation of medium\-sized projects and features. This position might be a great fit if you: * Are a curious and efficient engineer who wants to help shape the direction of development and collaborate closely with some of the brightest minds in our organization. * Thrive in an agile, collaborative environment where teamwork and innovation are valued. In this role, you will focus on the systems that govern and track the rights \& availability of TWDC media for use in 1st party products such as Disney\+ and 3rd party digital media sales. You will collaborate closely with multiple internal and external teams to enable robust data integration capabilities. **Responsibilities:** * Maintain a deep understanding of our core systems and how they interact with upstream and downstream dependencies. Contribute and review code, and work with engineers to ensure product and design specifications are met. * Responsible for fundamental platform performance, scalability, and resiliency. Influence and contribute to department technical strategy and planning. Research, learn, and evangelize widespread adoption of new technologies and architecture patterns * Lead cross\-functional troubleshooting of complex issues as needed. Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives **Minimum Qualifications:** 3\+ years of professional experience in a software engineering role. Proficient in Java and JVM languages, with hands\-on experience in Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Integration, and other Spring frameworks. Solid experience across the full software development lifecycle, including continuous integration, unit and integration testing, functional testing, code reviews, and documentation. Experience designing, building, and integrating APIs. Practical experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, messaging, VPC, Cloudformation/Terraform, and related infrastructure. Design and build modern, performant, responsive user interfaces using React and related technologies. Strong understanding of data integration concepts and workflows. Experience with event\-driven architecture (EDA) and publish/subscribe messaging patterns (e.g., Kafka, SNS). Experience in monitoring and maintaining application health and performance. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Voice AI [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About this role** =================== As a Research Engineer, Voice AI at Concurrence, you'll build and tune speech models for patient conversations and ambient clinical audio. You'll own models from data and training through evaluation and production, working with runtime engineers on streaming inference, latency and turn\-taking. The work includes full\-duplex speech\-to\-speech models that listen and speak at the same time, handle interruptions and preserve clinical details. **What you'll do** ================== * Train and fine\-tune speech and audio models for patient calls and clinical encounters * Own data preparation, training experiments and evaluation code * Improve streaming inference, turn\-taking and interruption handling, balancing model quality, latency and cost * Define clinical failure cases with clinicians, product and evaluation engineers, and measure the errors that matter to patients * Evaluate changes on held\-out examples, investigate regressions and carry improvements into production * Use evidence from real conversations to choose the next experiment and shape our modeling approach **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've personally trained or fine\-tuned speech or audio models on large audio datasets as a substantial part of your work * You've shipped a model into a real\-time product, with concrete results on streaming inference, latency, turn\-taking or overlapping speech * You've taken an ambiguous problem, defined a useful metric and led the work through to a model running in production * You write the training and evaluation code yourself and can explain the choices behind an experiment * You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience building or tuning a full\-duplex speech\-to\-speech model, our strongest preference * Neural audio codecs or audio language models * Telephone audio, overlapping speech or multi\-speaker audio * Model adaptation for a particular customer, domain or regulated environment **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About Allermi** ----------------- Allermi makes personalized prescription allergy treatment simple. Patients get care from licensed providers online, and treatment ships straight to their door. We're a small, fast\-moving team working across telehealth, pharmacy and e\-commerce, and data sits at the center of how we care for patients and grow. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring our first Senior Analytics Engineer to own Allermi's data foundation end to end, from raw sources to the metrics the company runs on. You'll build well\-modeled, tested data and reliable pipelines, then partner with Finance, Product, Marketing and Operations to turn it into decisions. As our first data hire, you'll cover the full stack: modeling, metric definitions and analysis, plus the ingestion and pipeline health underneath them. You'll report to our CTO and have real ownership over how data works here. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Model and define** * Design and own our data models in Databricks: a layered medallion architecture. * Define and document the core metrics the company runs on, such as active subscribers, retention cohorts, CAC and lifetime value, so every team gets the same answer. * Build the semantic layer behind our BI tool so teammates can self\-serve dashboards and natural\-language questions on trusted data. * Bring software engineering practice to analytics: version control, code review, tests and documentation for every model. **Own the pipelines** * Own ingestion into the lakehouse from our application database, Shopify, our lifecycle messaging platform and marketing sources, moving existing custom pipelines onto managed tooling. * Monitor freshness, completeness and data quality, and catch problems before stakeholders do. * Protect patient data: set access controls, build de\-identified datasets, and handle sensitive fields to HIPAA standards. * Work with Product to improve event tracking and connect the customer journey from first visit to subscription. **Turn data into decisions** * Partner with Finance, Product and Marketing on A/B test readouts, funnel analysis and cohort analysis. * Go beyond reporting with forecasting, churn\-risk signals and opportunity sizing. **What you bring** ------------------ * 4\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering or a closely related role, including owning production data models end to end. * Expert SQL (Python a plus). * Deep experience with dbt or a similar modeling framework, on Databricks or another lakehouse or warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery). * You've built a semantic layer or metric definitions that business teams trust (dbt Semantic Layer, Unity Catalog metric views, LookML or similar). * Hands\-on experience with ingestion and orchestration (Fivetran, Lakeflow, Airflow or similar). * Experience handling sensitive data, such as health or financial data, with appropriate access controls. * You turn vague business questions into clear definitions and explain results to non\-technical partners. * You work independently and set direction without a data team around you. * Based in the US. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Subscription or direct\-to\-consumer e\-commerce data: Shopify, retention, CAC and LTV. * Healthcare, telehealth or pharmacy data. * Experience with Hex, Iterable, Mixpanel or Amplitude. * Forecasting or predictive modeling. * Experience as the first or only data person at an early\-stage company. **Why join** ------------ * Shape the data function from the ground up, with direct impact on patient care and company growth. * Work closely with leadership on the questions that shape the business. * Fully remote within the US. **Compensation** ---------------- USD 130,000–160,000 per year

jobs.title: Senior Automation Test Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Test Engineer with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience to lead the design, development, and execution of automated testing strategies for our complex, distributed enterprise systems, APIs, and data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring high quality, reliability, and performance across post\-trade processing, message\-driven microservices, ETL workloads, and front\-end user interfaces. The ideal candidate possesses deep hands\-on expertise in building scalable test frameworks, validating end\-to\-end data flows, and embedding automated test solutions directly into CI/CD pipelines. **Key Responsibilities** · **Test Framework Design \& Development:** Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable automated test frameworks and test suites for functional, integration, API, regression, and performance testing. · **API \& Microservices Validation:** Execute comprehensive testing of REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging\-based integrations in event\-driven, microservices\-based architectures. · **Data Movement \& ETL Testing:** Validate data movement, complex transformations, reconciliations, and end\-to\-end workflows across distributed applications, data warehouses, and reporting solutions. · **Database \& SQL Verification:** Utilize strong SQL queries to inspect, validate, and verify transactional data across relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server). · **CI/CD \& DevOps Integration:** Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing, rapid release cycles, and DevOps best practices. · **Performance \& Observability:** Conduct performance, load, and reliability testing, leveraging monitoring tools to identify system bottlenecks and ensure high availability. · **Defect Lifecycle \& Collaboration:** Manage defects, test runs, and coverage tracking in tools like PractiTest or Jira/Xray, collaborating closely with developers, business analysts, and DevOps teams. · **Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis:** Analyze test failures, troubleshoot complex issues across applications, services, integrations, and data pipelines, and drive sustainable root\-cause resolution. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** · **Professional Experience:** Minimum of 7 years of professional experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications. · **Automation Frameworks \& Tools:** Proficiency with modern testing tools and frameworks such as Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, Power Automate, Rest Assured, Postman, or equivalent technologies. · **Programming Languages:** Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, and/or Python with proven ability to build automated test solutions. · **Architecture \& API Testing:** Hands\-on experience testing microservices\-based architectures, event\-driven systems, REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging integrations. · **Data \& ETL Validation:** Experience validating data movement, transformations, reconciliations, and end\-to\-end workflows; hands\-on experience testing ETL/data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting tools. · **Relational Databases \& SQL:** Strong SQL skills with hands\-on experience validating data in relational databases such as PostgreSQL and SQL Server. · **Messaging \& Event Streaming:** Experience working with message queues and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, or similar technologies. · **Front\-End Automation \& Web UI:** Exposure to modern front\-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular) and UI test automation. · **SDLC \& DevOps Integration:** Proficiency in SDLC, DevOps (CI/CD), and Agile methodologies, with demonstrable experience embedding automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. · **Test Management Tools:** Experience with test management and defect tracking platforms such as PractiTest, Jira, Xray, Zephyr, or similar tools. · **Performance \& Reliability Testing:** Familiarity with performance, load, and stress testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or equivalent solutions. · **Monitoring \& Observability:** Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk. · **Problem Solving \& Troubleshooting:** Excellent problem\-solving skills and proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across multi\-tier applications, integrations, and data pipelines. **Preferred \& Desirable Qualifications** · **Financial Domain Knowledge:** Understanding of trade lifecycle workflows and post\-trade processes across asset classes including equities, bonds, options, and futures is highly desirable. · **Containerization \& Cloud Expertise:** Working knowledge of containerization and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes); AWS experience and strong Kubernetes expertise are major pluses. Pay: $50\.35 \- $60\.64 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in Charlotte, NC 28216

In this role, you will be responsible for modeling complex financial data structures, implementing scalable ETL/ELT workflows using Python and SQL, managing large\-scale transactional and analytical platforms, and ensuring rigorous data quality, lineage, and compliance across downstream reporting, risk, finance, and settlement platforms. **Key Responsibilities** · **Pipeline Design \& Engineering:** Design, develop, and maintain high\-throughput batch and streaming data pipelines (ETL/ELT workflows) utilizing Python, SQL, Spark, and streaming platforms. · **Post\-Trade \& Financial Data Management:** Process and integrate post\-trade data flows including trade allocations, confirmations, settlement, risk management, finance, and regulatory reporting. · **Data Modeling \& Architecture:** Design and optimize relational data models, database schemas, security master structures, reference data models, and time\-series financial datasets. · **Platform \& Cloud Warehousing:** Implement and manage scalable data repositories across Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, and Data Lakehouses using cloud platforms (preferably AWS, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks). · **Data Governance \& Reconciliation:** Establish comprehensive data quality rules, data lineage, automated validation checks, and reconciliation processes across complex data flows. · **Event Streaming \& jobs.title: Software Engineer, Voice Evaluation [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About this role** =================== As a Software Engineer, Voice Evaluation at Concurrence, you'll build the system that determines whether a voice agent is ready for patients. You'll own realistic audio tests, scoring and the release gate, with authority to block releases that fail it. The tests need to catch failures that a clean transcript can miss, from mishandled interruptions to missed clinical information or a failure to hand off to a person. **What you'll do** ================== * Build simulated callers and call\-replay tests that exercise the production voice path with real audio * Test phone trees, hold queues, interruptions, conflicting clinical information and appropriate escalation * Build scoring systems and calibrate automated judges against human assessments * Measure clinical failure rates and uncertainty, and test whether simulation results predict behavior on real calls * Define release criteria with model, runtime, product and clinical colleagues, own the gate and block changes that fail those criteria * Turn production failures into regression tests, verify fixes and monitor behavior after release * Maintain held\-out evaluation sets so models are tested on examples they did not train against **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've personally built and owned evaluation or simulation for production agents at scale. Voice and audio experience is a strong preference * You've built agent simulations or replay systems, implemented scoring and caught a concrete failure before release * Your evaluation results determined what shipped, and you led that work * You can explain what a score captures, what it misses and how you checked it against real behavior * You write reliable software that runs at volume and follow failures through to a verified fix * You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output * You're low ego, direct, and can hold the line on release criteria with evidence * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience calibrating automated judges against human labels * Load testing and concurrent calls using audio * Speech or audio machine learning * Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K
