jobs.title: Staff Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** We are seeking a Staff Agentic AI Engineer to lead our agentic AI engineering team: setting technical direction, driving delivery, and turning fast\-moving model and orchestration capabilities into secure, reusable, observable production systems. You will be the team's technical lead. You will own the architecture of our agent platform, define how the team builds and operates agents, and make sure the work ships reliably within enterprise controls. You will stay hands\-on in the most critical architectural and engineering work while guiding Senior engineers, shaping the roadmap with engineering and product leadership, and partnering with data, security, and operations to deliver measurable business outcomes. **WHAT YOU'LL** **DO** * **Team technical leadership:** Act as the technical lead for the agentic AI engineering team. Set the technical roadmap with engineering and product leadership, break large initiatives into well\-scoped work, assign clear ownership, and hold the team accountable for quality and delivery. * **Architecture and platform strategy:** Define the target architecture, technical principles, and evolution plan for the agent platform. Make clear build\-versus\-integrate decisions and guide migration from prototypes to supported services. * **Multi\-agent systems:** Design orchestration patterns for single\- and multi\-agent workflows, including delegation, planning, state, handoffs, tool use, human review, retries, and bounded autonomy. Address coordination, latency, failure containment, and cost. * **Reusable platform capabilities:** Build and guide shared services and SDKs for agent lifecycle management, workflow execution, tool and connector registration, identity propagation, prompt and policy management, model access, tracing, evaluation, and release controls. * **Interoperability:** Establish practical patterns for MCP and A2A interoperability, including capability discovery, tool contracts, authentication, authorization, versioning, provenance, and safe exchange across internal and external systems. * **LLM engineering:** Guide model selection and routing, structured generation, retrieval and grounding, context engineering, prompt lifecycle, fine\-tuning where appropriate, and systematic evaluation. Keep the platform adaptable as models and techniques change. * **Security, governance, and responsible use:** Partner with security, privacy, legal, and risk teams to embed least privilege, tenant isolation, data protection, auditability, policy enforcement, human oversight, and misuse controls into platform defaults. * **Production reliability:** Set the team's standards for service\-level objectives, observability, incident response, fallback behavior, capacity, disaster recovery, regression testing, and safe rollout. Use production evidence to improve quality and resilience. * **Engineering standards and reviews:** Lead architecture and design reviews, write concise decision records, own the team's coding and review standards, and resolve technical dependencies with adjacent teams. * **Mentorship and team growth:** Coach Senior and mid\-level engineers, raise the quality of design and code reviews, take part in hiring and onboarding, and build a culture of measured experimentation and operational accountability. * **Outcomes and adoption:** Work with product and business partners to define baselines and success measures. Track adoption, workflow completion, quality, latency, cost, reliability, and risk, then prioritize the team's work based on evidence. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **YOUR LOCATION** This is a fully remote role, with the exception of onboarding and optional in\-office events. **SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** * Typically 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial work on distributed services, APIs, event\-driven workflows, and cloud\-native platforms. * Demonstrated experience as the technical lead of an engineering team: setting direction, breaking down work, unblocking engineers, and owning delivery outcomes. * Deep hands\-on experience building and operating LLM\-based applications and agentic systems in production, including tool use, orchestration, retrieval or grounding, evaluation, and monitoring. * Strong engineering skills in Python and at least one other production language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, or Kotlin, with sound practices for testing, deployment, and operations. * Experience designing secure systems involving sensitive data, identity and access management, audit trails, threat modeling, and applicable governance requirements. * Ability to communicate complex trade\-offs clearly and influence engineering, product, security, and business stakeholders. * A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards through reviews, design guidance, and shared technical practices. * Experience building an internal developer platform, AI platform, workflow engine, or reusable product infrastructure adopted by multiple teams (preferred) * Practical experience with MCP servers/clients, A2A protocols, agent frameworks such as LangGraph, and integration patterns for enterprise systems (preferred) * Experience with model gateways, vector or hybrid search, data/ML platforms, evaluation harnesses, and LLM observability tooling such as LangSmith (preferred) * Experience operating systems in regulated or high\-trust environments, including privacy, retention, model risk, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls (preferred) * Experience defining platform economics and optimizing inference cost, latency, quality, and capacity at scale (preferred) * Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another domain with complex workflows and compliance requirements (preferred) **Physical Requirements** * Must be able to sit/stand/walk for prolonged periods of time (up to 8 hours per day), at a desk working on a computer. * Must be able to use standard office equipment for extended periods of time, including but not limited to, a mouse, keyboard, phone and video conferencing. * Must be able to travel to the Bold Penguin office in Dublin, Ohio for New Hire Onboarding \& Orientation (2 days, 2 nights); travel costs are covered by Bold Penguin. * Must be able to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for corporate events and team planning sessions. Bold Penguin is the premier digital broker for commercial insurance. Their technology expands top\-of\-funnel demand and increases yield for enterprise partners. Through digital distribution, wholesale capabilities, and AI\-driven insights, they transform the lifecycle of both simple and complex risks, from prospecting to placement. **Benefits** We offer competitive compensation and progressive benefits that include: * Medical, Dental, and Vision * Flexible PTO Policy * 401(k) with a company match * Employee Assistance Program * Parental Leave * Disability and Life Benefits **Stay connected to the Glacier.** We have great SLACK channels for work and play. We also like to video conference and hold all\-hands "Waddles" regularly. **Penguin bling.** Like swag themed after a certain Antarctic bird? Just. You. Wait. Bold Penguin believes in inclusion. To learn more about our results\-focused culture and employee\-focused perks, read more on our **careers page**.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day\-to\-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top\-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com. As a Senior Backend Engineer you will design, build, and scale the backend systems that enable remote operators to monitor, support, and interact with our autonomous ground support equipment (AGSE) operating in live airport environments. As our autonomous fleet expands across airports, remote assistance becomes a critical component of safe and reliable operations. You'll build the services that connect autonomous vehicles with remote operators, enabling real\-time communication, vehicle monitoring, assistance requests, and operational decision\-making. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time communication, and autonomous vehicle operations. You'll work closely with autonomy, platform, infrastructure, and operations teams to develop reliable, low\-latency backend services that support an increasingly large fleet of autonomous vehicles. You'll have significant ownership over system architecture, reliability, and scalability, building production systems where performance and availability directly impact real\-world operations. **You Will** ------------ * Design, develop, and maintain backend services powering AeroVect's remote assistance platform for autonomous vehicle operations. * Build reliable, low\-latency communication systems between autonomous vehicles, cloud infrastructure, and remote operators. * Develop APIs and cloud backend services that enable vehicle monitoring, remote assistance requests, operator interactions, and fleet coordination. * Design and implement real\-time data streaming and cloud event\-driven architectures to support vehicle state updates, telemetry, and operational events. * Build scalable systems to manage remote assistance sessions, including request routing, operator assignment, session state, and lifecycle management. * Ensure backend systems are resilient to network interruptions, latency, and intermittent connectivity in real\-world airport environments. * Develop robust mechanisms for authentication, authorization, auditing, and secure communication between vehicles and remote operators. * Build monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities to identify issues and maintain high system reliability. * Collaborate with autonomy and platform engineers to integrate remote assistance capabilities with vehicle software and fleet management systems. * Optimize backend performance, scalability, and fault tolerance as the number of deployed vehicles and remote assistance sessions increases. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of backend services, from system design and implementation through deployment, testing, and production support. **You have** ------------ * 5\+ years of experience in backend software engineering, with a strong track record of designing and operating production\-grade distributed systems. * Strong programming experience in Python, Go, C\+\+, or similar backend languages. * Experience designing and building scalable backend services, APIs, and microservices architectures. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous processing, and fault\-tolerant architectures. * Experience with real\-time communication technologies such as WebSockets, gRPC, or similar protocols. * Hands\-on experience with message brokers and event\-driven systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or equivalent technologies. * Experience building and deploying cloud\-native applications, preferably on AWS. * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, HTTP, connection management, and latency optimization. * Experience designing systems for high availability, observability, and production reliability. * Ability to independently own complex technical projects and make sound architectural decisions in an evolving environment. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating across software, infrastructure, and product teams. **We Prefer** ------------- * Experience building backend systems for autonomous vehicles, robotics, teleoperations, or remote assistance platforms. * Experience working with vehicle telemetry, fleet management, or real\-time operational monitoring systems. * Knowledge of video streaming technologies such as WebRTC, RTSP, or other low\-latency media protocols. * Experience developing systems that operate across unreliable or bandwidth\-constrained networks. * Familiarity with safety\-critical systems, operational safeguards, and secure remote interactions with physical devices. * Experience with edge\-to\-cloud communication architectures. * Experience building dispatching, scheduling, or resource allocation systems. * Previous experience in a fast\-paced startup environment, building products and infrastructure from the ground up.

technologies. * Develop systems to move data reliably from edge devices and on\-premise infrastructure into cloud\-based storage and processing environments. * Design and maintain data models, In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of the planning stack — owning the design and implementation of production\-grade mission planning, behavior planning, and motion planning software. You'll work across the full planning pipeline to achieve category\-defining vehicle autonomy for the airside, tackling hard problems in trajectory optimization, decision\-making under uncertainty, and real\-time constraint optimization. This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market\-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics\-as\-a\-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team. You Will: * Design, implement, and iterate on the mission planner, behavior planner, and motion planner for autonomous ground support equipment operating in airport airside environments. * Drive key technical decisions across the planning stack — selecting algorithms, defining interfaces, and establishing the architecture that the team builds on. * Prototype and evaluate new planning approaches (e.g., optimization\-based methods, search\-based planners, learning\-augmented pipelines) and bring the best ideas to production. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with perception, controls, localization, and systems engineering teams to deliver an integrated autonomous driving system. * Establish and promote best practices in software development, functional safety, and systems engineering as they apply to the planning domain. * Mentor other engineers through technical guidance, code review, and design discussions. You Have: * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Math, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or a related field. * Extensive hands\-on experience designing and implementing planning modules for autonomous systems shipped to production or deployed in real\-world operations. * Strong programming skills in C\+\+ (preferred) or Python, and experience with Linux\-based operating systems. * Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous technical problems and drive them to well\-architected solutions independently. * Excellent communication skills, proactiveness, and a strong sense of ownership. We Prefer: * MS or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * Mastery of Modern C\+\+ (14 and beyond) and safety\-critical coding practices (e.g., MISRA, ISO 26262\). * 5\+ years of industry experience in planning for robotic ground vehicles. * In\-depth understanding of DDS frameworks like ROS/ROS2 or other networking middleware. * Experience in startup environments, demonstrating adaptability to rapidly changing priorities. Compensation Range: $180K \- $220K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day\-to\-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top\-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com. **Software Engineer, Simulation** --------------------------------- You will own and extend our simulation: the simulator itself, how it connects to the autonomy stack, the models of the tractor and of the aircraft, people, and vehicles around it, and the scenarios we run. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build and extend the simulator and its integration with the production autonomy stack. * Model vehicle dynamics, actor behavior, and sensors so that the stack behaves in simulation as it does on the road. * Find where simulated and real inputs differ enough to change the stack's behavior, and close those gaps. * Bring field data into simulation: replay real\-world recordings through the stack, and rebuild field events as scenarios. * Grow scenario generation and the authoring tools, across backend and frontend, and extend coverage to new maps and sites. * Run simulation at scale in the cloud: orchestration, parallel execution, artifacts, and cost. * Build the evaluation that turns a run into a pass/fail result, and the triage tools that autonomy engineers use on their own. * Keep the simulation deterministic, reproducible, and fast as the number of scenarios grows. **What you'll need** -------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in simulation work for autonomous vehicles, robotics, or aerospace * Strong Python, with a track record of maintainable code in a shared codebase * Experience with a simulator such as CARLA, Applied Intuition, Foretellix, NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or an in\-house platform * Understanding of simulation and modeling methodology: vehicle and actor models, fidelity, and how simulated results support claims about real\-world behavior * Docker, Linux, and distributed\-systems fundamentals, with experience running GPU\-based simulation * Experience running simulation at scale in the cloud and in CI * Experience debugging and profiling distributed, GPU\-bound systems, and finding bottlenecks and failure modes in simulation output and telemetry * Git and code review experience * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * 6\+ years building simulation for autonomous vehicles, robotics, or aerospace * Experience with ROS 2 or other autonomous vehicle software stacks * Vehicle dynamics or actor behavior modeling * Sensor modeling (camera, lidar, radar), environment generation, or perception ground\-truth pipelines * Unreal Engine or other game engines * Log replay and reconstruction of scenarios from real\-world recordings * Large\-scale cloud simulation infrastructure * Determinism and reproducibility work in simulators, including golden\-output comparison * Safety\-critical systems in autonomous driving, aerospace, or robotics * Safety standards: ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), UL 4600, ISO 13849 **Leveling** ------------ We hire remotely from Europe and North America at two levels and set the level from the interviews, based on demonstrated depth rather than years. Mid level (typically 3\-6 years): you own defined parts of the simulation end to end, ship them tested and documented, and make routine design decisions on your own. Senior level (typically 6\+ years): you own the roadmap for an area, such as scenario expansion or cloud execution. You find problems in how we build and use the simulation, not only in the code, and you mentor other engineers. Compensation Range: $110K \- $170K

jobs.title: Systems Engineering Lead, Genomics Instrumentation
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **About the Role** ================== Agilent is a global leader in life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets. Our genomics organization develops **innovative technologies** that enable the manufacture of **complex DNA\-based products**. We are seeking an experienced **Systems Engineering Lead** to provide **technical leadership for the development and continued evolution of advanced instrumentation used in genomics** manufacturing. Our systems bring together multiple engineering disciplines, including precision mechatronics, fluidics, electronics, automation, environmental controls, and complex instrument\-control software that integrates and orchestrates the overall system. The performance of these systems depends not only on individual components, but also on the complex interactions between hardware, software, process, and chemistry. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with broad systems thinking and a hands\-on approach to engineering. We are particularly interested in engineers who have **lived the full technology\-development lifecycle, from development and system integration through technology transfer, manufacturing launch, and sustained production**. The ideal candidate understands what it takes to transform innovative R\&D technology into robust, reliable systems that succeed in real\-world manufacturing environments. **Why This Role** ================= This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible technical leadership role at the intersection of advanced engineering, life science, and manufacturing. You will remain close to the technology and hands\-on problem solving while having broad influence over system design, software, integration, and future technical direction. For an engineer who enjoys **building new technology and making it work in the real world**, this role offers the opportunity to: * Provide **broad technical leadership** while remaining hands\-on with challenging engineering problems. * **Work across** hardware, software, automation, process, and scientific disciplines. * **Own and evolve critical instrument\-control software** as an integral part of the overall system. * Help **bring innovative R\&D technology into manufacturing** and shape the continued evolution of the platform. * **Mentor technical contributors** and build engineering capability across the organization. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Provide senior technical leadership for complex, multidisciplinary instrumentation and automation systems.** * Guide system architecture, integration, technical trade\-offs, and design decisions across hardware, software, controls, and process. * **Own the technical direction of instrument\-control software, including architecture, development, integration, reliability, and continued evolution.** * Lead the investigation and resolution of complex system\-level problems that span multiple engineering disciplines. * Work closely with mechanical, electrical, software, process\-development, and scientific teams to translate application and process needs into effective engineering solutions. * Lead with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, suppliers, and external development partners through production launch and stabilization. * Thoughtfully leverage AI\-enabled tools and emerging technologies to accelerate engineering analysis, problem solving, knowledge development, and team effectiveness. * Mentor engineers and scientists and communicate complex technical issues, trade\-offs, and recommendations effectively across technical teams and senior leadership. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Qualifications** ================== * Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. * Typically **10\+ years of demonstrated experience developing complex instrumentation,** automation, manufacturing equipment, or multidisciplinary engineered systems. * Demonstrated technical depth in one or more engineering disciplines with the ability to work effectively across multiple technical areas. * **Demonstrated experience developing, architecting, or providing technical leadership for software used to control complex instruments or physical systems.** * Significant experience integrating hardware, software, controls, and physical processes. * Strong hands\-on experience with system integration, debugging, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis. * Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems that cross traditional subsystem or discipline boundaries. * Experience providing technical leadership for multidisciplinary engineering programs and influencing decisions across organizational bo ence supporting manufacturing launch and ramp and using production experience to improve equipment reliability, robustness, serviceability, and performance. * Experience with complex scientific instrumentation, precision automation, or other multidisciplinary equipment. * Experience with one or more areas such as precision motion, fluidics, machine vision, environmental control, embedded systems, or automation. * Software development experience for complex instrument or machine control using C\# or comparable object\-oriented development environments * Experience in the creation and use of instrument telemetry data, test scripts, and common data\-analysis tools to characterize and troubleshoot instrument behavior. * Experience working with external engineering partners, equipment developers, or technology suppliers. * Experience in life sciences, analytical instrumentation, semiconductor equipment, precision manufacturing, or another complex technical environment. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== The ideal candidate is a **broad systems thinker with deep technical expertise** who is equally comfortable setting technical direction and working hands\-on to solve difficult engineering problems. You understand software as an integral part of how complex instrumentation interacts with the physical world and delivers reliable performance. You are energized by multidisciplinary challenges, enjoy developing other technical contributors, and **thoughtfully adopt emerging tools, including AI, to make yourself and the broader team more effective.** In this role, you will have the opportunity to become a recognized technical authority, **take ownership of business\-critical technology and integrated system behavior**, and shape the continued evolution of the platform. **Additional Details** This job has a full time weekly schedule. Read our operating principles to see it in full. **How you'll make impact** -------------------------- Airwallex is evolving its data and AI platforms into an agent\-ready foundation for company\-wide decision\-making and measurable business impact. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll shape the architecture and technical direction that makes this possible. * Own the strategy, architecture, development, and operation of Airwallex's data and AI platforms, turning data and AI capabilities into measurable business impact. * Identify and solve company\-wide challenges through scalable data platform solutions, influencing technical direction across multiple teams. * Shape the evolution of our data ecosystem into AI agent\-ready infrastructure that supports real\-time performance, analytics, natural\-language querying, and data\-driven decision\-making. * Raise the bar for technical excellence across data platforms by solving complex problems hands\-on, advocating for strong engineering practices, and mentoring engineers and technical leaders. You'll work from our Seattle/San Francisco office three days a week. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- ### **Essentials** * 8\+ years of experience in data platforms or an equivalent combination of professional experience and academic exposure in a quantitative field. * Experience leading company\-wide initiatives across multiple teams or influencing technical roadmap planning. * A track record of collaborating with diverse teams and stakeholders to drive tangible business outcomes. * The ability to balance execution and velocity with in\-depth research, statistical understanding, and scalable system design. * Experience mentoring and investing in the development of scientists, engineers, and peers. * Technical leadership experience across significant data platform projects, including ETL frameworks, metrics stores, infrastructure management, and data security. * Experience building, deploying, and maintaining reliable data pipelines across multiple geographies and at scale. * Familiarity with workflow or orchestration frameworks such as Airflow and dbt. ### **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience designing data processing patterns for a modern lakehouse architecture. * Experience designing and developing standard framework modules, high\-performance services, and client libraries for big data. * Experience with technologies such as GCP, Databricks, BigQuery, Dataproc, Kafka, Kubernetes, Spark, Dataflow, Google Cloud Storage, and Airflow. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor communication for leadership, users, and company\-wide audiences. * Ability to rapidly evaluate technologies and run proofs of concept to inform architecture decisions. * Experience thriving in a complex environment. **You'll thrive here if** ------------------------- * You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. * You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. * You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. * You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability. * You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. **Learn more about your team** ------------------------------ The Knowledge Platform sits at the foundation of Airwallex’s Data and AI strategy. We are evolving traditional data infrastructure into knowledge infrastructure—turning structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable context that helps people and AI systems make better decisions and take action. You’ll build the platform end to end, from core technologies such as Databricks, Clickhouse, Spark, and Kafka to real\-time analytics, knowledge retrieval and indexing, model infrastructure, agent capabilities, and AI interaction history. You’ll also develop the evaluation, annotation, feedback, governance, permission, and freshness frameworks required to operate AI reliably at global financial scale. Our mission is making this ecosystem truly agent\-ready. That means enabling teams to explore data through natural language, investigate business drivers in real time, and give AI systems secure access to the context and capabilities they need to support decisions and execute workflows. If you want to build the foundation that turns Airwallex’s data into knowledge, knowledge into intelligence, and intelligence into measurable business impact, this is where that work happens. **Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------- *To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.* *Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI & Automation
jobs.description: Since 2010, Aladdin has supported transportation businesses across North America with financing and services. We're growing, modernizing our technology, and investing heavily in AI and automation to build better software, improve business processes, and move faster. We're looking for an experienced developer who is excited about what AI makes possible and is already using it to build real solutions. This isn't a traditional development position. We want someone who can help us rethink how software gets built, take ownership of meaningful projects, and help our entire Technology team become more effective. **Location:** This is an on\-site position based in Sioux Falls, SD. Local candidates are preferred, but we're open to candidates willing to relocate for the right opportunity. **What You'll Do** * Build and enhance internal applications, customer\-facing platforms, and business automation using **Python/Django, .NET/C\#, SQL, and modern web technologies**. * Use **AI\-assisted development tools** such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar tools as part of your everyday workflow. * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive business processes, integrations, testing, and development tasks. * Build reliable integrations with third\-party APIs, internal systems, and cloud services. * Help establish better AI development practices, including reusable instructions, documentation, automated testing, and code reviews. * Work closely with other developers, sharing techniques and helping the team adopt more efficient development approaches. * Take projects from concept to working software, balancing speed with security, reliability, and maintainability. * Explore emerging AI capabilities, including agents and workflow automation, and apply them where they provide real business value. **What Makes You a Fit** * **4\+ years of professional software development experience**, or equivalent demonstrated ability. * Strong programming fundamentals and experience delivering production applications. * **Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools to build, debug, test, or maintain real software.** We want to hear what you've built and how AI changed your workflow. * Experience with Python, C\#, TypeScript, or similar languages. You don't need to know every language we use. * Strong SQL fundamentals and experience working with relational databases. * Comfortable working with APIs, Git, CI/CD, and cloud\-based applications. * Understands that AI\-generated code still needs testing, security review, and sound engineering judgment. * Willing to experiment, learn quickly, and challenge traditional development approaches when there's a better way. * Able to communicate clearly, collaborate, and help others grow. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Azure, Azure SQL, Azure DevOps, or Microsoft Entra. * Experience building AI agents, tool integrations, or automated workflows. * Familiarity with Django, Angular, .NET, or enterprise application development. * Experience with automated testing and deployment pipelines. * Experience mentoring developers or introducing new tools and practices to a team. **How You Work** * **AI\-first mindset:** You naturally look for ways to use AI and automation to work smarter. * **Curious:** You experiment with new tools and continuously improve your skills. * **Results\-driven:** You care more about delivering working solutions than writing code for the sake of writing code. * **Collaborative:** You share what you learn, communicate progress, and help teammates succeed. * **Pragmatic:** You move quickly without sacrificing security, quality, or maintainability. * **Ownership mindset:** You identify problems, propose solutions, and follow through. **Why Work for Aladdin?** * **Opportunity:** Help shape how AI and automation are used across a growing company. * **Impact:** Work directly on applications and systems that support real business operations. * **Environment:** Join a tight\-knit team with the flexibility to explore new technologies and approaches. * **Stability:** Consistent growth since 2010\. * **Culture:** Work hard, play harder, family\-first culture. Be proud of where you work and who you work with. * **Perks:** Snacks, drinks, Great Shots pass, and Premier Center box seats. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, vision, life, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Health Savings Account * 401(k) with employer match * PTO and 6 paid holidays * Ongoing technical training and professional development **Interested?** We'd especially like to hear about something you've built using AI\-assisted development. Tell us what tools you used, what you built, and how you approached testing and delivering the final solution. A GitHub project, demo, or real\-world example is a plus. We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to keep up with where software development is going, but wants to help lead the way. \#hc273656

jobs.title: Senior Detection Engineer - Cloud
jobs.description: At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. **Job Description** The Senior Detection Content Engineer (Cloud) is the technical authority for cloud detection content in Detection and Response Engineering. You own coverage of attacks against Azure and AWS control planes, containers and Kubernetes, and cloud\-hosted AI services, using industry leading Cloud Detection and Response Platforms. You turn posture findings and control plane logs into detections of real attacker behavior, including lateral movement using cloud identities and abuse of LLM APIs. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Detection Engineering Manager.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own cloud coverage strategy against Allstate's threat profile, with emphasis on control plane abuse, privilege escalation through roles and policies, persistence via access keys and service principals, and data access from storage. * Design detections across industry standard sources, including but not limited to Azure Activity, AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Kubernetes audit logs. * Build detections for emerging cloud and AI risks: LLM abuse via API, shadow AI usage and prompt or key misuse in AI services. * Maintain cloud Knowledge Objects that feed downstream detections, enrichments and contextualization: account and subscription inventories, sanctioned service lists, privileged role watchlists and cloud investigation context files. * Work with Automation Engineers on key revocation, role removal and workload isolation workflows. * Drive cloud logging requirements (for example data events, Kubernetes audit levels) with Pipeline Engineers and cloud platform owners. * Assist in driving the Detection Standard for the Cloud domain: reusable detection patterns, templates and the Definition of Done, consistent with the team\-wide standard. * Set tuning standards, fidelity thresholds and suppression governance for domain content. Approve tuning and redesign recommendations. * Run the lifecycle review for domain content and present retirement recommendations, confirming no coverage gap is created. * Own and develop the Cloud domain's agentic content development workflow (context files, skills and agents), with human review before anything reaches production. * Final technical reviewer for high and critical severity Cloud domain content. Coach and develop Junior and Mid\-Level engineers, and act as secondary Subject Matter Expert (SME) cover for at least one other domain. **Key Requirements** -------------------- * 7\+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, SOC or incident response, with at least 2 years at a senior or lead level. * Significant experience using industry standard querying languages, such as Kusto Query Language (KQL) and CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL). * Experience using Microsoft Security Suite, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, and E5 Logging Sources. * Proven delivery of detection\-as\-code in Git (branching, pull requests, CI/CD). * Deep hands\-on knowledge of Azure and AWS logging (eg; Azure Activity, Entra workload identities, CloudTrail, GuardDuty) and the IAM models behind them. * Strong understanding of cloud attack techniques (MITRE ATT\&CK cloud matrices) and container / Kubernetes attack paths. * Experience turning CNAPP or CSPM findings (eg; Wiz, Prisma Cloud or MDC) into actionable detections. **Desired Qualifications** -------------------------- * Cloud security certifications (e.g.; GIAC GCTD, Microsoft SC\-200, SC\-500, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty) or cloud engineering background. * Detection of AI and LLM service abuse. * Infrastructure as code awareness (Terraform, Bicep) for spotting risky changes. * GCP logging and detection experience. * Built agentic workflows with human\-in\-the\-loop controls for security content. * Hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar), including writing custom context, skills or prompts. * Experience writing investigation context for AI SOC agents. * Experience in a large, regulated enterprise (financial services or insurance). \#LI\-JJ1 **Skills** Artificial Intelligence (AI), CI/CD, Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP), Cloud Security, Cyber Incident Response, Kubernetes, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Large Language Models (LLMs), Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Defender, MITRE ATT\&CK Framework, Security Engineering, Security Operations, Threat Detection**Compensation** Compensation offered for this role ranges from $100,000 – 195,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications. The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation. **Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.** Allstate generally does not sponsor individuals for employment\-based visas for this position. Effective July 1, 2014, under Indiana House Enrolled Act (HEA) 1242, it is against public policy of the State of Indiana and a discriminatory practice for an employer to discriminate against a prospective employee on the basis of status as a veteran by refusing to employ an applicant on the basis that they are a veteran of the armed forces of the United States, a member of the Indiana National Guard or a member of a reserve component. For jobs in Los Angeles, please click “here” for information regarding the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. To view the “EEO Know Your Rights” poster click “here”. This poster provides information concerning the laws and procedures for filing complaints of violations of the laws with the Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs. To view the FMLA poster, click “here”. This poster summarizing the major provisions of the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and telling employees how to file a complaint. It is the Company’s policy to employ the best qualified individuals available for all jobs. Therefore, any discriminatory action taken on account of an employee’s ancestry, age, color, disability, genetic information, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual and reproductive health decision, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, race (include traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles), religion (including religious dress), sex, or sexual orientation that adversely affects an employee's terms or conditions of employment is prohibited. This policy applies to all aspects of the employment relationship, including, but not limited to, hiring, training, salary administration, promotion, job assignment, benefits, discipline, and separation of employment. jobs.title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Ally and Your Career** Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do \- and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people \- with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work\-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too? **Work Schedule** **:** Ally designates roles as (1\) fully on\-site, (2\) hybrid, or (3\) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need. **The Opportunity** As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) within Ally's Production Engineering/Operations organization, you will be responsible for maintaining the health of our applications in production. This includes designing technology approaches that modernize our application stack and enabling our Agile teams to deliver with quality and speed. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, especially the benefits and opportunities that cloud infrastructure brings to an enterprise. In this role, you will provide in\-depth technical expertise on decisions related to running complex software systems at scale. You will partner with our Enterprise Architecture and Infrastructure teams to enable flexible application patterns driven by business use cases. Most importantly, you will be an integral part of Ally's technology strategy, partnering closely with our Application Product teams to translate business requirements into scalable, flexible, and secure cloud solutions. **The Work Itself** **The Work Itself:** * Provide technical guidance across development, delivery, production support, and application modernization. * Partner with product and engineering teams to influence architecture, cloud migration, Agile practices, and technology roadmaps. * Build automation to streamline provisioning, deployment, recovery, remediation, and operational support. * Establish and manage SLIs/SLOs, observability, monitoring, and service health to improve application reliability. * Strengthen resiliency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and release readiness, including resiliency and chaos testing. * Support incident response and post\-mortems, translating findings into engineering improvements that reduce recurring issues and recovery time. * Conduct capacity planning and resource optimization to support performance and growth. * Communicate technical recommendations to senior leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders. **The Qualifications We’re Looking For** ---------------------------------------- * 3\+ years of software development experience * Experience with monitoring, alerting, performance analysis, and reliability, including SLI/SLO/SLA development. * Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, microservices, and cybersecurity best practices. * Hands\-on development experience with Java/J2EE, JavaScript, Spring/Spring Boot, React, REST APIs, Python, Shell scripting, PL/SQL, Oracle, and Windows/Linux. * AWS/cloud experience or certification, including services such as Fargate, Lambda, Aurora, DynamoDB, ALB/NLB, and Auto Scaling. * DevOps and automation experience with Terraform, Jenkins, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, and Ansible. * Experience with observability tools such as Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana. * Experience working across Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and Waterfall environments. **Minimum Qualifications** * 3\+ years of relevant experience * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Engineering, or related field of study or equivalent **How We'll Have Your Back** Ally's compensation program offers market\-competitive base pay and pay\-for\-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. Our Total Rewards program includes industry\-leading compensation and benefits plus additional incentives that are designed to meet your needs and those of your family so you can get the most out of your career and your life, including: **Time Away:** Program starts at 20 paid time off days in addition to 11 paid holidays and 8 hours of volunteer time off yearly (time off days are prorated based on start date and program varies based on full or part\-time status and management level). **Planning for the Future:** plan for the near and long term with an industry\-leading 401K retirement savings plan with matching and company contributions, student loan pay downs and 529 educational save up assistance programs, tuition reimbursement, employee stock purchase plan, and financial learning center and financial coach access. **Supporting your Health \& Well\-being:** flexible health and insurance options including medical, dental and vision, employee, spouse and child life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability, pre\-tax Health Savings Account with employer contributions, Healthcare FSA, critical illness, accident \& hospital indemnity insurance, and a total well\-being program that helps you and your family stay on track physically, socially, emotionally, and financially. **Building a Family:** adoption, surrogacy and fertility assistance as well as paid parental and caregiver leave, Dependent Day Care FSA back\-up child and adult/elder care days and childcare discounts. **Work\-Life Integration:** other benefits including Mentally Fit Employee Assistance Program, subsidized and discounted Weight Watchers® program and other employee discount programs. **Other Compensations:** depending on the role for which you are considered, you may be eligible for travel allowances, relocation assistance, a signing bonus and/or equity. To view more detailed information about Ally’s Total Rewards, please visit this link: https://www.ally.com/content/dam/pdf/corporate/ally\-total\-rewards\-snapshot.pdf **Who We Are** **:** Ally Financial is a customer\-centric, leading digital financial services company with passionate customer service and innovative financial solutions. We are relentlessly focused on "Doing it Right" and being a trusted financial\-services provider to our consumer, commercial, and corporate customers. For more information, visit www.ally.com . Ally is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy status, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic disposition or any other reason protected by law. In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if after review of the position expectations, you believe that you may need a medical accommodation to fulfill the duties of this role, please email hrpolicy@ally.com with details of your accommodation request. **Base Pay Range** $85,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 An individual's position in the range is determined by the specific role, the scope and responsibilities of the role, work experience, education, certification(s), training, and additional qualifications. We review internal pay, the competitive market, and business environment prior to extending an offer. **Incentive Compensation:** This position is eligible to participate in our annual incentive plan.

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Architect, Data, AWS Industries, Telco/RCPG
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced and deeply technical Generative AI Solutions Architect to accelerate AI adoption across North America's largest telecommunications operators. This is a builder\-first role. You will prototype, architect, and deliver production\-grade generative AI solutions spanning agentic voice systems, AI\-powered SMB assistants, personal subscriber assistants, real\-time translation, and intelligent network operations. In this highly technical and customer\-facing role, you will lead the design and implementation of AI\-powered experiences that transform how telecommunications companies serve their customers and run their networks. You will bridge the gap between frontier AI capabilities (large language models, multimodal foundation models, retrieval\-augmented generation, speech\-to\-speech models) and real\-world telco environments, from voice infrastructure (SBCs, IMS, SIP) to subscriber platforms and network operations centers. As a trusted technical advisor, you will guide telco engineering and product teams through designing AI\-native products and services: agentic voice pipelines for customer care, AI assistants that automate appointment booking and call answering for SMB customers, multilingual real\-time translation, and GenAI copilots for network operations. You will work backwards from customer outcomes to define reference architectures that combine AWS AI services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Polly, Amazon Connect) with partner and open\-source components in carrier\-grade deployments. This role requires someone who builds. You will write code, construct proof\-of\-concept implementations, contribute to open\-source projects, and develop reusable blueprints that accelerate GenAI adoption across the telco vertical. You will influence AWS product roadmaps by translating customer requirements into feature requests and working directly with service teams. You will publish your work through whitepapers, blog posts, reference architectures, and conference presentations. The ideal candidate combines deep generative AI expertise with a passion for shipping AI products in complex, regulated environments. You are equally comfortable whiteboarding transformer architectures with ML engineers, designing multi\-turn agentic workflows, and understanding the operational realities of carrier\-grade telecommunications networks. Key job responsibilities * Design and deliver generative AI solutions for telco customers across multiple domains: agentic voice, AI assistants, real\-time translation, and network operations AI. * Architect end\-to\-end AI pipelines integrating foundation models, speech, vision, and tool\-use agents with telco platforms and infrastructure. * Build production\-quality proof\-of\-concepts demonstrating agentic capabilities including multi\-turn reasoning, tool use, RAG, and real\-time voice interaction. * Lead technical engagements with telco engineering teams on foundation model selection, fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, guardrails, and responsible AI. * Provide strategic guidance on deploying AI agents into telco environments, addressing latency, reliability, compliance, and scale requirements. * Develop reference architectures and reusable blueprints that accelerate GenAI adoption, combining Bedrock, Transcribe, Polly, Connect, and partner ecosystem components. * Influence AWS AI service roadmaps by capturing customer requirements and collaborating with service teams. * Author whitepapers, blog posts, and reference implementations establishing AWS's point of view on GenAI for telecommunications. * Drive customer growth through GenAI\-focused sales strategies in partnership with AWS Sales teams. * Build trusted advisor relationships with senior technical leaders (VP Eng, CTO, Chief AI Officer) at telco customers. A day in the life You whiteboard an agentic voice architecture with a Tier 1 operator's engineering team, then shift to coding a proof\-of\-concept for an AI\-powered assistant that handles appointment scheduling and call answering. In the afternoon, you join a Bedrock product roadmap session advocating for features your customers need, then review a partner's proposal for integrating real\-time translation into a subscriber app. Every engagement produces a tangible artifact (code, architecture, or content) that scales beyond a single customer. About the team The AWS Industries Telco SA team partners with North America's largest telecommunications companies to accelerate cloud transformation and AI adoption. We combine deep telco industry expertise with technical depth across AI/ML, networking, and modern application architectures. We operate at the intersection of frontier AI and carrier\-grade operational requirements, helping customers reinvent their customer experiences through generative AI. We are builders who lead by example: we publish, code, prototype, and scale solutions across the i ’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 10\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent * Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end\-to\-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing * Experience communicating across technical and non\-technical audiences and at C\-level, including training, workshops, publications * Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers, or experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent * Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers * Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud * Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design * Experience with voice interface, natural language or multimodal design Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. USA, IL, Chicago \- 182,800\.00 \- 247,300\.00 USD annually USA, NY, New York \- 201,000\.00 \- 272,000\.00 USD annually USA, TX, Dallas \- 182,800\.00 \- 247,300\.00 USD annually USA, WA, Seattle \- 182,800\.00 \- 247,300\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy? \*\*Who are we?\*\* Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We're a new team inside Annapurna Trainium Systems taking Trainium beyond AWS, so customers can run it in their own data centers. \*\*What do we do?\*\* We build the software that runs on Trainium servers in customers' own data centers. We also build the software customers use to install, provision, operate, update, and monitor those servers. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system. \*\*Why it's high\-impact?\*\* The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day. \*\*What's the challenge?\*\* There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast\-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup\-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love. \*\*What you will do?\*\* You own a large component of the software that manages servers, racks, and clusters from outside. That might be a provisioning plugin, a telemetry exporter, or the service that delivers software updates. It might also be a test suite every release passes, or the tool that walks a customer through a repair. Some of it works against the server's interfaces, and some of it never touches hardware. You design it with direction from your lead and run it in production. \*\*Who would succeed in this role?\*\* An engineer who builds and operates a service in production and takes a large component from design to running code with some direction. You read logs and reason across process and system boundaries, you ship in small verifiable steps, and you start to mentor the engineers around you. Key job responsibilities * Own the design and implementation of a large component or service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics. * Make the application\-level trade\-offs on your component, and seek direction on the calls that reach beyond it. * Automate and simplify the team's development, test, and operations work, and mentor peers as you grow. * work backward from customer requirements and deliver solutions that are simple. A day in the life You design and build the provisioning and management surface over standard interfaces like Redfish, and the boot flow operator tools drive. You build the offline software\-update service and prove the signed bundle applies and recovers cleanly. You design each system against the interfaces the platform exposes and turn architecture decisions into APIs and tools a customer runs without you in the loop. About the team Our team builds the software suite for provisioning, monitoring, software delivery, and the diagnostics of Trainium systems, and we build all of it on open, standard interfaces. We serve the engineers and operators who run large\-scale AI training and need to provision, monitor, update, and troubleshoot it on their own terms. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Seller Fee Science
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon’s third\-party marketplace is a multibillion\-dollar global ecosystem, connecting customers and sellers across the world through millions of transactions annually. The Seller Fee Science Team integrates economic modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to guide business fee strategy, ensure fees are accurately computed for millions of products, and improves the seller experience with AI tools that support any fee related contact (understanding, audit, and dispute). We build the scientific foundation that empowers sellers to grow their businesses with clarity and confidence. Our team brings together world\-class economists, physicists, mathematicians, and computer scientists to tackle diverse challenging problems that require theoretical rigor and deliver real\-world impact. For example, precision measurement of difficult to measure products, large\-scale simulation of sales, inventory, and policy changes, as well as leveraging natural language understanding and automated reasoning to interpret policy, generate code, resolve disputes, audit fees, and respond to sellers at meaninful scale. As an applied scientist on our team, this role will focus on the application of machine learning and artificial intelligence to predict and reconcile measurement of products globally. This blends together statistical modeling, application of NLP, image processing, classical machine learning, cost\-benefit analysis, causal modeling, and optimization. Your work will shape not only how fees are implemented, but how they are interpreted, experienced, and trusted at scale. You will partner closely with engineers and product partners to take your solutions from research to production. We are seeking scientists who are motivated by first principles, disciplined experimentation, and the technical challenge of deploying ideas at global scale. This is an opportunity to work on consequential problems where mathematical rigor meets real\-world complexity, and where your models, algorithms, and systems will directly influence the experience of millions of sellers. If you are driven to build elegant solutions to hard problems—and to see them operate in production at meaningful scale—we would welcome the opportunity to build with you. Key job responsibilities * Identify opportunities to improve Seller Experience and translate ambiguous business challenges into well\-defined scientific problems with measurable impact. * Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models that improve fee accuracy, automate policy\-to\-code translation, and enhance seller understanding of fee calculations. * Partner closely with engineering and product teams to productionize solutions, meeting latency, scalability, reliability, and other system constraints. * Apply rigorous experimentation, causal inference, and simulation methods to validate models and quantify business impact at scale. * Communicate scientific innovations and results clearly to cross\-functional stakeholders and contribute to the broader internal and external scientific community through publications, talks, and technical artifacts. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * PhD * Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language * 2\+ years of building models for business application experience * Experience in state\-of\-the\-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application * Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results * Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment * Experience in patents or publications at top\-tier peer\-reviewed conferences or journals Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide. The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third\-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission\-critical servers must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small\-to\-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer, Amazon Robotics
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Robotics is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building revolutionary robotic systems that combine AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at unprecedented scale, working with world\-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic manipulation, locomotion, and human\-robot interaction. If you're passionate about actuation and robotics systems, and have a strong interest in safety and performance, then we'd like to talk to you about becoming part of an organization with global impact on millions of customer Key job responsibilities * Design, implement and maintain embedded firmware for motor control and actuation systems, and contribute to the architecture of complex control systems alongside senior engineers and adjacent teams. * Own the firmware features and modules you deliver across the development lifecycle, from design through integration, testing and field deployment. * Support the gathering of functional and safety requirements, and turn them into robust, testable firmware implementations. * Take part in system bring\-up, debugging and root cause analysis, working systematically to fix issues at the source rather than the symptom. * Give and take constructive feedback in design and code reviews, and communicate status, risks and findings clearly to the team. * Build solutions that balance performance and reliability, and keep improving code quality, test coverage and documentation. * Write automated tests and contribute to continuous integration to validate new features. * Support system commissioning and field deployment, helping ensure results hold up in real\-world conditions. A day in the life As a Firmware Engineer, you will work with cross\-functional teams to design, build, test and debug cutting\-edge robotic systems. You will own the firmware features you deliver, from early design to live field deployment. No two days look the same, and every one moves fast. You contribute ideas in design discussions, work with senior engineers to tackle hard problems in robotics, and turn product concepts into firmware that ships. You act with urgency and sound judgment without compromising quality or safety. When it's time to prove the work, you write automated tests to validate new features and run live testing to debug and find the root cause of issues. You stay accountable until the system performs and holds up under real\-world conditions. You take initiative: you see what needs to happen and help make it happen.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of embedded firmware development experience * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ development for resource\-constrained embedded systems * Hands\-on experience with ARM\-based microcontrollers and processor peripherals (timers, PWM, ADC), and standard interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN) * Experience developing on a real\-time operating system such as FreeRTOS * Working knowledge of Field\-Oriented Control (FOC) and motor control fundamentals * Ability to read schematics and work closely with hardware engineers during bring\-up and debugging * Experience with the full embedded software development lifecycle (requirements, design, implementation, testing, integration) **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Solid working knowledge of IEC 61508 (Functional Safety of Electrical/Electronic Systems), with a practical grasp of Safety Integrity Levels (SIL) and the full safety lifecycle. * A firm foundation in cybersecurity principles and standards for embedded systems. * Working knowledge of bootloaders and firmware update mechanisms. * Practical familiarity with robotic control systems architecture. * Applied experience with model\-based development and code generation (MATLAB/Simulink). * Hands\-on exposure to continuous integration and automated testing. jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join our Reliability \& Maintenance Engineering team and help keep Amazon's operations running smoothly across hundreds of countries. You'll work on maintaining and improving the robotics and material handling equipment that enables us to deliver tens of thousands of products daily, directly impacting the experience of millions of customers worldwide. About the Role: As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll mentor junior engineers and lead cross\-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems, implement innovative projects, and develop system design improvements to enhance site throughput. You'll work with state\-of\-the\-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your technical leadership and design optimization efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy while building team capabilities and driving operational excellence. What Do We Offer? Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave.
