Amazon Enterprise Security Products is a newly launched group building intelligent, cloud\-agnostic security tools using AI\-first development practices. Here, you build AI and you build with AI — at the same time. This is not a traditional SDE role. It's a chance to shape the future of security tooling with a small, fast team that ships like a startup and deploys like Amazon. Key job responsibilities Architect and drive AI powered security products end to end: Lead technical vision, system design, and production delivery of large scale, distributed systems that protect Amazon Business Customers. Set architectural direction and make high judgment decisions that shape the product roadmap. Leverage agentic AI development practices to accelerate every phase. Own cross team technical leadership: Drive execution across multiple teams and stakeholders. Decompose complex, ambiguous problems into actionable plans, unblock dependencies, and deliver cross team initiatives on time and at quality. Define and advance AI/ML capabilities: Lead the design of agentic systems, RAG architectures, conversational interfaces, and intelligent automation pipelines. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and make strategic build versus buy decisions. Champion AI assisted engineering practices: Establish the team's AI first development workflows including agentic coding and experimental techniques. Drive adoption, measure impact on velocity and quality, and set the standard for how the team builds. Shape product direction: Partner with security researchers, applied scientists, product managers, and UX designers to translate customer needs into technical strategy. Influence roadmap priorities with data and technical insight. Build the foundation of a growing team: Establish development rigor, best practices, and technical review processes that set the bar for all future work. A ground floor opportunity to define how a high performing team operates. Mentor and grow engineers: Develop junior and mid level engineers through pairing, design reviews, and hands on coaching. Foster a culture of ownership and continuous learning. Drive operational excellence: Own reliability, performance, and security of your services. Lead on call rotations, drive root cause analysis, and implement systemic improvements. Innovate with urgency: Prototype rapidly, validate with customers, and iterate. Bring a builder's mindset to an environment where the best idea wins. A day in the life You lead from the front on a startup paced, AI first security team. One moment you're whiteboarding agentic system architecture with principal engineers, the next you're deep in code shipping a feature alongside your team. You drive sprint planning, decompose ambiguous problems into clear technical paths, and unblock your team when things get hard. You author vision docs, build consensus across stakeholders, and mentor engineers who are growing fast. You don't just talk about AI assisted development, you establish the practices and set the standard. Every day you're building products and building a team. About the team Amazon Enterprise Security Products is built by builders who tackle challenges others might consider too ambitious. We're a small team where there are no layers between you and the decision, no waiting quarters to see your work reach customers. Every team member brings an owner's mentality. If there's a problem worth solving, we solve it. No mission is beyond reach, no detail beneath our attention. We move fast, we ship fast, and we learn from what we ship. This is where builders who want to make the impossible routine come to do their best work. Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team * Experience building agentic coding best practices (Ralph loop, parallelized agentic development, etc.) **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Storage, AWS Hardware Engineering, Hardware Engineering Services
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Application deadline: Nov 21, 2026 AWS operates the world’s largest fleet of storage servers powering exabyte\-scale cloud storage services. Our team designs, builds, and operates this fleet — solving systemic hardware issues and building systems that detect and prevent recurrence so customers experience the highest quality of service. We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive end\-to\-end delivery of storage servers across our global fleet. You will coordinate cross\-functional engineering teams spanning hardware, firmware, and software, manage ODM partnerships across multiple continents, and establish closed\-loop quality systems that drive continuous improvements. This role requires technical depth to translate engineering constraints into program risk, combined with program management excellence to deliver complex hardware at global scale. Key job responsibilities RFP \& ODM Selection: Translate technical requirements into ODM evaluation criteria. Build scoring frameworks covering technical capability, manufacturing capacity, DFx maturity, automation capability, and commercial terms. Coordinate technical deep\-dives between engineering and ODM design teams during competitive evaluation. Compile selection decision packages and drive decision meetings. Transition to NPI with requirements locked and statement of work signed. NPI Program Delivery: Facilitate requirements gathering with internal customers; develop Technical Requirements Documents (TRDs) covering server specs, rack configurations, PCIe topology, NVMe/SSD layout, power/cooling topology, and drive interconnects. Build program timelines with critical path analysis, risk identification, and milestone tracking. Own milestone\-driven gate progression: manufacturing readiness, production readiness, operational readiness review, and general availability. Drive cross\-functional dependencies across firmware, thermal, mechanical, and silicon teams. Communicate program status to leadership with clear reporting on milestone progress, risk posture, and mitigation plans. Production Yield \& Manufacturing Delivery Own manufacturing readiness gates and production yield tracking from first build through volume ramp. Monitor first\-pass yield by test stage, drive root cause analysis on excursions, and ensure corrective actions close before yield issues compound. Track ODM delivery cadence, line throughput, and supply chain continuity. Fleet Operations \& Feed\-Forward: Maintain fleet\-level program visibility: AFR targets, unsellable resolution velocity, and component lifecycle risk. Own the feed\-forward cadence — ensuring fleet failure patterns, manufacturing yield data, and vetting escapes translate into requirements and test content for next\-generation programs. Dashboards \& Mechanisms Build and own mechanisms for program visibility — defining metrics, dashboards, and review cadences that enable data\-driven decisions and early risk detection. Define leading indicators: unsellable inflow/outflow rate, NPI milestone velocity, first\-pass yield by test stage, and component lifecycle risk. Streamline delivery processes across teams; identify and eliminate dependencies, redundant gates, or coordination overhead that slow velocity. Risk \& Quality: Challenge technical workstreams to surface risks early; quantify impact to schedule and reliability (annualized failure rate targets, availability SLAs) with proposed mitigations. Drive root cause analysis of fleet\-wide hardware failures and ensure corrective actions flow back into qualification criteria and design requirements. Define acceptance criteria, coordinate qualification testing at server and rack levels, and manage go/no\-go decisions for mission\-critical storage services. May require occasional ( A day in the life You start the day syncing with ODM partners across time zones on build status and open engineering actions. Mid\-morning, you run an engineering review connecting firmware, software, and hardware teams to unblock a qualification gate. In the afternoon, you lead the weekly feed\-forward review — translating fleet failure patterns into test content requirements for the next\-generation program. You end the day reviewing NPI milestone readiness and updating the production yield dashboard before the ODM delivery cadence call. About the team The Storage Server Hardware Engineering team designs and delivers the storage platforms that power Amazon S3, EBS, and other critical AWS storage services. We own our platforms cradle\-to\-grave: from architecture definition through NPI, manufacturing, fleet deployment, and end\-of\-life. Our sustaining engineers are the backbone of fleet reliability — ensuring that deployed platforms continue to meet quality and performance targets throughout their operational life. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent * 6\+ years of technical product or program management experience, working directly with multiple engineering teams. * 6\+ years of experience driving hardware development programs (servers, racks, networking, or storage) through full product lifecycle including design, validation, manufacturing, and fleet deployment * Experience managing programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes, and coordinating release schedules **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field * 5\+ years of experience coordinating complex server programs with ODM/JDM partners across multiple geographies, managing design reviews, manufacturing readiness gates, and quality checkpoints * 5\+ years of experience working with storage server platforms or NVMe/SSD infrastructure across NPI qualification phases (EVT, DVT, PVT) * Experience driving root cause analysis and corrective action processes for hardware reliability issues at fleet scale * Knowledge of server hardware development lifecycle: electrical/mechanical design, firmware, thermal/power validation, and manufacturing testing. * Experience driving zero\-touch automation or fleet health programs for large\-scale infrastructure * Experience communicating engineering trade\-offs and technical risks in business terms to leadership. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Appointee - Autonomous Discovery Boron Doped Diamond
jobs.description: The Materials Science Division (MSD) and Q\-NEXT at Argonne National Laboratory seek a Postdoctoral Researcher to establish an autonomous solid\-state synthesis testbed within the Argonne Quantum Foundry (AQF). Driven by the Laboratory’s Autonomous Discovery LDRD initiative (Self\-Driving Laboratories / AI\-for\-Science), this 2\-year position focuses on developing and executing closed\-loop autonomous experimental workflows. This research is at the heart of the Autonomously Driven Solid\-State Synthesis effort. This experimental environment features an 8\-module high\-vacuum robotic cluster tool equipped with a commissioned Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) reactor complete with boron\-doping capabilities. To support rapid evaluation, the system integrates optical diagnostic modules, including Raman and Photoluminescence spectroscopy, for vacuum\-isolated, automated in\-situ and ex\-situ characterization. Surrounding this hardware is a modern software stack leveraging MADSci for orchestration and software currently under development for data management and telemetry ingestion. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of materials science, solid\-state synthesis, hardware\-software integration, and artificial intelligence, taking primary responsibility for assembling, validating, and operating closed\-loop synthesis protocols and robotic transfer mechanics across the multi\-module cluster tool. A core aspect of the role is the development of dual\-loop AI/ML methodologies. In the outer, low\-data regime, the researcher will develop Bayesian optimization, active learning, and surrogate models to efficiently explore complex phase spaces, such as single\-crystal boron\-doped diamond, despite hardware\-imposed throughput constraints. In the inner, telemetry\-rich regime, they will implement real\-time AI control for the ingestion of high\-dimensional sensor data, including plasma optical emission spectroscopy, impedance, and thermal telemetry, to dynamically optimize growth dynamics on the fly. Ultimately, the candidate will be tasked with quantifying and demonstrating a tangible active learning advantage over traditional empirical parameter sweeps in solid\-state materials discovery while driving forward his/her own ideas as to best push the research forward. The appointment consists of up to two one\-year terms, reviewed annually. A third\-year extension may be considered if additional funding becomes available and performance remains satisfactory. This position description documents the general nature and level of work but is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all activities, duties and responsibilities required of job incumbent. Consequently, job incumbent may be required to perform other duties as assigned. **Position Requirements** **Position Requirements** Ph.D. Requirement: Must possess a recent Ph.D. in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Computer Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or strong background in a relevant scientific/engineering discipline. Core Technical Capabilities: The ideal candidate will have at least one strong competency amongst these, with a tangible interest in the other two. * Solid\-State Synthesis \& Hardware: Hands\-on experimental background in solid\-state synthesis hardware, high\-vacuum systems, and Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) or related crystal/thin\-film growth environments. * Hardware\-Software Integration: Demonstrated expertise in laboratory automation, robotic sample\-handling integration, and managing multi\-module experimental hardware. * AI/ML for Science: Practical experience applying machine learning to experimental sciences, specifically implementing active learning, Bayesian optimization, or surrogate modeling for low\-data regime exploration. * Ability to model Argonne’s core values of impact, safety, respect, integrity, and teamwork. Additional Valued Capabilities: * Strong proficiency in Python for hardware control, API integration, and automated data pipelines. Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices, and modern orchestration or telemetry management frameworks are a big plus. * Familiarity with in\-situ or ex\-situ optical characterization techniques (such as Raman spectroscopy and Photoluminescence) for rapid materials evaluation. * Advanced analytical skills to process high\-dimensional sensor and telemetry data (e.g., thermal, impedance, and plasma optical emission) to continuously improve analysis techniques. * Demonstrated resilience and effective troubleshooting ability required to diagnose and resolve complex, interdependent hardware\-software issues. * Ability to produce high\-quality scientific reports, present ideas and project proposals to multidisciplinary scientists and engineers, and maintain clear written and oral communication. * Proven ability to work effectively as part of an interdisciplinary team bridging materials science, computer science, and facility engineering. **Please upload the following as attachments to your application via Workday:** * CV/Resume * Research statement * Candidates can be currently enrolled to apply but must have their degree conferred by the position start date. **Job Family** Postdoctoral**Job Profile** Postdoctoral Appointee**Worker Type** Long\-Term (Fixed Term)**Time Type** Full time The expected hiring range for this position is $72,879\.00\-$121,465\.00\. Please note that the pay range information is a general guideline only. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, business considerations, internal equity, and external market pay for comparable jobs. Additionally, comprehensive benefits are part of the total rewards package. jobs.title: Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Seeking a highly experienced **Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer** to lead the implementation, configuration, governance, and ongoing management of an enterprise Microsoft Azure environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a senior\-level cloud engineer who enjoys designing and maintaining secure, resilient, and scalable cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings extensive hands\-on Azure expertise, strong infrastructure engineering capabilities, and the ability to provide technical leadership across teams. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, thrives on complex technical challenges, and can translate infrastructure strategy into secure, reliable, and business\-focused solutions. What You'll Bring * Extensive hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure services, Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud infrastructure design, security best practices, governance, and operational management. * A strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to manage complex projects from initial design through implementation and delivery. * The ability to guide, mentor, and cross\-train engineers while promoting collaboration and technical excellence. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to present technical recommendations, risks, and strategies to management and executive leadership. Core Responsibilities Cloud Architecture \& Engineering * Design, implement, and maintain secure Azure environments, including air\-gapped and highly restricted cloud tenancies. * Build and maintain hub\-and\-spoke network topologies using Azure Firewall, Application Gateway/WAF, private endpoints, DNS, and routing. * Apply strong networking fundamentals, including OSI model concepts, core network protocols, and network\-level troubleshooting. * Deliver infrastructure solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Terraform and PowerShell, along with CI/CD pipelines. * Develop architecture designs, establish technical standards, and document architectural decisions for review and approval. Security, Identity \& Zero Trust * Implement Zero Trust security principles, least\-privilege access management, and Conditional Access controls. * Establish and enforce security guardrails using Azure Policy, firewall rules, and Network Security Groups (NSGs). * Leverage cloud\-native application protection platforms, including Tenable and Microsoft security tools, to manage vulnerabilities and strengthen security posture. * Collaborate with Security Operations teams to implement security baselines and remediate audit findings. * Support compliance with enterprise and regulatory security requirements. Logging, Monitoring \& Observability * Design and implement enterprise monitoring and observability solutions. * Configure and optimize Azure Monitor Data Collection Rules and Log Analytics workspaces. * Integrate logging pipelines with enterprise SIEM platforms, including Splunk through Azure Event Hubs. * Establish alerting, diagnostic, and incident response capabilities while balancing log retention, performance, and cost. Cloud Migration \& Transformation * Plan and lead cloud architecture modernization and workload migrations within and across Azure environments. * Support migrations from on\-premises infrastructure to Microsoft Azure. * Design Azure landing zones, identify workload dependencies, and coordinate migration cutovers, validation, and rollback strategies. * Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure resilience requirements are met while minimizing downtime and protecting critical data. Operations, Governance \& Collaboration * Provide technical leadership and guidance for Azure resource design, implementation, configuration, networking, and security governance. * Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), operational runbooks, and knowledge\-transfer documentation. * Implement, maintain, and monitor mission\-critical cloud resources within a large enterprise environment. * Participate in service operations, including change management, incident management, problem management, service requests, and escalated technical support. * Troubleshoot and resolve production application and infrastructure issues. * Manage and optimize enterprise backup and disaster recovery operations. * Contribute to cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, and governance initiatives. * Collaborate with architecture, security, development, and governance teams. * Mentor engineers, lead technical design reviews, and coordinate with vendors and strategic technology partners. Preferred Qualifications * Microsoft Azure certifications, such as: * Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert * Other relevant Microsoft Azure certifications * Networking certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, Cisco CCNA, or equivalent. Pay: $75\.00 \- $82\.55 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Research Scientist, NeuroAI
jobs.description: ### **Company Overview** Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large\-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain\-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high\-risk, high\-reward science in a well\-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy. ### **Position Summary** Research Scientists in NeuroAI at Astera Neuro develop and lead research programs aimed at understanding how the brain builds a model of the physical world, forms new thoughts, and creates a stable model of the self. The goal is enough understanding and technical ability to precisely and reversibly modulate each of these functions through write\-in experiments. You will bring modern AI and machine learning methods to large\-scale neural and behavioral recordings from our primate, rodent, and human programs. Working closely with experimental neuroscientists and engineers, you will build models that uncover how neural circuits in artificial and biological networks represent information and compute, and use those models to guide closed\-loop experiments and targeted neural perturbations. This role suits researchers whose primary training is in machine learning; prior neuroscience experience is welcome but not required. Title and scope are calibrated to track record. ### **What You’ll Do** * Develop and lead a machine learning research program to understand how the brain builds an internal model of the world, composes structured thoughts, and guides flexible behavior. * Train foundation models that align neural activity with sensory inputs and behavior across recording sessions, subjects, and species, enabling in silico experiments and closed\-loop control of neural activity. * Develop mechanistic interpretability and representation analysis methods to uncover how artificial and biological networks compute, and analyze how neural geometry evolves over time and across task contexts. * Collaborate with experimental neuroscientists to test model predictions in vivo, designing behavioral tasks and closed\-loop write\-in perturbations that steer neural activity to alter percepts, thoughts, or internal states. * Translate computational principles discovered in the brain into new AI architectures and learning algorithms. * Mentor research engineers and, at the senior or principal level, more junior scientists; contribute to hiring, onboarding, and lab culture. * Contribute to publications, talks, open data and tooling releases, and engagement with the broader scientific community. ### **Who You Are** **Required:** * PhD with 3\-12\+ years of experience in machine learning, computer science, computational neuroscience, physics, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent research experience. * Demonstrated ability to lead original machine learning research end to end, with depth in areas such as mechanistic interpretability, representation learning, reinforcement learning, world models, or foundation models. * Strong programming and research engineering skills in Python and PyTorch or JAX, with experience building custom architectures, learning objectives, or interpretability tools at scale. * Ability to collaborate closely with neuroscientists and engineers in a fast\-moving, interdisciplinary environment. **Preferred/Nice to Have:** * Experience in neuroscience, especially collaborating closely with experimentalists, analyzing large\-scale neural and behavioral recordings, or conducting experimental work. * Experience connecting the internal computations of artificial networks to biological circuits, or designing model\-guided, closed\-loop neural perturbation experiments. * Experience scaling training and data pipelines across large, heterogeneous datasets, and contributing to ML or scientific tooling. ### **What We Value** * Deep interest in understanding intelligence in biological and artificial systems. * Conviction that the brain’s internal model can be understood in full, and recognition that getting there requires a kind of science no single academic lab can do. * Willingness to be held to an engineering standard: our decisive tests are write\-in experiments, not merely decoding. What we cannot build, we do not understand. * Comfort building on shared infrastructure rather than private projects. * Commitment to open science, including releasing code, models, and data publicly. ### **Additionally Expected at Senior / Principal Level** * Experience setting research direction and leading collaborative projects across disciplines. * Track record of mentorship and technical leadership. ### **Why Join Us** Join Astera Neuro to work on the hardest and least understood questions in neuroscience: how the brain generates thoughts, intelligence, and consciousness. You will bring machine learning into close contact with large\-scale neural experiments, building models that explain biological computation and using discoveries about the brain to inform new approaches to AI. Astera Neuro provides a comprehensive benefits package and total compensation that is competitive and commensurate with the level of experience and qualifications. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion! Compensation Range: $150K \- $350K

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco or New York (Hybrid) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission\-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry\-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data\-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io. **About the role** ------------------ The world’s most regulated companies, from global banks to healthcare systems, need a secure and reliable way to orchestrate the flow of mission\-critical data. With 3,600\+ contributors and 30 million downloads a month, Airflow is one of the most active projects in the history of the Apache Software Foundation, and the de facto standard for data orchestration. Astro Private Cloud (APC) lets regulated companies run managed Apache Airflow at scale inside their own infrastructure, meeting their security, compliance and data\-residency requirements. APC customers are among Astronomer’s largest: at one global retailer more than 1,000 data teams use it for workloads that cannot fail, everything from supply chain to payroll. They expect the same experience as our hosted platform, but their environments are locked down, sometimes air\-gapped, and each one differs from the next. So some features need a different architecture to work here, and others exist only in APC. As Staff Product Manager for APC, you’ll own its roadmap end to end. You’ll decide the strategy to make APC the obvious choice for even the most sophisticated open\-source Airflow teams. You’ll work out which capabilities matter most to these customers, how to deliver them in environments we don’t control, and where APC should lead — including new AI pipelines. You’ll work with engineering to ship on dates customers can plan around, spend real time with customer executives, and partner closely with sales and services to keep our biggest accounts growing. And you’ll help build the foundational systems that our products will depend on for years. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Set the vision and roadmap.** Define and drive the strategy for APC, starting with the near\-term goal of reaching feature parity with Astro Hosted. * **Write the requirements.** Specify a complex distributed platform that serves platform administrators, platform engineers, data engineers and AI teams. * **Build alongside engineering.** Work with R\&D from design through release, including the infrastructure decisions that shape the product: Kubernetes, cloud environments, multi\-tenancy and observability. * **Listen to our most strategic customers.** Engage executives and technical leaders on their security, compliance, certification and central\-management needs, and use what you learn to prioritize. * **Balance the few and the many.** Weigh specific customer demands against a committed roadmap that serves the broader customer base. Push back where necessary, and work with forward\-deployed engineers to deliver custom requirements. * **Enable go\-to\-market teams.** Support product marketing and sales with customer\-focused messaging and content. * **Be the voice of APC.** Represent the product externally through conferences, webinars and written content. **What you bring** ------------------ * **Staff\-level product experience.** 8–9 years of product roles at enterprise data or infrastructure companies, with demonstrated experience driving product strategy and delivering impactful outcomes. * **Technical depth.** You can engage as a peer with engineering partners across R\&D. * **Platform knowledge.** Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and the modern data stack. * **Experience with demanding technical users.** You've handled large, complex requests and have the judgment to weigh them against the product's overall roadmap. * **Customer\-facing presence.** You're comfortable with executives and can turn customer input, product data and industry trends into a data\-driven roadmap. * **A bias to action.** A record of delivering the product vision you set across multiple R\&D teams. * **Strong communication.** You work well with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * **Public voice.** You're comfortable speaking and writing publicly about technical products. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience with on\-premise or self\-hosted enterprise software, or with customers in regulated industries such as finance and healthcare * Familiarity with Apache Airflow * Background in security, compliance and certification requirements for enterprise platforms * Experience with open\-source projects and communities *The estimated total compensation for this role ranges from $230,000 \- $300,000, along with an equity component and a comprehensive benefits package. This range is merely an estimate, and the width of the range reflects willingness to consider candidates with broad prior seniority. jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Compute
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. The journey to developing our cutting\-edge self\-driving truck Driver software requires a massive and continuous computational effort. Every day, Aurora's engineers initiate and manage millions of compute tasks, systematically processing and analyzing petabytes of critical data. This colossal computational workload spans various essential domains, including raw and derived data processing pipelines, large\-scale simulations to test and validate the software in countless scenarios, and the intensive machine learning training jobs that are the core of our autonomous system's intelligence. At the heart of orchestrating this monumental computing infrastructure is the **Compute team**. This team is dedicated to building and maintaining the foundational technology that solves the fundamental challenges of resource scheduling, task isolation, and distributed state consistency across our massive batch compute fleet. At our scale, traditional off\-the\-shelf orchestrators break. The Compute team builds the custom engine \- **BatchAPI** \- that manages the lifecycle of millions of tasks \- built on top of K8s primitives but implements our own custom scheduler. We deal with the 'unsolved' problems of distributed computing: maximizing hardware utilization while ensuring that a failure in one node doesn't cascade across the entire cluster. This engine is engineered to handle massive scale, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and rapid turnaround for our engineers. Furthermore, the Compute team empowers engineers across the company to run detailed, end\-to\-end simulation and integration tests (at scale) between “virtual vehicles” and backend services. They develop and maintain the **AV to Offboard (AV2O)** system. This framework provides a powerful, flexible interface that allows engineers to programmatically define, construct, deploy, monitor, and manage complex integration and simulation tests. The framework abstracts away the complexities of traditional “hardware\-in\-the\-loop” testing, enabling engineers to rapidly iterate on difficult integration efforts, thus accelerating the entire development cycle for the Aurora Driver. **In this role you will** * Design, implement, and maintain core components of the high\-performance, large\-scale distributed batch compute engine (BatchAPI). Architect and optimize the scheduler, resource allocator, and execution engine of BatchAPI to handle bursty, heterogeneous workloads with minimal overhead. * Design low\-latency APIs and resilient communication protocols that bridge our Python SDK with the Golang\-based core engine. * Develop high\-level workflow abstractions, enabling engineers across the company to programmatically define, deploy, and manage complex data processing, simulation, and ML training pipelines. * Solve complex problems in distributed locking, throttling, and fair\-share scheduling to ensure multi\-tenant stability. * Drive continuous improvements in the performance, scalability, and resilience of the entire compute infrastructure, implementing robust monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence for critical workflows. * Collaborate closely with infrastructure and product engineering teams (e.g., Autonomy, Data, Simulation, Machine Learning) to gather requirements, provide expert consultation, and integrate compute workflows with key company systems. **Required qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Deep expertise in Golang (for core systems) and some knowledge of Python (for SDK/API layering). * Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals (e.g., CAP theorem, consensus algorithms, or gossip protocols). * Experience with performance profiling and tuning (e.g., memory management, I/O bottlenecks, or network latency optimization). * Specialized knowledge of container orchestration systems like Kubernetes. * Proven track record of driving continuous performance, scalability, and resilience improvements in production environments managing critical data. * Familiarity with cloud provider compute and data services (e.g., AWS EKS, S3, RDS). **Desirable qualifications** * Experience working with computational workloads specific to the autonomous vehicle, robotics, or large\-scale machine learning domains (e.g., data processing for perception, simulation, or model training). * Demonstrated ability in creating and refining user\-facing tools, including adeptness at incorporating user feedback, managing expectations, and effectively prioritizing development based on user needs. * Web UI development experience (Typescript, React) For roles based in Louisville, CO: The salary range for this position is $126,000 \- $201,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

Under limited supervision, this position directs projects through all phases of development, including planning, design, budgeting, procurement, contract administration, permitting, construction oversight, and post\-construction services. The role collaborates with engineers, architects, consultants, contractors, vendors, regulatory agencies, and internal stakeholders to deliver projects safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contract requirements. The successful candidate will apply expertise in City of Austin Building Technical Codes, International Building Codes, and Land Development Code requirements to guide project development and ensure regulatory compliance. Responsibilities include developing project scopes, contract documents, and design exhibits; overseeing multidisciplinary design and construction activities; managing space planning and interior renovation projects; and representing Austin Energy before City leadership, community stakeholders, boards, commissions, and other public agencies. This position requires strong technical, project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills, as well as the ability to conduct site visits and field assessments at multiple Austin Energy facilities and project locations. jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Closes:** November 23, 2026 **Job Description** In this role, you will join the Generation Controls Engineering team and primarily support Avista’s Cabinet Gorge and Noxon Rapids hydroelectric generating facilities on the Clark Fork River. You will design PLC‑based control system solutions that monitor, control, and protect generating equipment and associated auxiliary and support systems. As a Controls Engineer, you will support capital projects that include control system scope, which may range from stand‑alone control system replacements to control system upgrades delivered as part of broader plant improvement initiatives. You will support work across the full project lifecycle, including concept development, detailed design, implementation planning, and commissioning support. You will work closely with other engineering disciplines, project managers, plant operators, maintenance personnel, technicians, consultants, and vendors to deliver control system solutions. You will translate functional requirements and operational needs into control system designs, PLC logic, electrical design packages, and technical documentation. Field installation, configuration, and physical modifications are performed by technicians, with Controls Engineers providing technical direction, review, and engineering support. In addition to project work, Controls Engineers provide ongoing engineering support for the operation and maintenance of generating facilities. This includes troubleshooting control system issues, evaluating system performance, supporting plant operations, and developing engineering changes or improvements to existing control systems as needed. **Responsibilities** * Develop working knowledge of Cabinet Gorge and Noxon Rapids control systems and provide ongoing controls engineering support to plant operations, maintenance, and project teams. * Own the technical design of generation control systems, including control philosophies and functional requirements supporting safe and reliable operation of generating assets and associated auxiliary and support systems. * Develop and maintain PLC‑based control solutions using the Rockwell Automation Studio 5000 platform, translating functional control requirements into implemented logic and system behavior. Designs may be validated through testing and simulation, including use of lab environments when appropriate, prior to field deployment. * Develop and maintain electrical and controls design packages that define the physical installation and logical integration of control system equipment, including general arrangements, panel layouts and elevations, PLC I/O lists (hard‑wired and communicated), I/O schematics, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, bills of material, and related installation details. * Define and implement control functions that support mechanical equipment protection, including monitoring, permissives, interlocks, and protective actions associated with generators, auxiliaries, and balance‑of‑plant systems. * Define and document the exchange of data between PLCs and other systems such as HMI, SCADA, and PI Historian. * Specify and evaluate automation and monitoring equipment by developing technical requirements, reviewing manufacturer and vendor submittals, and ensuring selected equipment meets functional, environmental, regulatory, reliability, and lifecycle expectations. Equipment may include PLC hardware, field instrumentation, motor controls, communication interfaces, and other components integral to generation control systems. * Develop, maintain, and use technical engineering documentation as a core part of control system design and delivery, capturing control system intent, design decisions, and operational behavior. Documentation may include Basis of Design documents, Controls Narratives, Design Standards, Process Flow Diagrams, and Standard Operating Procedures. * Provide field engineering support during construction, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and operational events, ensuring installed systems perform as intended. **Requirements** * Bachelor of Science in an ABET\-accredited Engineering Program (Electrical, Mechanical, or related discipline) * Effective and flexible communication skills * Ability to regularly work at Cabinet Gorge and Noxon Rapids generating facilities and travel to other Avista generation facilities as project and operational needs require, including occasional overnight travel * Minimum of six (6\) years engineering work experience required * Demonstrated skills illustrating use of productivity, presentation, and analytical tools specific to area of expertise * Demonstrated technical leadership within engineering * Demonstrated positive and effective working relationships with internal and external parties * Specialty technical proficiency, project leadership, and ability to be self\-directed Hiring Range: $114,207 to $150,183 **Preferred Requirements** * Demonstrated experience with PLC‑based control systems,   based on project, operational, and team needs. Cabinet Gorge Generation Station will be the employee’s primary work location.*** **To Apply** We encourage you to apply as many of our positions have multiple levels to account for an incoming employee’s various knowledge, skills, and experience. Complete an online application and attach your resume and cover letter to your profile**. All documents must be attached to your application at the time of submitting your application for review.** No documents can be attached after you click "Submit". **Total Rewards** At Avista, our employees are the foundation of our success. Their dedication drives the value we deliver to our customers and communities. That’s why we prioritize the physical, mental, and financial well\-being of our team members and their families. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards program designed to support every stage of life and career. Our offerings include: * **Affordable healthcare options** including medical, dental, and vision coverage * **Retirement benefits** with an enhanced 401(k) match * **Incentive programs** rewarding performance and contributions * **Competitive paid time off** including holidays, personal days, and vacation * **Life and disability insurance** for added peace of mind * **Wellness resources** supporting mental and physical health * **Education and development support** including tuition assistance * **Community giving programs** encouraging employee engagement and impact * **Other optional benefits** from Legal insurance, Pet insurance, and more *(Eligibility subject to Bargaining Unit affiliation)* To learn more, please visit our benefits website at https://avistabenefits.com/ (https://avistabenefits.com/). In compliance with state laws, we provide the full salary range for each position, along with the typical hiring range based on qualifications, experience, and internal equity. jobs.title: Sr. Staff, Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Sr. Staff, Firmware Engineer** Location: San Jose, CA (on\-site, occasional international travel) Ayar Labs, the global leader in optical I/O chiplets, is harnessing silicon photonics to revolutionize the scaling of AI compute hardware. Ayar Labs is shattering AI data bottlenecks by moving data at the speed of light. As pioneers of co\-packaged optics (CPO), we are using light instead of electricity to move data faster, further, and with a fraction of the energy needed to fuel the explosive growth of AI models. Backed by industry giants like NVIDIA, AMD and Intel and manufactured in partnership with the world’s leading semiconductor ecosystem, Ayar Labs’ co\-packaged optics solution is key to unleashing next\-generation AI scale\-up architectures. Ayar Labs builds co\-packaged optics for datacenter interconnect. Our customers deploy it in AI infrastructure at scale, where a single firmware defect can take down systems that many workloads depend on. This role owns the verification practice that keeps those defects out of the field. Every firmware release will ship with evidence of what has been tested, so customers can deploy it with confidence. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set the technical direction for firmware verification and lead the engineers across a geographically dispersed team, including contract staff, who write tests against it. **Essential Functions** * Own the verification strategy and test plan, including what results are required before a release ships * Define and automate the release gate, with authority to block a release * Own hardware\-in\-the\-loop regression and the unit and integration test harness * Root\-cause escaped defects and close the coverage gaps they expose * Write specifications and review test code for engineers in other time zones, working mostly asynchronously **Minimum Requirements** * Embedded firmware background that includes owning the verification strategy and test infrastructure for at least one shipping product * Strong C, C\+\+ and Python * Experience building hardware\-in\-the\-loop rigs and a firmware CI and regression system * Board\-level debug with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and datasheets * Technical leadership across teams or sites, and clear technical writing **Preferred Qualifications** * Optical module firmware and management standards; platform management and BMC firmware; silicon photonics; manufacturing test; secure boot; Zephyr, FreeRTOS or bare\-metal firmware. Founded in 1993, BH is celebrated for its simple commitment to doing business the right way and investing in its team. Today, BH manages over 100,000 units, employs over 2,800 people, owns its processes in\-house, and is praised by Fortune Magazine as the “Best Workplace for Women,” “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplaces for Diversity.” Powered by innovation and a can\-do attitude, BH improves daily, striving to construct a smarter way to live, invest, manage, and grow. BH is passionate about setting the standard in the multifamily industry. We are a welcoming band of go\-getters who think big, sweat the details, and take our work (but never ourselves) too seriously. We set our sights high, own our mistakes, and turn lemons into lemonade. We are incredibly proud of where we’ve come and are ready to tackle what’s next. Come join us! **Pay range $130,000 \- $145,000 per year** JOB SUMMARY **Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** The Senior Backend Developer will be responsible for designing, building, and delivering highly performant, scalable services and customer experiences using backend technologies on Amazon Web Services (AWS). The environment is fast paced and time to market of applications is critical to the success of the organization. This position will be part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to delivering applications for high\-quality, on\-time software releases leveraging best\-of\-breed agile and DevOps practices with a focus on how to enable the operations of those applications through a combination of infrastructure solutioning, continuous delivery \& integration, and efficient system sustainment planning. This role is responsible for working with our architects and peer developers on technical design of cloud and digital platforms, including hands\-on full stack development (80% backend, 20% frontend). The developer must have a passion for developing and launching robust scalable products that are business and customer facing. This position should have a full understanding of the tools, platforms and technologies used to develop exceptional applications. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS * Hands\-on development across a variety of technologies and platforms * Build highly performant, scalable, cloud\-native microservices\-based applications using technologies like AWS Serverless, Kubernetes, Docker, Node.js, TypeScript, Key\-Value Stores, and MongoDB * Evaluate new technology for inclusion in our stack * Develop proof\-of\-concept projects to validate new architectures and solutions * Support the refactoring and re\-architecting of existing software * Work jointly with other developers to identify and create common reusable components * Drive technical consolidation and reduction of duplicate effort across projects * The candidate should have a strong understanding of agile software development and how that impacts the operations of software; and must participate in strategy discussion with all levels of management and business sponsors * Work closely with architects, engineering manager and other senior developers to understand the technology roadmap and assist in enforcing the enterprise architecture standards * Support testing \& deployment cycles, including working with project managers to coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and gathering feedback from pre\-release testers. * Log, track, and manage issues, bugs, and enhancement/ features requests logged in JIRA. * Participate in software release and post\-release activities, including developing designs for proof of concepts. * Capture, mitigate and /or escalate risks \& issues in a timely fashion * Ensure development standards and consistency of specifications across sub\-systems * Write and/or review deliverables, solution blueprints, and architecture documentation QUALIFICATIONS * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent engineering field * 6 \- 8 years of solid development experience in building internet\-scale web / mobile applications and public APIs * Expertise in designing highly\-scalable and performant micro\-services and storage layers using common frameworks, languages, and cloud infrastructure – using NodeJS frameworks, TypeScript, AWS Serverless, MongoDB * Experience in building Microservices \& REST APIs with focus on System Design and Integration * Good understanding of Public Cloud Services preferably AWS * Good Python, SQL and NoSQL skills * Prior experience in React, React Native, GraphQL or Salesforce platform is preferred * Experience with entire software development lifecycle (Agile, SDLC, Iterative) * Hands on experience with the different CICD tools – Jenkins, Github / BitBucket, Dockers, Containers, Build and Deploy tools * Strong communication skills (both verbal and written) and ability to communicate effectively with business owners * Strong analytical, problem\-solving skills and ability to abstract functional requirements * Flexibility and positive attitude to achieve tight deadlines * Rapidly adapt and respond to changes in environment and priorities * Ability to work creatively, propose ideas and contribute to working groups **BH is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.**

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** The Security Engineer is the primary technical owner of information security at Buske Lines Inc. and the Company’s point of accountability for its Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP). Reporting to the VP of Technology, this position designs, implements, and independently validates the safeguards protecting the Company’s network, endpoints, identities, data, and cloud services across all operating sites, and demonstrates measurable compliance with the Buske CIS Framework and the cybersecurity reporting requirements of the Company’s private equity sponsor. Several core security platforms are operated by the MSSP rather than by the Company. A defining requirement of this role is therefore the ability to govern security outcomes through contracted reporting and evidence — specifying what the provider must report, auditing what is delivered, and proving it accurate — rather than through direct console administration alone. The position works in close partnership with the Network Engineer on perimeter and infrastructure security, and coordinates with the Director of IT, IT Project Manager, IT Support Specialist, Data Engineer, and Human Resources. This position reports to the VP of Technology, who is responsible for cybersecurity reporting and escalation to the Company’s private equity sponsor. In the absence of the VP of Technology, this position reports and escalates directly to the sponsor. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * **MSSP oversight.** Serve as primary technical liaison to the MSP/MSSP/CSP; own escalation, issue tracking, and quarterly reviews of performance against contracted service levels. * **Security reporting requirements.** Define the security reporting the provider must deliver — content, level of detail, and cadence — and ensure these obligations are contractual and carry forward through any provider transition. * **Audit of provider reporting.** Audit provider\-supplied reporting rather than accept it. Reconcile reported results against Company\-held sources of truth, sample\-test findings against underlying artifacts, and drive every unexplained variance to closure. * **Endpoint protection governance.** Govern the CrowdStrike EDR platform through contracted reporting and evidence; the Company does not hold direct console access. Verify sensor coverage against the asset inventory and Entra ID and Intune records, and review agent health, detection disposition, and all policy and exclusion changes each reporting cycle. * **Identity, email, and device security.** Working with the Director of IT and the IT Support Specialist, administer Microsoft Entra ID P2 conditional access and privileged identity management, Defender for Office 365 Plan 2, Intune compliance baselines, and FortiClient EMS; enforce least privilege and reduce standing administrative access. * **Network and perimeter security.** Partner with the Network Engineer on FortiGate policy design and rule base review, segmentation and DMZ initiatives, remote access validation, FortiManager standardization, and wireless, network access control, and IoT device isolation. * **Vulnerability management.** Set scope, risk\-based remediation priorities, and service levels for the provider\-operated vulnerability and patch management program; audit scan coverage and reported remediation against independent evidence, and drive open findings and exceptions to closure. * **Configuration and asset management.** Govern secure configuration baselines and maintain authoritative hardware and software asset inventories. * **Incident response.** Serve as technical incident commander for security events, leading containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident review, and ensuring High and Critical incidents meet the required one\-hour sponsor escalation through the VP of Technology. * **Business continuity.** Support disaster recovery validation, backup integrity testing, and restoration exercises. * **Compliance and audit.** Own the Buske CIS Framework roadmap and evidence library across all eighteen controls; prepare recurring cybersecurity reporting for the VP of Technology for delivery to the private equity sponsor; support audits, cyber insurance questionnaires, and customer security reviews. * **Third\-party risk.** Conduct vendor and third\-party security assessments and maintain the IT risk register. * **Security awareness.** Own security awareness policy and define campaign, training, and escalation requirements for the provider\-administered KnowBe4 program; audit completion and phishing\-failure reporting and drive remedial follow\-through. Support delivery of annual IT security training. * **Employee security communication.** Notify employees of emerging cyber risks — active phishing campaigns, scams, and threats relevant to the Company — in clear, practical terms; provide training on those risks; and serve as the point of contact for employee security questions, following each through to a resolution  n the Company’s artificial intelligence governance program — define acceptable use, data handling, and review requirements for AI tools; assess proposed AI services for security and data exposure risk before adoption; and monitor use across the business. * **Documentation and governance.** Maintain assigned security policies, procedures, and network and data flow documentation, and follow established change management and purchase approval processes. * Perform other duties as assigned by the VP of Technology. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. * Five or more years in information technology, including at least three years in a dedicated information security role. * Hands\-on production experience with next\-generation firewalls (Fortinet strongly preferred) and Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security administration. * Working knowledge of endpoint detection and response platforms (CrowdStrike preferred) sufficient to interpret, question, and audit provider\-supplied reporting. * Demonstrated experience managing or holding accountable a managed service or managed security service provider. * Working knowledge of a recognized control framework — CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or ISO/IEC 27001 — and of vulnerability management and incident handling. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce audit\-grade documentation and executive\-level reporting, to explain security risks clearly to non\-technical employees, and to work independently in a lean IT organization supporting distributed sites. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Transportation, logistics, warehousing, or third\-party logistics industry experience. * Private equity–backed portfolio company experience with sponsor\-level security reporting obligations. * Experience auditing vendor\-supplied security reporting, and prior participation in an MSP or MSSP transition. * FortiManager and FortiClient EMS administration; scripting proficiency (PowerShell, Python). * Demonstrated practice of tracking emerging threats and security technologies, and familiarity with AI governance or acceptable\-use frameworks. * **Certifications preferred:** CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GSEC or GCIH), CompTIA Security\+ or CySA\+, Microsoft SC\-200 or SC\-300, or Fortinet NSE 4 or above. **WORK ENVIRONMENT AND TRAVEL** This is a hybrid position performed primarily from a home office during standard business hours, with occasional on\-site presence at Company facilities as business needs require. Travel is expected to be minimal, though periodic visits to Buske Lines Inc. operating sites for assessments, deployments, or audit support are possible. After\-hours and weekend availability is required for security incidents, maintenance windows, and cutover events, including participation in an on\-call rotation. The position requires a reliable, private home work environment suitable for handling confidential Company information. Site visits may involve work in warehouse and equipment room environments and occasional handling of computing equipment. **ACKNOWLEDGMENT** I have received, read, and understand this job description. I acknowledge it describes the general nature and level of work assigned to this position and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Buske Lines Inc. reserves the right to revise this job description at any time. This document does not constitute an employment contract and does not alter the at\-will nature of employment. Pay: Up to $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Experience: * IT: 5 years (Required) * Information security: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Springfield, MO 65802

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer III, AI Products
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== **What we're building** ======================= We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start. Baker Tilly is the sixth\-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the screens practitioners use and the services behind them. You'll take well\-scoped features from frontend to production and learn from experienced engineers as you go. **What you'll work with** ========================= * Years of client engagement history, tax returns, and financial records, at the scale of a major firm. * Tax, audit, and advisory practitioners who help define what good looks like and review what the agents produce. * Real users inside the firm who give direct feedback on what you build. * We work in partnership with frontier labs. * A mix of building and buying. You'll help decide which is which, and everything we ship meets the same standards for security, tracing, and testing. * Our stack: Python, TypeScript and React, Databricks, graph and vector databases, MCP, OpenTelemetry, and Braintrust, on Azure. **What you'll do** ================== * Build features for our AI agents end to end: the screens practitioners use, the services behind them, and the data they read. * Build the tools our experts use to review agent output and flag what's wrong. * Work directly with practitioners to understand how they do their jobs, then turn that into software. * Connect to firm systems and data through APIs, with the right access controls. * Write tested, readable code. Review other people's code, and have yours reviewed. * Watch what you ship: tests, tracing, user feedback, and fixing what breaks. * Use AI coding tools extensively to build and ship, and check their work. We ship through a code factory more and more, and you'll help us get there. **Who you are** =============== * You're a hands\-on technologist who has built things people actually use, ideally end to end, from the first conversation with users through production and after. * You're naturally curious, a strong problem solver, and a clear communicator. * You can take an objective, form an opinion, and move things forward on your own, even when the path is unclear. **What you bring** ================== * 5 years of experience preferred building and shipping production software, on both frontend and backend. * You use AI coding tools extensively, and you have opinions about what works. * TypeScript or JavaScript with a modern frontend framework, plus a backend language like Python, Node, Go, or Java. * Comfort with APIs, relational databases, and common authentication patterns. * Solid habits: debugging, automated tests, version control, secure coding. * You ask who should see the data before you ask how to show it. * Bachelor's Degree required **Nice to have** ================ * React, Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, Databricks, containers, or CI/CD tooling. * Some exposure to LLM apps, retrieval, agents, or evals. No AI background needed. * Experience with enterprise systems, specialist business users, or regulated data. **In a year** ============= * You've shipped features practitioners use every week. * You've improved a real workflow, and you can show it with feedback or numbers. * You're taking on bigger pieces, and the team is better for having you. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employee*s. *The national pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* *In California: pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* \#LI\-AC1

Candidate will design, develop, test, and support scalable software solutions and AI\-powered applications. **Responsibilities:** * Codes solutions and unit test to deliver a requirement/story per the defined acceptance criteria and compliance requirements * Designs, develops, and modifies architecture components, application interfaces, and solution enablers while ensuring principal architecture integrity is maintained * Mentors other software engineers and coach team on Continuous Integration and Continuous Development (CI\-CD) practices and automating tool stack * Executes story refinement, definition of requirements, and estimating work necessary to realize a story through the delivery lifecycle * Performs spike/proof of concept as necessary to mitigate risk or implement new ideas * Automates manual release activities * Designs, develops, and maintains automated test suites
