jobs.title: Engineer - Embedded
jobs.description: ### **Description** Brivo SmartHome connects apartments and rental homes to the cloud. Our gateways are Linux\-based devices installed at each property. They control Z\-Wave door locks, thermostats, leak sensors and switches, and report to our cloud platform over MQTT. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will help design, develop, test, debug and release the software that runs on thousands of these gateways in the field. Our next\-generation gateway software is written in TypeScript on Node.js and runs on a custom embedded Linux image built with Yocto. You'll write application code on the device, and you'll learn the whole path: from a Yocto build, to a firmware update shipped to the fleet, to diagnosing problems on real gateways at real properties. You'll work with our cloud/backend engineers on the device\-to\-cloud messaging layer, with hardware and QA on validation, and with support teams when devices in the field need investigation. A senior engineer will mentor you and review your work closely.### **What You'll Do** * Spend most of your time writing clean, maintainable, well\-tested TypeScript/Node.js code for the gateway software * Support the full lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, release, over\-the\-air updates and support in the field * Work on device integrations, such as Z\-Wave locks, thermostats and sensors, and on the MQTT messaging that links gateways to the cloud * Help build and maintain our embedded Linux image (Yocto/BitBake), including packaging the Node.js application and its dependencies for ARM hardware * Investigate field issues using device logs (systemd/journald), remote diagnostics and fleet data, and turn what you find into fixes * Write Bash and Python tools for builds, testing, provisioning and diagnostics * Join code reviews, sprint planning and backlog grooming on an Agile team ### **About You** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field * 0–2 years of software experience. Internships, co\-ops, capstone projects and serious personal projects all count. * Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript, including asynchronous programming (Promises, async/await, event\-driven design) * Comfortable on the Linux command line, with some Bash scripting * Basic knowledge of data structures, algorithms and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP) * Familiar with Git * Clear written and spoken communication, and an eagerness to learn * Interest in hardware, IoT and how software behaves on real devices ### **Why work for Brivo?** Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. * *The Brivo Experience:* We thrive on in\-person collaboration and a "one\-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. * *Total Rewards:* We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company\-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work\-life balance. Individual compensation packages are based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location.### **About Brivo** Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises. As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure. With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com. *Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

jobs.title: Founding Harness Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build the runtime and evaluation systems behind an AI coworker for teams. In this founding role, you will help make tool\-using agents proactive when useful, careful when approval is needed, and dependable in real work. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and build the agent runtime, including how it gathers context, decides when to respond, selects tools, requests approval, and completes work. * Write and refine system prompts that encourage useful initiative without noisy or unsafe behavior. * Create evaluation and regression tests for real tasks, tool use, and failure cases, and use them to catch regressions from prompt changes. * Improve reliability across long\-running tasks, interruptions, and retries. * Implement safe execution boundaries, including approval gates and separation of multi\-tenant data. * Work directly with company leadership and early users to shape the product. ### **What We're Looking For** * Four or more years of relevant experience, including production deployment of tool\-using LLM agents, rather than demos or thin prompt wrappers. * Hands\-on system prompt design, iterated and improved through testing. * Experience building evaluation and regression test harnesses for LLM or agent behavior. * Practical experience with safe tool execution, approval gates, and multi\-user or multi\-tenant data separation. * Strong ownership across broad technical problems, from prototype through production, and the ability to explain tradeoffs. * Interest in a founding role and in\-person collaboration in San Francisco. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary up to $200,000, plus founding equity. Equity percentage and vesting details are to be confirmed. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, United States. Candidates should be in the Bay Area or willing to relocate. Compensation Range: $200K

jobs.title: Founding ML Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** As the first machine learning engineer on a founding team at an agricultural technology company, you will build the core insight engine for an operations platform serving growers. You will turn fragmented farm data into carefully evaluated models that help inform important operational decisions. ### **What You'll Do** * Audit and integrate historical data from farm systems, identifying useful signals and gaps. * Build machine learning tools for forecasting, performance analysis, and operational efficiency. * Develop backtesting and evaluation frameworks to validate model accuracy before deployment. * Create privacy\-first datasets that enable farms to benefit from pooled insights. * Collaborate with an agent engineer to present actionable insights through the product. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience, including ownership of meaningful projects and production ML models used to inform decisions. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience in pandas or Polars, scikit\-learn, gradient boosting, and forecasting libraries. * Experience with tabular or time\-series data, data pipelines, or tools that help explain model behavior. * Rigor in model evaluation, including awareness of data leakage, backtesting, and production readiness. * Ability to communicate model outputs and uncertainty to non\-technical stakeholders. * Regular use of AI tools and interest in combining LLMs and agents with classical machine learning. * Experience with large\-scale or messy startup data is useful. Agriculture, weather, supply chain, physical\-world forecasting, or privacy\-preserving data experience is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity vesting over four years with a one\-year cliff. Healthcare and work equipment are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must already have authorization to work in the United States. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week, with approximately one week of quarterly travel to farms in Washington, Oregon, and California. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage consumer AI company as its founding product engineer, with end\-to\-end ownership of a personal AI assistant. You will shape how the assistant reasons, communicates, and takes action, while building a thoughtful user experience across mobile and web. ### **What You'll Do** * Build the agent decision\-making system, including tool\-calling loops, memory, context assembly, prompts, and model routing. * Develop evaluation infrastructure with conversation replay, turn\-level assessments, and regression suites to guide releases. * Own product experiences from onboarding and first interactions through ongoing use, including group conversations and approval flows. * Ship features end to end, using experimentation and user feedback to improve product outcomes. * Build integrations with email, calendars, bookings, payments, and browser automation, with reliable recovery and user consent. * Review conversations and speak with users regularly to guide product decisions. * Set engineering standards and help grow the team while staying hands\-on. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 4 years of software engineering experience at an AI product company, AI lab, or consumer product company. * Production experience building agents with tool use, memory, and long\-running conversations, plus evaluation systems that inform release decisions. * Full\-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Postgres. * Experience with third\-party APIs, OAuth, or payments, and agent tools such as function calling, MCP servers, or browser automation. * A record of owning features end to end and demonstrating measurable product impact. * Strong product judgment, consumer UX experience, and familiarity with AI\-assisted development workflows. * Post\-training or fine\-tuning experience is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI company building cloud infrastructure and backend systems that turn robotics research into production\-ready products. This generalist role focuses primarily on backend engineering while also contributing to frontend experiences and shaping engineering practices across research, robotics, and product teams. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and deploy cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure using infrastructure as code and automated deployments. * Build serverless APIs, containerized services, background jobs, and event\-driven workflows, optimizing for latency, reliability, throughput, and cost. * Implement authentication, authorization, secrets management, API keys, OAuth/OIDC, role\-based access control, and tenant isolation. * Model and maintain relational databases, object storage, and caches, including indexing, migrations, backups, and recovery. * Build pipelines for sensor streams, 3D spatial data, telemetry, and model outputs, with edge\-to\-cloud connectivity. * Develop product foundations and web experiences for organizations, projects, devices, onboarding, configuration, and monitoring. * Establish CI/CD, automated testing, observability, security controls, and incident diagnostics. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 5 years of backend or full\-stack engineering experience building production systems, including experience taking an early\-stage product from concept to launch. * Backend development experience in Python, TypeScript, Go, or Rust, along with practical React and TypeScript experience owning features from API to UI. * Strong experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure; SQL and NoSQL databases; API design; infrastructure as code; containers; and deployment automation. * Experience shipping products end to end and making sound build, buy, and outsource decisions. * Background in AI/ML infrastructure, developer infrastructure, databases, robotics, autonomy, or spatial technology is relevant. Experience with multi\-cloud or hybrid deployments, ML inference, GPU workloads, or streaming systems is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $150,000 to $300,000 annually. ### **Location** Hybrid, San Francisco, California, United States. Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Mid-Level AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join the core product team at a growing AI SaaS company to build agentic systems that automate complex workflows across regulated and enterprise domains. You will work across the stack to deliver reliable, production\-ready AI services and user experiences. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and maintain agentic systems that automate multi\-step workflows across healthcare, legal, fintech, logistics, and compliance. * Build production retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines and retrieval infrastructure, including vector databases, embeddings, and indexing. * Implement multi\-agent orchestration, tool calling, memory, and reasoning components. * Develop evaluation and safety infrastructure to measure performance, detect regressions, and support reliable enterprise use. * Ship full\-stack AI products by designing APIs and data models, writing frontend and backend code, and operating production systems with CI/CD, monitoring, and testing. * Work with product and design partners to prioritize work, define success metrics, and iterate using user feedback and telemetry. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to eight years of software engineering experience delivering user\-facing or backend products. * Broad production AI and ML engineering experience, including deployment of LLM services, prompt design, orchestration, and tool integration. * Proficiency with Python and TypeScript/React or equivalent, plus cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP and relational or NoSQL databases. * Working knowledge of RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines. * Experience building automated tests, evaluations, and monitoring for production AI systems. * Experience with agent or workflow frameworks and orchestration tools, such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Temporal, or Trigger. * Experience designing API\-driven, high\-throughput systems and real\-time product features, with end\-to\-end ownership from data model through deployment and monitoring. * Enterprise or multi\-tenant system experience, or experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, or legal, is valuable. Familiarity with fine\-tuning or multimodal models is also useful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $150,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a founding\-stage team building AI tools for public safety and criminal investigations. As a senior technical contributor, you will develop secure, production\-grade systems that help investigative teams find and analyze evidence. ### **What You'll Do** * Build resilient, secure distributed systems for AI\-driven evidence search and analysis. * Deploy language models, vision models, and other machine learning systems in production. * Design retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines and semantic search infrastructure for unstructured data. * Architect structured data systems, including query planning and semantic reasoning layers. * Develop or work with agentic systems that reason, plan, and act across investigative data. * Evaluate emerging models and infrastructure approaches, and own solutions from design through deployment. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 6 years of backend engineering experience building distributed systems, including production deployment of LLMs, vision models, or other machine learning systems. * Strong skills across multiple programming languages, including Python; experience with JavaScript and React is useful. * Experience designing RAG or similar pipelines for unstructured data, and building structured data systems with query planning, semantic modeling, or reasoning. * Experience working with multiple infrastructure providers and designing for security and resilience. * Background spanning an established technology organization and an early\-stage startup, with ownership in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments. * Experience with agentic AI systems is a plus. * Must be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $150,000 to $215,000 annually. jobs.title: Software Engineer

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to spearhead the architecture and delivery of our next\-generation backend services. Operating as a dual\-mode operator, you will partner closely with product leaders to turn ambitious new ideas into reality while serving as a technical multiplier for engineering squads across our GCP and Java Spring/Python microservices mesh. If you have a ship\-first mindset and love building systems at scale for millions of users, we want to talk to you. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Who You Are:** * **A Next\-Gen Builder:** You thrive on taking raw concepts and translating them into modern, production\-grade microservices that comfortably support millions of users. * **A Dual\-Mode Operator:** You fluidly shift between two gears: prototyping 0\-to\-1 ideas alongside product leadership, and embedding with engineering teams to unblock, level up, and amplify their technical execution. * **High\-Agency \& Relentless:** You possess a bias toward action and a ship\-first mindset. You eliminate friction, navigate technical complexity, and make decisive moves to keep momentum high without sacrificing service reliability. * **A Service Mesh Specialist:** You understand distributed systems at scale. You know how to build, deploy, and observe services in a complex microservice mesh environment running on GCP. **Who We Are:** At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives. **What You'll Do:** Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a Staff Individual Contributor shaping the next generation of Castlight’s backend architecture. You will drive core service modernization, partner with product to bring high\-impact ideas to life, and elevate the performance of our microservice ecosystem. In this role, you will: * **Architect Next\-Gen Services:** Design, build, and deploy resilient, high\-scale microservices using Java Spring Boot and Python on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * **Drive Product Prototyping:** Partner directly with Product Managers to rapidly build out POCs, validate technical feasibility, and breathe life into brand\-new consumer health features. * **Amplify \& Empower Teams:** Embed across engineering squads to solve hard architectural problems, modernize legacy paths, and raise technical standards across the mesh. * **Ensure Scale \& High Availability:** Optimize microservice interactions, data access layers, and API performance to seamlessly support millions of active users. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * **Technical Experience:** 8\+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a proven track record of architecting distributed systems at scale. * **Core Stack Mastery:** Expert\-level capability in Java (Spring / Spring Boot) and/or Python, with hands\-on experience building scalable RESTful microservices and API\-driven architectures. * **Cloud \& Mesh Ecosystems:** Deep operational experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or equivalent major cloud provider, along with modern containerization and service mesh architectures. * **High\-Scale Systems:** Proven expertise in building low\-latency, fault\-tolerant backend services that process heavy traffic volumes for large user bases. * **Product Collaboration:** Exceptional ability to partner with product managers, turning fluid requirements into scalable engineering realities. * **Communication:** Clear, effective communicator who can explain complex architectural trade\-offs to business, product, and engineering teams alike. **What You'll Get:** * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. * **High Impact \& Autonomy:** Direct influence over the technical roadmap of next\-generation services powering millions of healthcare journeys. * **Growth \& Visibility:** Solve high\-scale backend challenges alongside cross\-functional leadership, acting as both an innovator and team force\-multiplier. * **Work That Matters:** Build systems where performance and uptime directly enable people to get the care and benefits they need. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $131,243\.00 to $196,865\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: Vice President, AI Delivery
jobs.description: **Location**: San Antonio, TX (on\-site). Reports to the CEO. ABOUT CENTAGE Centage is building the AI Finance Department: a managed\-service team that walks into the CFO's office at a $50M to $500M company, maps where finance time goes, ranks those hours by dollar value, and ships the first production workflow within 90 days. We start from a foundation most AI services firms don't have: more than 500 finance teams already run their close, budgets, forecasts, cash, consolidation, and board reporting on our FP\&A platform. Our promise to every customer is that we build agents that automate their finance workflows, governed so a controller can trace every number, secure enough for their auditor, and built to scale across their entities. The internal measure we care about most is time to value. THE ROLE You own the team that delivers the AI Finance Department to every customer we sign, and you report to the CEO. This is a player\-coach role: you set the standard, hire the team, and still ship the hardest deployment yourself when it matters. Your team includes applied AI architects who design each customer's agent workflows, forward\-deployed engineers who build them and connect them to the customer's ERP, HRIS, CRM, and data warehouse, DevSecOps engineers who keep them secure, observable, and audit\-ready, and implementation specialists who drive adoption inside the customer's close and forecast cycles. You own how we deliver: the playbook for Map, Rank, Build, Prove, the quality bar, and the monthly scorecard every customer sees. You also run the first conversation with every new CFO, sit in their quarterly reviews, and decide when a customer request breaks the standard and when it shows us a real gap. WHAT YOU INHERIT AND THE STACK On day one, you inherit a comprehensive FP\&A platform built specifically for mid\-market organizations. It handles the hardest parts of budgeting, forecasting, and reporting natively, including multi\-entity consolidation and workforce planning. Our customers are mainly in nonprofit, manufacturing, healthcare, retail, and education. You also inherit working connectors to the major mid\-market ERP, HRIS, payroll, CRM, and data warehouse systems. You're fluent across the frontier model families (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and know when an open\-weights model is the better choice for a cost\-sensitive step. You've built on modern agent frameworks and MCP. Here, you'll build and own the governed business context layer that every workflow draws from, bringing together each customer's ERP, CRM, HRIS, and industry\-specific data so agents answer from real records. Every agent output traces back to its source, every change to a customer's model needs a human approval, and every engagement produces a monthly scorecard the CFO signs. We run on AWS, and SOC 2 Type II, SSO, and full audit logging are the baseline. YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS There's no ramp\-up period. You're accountable for delivery from day one, and you stay hands\-on throughout, writing code and shipping agents yourself while you build the team around you. **By day 30**: ship weekly and build the harness. You ship agents to customers every week, starting in your first week. At the same time, you plan and start building a repeatable, secure, templated agentic harness: model routing, access to the context layer, guardrails, evals, human approvals, and audit logging. With it, each new engagement starts from a proven template instead of from scratch. By day 30, the plan is written and you're executing against it. **By day 60**: build the team. You hire the core delivery team: forward\-deployed engineers, an AI architect, and DevOps with security. You onboard them onto the harness so they ship on it from their first week, and you keep shipping yourself. **By day 90**: own the numbers. You have complete ownership of the service delivery metrics: time to value, cost to deliver, and customer delight. You report them to the CEO every month, and they're the scorecard you're measured against. **Requirements** WHAT YOU BRING * Deep, hands\-on applied AI. You know how to pick the right frontier model for each step, and how to design agents, skills, harnesses, and the loops and goals that keep them on track. You've shipped this in production, not just in a demo. * A business context layer. You've connected production systems such as ERPs, CRMs, HRIS, and industry\-specific platforms into one governed context layer that AI workflows can reliably draw from. * Data you can trust. You know how to source, store, and serve data so agents answer from real records instead of making things up, and so every access is governed and secured. * Infrastructure built for speed. You know how DevOps, security, and cloud infrastructure need to be set up so a customer sees value in weeks, not quarters. * Business acumen. You can sit with a CFO, find where the pain is, and tell which workflows are worth automating first. Team leadership. You've managed engineers, DevOps, security, and implementation specialists, and held them to a high bar. * Experience: 7\-8 years in technology, across engineering and services, ideally both. HOW YOU WORK * Extreme bias to action. You'd rather ship a working workflow and improve it than plan for one more month. * No jerks. Life is short. We want humble, confident people who win together and make everyone around them better. NICE TO HAVE * Finance background: FP\&A, controllership, accounting, or audit, with familiarity with ASC 606 and 842, SOX controls, and GAAP consolidation. * SOC 2 Type II: you've been the accountable operator through an audit. * CFO office experience: you've worked inside or for a mid\-market CFO office. YOU'RE PROBABLY NOT THE FIT IF * You've only shipped agents in demos or hackathons. * You need a long discovery phase before you build anything. * You'd rather stay out of the room with the CFO. * You're great at the work but hard to work with. **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and equity * Health, dental and vision insurance plans, including a flexible spending account option * Open paid time off policy, plus 9 paid holidays per year as listed in our Company Handbook * Participation in our 401(k) savings plan * Company\-paid life and AD\&D coverage * Educational materials and expenses to support continuing education

jobs.title: Senior Advanced AI Gameplay Designer
jobs.description: Senior Advanced AI Gameplay Designer Would you like to work on some of the greatest franchises in gaming history? What about working on our new original IP? Certain Affinity is a game development studio in Texas, based out of Austin, and we have a growing presence in Toronto, Canada. Our culture reflects the values and the vibrant nature of the cities we call home. This includes a commitment to evolution, diversity, excellence, and work\-life balance. We are also excited to be a recipient of the Canadian Studio of the Year award. We're best known for co\-developing numerous AAA FPS games, though now we are creating compelling new games of our own. We're always on the lookout for amazing talent to join our team. As an AI Gameplay Designer at Certain Affinity, you’ll own the design and implementation of enemy gameplay and encounter design for AAA action titles. You’ll prototype enemy archetypes, script their behaviors and combat abilities, and tune how they work together in encounters. You’ll work with the Lead Designer and Game Director to set goals for enemy combat and partner with engineering, animation, and level design to take enemies from first playable through ship. Responsibilities* Work with design leadership to define enemy combat goals and own the design and implementation of assigned enemy archetypes and encounters from prototype through polish. * Design, document, script, and tune enemy behaviors and combat abilities in partnership with engineering, animation, and level design. * Maintain and extend existing AI gameplay systems. Debug enemy behavior in\-editor and work with engineering to resolve underlying issues. * Build and tune encounters around enemy composition, placement, and pacing. Make enemy roles and attacks readable so players can recognize threats and respond under pressure. * Run focused playtests of enemies and encounters, diagnose what’s driving player frustration or confusion, and iterate based on player and QA feedback. Requirements* 6 or more years of professional experience in gameplay design, technical design, or gameplay scripting. * Experience with scripting or programming languages (C\+\+, LUA, Python, etc.) as well as visual scripting languages (Blueprint, etc.) * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing enemy behaviors, combat abilities, or encounters on at least one shipped game. * Experience working in Unreal 5\. * Experience implementing and debugging AI for human and non\-human enemy archetypes using tools such as behavior trees, action planners, finite state machines (FSMs), or Unreal’s Environment Query System (EQS). * Experience building, debugging, and tuning gameplay in a game editor such as Unreal Editor. * Ability to dissect and understand core gameplay and mechanics and then implement and improve them. * Ability to manage your own work, meet deadlines, and communicate tradeoffs early as priorities change. Extra Credit* Experience taking enemy gameplay or encounters from prototype through ship on a AAA title. * Player character or 3C (character, camera \& controls) design experience. * Extensive experience playing shooters and action games such as Call of Duty, Halo, Left 4 Dead, or Warframe. * Experience in level design and construction. * Degree from an accredited four\-year college or university in a related field. Certain Affinity or its partners or affiliates run background checks on candidates or employees with written authorization from the candidates or employees. These may be done to offer employment or determine eligibility to work on a specific project. Multiple searches may be required. Certain Affinity is authorized to do business in many, but not all, of the states in the US and the Canadian provinces. If you are not located in or able to work from a state where Certain Affinity is registered, you may not be eligible for employment as a fully remote employee. Please speak with your recruiter to learn more about where we are registered. a0FHDALoI8

jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/29/2026 Meet the Team The Cisco 8000 Layer 3 Forwarding team develops the IOS XR software that powers packet forwarding on Cisco Silicon One, Cisco’s family of high\-performance networking ASICs. As part of Cisco’s Distributed Systems Engineering (DSE) organization, we build scalable, high\-performance routing platforms for service providers and hyperscale networks, supporting the growing demands of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML workloads. Our work connects routing decisions to hardware forwarding behavior—from programming routes and next hops to optimizing forwarding scale, performance, and reliability. We collaborate closely with routing control plane teams to translate routing information into hardware forwarding entries, and with Cisco’s Silicon One ASIC and SDK engineering teams to program the network processors using their software development kit (SDK). These partnerships put our team at the intersection of routing software and networking hardware. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, from design and implementation to validation and production troubleshooting. Join a team where your work directly shapes how some of the world’s largest networks move traffic. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelors \+ 7 years of related experience OR Masters \+ 4 years of related experience OR PhD \+1 years of related experience. * Experience in all phases of SW development cycle with some exposure to agile development methodologies * Experience programming in C, C\+\+ or Python * Development Experience with Network routing protocols * Experience using AI tools to improve engineering productivity such as optimizing complex routing protocols and reducing latency. Preferred Qualifications * Familiarity with Linux and modern software tools like GDB, VTune, Valgrind, Perf etc. for development and debugging. * Deep understanding of L2/L3 to L7 technologies like OSPF, ISIS, BGP, BFD, MPLS technologies. * Familiarity with VMs and virtualization technologies. * Automation experience with Python, Tcl, REST, Jenkins. jobs.title: Senior Staff GIS Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation \& Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia \- increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. **Job Description** The Philadelphia Water Department (PWD) serves the greater Philadelphia region by providing integrated water, wastewater, and stormwater services. This position supports GIS operations and analytics of PWD, and reports to the GIS Manager. The Staff GIS Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design and development of internal GIS applications that support the design, operation, and maintenance of Philadelphia's drinking water, wastewater, and green stormwater infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can own systems end\-to\-end, from architecture and data modeling through frontend implementation, deployment, and long\-term maintenance. You'll work at the intersection of GIS, software engineering, and database design, building tools that engineering and operations staff depend on every day. The bulk of the role is greenfield development of modern applications that replace aging systems, with the rest spent keeping existing tools reliable, automating GIS editing workflows, and investing in the development practices that make all of it sustainable. A core part of new application work is partnering directly with the many civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers across PWD to understand their work processes and design tools that fit what their needs. You'll work alongside a team of several GIS professionals and editors who maintain the datasets your applications display. **Essential Functions** * Developing new applications and API’s on modern tech stacks to replace legacy ones. Primarily with C\#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server for backend, and JavaScript/TypeScript, React and the Esri ArcGIS Maps SDK for frontend. * Design and maintain a document management system for over 340,000 georeferenced engineering drawings. * Maintaining legacy Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework applications. * ArcGIS Pro Add\-in/extension development using C\# and the ArcGIS Pro .NET SDK to automate common workflows for GIS editors. * Implementing modern DevOps; CI/CD pipelines and other best practices to support application development, testing, and long\-term maintenance. * Direct collaboration with civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers, city planners, and field operations staff to gather requirements, validate designs, and iterate on tools that fit their needs. * Python GIS data processing and alerting scripts. * Directs the work of a junior level software engineer **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. **Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Significant professional experience building and shipping production software, with strong full\-stack range across C\#/.NET on the backend and React \+ TypeScript on the frontend. * Demonstrated ability to design and build polished, maintainable frontend applications — component architecture, state management, type safety, and an eye for UX. * Experience with web mapping development using the Esri JavaScript API (or comparable mapping libraries) and a solid grasp of how spatial data flows from server to browser. * Deep familiarity with SQL Server, including schema design, performance tuning, and permissions. * Strong working knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem and the data systems built around it. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and the practices around them — automated builds, deployments, environment promotion, and release management. * Comfort working directly with non\-developer subject matter experts (engineers, GIS editors, operations staff) to elicit requirements and shape the design of new applications. * Willingness to maintain and incrementally improve legacy systems — including older Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework codebases — while charting a path toward replacing them. * A track record of making pragmatic architectural decisions and avoiding unnecessary complexity. * Strong communication skills, especially around documenting decisions and explaining tradeoffs to non\-developers. **Preferred Skills:** * ArcGIS Enterprise 10\.6 and later * Experience with ArcGIS Pro SDK development. * SQL Server * Windows Server, IIS 10 * Experience as a user of of ArcMap and ArcGIS Pro * Python experience, particularly for GIS data processing and ETL work. Background in utility, municipal, civil engineering, or infrastructure data systems. * **Additional Information** **Salary cannot exceed $110,000** **We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply.** **Please include:** * Resume * A cover letter **Please note: Applications will not be considered without a cover letter.** Did you know? * We are a Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program qualified employer : 25% tuition discount program for City employees (and sometimes spouses and dependents as well) in partnership with area colleges and universities * We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan * Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays * Generous retirement savings options are available **\*The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire** Effective May 22, 2023, vaccinations are **no longer required** for new employees that work in non\-medical, non\-emergency or patient facing positions with the City of Philadelphia. As a result, only employees in positions providing services that are patient\-facing medical care (ex: Nurses, doctors, emergency medical personnel), must be fully vaccinated. The City of Philadelphia is an Equal Opportunity employer and does not permit discrimination based on race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, source of income, familial status, genetic information or domestic or sexual violence victim status. For more information, go to: Human Relations Website: http://www.phila.gov/humanrelations/Pages/default.aspx

jobs.title: Development Manager
jobs.description: **Development Manager** * **Location:** Chicago, Illinois \| Hybrid * **Position Type:** Full\-time individual contributor role with no direct reports * **Salary:** $70,000–$78,000 annually * **Reports to:** Development Director * **Anticipated Start:** Early 2027 **About Code Platoon:** Code Platoon began in a Chicago classroom with nine Veterans in 2016 and has grown into a nationally recognized, military\-specific pathway into AI and software engineering. We serve Veterans, active duty Servicemembers, military spouses, and adult children of Veterans and Servicemembers through AI \+ Full\-Stack Engineering and AI Cloud and DevOps Engineering training—remotely or in person, full\-time or evenings and weekends. No computer science degree is required. With mentors, volunteers, and employer partners, Career Services supports students from enrollment through placement and beyond. We build on the talent, expertise, and lived experience the military\-connected community brings to the technology workforce. **Our Values** * . We recognize the strengths, perspectives, and lived experience our students bring, and expand access to career pathways that build on those assets. * We meet people where they are, regardless of branch, role, family connection, or route into tech. * . Students succeed together, and so do our teams—across departments, sharing information and credit. * . Graduates, mentors, volunteers, funders, and employers stay connected beyond a cohort. * . Philanthropy expands access to rigorous technology training and long\-term economic mobility for students and families. **Our Team** Development is a three\-person team. The Director of Development leads strategy, institutional grant writing, and major gift solicitation. The Development Manager manages institutional and individual donor relationships, LOI \& proposal submissions, and prospect development. The Projects Manager leads HubSpot, donor segmentation, CRM infrastructure, and supports research content development. Together with Career Services, Programs, Marketing, Finance, the Executive Director, and our board, the Development team stewards institutional grants and reporting, corporate partnerships and grows workplace giving, individual and major gifts, and produces ‘Celebrate Code Platoon’, our annual event. **Our 2027 development plan establishes four priorities:** * . Retain and deepen institutional renewals, re\-engage lapsed funders, and cultivate new foundation and public\-sector investment. * . Grow recurring and major gifts and deepen relationships with supporters beyond our annual event. * . Connect philanthropy, workplace giving, sponsorships, and employee engagement with employer partnerships and talent acquisition priorities, alongside Career Services. * . Use HubSpot for coordinated moves management, cultivation, stewardship, and continuity across relationships. **The Role** The Development Manager is a fundraising professional who manages relationships across the donor lifecycle—from prospect qualification and cultivation through solicitation and stewardship—and represents Code Platoon across Chicago's philanthropic, corporate, and Veteran\-serving communities. This is an opportunity to implement an established 2027 development plan while contributing ideas and judgment that strengthen how the team works. Much of the portfolio is already in place: renewing institutional funders, corporate partners who hire and volunteer with us, lapsed funders, and supporters introduced through the board, leadership, and Celebrate. The Development Manager advances these relationships through intentional cultivation and stewardship, opens new opportunities alongside the Projects Manager, and maintains contact reports, relationship strategies, and next steps in HubSpot. About 70 percent of the role is development, reporting to the Director of Development, and 30 percent is employer engagement and workforce partnership development, with a dotted line to the Director of Career Services. Within development, most work is institutional and individual giving with an emphasis on cultivation of new relationships and stewardship of existing supporters across the full lifecycle. A corporate relationship may involve grant making, workplace giving, mentoring, and/or hiring. Similarly, an individual donor may also be an event supporter, as well as engage via volunteer activations. The Development Manager recognizes those intersections, coordinates engagement cross\-functionally, and collaborates closely with primary relationship holders to steward donors and funders across portfolios. Our annual cycle moves from new proposals, letters of inquiry, and individual donor cultivation (January through mid\-spring), to institutional renewals and reports (late spring through summer), to Celebrate Code Platoon, year\-end giving, stewardship, and year\-end planning (fall). **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Institutional \& Individual Giving (70%)** ***Portfolio an s supplant critical thinking and professional expertise. **Required** \[*Relational Judgement*]: * Initiative, discernment, and comfort navigating ambiguity and unique dynamics in a small, evolving nonprofit environment while collaborating cross\-functionally. * Confidence representing an organization with corporate leaders, funders, donors, and community partners, and strong written and verbal communication. * Sound judgment, discretion with confidential donor information, and a commitment to ethical fundraising best practices. * A growth mindset and a partner approach to cross\-functional collaboration, with a commitment to continued professional learning, elevating peers, and shared successes. **Preferred** * A four\-year college degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience. * Experience developing and stewarding integrated corporate partnerships spanning philanthropic investment, employee engagement, and talent acquisition or workforce development. * Experience in workforce development, education, or Veteran\-serving organizations. * Knowledge of Chicago's corporate and philanthropic community. * HubSpot experience. * Lived experience of military service or military\-connected family life, or meaningful professional or community engagement with Veterans and military\-connected communities. *We welcome candidates from many backgrounds and career paths. If your experience aligns with the responsibilities of this position, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification.* **Compensation \& Benefits** The salary range for this position is $70,000–$78,000 annually. Benefits include: * Employer\-subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited paid time off * A dedicated annual professional development budget for continuing education, conferences, training, and professional certifications * A 403(b) tax\-deferred savings plan * Reimbursement for local work travel * A hybrid schedule with time for independent and collaborative work **Work Environment** Most of the Code Platoon team works remotely. jobs.title: Development Manager
jobs.description: Join the Mission **Be Part of a Team that Changes Lives** ======================================== We’re seeking passionate individuals ready to transform lives. Explore and be part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to guiding Veterans and military families into successful tech careers. We’re always looking for talented individuals to join our team. ###### **Development Manager** * **Location:** Chicago, Illinois \| Hybrid * **Position Type:** Full\-time individual contributor role with no direct reports * **Salary:** $70,000–$78,000 annually * **Reports to:** Development Director * **Anticipated Start:** Early 2027 **About Code Platoon:** ----------------------- Code Platoon began in a Chicago classroom with nine Veterans in 2016 and has grown into a nationally recognized, military\-specific pathway into AI and software engineering. We serve Veterans, active duty Servicemembers, military spouses, and adult children of Veterans and Servicemembers through AI \+ Full\-Stack Engineering and AI Cloud and DevOps Engineering training—remotely or in person, full\-time or evenings and weekends. No computer science degree is required. With mentors, volunteers, and employer partners, Career Services supports students from enrollment through placement and beyond. We build on the talent, expertise, and lived experience the military\-connected community brings to the technology workforce. **Our Values** -------------- * Mission first. We recognize the strengths, perspectives, and lived experience our students bring, and expand access to career pathways that build on those assets. * No wrong door. We meet people where they are, regardless of branch, role, family connection, or route into tech. * Collaboration over competition. Students succeed together, and so do our teams—across departments, sharing information and credit. * Community for the long term. Graduates, mentors, volunteers, funders, and employers stay connected beyond a cohort. * Access and economic mobility. Philanthropy expands access to rigorous technology training and long\-term economic mobility for students and families. **Our Team** ------------ Development is a three\-person team. The Director of Development leads strategy, institutional grant writing, and major gift solicitation. The Development Manager manages institutional and individual donor relationships, LOI \& proposal submissions, and prospect development. The Projects Manager leads HubSpot, donor segmentation, CRM infrastructure, and supports research content development. Together with Career Services, Programs, Marketing, Finance, the Executive Director, and our board, the Development team stewards institutional grants and reporting, corporate partnerships and grows workplace giving, individual and major gifts, and produces ‘Celebrate Code Platoon’, our annual event. **Our 2027 development plan establishes four priorities:** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Diversified institutional support. Retain and deepen institutional renewals, re\-engage lapsed funders, and cultivate new foundation and public\-sector investment. * Year\-round individual giving. Grow recurring and major gifts and deepen relationships with supporters beyond our annual event. * Integrated corporate partnerships. Connect philanthropy, workplace giving, sponsorships, and employee engagement with employer partnerships and talent acquisition priorities, alongside Career Services. * Relationship\-centered systems. Use HubSpot for coordinated moves management, cultivation, stewardship, and continuity across relationships. **The Role** ------------ The Development Manager is a fundraising professional who manages relationships across the donor lifecycle—from prospect qualification and cultivation through solicitation and stewardship—and represents Code Platoon across Chicago's philanthropic, corporate, and Veteran\-serving communities. This is an opportunity to implement an established 2027 development plan while contributing ideas and judgment that strengthen how the team works. Much of the portfolio is already in place: renewing institutional funders, corporate partners who hire and volunteer with us, lapsed funders, and supporters introduced through the board, leadership, and Celebrate. The Development Manager advances these relationships through intentional cultivation and stewardship, opens new opportunities alongside the Projects Manager, and maintains contact reports, relationship strategies, and next steps in HubSpot. About 70 percent of the role is development, reporting to the Director of Development, and 30 percent is employer engagement and workforce partnership development, with a dotted line to the Director of Career Services. Within development, most work is institutional and individual giving with an emphasis on cultivation of new relationships and stewardship of existing supporters across the full lifecycle. A corporate relationship may involve grant making, workplace giving, mento mall, evolving nonprofit environment while collaborating cross\-functionally. * Confidence representing an organization with corporate leaders, funders, donors, and community partners, and strong written and verbal communication. * Sound judgment, discretion with confidential donor information, and a commitment to ethical fundraising best practices. * A growth mindset and a partner approach to cross\-functional collaboration, with a commitment to continued professional learning, elevating peers, and shared successes. **Preferred** ------------- * A four\-year college degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience. * Experience developing and stewarding integrated corporate partnerships spanning philanthropic investment, employee engagement, and talent acquisition or workforce development. * Experience in workforce development, education, or Veteran\-serving organizations. * Knowledge of Chicago's corporate and philanthropic community. * HubSpot experience. * Lived experience of military service or military\-connected family life, or meaningful professional or community engagement with Veterans and military\-connected communities. *We welcome candidates from many backgrounds and career paths. If your experience aligns with the responsibilities of this position, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification.* **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The salary range for this position is $70,000–$78,000 annually. Benefits include: * Employer\-subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited paid time off * A dedicated annual professional development budget for continuing education, conferences, training, and professional certifications * A 403(b) tax\-deferred savings plan * Reimbursement for local work travel * A hybrid schedule with time for independent and collaborative work **Work Environment** -------------------- Most of the Code Platoon team works remotely. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Data
jobs.description: Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business. **Job Description** =================== Location: New York, NY Condé Nast is one of the world’s most renowned media companies, creating and distributing content across print, video, film, digital, audio, and social platforms. Our portfolio includes iconic brands such as Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Glamour, AD, Vanity Fair, and WIRED, among many others. Our award\-winning content reaches audiences around the world through a broad portfolio of consumer experiences and platforms. We are a privately owned company headquartered in New York, with a significant business and leadership presence in London. We operate across 32 markets, with additional countries served by local license partners. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for a **Principal Engineer – Data** to shape the technical direction and evolution of the data ecosystem supporting our consumer products and business capabilities. As a senior technical leader, you will define architectural direction, establish engineering standards, influence technology decisions across teams, and mentor engineers while remaining hands\-on in the design, development, and operation of critical data systems. This role requires broad technical expertise across the data ecosystem, including event collection, streaming, data processing, transformation, modeling, governance, trusted metrics, and AI\-enabled analytics. You will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, privacy, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable, reliable, secure, and cost\-effective data capabilities. Success in this role means building and evolving a data ecosystem that is reliable, understandable, governed, compliant, and accessible, enabling trusted decisions across product, content, audience, subscriptions, and advertising. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ **Technical Leadership \& Architecture** * Define and drive the technical direction of our data ecosystem, establishing scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectural patterns across data engineering teams. * Lead the design and evolution of data solutions built on Databricks and related technologies, making informed tradeoffs across performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and cost. * Provide architectural guidance across the data lifecycle, including event collection, ingestion, streaming, transformation, storage, modeling, and consumption. * Identify systemic technical challenges, evaluate emerging technologies, and drive architectural improvements that support long\-term business and engineering objectives. * Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, and technical best practices that improve consistency, development efficiency, and operational excellence. **Hands\-on Engineering \& Reliability** * Remain actively involved in data engineering delivery, writing and reviewing production SQL, Python, PySpark, and dbt code, prototyping solutions, and helping resolve complex technical challenges. * Drive data engineering excellence through robust data contracts, schema evolution practices, automated testing, lineage, and observability. * Leverage Monte Carlo and related capabilities to improve data reliability, detect issues proactively, assess downstream impact, and implement sustainable solutions. * Guide performance optimization, resource utilization, and cost\-efficiency initiatives across data processing and storage workloads. * Promote operational excellence through monitoring, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of critical data systems. **Data Modeling, Governance \& Consumer Data** * Guide the design of scalable data models, including dimensional modeling and reusable data products that support analytics, reporting, and operational use cases. * Establish consistent, governed KPI definitions and trusted datasets that enable reliable measurement of audience, engagement, conversion, retention, and other business outcomes. * Define and promote engineering practices for handling personally identifiable information (PII), including classification, access controls, consent\-aware thon, and dbt, including the development and optimization of batch and streaming data pipelines. * Strong architectural expertise across modern data ecosystems, including ingestion, event\-driven systems, distributed processing, transformation, modeling, and data consumption. * Experience designing Kafka\-based or comparable event\-driven architectures and working with event tracking platforms such as Snowplow, RudderStack, or Segment. * Strong command of dimensional modeling and the ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into well\-defined, reusable datasets, metrics, and data products. * Proven experience implementing data governance and privacy controls, including PII protection, access management, data retention, and secure data processing. * Demonstrated ability to improve data reliability through automated testing, monitoring, observability, incident management, and clear ownership of critical datasets. * Proven Principal\-level technical leadership, including defining architectural direction, influencing multiple teams, driving technical alignment, and delivering complex engineering initiatives. * Ability to communicate architectural tradeoffs effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, connecting engineering decisions to business outcomes. Practical experience applying LLMs, AI agents, or AI\-assisted development practices to engineering or analytical workflows, with an understanding of evaluation, governance, and human oversight. * **Relevant data modeling experience** ------------------------------------- You should be able to explain data models you have built for comparable consumer journeys and how you would apply them to a digital publishing business. Examples include: * **Content and consumption:** Dimensions for articles, authors, topics, brands, and content formats; fact tables for page or screen views, sessions, video plays, and content engagement. Measures may include engaged time, scroll depth, recirculation, and completion. * **Consumer identity and lifecycle:** Models that connect anonymous activity, registration, and subscription status across devices while respecting consent and keeping PII appropriately protected. * **Acquisition and subscriptions:** Models for referral sources and campaigns, registration and paywall funnels, subscription starts, renewals, cancellations, and retention. * **Advertising:** Models for ad inventory, placements, campaigns, impressions, viewability, clicks, and revenue. * **Shared metrics:** Curated models and definitions for reach, active audience, engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue that remain consistent across brands and platforms. **Especially Valuable** ----------------------- * Experience in digital publishing, media, or other consumer\-facing industries, including audience development, content performance, subscriptions, or advertising measurement. * Experience establishing semantic layers, self\-service analytics capabilities, or shared metric definitions across multiple teams. * Experience defining technical strategies or leading architectural transformations across large\-scale data platforms. Experience improving data platform cost efficiency, performance, and operational scalability. * *The expected base salary range for this position is from $190k \- $210k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.* **What happens next?** ====================== If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile. ***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

We're looking for a Software Engineer II to help build and scale backend systems that power commerce initiatives, including styling and product recommendations, catalog, inventory, and order infrastructure, built to serve multiple brands, not just one. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers across the org to build systems that are fast, reliable, and designed for reuse and scale across Condé Nast's diverse editorial and commerce properties. **Key Qualifications** ---------------------- * 3\+ years building production backend systems, ideally with some exposure to e\-commerce, retail, or content\-commerce platforms * Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript/JavaScript, with a track record of designing services that hold up under real user traffic, including seasonal or campaign\-driven spikes * Experience building REST or GraphQL APIs that serve both internal teams (editorial, styling, merchandising) and external partners (retail affiliates, payment providers, product data feeds) * Familiarity with event\-driven systems (Kafka, SQS, EventBridge) for things like inventory sync, price updates, order status, and affiliate commerce events * Working knowledge of relational and NoSQL systems (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) * Basic fluency in React, enough to collaborate closely with frontend engineers building shoppable articles, styling widgets, and product carousels * Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design, applied pragmatically rather than academically * Comfortable working across the full development lifecycle, from version control and code review to automated testing and CI/CD deployment. * A collaborative streak: you'll be pairing with product, editorial, and design stakeholders across multiple brands, each with its own voice and priorities AI\-native mindset. Engaging over a billion consumers through its cutting\-edge print, digital, and video brands, the portfolio proudly features some of the most iconic titles in the media landscape, including Architectural Digest, Bon Appétit, Condé Nast Traveler, GQ, Pitchfork, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, Vogue, and WIRED. Consistently delivering excellence, Condé Nast extends its influence across 32 markets worldwide, with headquarters in both London and New York, embodying a commitment to quality and innovation. **About Condé Nast Technology** Condé Nast Technology builds the products, systems, and experiences that power our brands. We’re a global team of designers, engineers, product managers, and researchers dedicated to creating innovative, user\-centric products that enable world\-class storytelling and digital experiences. You’ll be part of a talented international team working across London, New York, and ten other markets, collaborating daily with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, UX, and Data. jobs.title: DAS Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Connectivity Solutions Inc. (CSI) is seeking an experienced **DAS Commissioning Engineer** to join our RF Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have direct, hands\-on experience commissioning, integrating, configuring, optimizing, and troubleshooting Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS) from major manufacturers, including **JMA Wireless, Andrew/CommScope, Corning, SOLiD, and Nextivity (CEL\-FI).** Candidates must have demonstrated commissioning experience with at least one of these manufacturers. Experience with multiple DAS platforms is highly desirable but not required. This position is primarily focused on the technical commissioning, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and operational performance of commercial cellular and public safety DAS installations. We are looking for an individual who understands DAS architecture, can work directly with manufacturer\-specific commissioning software, diagnose complex RF and equipment issues, and independently support system turn\-up and acceptance activities. Additional experience in RF engineering, iBwave design, RF benchmarking, system optimization, and wireless network technologies is a significant advantage. The successful candidate will support projects throughout Northern Virginia, Washington, DC, Maryland, and occasionally other locations as project requirements dictate. **Primary Responsibilities – DAS Commissioning \& Integration** * Perform hands\-on commissioning, integration, configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting of commercial cellular and public safety DAS systems. * Commission DAS equipment manufactured by JMA Wireless, Andrew/CommScope, Corning, SOLiD, Nextivity (CEL\-FI), and other major OEMs, as qualified. * Configure and commission DAS head\-end equipment, master units, remote units, and associated RF distribution components. * Perform system initialization, software configuration, firmware updates, equipment provisioning, alarm verification, and operational testing. * Configure and verify uplink/downlink RF power levels, gain settings, attenuation, and system balancing. * Troubleshoot RF performance issues, equipment communication failures, optical connectivity problems, system alarms, and equipment malfunctions. * Support carrier integrations, Baseband Unit (BBU) connections, RF source configurations, and system turn\-up activities. * Perform RF power measurements and validate system performance against engineering designs, manufacturer specifications, and carrier requirements. * Conduct commissioning acceptance testing, equipment verification, and system performance validation. * Prepare commissioning reports, test results, system documentation, and technical closeout packages. * Coordinate directly with wireless carriers, OEM technical support teams, project managers, and field installation personnel. * Support ongoing DAS maintenance, equipment replacements, system upgrades, emergency troubleshooting, and service restoration. * Identify installation deficiencies, equipment configuration issues, and potential system performance concerns before final acceptance. * Work independently or alongside field technicians and project managers to ensure successful project delivery. **Additional Responsibilities – RF Engineering \& Design** While the primary focus of this position is DAS commissioning, candidates with additional RF engineering experience will be strongly considered. Additional responsibilities may include: * Conduct RF benchmarking, site surveys, and coverage evaluations for commercial wireless operators, including AT\&T, Verizon, and T\-Mobile. * Utilize iBwave Design software to develop, review, modify, and optimize DAS designs. * Perform Continuous Wave (CW) testing to validate RF propagation, path loss, and system design assumptions. * Conduct RF performance surveys and post\-installation testing using tools such as TEMS, QualiPoc, WINd, and other RF data collection platforms. * Perform cable sweeps, return loss, insertion loss, Distance to Fault (DTF), VSWR, and Passive Intermodulation (PIM) testing. * Develop, review, and validate RF link budgets for commercial cellular and public safety DAS applications. * Review engineering drawings, equipment specifications, installation packages, and system documentation. * Support pre\-sales engineering evaluations, feasibility studies, constructability assessments, and customer site walks. * Assist with RF design modifications, equipment selection, and technical project planning. * Support fiber\-optic testing and troubleshooting associated with DAS transport and distribution networks. * Assist with public safety DAS testing, commissioning, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) acceptance requirements. * Collaborate with project managers and field teams to identify and resolve technical challenges during system deployment. **Required Qualifications** **Direct DAS commissioning experience is mandatory for this position.** Candidates must meet the following req rcial cellular RF technologies, including LTE, 5G NR, and associated frequency bands. * Understanding of RF components, including antennas, splitters, tappers, couplers, combiners, amplifiers, and fiber\-optic distribution systems. * Ability to read and interpret RF design drawings, system schematics, equipment specifications, and commissioning procedures. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills. * Ability to work independently, manage assigned responsibilities, and communicate effectively with internal teams and customers. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and technical documentation. * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project locations as required. **Important:** Experience limited to DAS equipment installation, structured cabling, cable placement, equipment mounting, or general IT networking does not satisfy the commissioning experience requirement. **Preferred Qualifications – Additional Experience** The following qualifications are highly desirable but not required: * Hands\-on commissioning experience with multiple DAS manufacturers. * OEM commissioning certifications or formal manufacturer training from JMA, CommScope/Andrew, Corning, SOLiD, Nextivity, ADRF, or other DAS manufacturers. * Experience with DAS carrier integrations and wireless operator acceptance procedures. * Experience commissioning and troubleshooting public safety DAS/BDA systems. * iBwave Design certification or practical DAS design experience. * Experience performing RF benchmarking, walk testing, and post\-installation optimization. * Experience with RF testing equipment, including spectrum analyzers, cable and antenna analyzers, PIM testers, and RF power meters. * Familiarity with RF propagation, link budgets, signal levels, interference, and system optimization. * Knowledge of wireless technologies such as 5G NR, LTE, UMTS, GSM, CDMA, and associated modulation schemes. * Experience with RF data collection and analysis tools such as TEMS, QualiPoc, WINd, Mentum Planet, Atoll, Actix, or MapInfo. * Experience troubleshooting fiber\-optic distribution and transport systems associated with DAS installations. * Experience supporting large commercial facilities, hospitals, airports, government facilities, data centers, or other complex indoor wireless environments. * Familiarity with carrier\-specific requirements for AT\&T, Verizon, and T\-Mobile. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline. **A college degree is not required.** CSI places significant value on demonstrated technical capabilities, practical field experience, and the ability to independently commission and troubleshoot DAS systems. **Compensation \& Benefits** **Annual Salary: $80,000 – $115,000** Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, technical qualifications, OEM commissioning capabilities, and ability to independently support projects. CSI offers a competitive employee benefits package, including: * 100% employer\-paid employee health insurance coverage (employee only) * Ability to add eligible family members and dependents at the employee's expense * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan * Company 401(k) matching * Paid time off (PTO) * Opportunities for professional development and manufacturer\-specific training * Career advancement opportunities within CSI's RF Engineering and technical operations teams **Work Schedule** * Full\-time position * Primarily Monday through Friday * Typical daytime working hours * Occasional evening, overnight, or weekend work based on project requirements and carrier maintenance windows * Occasional out\-of\-town travel may be required Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee stock purchase plan * Health insurance * On\-the\-job training * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person
