jobs.title: PTI - Research Associate - Mass Spectrometry
jobs.description: **Parallel Squared Technology Institute** (PTI) is a non\-profit research institute aiming to catalyze a leap in protein analysis technology and use it to explore new biological frontiers. PTI supports open research and educational opportunities supporting rapid career development for scientists, engineers, and mathematicians. **Why?** Protein dysfunctions directly cause many diseases, such as Alzheimer’s disease. Yet, proteins remain understudied because of technological hurdles. **How?** To resolve these limitations, PTI will develop mass tags enabling a new framework for multiplexed protein analysis by mass spectrometry towards achieving 100\-fold increase in throughput. Scientists at and collaborating with the institute will use these gains to directly investigate disease mechanisms and resolve problems that have proven intractable for decades. Our proof of principle technology and strategies are outlined at: parallelsq.org. PTI’s new approach requires synergy between a diverse team of chemists, machine learning engineers, biologists and mass spectrometrists. Alzheimer’s disease and aging will be among the first focuses of this technology\-driven research organization. **New career opportunities** Members of PTI will be supported with industry\-level resources to lead research projects and disseminate their discoveries and innovations to the broader biomedical community through frequent publications, presentations, and submissions to public data portals. **Summary of Position** We are looking for a Research Associate who is interested in mass spectrometry. This person will be working on maintaining MS instruments for running multitudes of samples for a variety of projects in addition to other responsibilities. **In order to be seriously considered for this position, we require a cover letter as part of the candidate's application.** ### **Responsibilities** * You will learn how to set up, operate and maintain mass spectrometers from multiple major vendors. * Protein and peptide sample preparation. * Analyze experimental data and interpret results for internal and public presentation. * Preparation of lab reagents and media. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees could be considered for a Senior RA position. * Basic proficiency with analytical chemistry assays or biochemistry techniques. * Demonstrated enthusiasm \& interest in analytical chemistry. * High level of initiative and flexibility, excellent communication and teamwork skills. * Attention to detail. * Good time management. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with analytical techniques, mass spectrometry preferred. * Familiarity with liquid chromatography. * Sample preparation and purification methods. ### **Who Will Love This Job** * You are passionate about science and technology and are eager to work in a team environment. * You love learning new techniques, new technologies, and new concepts. * You want an environment that will support your future plans as a scientist or engineer. * You are committed to open science ideas and want to see your work disseminated broadly. ### **We Offer** * An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and the most talented experts from different fields. * Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance with many $0 premium options for you and your family with several national and regional providers. Most employees have more than 20 plan options to choose from. * Company\-paid group life, AD\&D, long\- and short\-term disability insurance * 15 days PTO \+ 10 sick days per year * 18 company holidays \+ your birthday off * $5,000 per year educational reimbursement * Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave * Industry competitive salary We aim to help fill a structural gap in today's R\&D system. We enable fundamental research that requires unusual levels of scale and coordination yet is not rapidly monetizable by industry. We’re bringing together top talent from academia, industry, and startups to build a new model for innovative R\&D. As an incubator within the Schmidt Futures Network, we identify high\-impact scientific or technical research and development opportunities, ultimately defining and launching these projects as Focused Research Organizations. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender\-identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state, or federal law or company policy. We strive for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibit harassment of any kind. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Next Level Experience Designer
jobs.description: ### **Overview** Most websites and software make people think too much. Where do I click? What does this mean? How do I sign up? Our software works. That doesn’t mean it makes sense. Too many clicks, confusing workflows, and designs that make sense to the person who built them and no one else. We’re looking for someone who can take websites and software that technically do their jobs and make them dramatically better: clearer, simpler, faster, and easier for real people to use. From fixing frustrating workflows to turning curious website visitors into customers, you'll make every interaction feel more intuitive. You won’t spend your days debating button colors or making pretty pages just because they look cool. You’ll spend your days asking why there are twelve buttons in the first place, whether the message makes sense, and whether someone can figure out what to do next without a map. ### **Wage** $200,000 / year ### **Benefits** * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental \& visionFull coverage for employees — nothing comes out of your paycheck. Plus an annual review with a raise option. * Time off that grows with you22 days PTO \+ 4 holidays to start. After 3 years it bumps to 29 days, and after 5 years you move to flexible time off — not accrued, not capped. Take time off when you want. * Parental leave \& 401(k) matchPaid parental leave, plus up to 6% company 401(k) matching with no vesting period — it’s yours from day one. * Quarterly allowanceSpend it on whatever makes work better: a comfier remote setup, continuing\-education classes, a plant for your desk, coffee for a coworker, a massage for yourself… really, whatever. * No dumb perks (and a trail mix bar)No weekend dog\-walking gimmicks that look cool but cost nothing because nobody uses them. We spend on benefits you’ll actually use — an open\-concept office, friendly coworkers, a creative environment, and yeah… a trail mix bar. ### **Responsibilities** * Turn complicated software into experiences that feel obvious by finding unnecessary steps, confusing workflows, and friction everyone else has learned to tolerate. * Challenge assumptions about how our software should work, influencing what we build, how it works, and whether it should exist at all. * Raise the quality of our software through better thinking, not decoration, and push ideas beyond “good enough.” * Design websites and landing pages that are simple, clear, and useful. * Make it ridiculously easy for people to understand what we do and sign up. * Question confusing layouts, unnecessary steps, and design that exists just to look clever. ### **Requirements** * Learn our software, understand the problem, and take ownership of making it better. * Turn complicated workflows and information into experiences that feel simple and obvious without leaving out what matters. * Question anything that makes people stop, think, or give up during sign\-up. * Work directly with engineers, challenge ideas, and stay open to having your own ideas challenged. * Challenge designs and ideas, including your own, when they are not working. * Explain your thinking clearly and take feedback without getting weird about it. * Use feedback, testing, and failure to improve the work. Be willing to try, learn, adjust, and keep pushing until the experience is genuinely better. * Care more about whether the website works for real people than whether other designers think it looks cool. * We care more about what you can actually do than the size or name of the company you've worked for. You should be able to demonstrate your hands\-on design skills, walk us through your work, and explain the decisions behind it. ### **Next Level Experience Designer** Portland, OR If you’ve ever tried to cancel a subscription, find a buried setting, or sign up for something and thought, “Who designed this?” you’ll probably fit in here. You know simple things shouldn’t be so complicated. We want someone who spots those frustrations, calls out bad design, and makes things work the way people actually expect. Here, you get to turn those “there has to be a better way” moments into something better.

jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description: Join the company that's building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world's biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what's next. We're one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we're remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. **Location**: West coast **Why You'll Love This Role** Value Engineering is a consultative team that supports the Cribl sales and GTM organization and engages customers to explore the business value of Cribl. We deliver high\-touch customer engagements while building content, frameworks, tools, processes and best practices to help sellers independently develop the business case for Cribl. In this highly cross\-functional role, you'll collaborate with teams from sales, solutions engineering, product marketing, and customer success. Approximately 80% of your time will be focused on customer engagements and \~20% of your time will be working on broad GTM and value selling scale projects. Together, we'll drive value selling across the GTM organization, directly contributing to: * Boosting win rates, * Speeding up sales cycles, * Reviving dormant opportunities, * Increasing deal sizes, and * Enhancing deal margins. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will...** **Your Impact** * **Engage, Consult and Influence:** Partner with sales teams and customers, employing a value\-based selling approach to create compelling narratives and business cases. You'll help the customer answer the 3 key questions: "Why change?", "Why Cribl?", and "Why now?" * **Lead Discovery Sessions:** Conduct technical value discovery sessions with senior executives and technical staff, asking questions and providing insights that help shape their business case for Cribl. * **Craft Business Cases:** Develop comprehensive business cases for new business, expansions, and cross\-sell opportunities, as well as value realization analyses to propel renewals. * **Innovate and Build:** Create value discovery questions, financial models, and frameworks for new use cases and products. Develop and maintain a value metrics database for internal and customer use. * **Empower Sales Teams:** Enable our sales teams to become proficient with self\-serve value content and tools, ensuring they can independently explore and communicate value to customers. * **Travel Opportunities:** Enjoy a dynamic role that includes occasional travel (10% to 20%) throughout the year. There is the usual customer travel, but what you should really look forward to is Cribl Kickoff, which occurs over a week each year. It's an incredible time to engage, learn and most importantly, have fun with other Criblians. **If You've Got It \- We Want It** * **Driven and Collaborative:** You have a strong work ethic, a "get things done" attitude, and thrive in a team environment. Looking for someone who has grit. * **Detail\-Oriented and Analytical:** Your structured thinking and keen eye for value enable you to create detailed and accurate business cases. You excel in financial analysis and modeling, particularly around TCO and ROI concepts. * **Proactive and Adaptable:** You're a self\-starter who thrives in unstructured, fast\-paced environments and enjoys taking ownership of projects. * **Trusted Advisor:** You build and maintain strong relationships with customers and sales teams, providing valuable insights and guidance. * **Polished Communicator:** You can present complex analyses clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing. * **Selling Expertise:** Familiarity with Force Management, Challenger Selling, MEDDPPICC and 3 Why methodologies. * **Technical Expertise:** You have expert\-level skills in Google Sheets and Slides. Being familiar with tools like Omni, SFDC, Clari, Decision Link, Ecosystems, Mediafly, and Spotlight is a plus.**Educational Background:** A Bachelor's degree is required, with a preference for business management, finance, accounting, economics, information systems, or computer science. A MBA from a top\-tier institution is highly preferred. * **Experienced Professional:** For the Senior VE role looking for 5 to 10\+ years in enterprise software strategy / business operations, technology / management consulting, investment banking or value engineering. * **Technical Knowledge:** Familiarity with networking, cloud infrastructure, IT operations, observability, and/or security is a plus. * You live in the West Coast * As a Value Engineering team we breathe, eat and drink the four key values below … + **Demonstrate Accountability \& Extreme Ownership**: Proactively identify challenges and drive solutions. Do not call out a problem without proposing a solution or framework to find a solution. We are all equity holders \- act like an owner. + **Manage Ambiguity \& Complexity:** Like pioneers crossing the great plains, we must thrive in a VUCA (Volatile, Uncertain, Complex, and Ambiguous) world. We utilize frameworks and curiosity to break down complex business problems into clear, actionable insights. + **Embracing a Continuous Improvement Mindset**: Continuously push the envelope. "What is 'done'?" It is the enemy. We are OBSESSED with pushing the envelope. Status Quo? Don't know her. Our competitors always get a say so even when we are operating at the top of our game, there is a need to continue to push the envelope and improve on the margins to stay on top. + **Consistently acting with speed \& accuracy**: Operate with a bias for action, purpose, and intention. Time is our enemy. \#LI\-JK1 \#LI\-Remote **Bring Your Whole Self** Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you'll ever meet at cribl.io/about\-us.

jobs.title: Professional Services Technical Operations Engineer- Agentic AI (Remote)
jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** This is a Services TechOps Engineer position on the CrowdStrike Professional Services team, designing, building, and operating the agentic AI systems that amplify our consulting and internal operations teams. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **San Francisco, CA · On\-site · Full\-time** **Compensation:** $180K–$250K \+ competitive equity \+ relocation support ### **About the Company** Our client is an early\-stage, accelerator\-backed startup building AI agents that take on the repetitive work in chip design verification. Their product learns how the best verification engineers solve problems and turns that into playbooks that help every chip team find bugs faster. It runs on\-prem, often in air\-gapped environments, alongside verification teams at some of the largest semiconductor companies in the world. They are backed by tier\-1 Silicon Valley investors with deep ties to the semiconductor industry, and the team is small, in\-person, and moving quickly. Founded 2022 · 9 people · Industry: AI, Hardware, Enterprise, B2B ### **The Role** You'd be the engineer our client trusts with its most important customer relationships. This is a technical seat first: you'll own one or two large enterprise chip customer deployments from evaluation through rollout and expansion, debugging a complex AI agent platform live on customer screens inside strict on\-prem environments, then feeding what you learn back into the core product. No chip background is required; the team sees this as a way into semiconductors without a PhD in chip design. **What you'll be doing** * Own 1–2 enterprise customer engagements end to end (typically 3–6\+ months each), from eval through deployment and expansion * Debug the platform (Python backend, React frontend, AI agents) in real time with customers, across Linux, containers, networking, and filesystems * Drive adoption by running trainings, tracking and documenting issues, and closing the loop when fixes ship * Contribute to the core product when there isn't a customer fire, and shape the roadmap with field learnings * Travel occasionally to customer sites, mostly in the South Bay and Texas, with the odd trip to Asia **Tech stack:** Python, React, Linux, containers (Podman/Docker), networking, NFS ### **Requirements** * A track record of owning technical customer engagements or deployments from start to finish, ideally more than one at a time, as a forward deployed engineer, founding engineer, or founder * 2–6 years as a software, forward deployed, solutions, or infrastructure engineer at a venture\-backed startup or top\-tier tech company * Hands\-on depth in Linux/Unix systems: you've set up containers yourself (Podman or Docker) and worked through container networking, NFS, permissions, and the like * Strong Python, with the ability to get up to speed quickly inside a large, unfamiliar codebase and debug it * Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field from a strong engineering program * Experience at a high\-bar AI, defense, or hardware company where engineers work close to the metal * Based in, or willing to relocate to, San Francisco and work on\-site five days a week ### **Nice to Haves** * Prior experience as a startup founder, founding engineer, or in applied AI/ML * Exposure to chip design and verification (SystemVerilog, UVM, waveforms, regressions) * Familiarity with EDA tooling and CAD flows (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens/Questa, or similar) ### **Why Join** * Real enterprise customers from day one: the product is live with verification teams at some of the world's largest chip companies on leading\-edge designs * Break into semiconductors without an EE background and get deep exposure to AI accelerators and SoCs * Huge ownership on a roughly nine\-person team: you own major customer engagements and ship on the core product * Not a throwaway\-code FDE job: you debug and improve a real product and shape the roadmap with what you see in the field * Backed by tier\-1 Silicon Valley investors with deep semiconductor ties ### **Details** * **Location:** San Francisco, CA * **Work policy:** On\-site, 5 days a week * **Compensation:** $180,000–$250,000 \+ equity; relocation support available * **Visa sponsorship:** Open to visa transfers (e.g. OPT, H\-1B transfers) * **Employment type:** Full\-time

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Material Science, Technical Education, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in Quantum Mechanics. * Experience in Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning. * Experience using computational packages like VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, or similar. * Research experience with materials relevant to technology development. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * PhD in Computational Materials Science, Solid\-State Chemistry, Condensed Matter Physics, or a related field. * Demonstrated ability to manage and execute computational research tasks effectively, from simulation setup to data analysis and communication. **About the job** ----------------- As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large\-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real\-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Science, Computational Social Science, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related quantitative STEM discipline, or equivalent practical research experience. * One or more first\-author peer\-reviewed scientific publications at academic venues (e.g., CHI, UIST, CSCW, NeurIPS, ICML) or public preprint repositories. * Experience modeling and predicting human behavior when using interactive systems. * Experience with core research methodologies, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), and User Interface (UI) design. * Experience with one or more of the following: computational cognitive modeling, simulated user co\-pilots, human\-agent collaboration, or Generative AI. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * 1 year of experience initiating, scoping, and executing independent research agendas or leading collaborative scientific projects in human\-AI systems. * Experience contributing to highly cited seminal papers, widely adopted open\-source research frameworks, or recognized international scientific awards and fellowships. * Experience in PAIR's core strategic focus areas: interactive code or music synthesis, LLM steerability, developer tools, Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), and simulated human behavior alignment. * Experience with interdisciplinary research bridging cognitive science, computer science, machine learning, and human\-computer interaction (HCI). * Experience building novel user interfaces, visualization tools, or sandbox environments to inspect, simulate, and evaluate human\-agent interactions. **About the job** ----------------- The People and AI Research (PAIR) team conducts foundational research to make human\-AI partnerships productive, enjoyable, and fair. Based in Cambridge, MA, our multidisciplinary team of computer scientists, research engineers, social scientists, and designers invents novel interaction paradigms and develops open\-source tools that shape how people interact with intelligent systems. As a Research Scientist in Human\-AI Interaction and Simulation, you will develop computational, cognitive, and statistical models of human behavior to understand, predict, and optimize how people interact with advanced AI systems. Generative models, multimodal assistants, and autonomous agents are transforming interactive computing. Designing effective human\-AI partnerships requires models of human cognitive limits, trust dynamics, steerability, and collaboration patterns. In this role, you will design empirical user studies, build predictive simulations of user interaction, and translate behavioral insights into architectural and UX improvements across Google DeepMind's frontier models. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $147000 \- $210000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, validate, and land models of human behavior in the context of human\-AI interactions, translating complex behavioral insights into actionable improvements for frontier AI models, interactive tools, and user interfaces. * Focus on model integration and applied product impact across Google DeepMind's systems, pivoting focus from academic publishing to direct, applied contributions to frontier models. * Conduct empirical experiments, build interactive research prototypes, and run simulations to evaluate human\-agent collaboration, validate hypotheses, and refine research methodologies. * Define data structures, simulation frameworks, experimental designs, and evaluation metrics for research solution development, establishing clear execution timelines and resource needs. * Identify emerging research areas through internal and external collaborations, helping develop long\-term strategies to expand Google DeepMind’s applied scientific impact. jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.description: At Edmunds, we make the car buying experience easier. While we are an established leader in automotive tech, our company thrives on innovation and agility, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in a competitive industry to keep our customers and our culture at the forefront. **What You’re Applying For:** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Network Security Engineer to join our dynamic IT team. This role serves a critical dual function in network administration and cybersecurity defense. The ideal candidate will be responsible for administering and optimizing our core network infrastructure while simultaneously driving vulnerability analysis, incident remediation, and root cause investigations. You will serve as a defender of our digital assets, ensuring secure, high\-performing network operations and a rapid, coordinated response to any security events. The ideal candidate will possess a comprehensive understanding of network administration and security, as well as cybersecurity incident response and vulnerability remediation. Candidates must demonstrate a commitment to best practices and exceptional customer service. The successful candidate must possess exceptional troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities, with the ability to think critically, investigate unfamiliar technical challenges, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions. We are looking for someone who goes beyond following established procedures and demonstrates the initiative, resourcefulness, and technical curiosity to resolve problems that may not have obvious or readily available solutions. **What You’ll Do**: **Network Administration \& Infrastructure** * **Infrastructure Management**: Administer, manage, and maintain core network infrastructure, with a strong focus on Cisco, Meraki, and Zscaler solutions. * **Hardware Optimization**: Deploy, configure, patch, and maintain network switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and other critical network systems to ensure optimal network performance, uptime, and strict security posture. * **Network Security**: Work with System and Security Engineers to design and enforce network security policies across all hardware and cloud\-based network solutions to prevent unauthorized access and data loss. **Security Monitoring \& Incident Response** * **Active Monitoring**: Triage alerts from security and network monitoring tools to identify suspicious or malicious behaviors, potential threats, and vulnerabilities. * **Incident Investigation**: Analyze, investigate, assess, and aggressively respond to cybersecurity incidents, including reported phishing emails, suspected data breaches, and anomalous security events. * **Root Cause Analysis**: Conduct deep technical and root cause analyses of security incidents to understand breach mechanics and prevent future recurrence * **Documentation \& Reporting**: Meticulously document all security incidents, investigations, response actions, and findings. Conduct and record formal assessments of potential business and operational impact. * **Tool Maintenance**: Manage, configure, and maintain key security solutions, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms and vulnerability management systems. **Vulnerability Management \& Threat Intelligence** * **Risk Mitigation**: Conduct comprehensive vulnerability management and remediation activities. Evaluate security threats and prioritize response efforts based on potential risk and business impact. * **Proactive Defense**: Respond to and mitigate identified security risks and software vulnerabilities across the network and endpoint environment. * **Continuous Learning**: Stay actively informed of emerging cybersecurity threats, advanced attack methodologies, and new technologies to support proactive risk mitigation and defensive strategies. General Skills and Responsibilities * **Collaboration**: Work closely and collaboratively with Security, Information Systems (IS), and broader IT team members to investigate and resolve complex security incidents. * **Technical Support \& Escalation**: Provide escalated support for IT incidents and outages, diagnosing complex issues and implementing effective resolutions. * **Documentation \& Communication**: Develop and maintain comprehensive system documentation. Effectively communicate highly technical information and concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing. * **Best Practices**: Continuously research and implement industry best practices and emerging technologies to enhance system performance, security, and efficiency. **What You Need**: * Minimum of 3\-5 years of prior experience in a network security role, with a proven track record of successfully administering network infrastructure. * Proven, industry\-specific experience in network administration (Cisco, Meraki, Zscaler). * Strong knowledge of networking and networking concepts as they apply to the TCP/IP protocol. * Experience monitoring and configuring EDR platforms and vulnerability management tools * Working knowledge of firewall administration, access control lists (ACLs), NAT, port management, and security policy configuration. * Understanding of network authentication and access control technologies, including RADIUS, TACACS\+, 802\.1X, and Private Key Infrastructure (PKI). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Exceptional customer service skills with a strong user\-centric approach. * Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and departments. * Demonstrated ability to implement best practices based on industry trends. * Ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and work under pressure. * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field (or equivalent work experience). * Ability to be available for onsite support. jobs.title: Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems
jobs.description: **Job Title:** ============== Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems**Location:** ============= Charlotte, NC, Connecticut Home Office, Lenox, MA, Massachusetts Home Office, New York Home Office**Job Summary and Description:** ================================ The Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems is classified as a Technical Leader II. In this role the Senior Engineer will help lead research focused on overhead electric distribution systems. The Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems will have a strong technical foundation in the electric power industry while also being motivated to continue learning, explore new technologies and approaches, and help address emerging challenges facing electric utilities. The Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems will collaborate with utilities, manufacturers, laboratories, universities, and other technical experts to identify important research questions, develop and conduct research, evaluate technologies and practices, and translate the results into practical information that utilities can use. The Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems will help shape EPRI’s overhead distribution research portfolio, work with utility members to identify and develop new research opportunities, lead technical projects, and participate directly in laboratory and field research. The work spans areas such as overhead structures, conductors, connectors, inspection and monitoring technologies, materials, asset management, reliability, resilience, and emerging technologies. Expertise in all these areas is not required as we are looking for someone who brings relevant experience, strong technical judgment, and the interest and ability to continue developing expertise throughout their career. **As a Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems you will:** * Work independently on technical activities without direct supervision. * Demonstrate responsibility for highly specialized technical objectives or problems where the relationships between cause and effect are difficult to establish and little or no precedence exists, and the use of creative and imaginative thinking is required. * Maintain familiarity with the progress and problems in assigned technical areas. **Additionally, the Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems will:** * Develop relationships with primary advisors to a research area. * Provide assistance to the EPRI sales staff in Member Services and EPRI International. * Effectively communicate strategies and results, expressing thoughts clearly and concisely both verbally and in writing, to subject matter experts, program members and advisors through guidelines, reports, meetings, webcasts, workshops and conferences. * Regularly communicates and coordinates work activities across programs. * May provide oversight of a project team to assure technical and financial milestones are met. * Organize the external and interdepartmental activities ensuring completion of the project/product on schedule and within budget. * Support the planning and execution of complex project work within the technical department to meet member/client objectives; prepares and presents research reports. * Manage small or medium (less complex) projects including budgets and resources without direct people management responsibilities. * Influence project teams in the engineering aspects of the technical work. * Increase interactions and coordination of EPRI work with national and international technical networks (e.g, manufacturers, consultants, academia and research organizations) * Begin to lead proposal efforts and new promotional work. * Develop research or services opportunities of value to EPRI members that fit EPRI’s mission and capabilities. This will include solving customer problems, producing insights and information vital to the members, and delivering information in a manner that members and customers can and will apply. Continue to provide guidance and mentorship to junior staff. * **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline required. * 10\+ years of relevant engineering, testing, research, or utility industry experience. * Familiarity with utility distribution infrastructure and associated equipment. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capabilities. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Work Environment:** * The Senior Engineer – Overhead Distribution Systems role offers a balance of hands\-on laboratory testing, technical analysis, and collaboration with utilities and other industry stakeholders. Periodic fieldwork, site visits, and travel will be required to support research activities, utility assessments, and industry meetings. * Candidates located near EPRI’s Charlotte, NC office or the Lenox, MA laboratory are preferred. Remote candidates may also be considered if they are within reasonable commuting distance of the Lenox laboratory. * Regular travel to Lenox, MA will be an important part of the role, particularly to support hands\-on testing, research activities, and performance evaluations of overhead distribution assets. * undefined Research has shown that candidates who don’t tick all the boxes often don’t apply. We welcome candidates who demonstrate initiative, a willingness to learn, and can work independently. If you tick some of the boxes, consider applying regardless – we look forward to talking with you. The salary range for this position is $128,000 USD to $140,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on various factors, including without limitation applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. jobs.title: Substation Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** ============== Substation Engineer**Location:** ============= Charlotte, NC**Job Summary and Description:** ================================ The Substation Engineer is classified as a Technical Leader. In this role the Substation Engineer supports EPRI’s research efforts focused on the full life cycle of substation assets, including design, operation, maintenance, aging, and end‑of‑life considerations. **The ideal Substation Engineer candidate will have** * Strong technical background in power transformers and substation equipment, including design, application, operation, maintenance, diagnostics, and lifecycle management. * Knowledge of transformer condition assessment technologies. * Experience evaluating new technologies through laboratory testing, field demonstrations, pilots, and utility deployments. * Ability to engage directly with utility engineers and asset managers to understand operational challenges, emerging risks, and research priorities. * Working knowledge of major substation assets such as circuit breakers, instrument transformers, bushings, GIS/GIL, grounding systems, surge arresters, and protection and control systems. * Familiarity with applicable IEEE, IEC, CIGRE, and NERC standards and industry practices affecting transformers and substations. **Key Responsibilities and Requirements** The Substation Engineer will: * Work independently on technical activities without direct supervision. * Conduct technical searches and analyzes information in support of the project team. * Demonstrate responsibility for highly specialized technical objectives or problems where the relationships between cause and effect are difficult to establish and little or no precedence exists, and the use of creative and imaginative thinking is required. * Apply technical expertise, and has full knowledge of other related disciplines. * Develop technical solutions to complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity. **Additional Duties of the Substation Engineer consist of** * Develop relationships with primary advisors to a research area. * Provide assistance to the EPRI sales staff in Member Services and EPRI International. * Communicate strategies and results, written and verbal, to program members, potential members and external stakeholders through guidelines, reports, meetings, webcasts, workshops and conferences. * Communicate work across EPRI programs to make sure parallel work is informed. * May provide oversight of a project team to assure technical and financial milestones are met. * Organize external and interdepartmental activities ensuring completion of the project/product on schedule and within budget. * Support the planning and execution of complex project work within the technical department to meet member/client objectives; prepares and presents research reports. * Manage small or medium (less complex) projects including budgets and resources. * Begin interfacing with national and international technical networks (e.g, manufacturers, consultants, academia and research organizations). * Support proposal efforts and new promotional work. * Develop research or services opportunities of value to EPRI members that fit EPRI’s mission and capabilities. This will include solving customer problems, producing insights and information vital to the members, and delivering information in a manner that members and customers can and will apply. * Continue to provide guidance and mentorship to junior staff. **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field or equivalent experience required. * 7\+ years of experience related to the full life of substation equipment (design, operation, maintenance, aging and/or end\-of\-life) **About the Substations Program:** The Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) Substations Program addresses the evolving challenges faced by substation asset owners and operators across the electric power sector. As utilities face increased loading demands, workforce constraints, evolving regulatory requirements, and heightened physical and cyber threats, the Substations Program provides objective, third\-party research to reduce technical and financial risk. The program combines laboratory testing, field demonstrations, technology assessments, guidebooks, and collaborative forums to translate research outcomes into practical, utility\-ready solutions. jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer (Python)
jobs.description: **About Entrupy** Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods. Entrupy's solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e\-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy's solutions in market: * Entrupy Apparel Authentication * Entrupy Bags \& Leather Goods Authentication * Entrupy Sneaker Authentication * Entrupy Fingerprinting **As we continue to build...** We're seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key\-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you're invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we'd love to have you apply. **About the Role** Entrupy is seeking a Senior Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer to join our Platform team. You will work alongside other infrastructure engineers, under our Platform Lead, to keep our AWS platform secure, compliant and reliable. Nearly all of our platform and data services are written in Python, and this role sits right where that code meets the infrastructure under it. You will be a strong Python engineer who prefers to spend their time on infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD and production operations. The team has two main goals. The first is security and compliance across our AWS environment, including our SOC 2 program: keeping our infrastructure secure by default, meeting our controls continuously, and having audit evidence ready at all times. The second is a major infrastructure modernization. We are moving our services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, defining our infrastructure in Terraform / OpenTofu, and making every service build and deploy through automated CI/CD pipelines. Together, we make sure security and compliance are built into that new platform from day one, not bolted on afterwards. Some of the systems you will work with: * Multi\-account AWS infrastructure: networking, IAM, ECS, backups, audit logging and compliance controls * CI/CD, deploy tooling, secrets management, logging, monitoring and alerting * Python backend APIs for our mobile apps, SDKs and dashboards * Public\-facing APIs and webhooks used by partners and enterprise customers * Data pipelines and ingestors that feed analytics, search and reporting * Databases, caches, search and object stores (PostgreSQL/RDS, DynamoDB, Redis, OpenSearch, S3\) The Platform team works closely with the backend, mobile, machine learning and BI teams, and builds the secure, paved road those teams use to ship and run their services. **Employment Type:** Remote **Reports to:** Platform Lead **Location:** Fully remote (US), working East Coast hours **What you'll do:** #### **Security and compliance** * Help run the technical side of our SOC 2 program with the rest of the Platform team. Implement and maintain infrastructure controls, collect and automate audit evidence, fix control failures, and support each audit cycle. * Help enforce least\-privilege access across our AWS accounts: IAM roles and policies, AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO), cross\-account access, GitHub OIDC for CI, and regular access reviews. * Help make sure data is encrypted at rest and in transit across RDS, DynamoDB, S3, EBS and Redis, and help manage certificates, KMS keys and secrets (SOPS, Secrets Manager, SSM). * Contribute to audit logging, threat detection (CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub or similar) and vulnerability management for container images, dependencies and hosts. * Write security and compliance checks into Terraform / OpenTofu and CI, so that new infrastructure is compliant by default and drift is caught automatically. Take part in security incident response and postmortems, and help keep runbooks and policies current. * #### **Infrastructure and CI/CD** * Work with the team to migrate our Python services off Elastic Beanstalk onto Amazon ECS, managed with Terraform / OpenTofu. Plan and run cutovers with zero or minimal downtime, and decommission the legacy environments. * Build and maintain reusable Terraform / OpenTofu modules for ECS services, networking, IAM, databases and observability. Contribute to the team's state management, environment separation (dev / staging / prod) and a safe, peer\-reviewed plan/apply workflow. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) that test, build, scan, version and deploy every service. Help standardize Docker image builds, ECR storage and promotion between environments. * Help replace hand\-run and script\-based deploys with repeatable, automated, auditable workflows #### **Operations and reliability** * Share responsibility for production operations and on\-ca OpenTofu experience: writing and structuring modules, managing remote state, importing existing resources, and running IaC safely across multiple environments and accounts. * Production experience running containerized services on Amazon ECS (Fargate and/or EC2 launch types) with ECR, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling and service discovery. * Broad AWS experience: VPC, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, CloudFront. * Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including security scanning and OIDC\-based deploy credentials. * Experience migrating production workloads from one platform to another (e.g. PaaS to ECS) without disrupting customers. * Experience running production systems: on\-call, incident response, postmortems and database upgrades. * A collaborative working style. You are comfortable sharing ownership, reviewing and being reviewed, and splitting work across a team. * Clear written communication. You document your work and can explain security and infrastructure trade\-offs to engineers, auditors and leadership. * Comfortable working fully remote and asynchronously with a distributed team, during East Coast hours. #### **Preferred experience** * Experience moving services off AWS Elastic Beanstalk (or Heroku or a similar PaaS). * Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, Secureframe). * Multi\-account AWS setups: AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies, centralized logging. * Policy\-as\-code and IaC security scanning (e.g., Checkov, tfsec / Trivy, OPA / Conftest). * PostgreSQL administration, including blue/green upgrades, connection pooling (RDS Proxy / PgBouncer) and access management. * Familiarity with GDPR and data privacy requirements. * Experience with search systems (OpenSearch / Elasticsearch) and event\-driven pipelines (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, DynamoDB Streams). * Python web frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, Django) and Poetry\-based dependency management. * Fluency with AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) for infrastructure and code work. * Previous work on a small platform or infrastructure team in a startup\-like environment. #### **What we offer** * Market competitive and pay equity\-focused compensation structure * Generous time away including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! * Rich medical benefits and insurance coverage * Safe Harbor 401k match * Dedicated mental health support for employees and eligible dependents We have had an incredible run so far and are laying the foundation for a culture that is fast\-paced, entrepreneurial, and rooted in passion, kindness, and positivity. We live by these values – we hire by them, promote them, and celebrate them every day. Please apply if you want to be a part of a collaborative and dynamic team with a passion for working with high\-end luxury brands and cutting\-edge technology, and want to be at the forefront of AI innovation. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: The world’s largest organizations rely on Evident to help them protect their business and brand from third\-party risk. Our game\-changing technology \- which enables the secure exchange of risk data like proof of insurance, identity, business registration, and other information \- helps our customers verify that their partners have all of the required credentials to do business. In today’s new remote\-first, ever\-changing regulatory environment, our secure, privacy\-first enterprise platform, accessible via web portal or API, provides a highly scalable and configurable solution to manage communications, storage, decisioning, and ongoing monitoring of credentials. Evident is a VC\-backed technology startup, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Learn more at evidentid.com.### **Job Description** Evident is hiring a Solutions Engineer to be a technical lead on our high\-value deals. Evident runs the largest verified business network in third\-party risk management, and we’re making the product dramatically smarter with AI. Our customers operate in high\-risk industries \- construction, transportation, local service providers, and more \- where a single unqualified or uninsured partner can mean real losses, safety incidents, or liability. Getting verification right isn’t optional for them. These buyers don’t trust automation until they see it working on their own data, and this role is where that proof happens. You’ll partner with our Account Executives through the sales cycle, owning the technical side of the deal so they can own the relationship. This is a hands\-on role on a small team where you’ll see your impact on revenue directly. The position reports to our CTO and is based in our Atlanta office (hybrid work model with two days in the office and three days remote). ### **Responsibilities** * Design the solution. Map customer workflows to how Evident is configured, and build repeatable configurations and reference architectures. * Prove it on their data. Run proofs of concept and pilots \- take a prospect’s real documents and show the automation working end to end. * Be the technical voice in the deal. Lead conversations on APIs, integrations, data flows, and security reviews with prospect IT and architecture teams. * Scope it. Set realistic expectations so customers go live on solid ground, and hand off cleanly to implementation. * Build the playbook. Create demo environments, sample datasets, and reusable assets, using AI to shrink the time it takes to stand up a proof of concept. * Bring the field back to product. Translate what buyers are asking for into clear input for Product and Engineering. ### **Requirements** * 3\+ years in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or solutions consulting at a B2B SaaS or API\-platform company * Hands\-on technical depth: REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, Postman, and enough Python or JavaScript to build a demo yourself * Range to demo to a CFO in the morning and whiteboard an integration with an engineer in the afternoon * AI\-native \- you use modern AI tools daily to move faster and do more * Comfortable with ambiguity and with building things that don’t exist yet ### **Bonus Points** * Domain experience in risk, compliance, insurance, third\-party risk management, identity verification, or credentialing * Experience selling into construction, transportation, equipment rental, or lending * Forward\-deployed or customer\-embedded engineering experience * A central seat in our largest deals, working directly with the executive team * The ability to shape how we do pre\-sales **Why Evident?*** Our team solves a crucial problem with huge business potential together, and we are able to see exactly how our contribution affects customers! * Competitive pay package, including base pay and stock options * Full medical, dental, vision benefits and 401K * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave to support you and your family * Home internet stipend, virtual events, \& more! * Recently named one of Atlanta's Coolest Companies \& 50 on Fire by Atlanta Inno * Recently named one of the Top 10 Fastest Growing Companies in Atlanta \& one of the Best Places to Work in Atlanta by Atlanta Business Chronicle We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Vice President, Engineering – Fraud & Risk
jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to the Team** Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Fraud \& Risk organization at Expedia Group is a large\-scale, mission\-critical function responsible for protecting our travelers, partners, and platform across the full fraud and risk lifecycle. As we enter the next era of fraud — shaped by increasingly sophisticated AI and large language models — we are seeking a transformational leader to drive a comprehensive modernization of how we detect, investigate, and respond to fraud at scale. **In this role, you will:** * Lead and develop a global Fraud \& Risk organization of approximately 500\+ personnel, including direct leadership teams spanning Engineering, Operations \& Investigations, Incident Response, Product Management, Machine Learning, and Analytics * Define and execute a comprehensive transformation roadmap that modernizes fraud detection, risk operations, investigations, analytics, and automation capabilities across the full fraud lifecycle * Champion the adoption of AI, machine learning, and large language models (LLMs) to transition the organization from manual, legacy processes to a highly automated and intelligence\-driven operating model * Evaluate the current build\-versus\-buy landscape and develop an optimal strategy that leverages best\-in\-class external solutions alongside proprietary capabilities * Establish scalable, AI\-powered automation of investigations, triage, and workflow management to significantly reduce manual effort and increase operational efficiency Attract, develop, and retain diverse, high\-performing technical and operational talent across a complex, multi\-functional organization * **Experience and Qualifications** **Required:** * Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale fraud, risk, or trust \& safety organizations, including end\-to\-end scale * Hands\-on expertise with AI and machine learning applied to fraud detection, including experience building and deploying ML models and integrating LLM\-based capabilities * Experience developing and executing automation strategies that reduce manual investigation workloads and increase operational scale * Experience evaluating and executing build\-versus\-buy decisions for technical fraud and risk capabilities Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience * **Preferred:** * Experience automation tooling used by industry\-leading organizations * Experience scaling machine learning and analytics teams alongside engineering and operations functions Advanced degree in a relevant technical or business discipline; or equivalent related professional experience * **Benefits and perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, (IATAN) membership. jobs.title: Data Product Manager
jobs.description: THE POSITION Our roster has an opening with your name on it FanDuel is looking for a Data Product Manager to join our centralized Data Products team and own the products and services behind how FanDuel personalizes and experiments. Your flagship product is Personalization, one of FanDuel's largest strategic programs, and it is just getting started. The vision has two parts. The first is one personalization service that works with any front end. Given a customer, a page, and a moment, it returns ranked content that any surface can render, across sports betting, casino, racing, predictions, fantasy, social and community, payments, editorial, and video. Redesign the app tomorrow and the service does not change. The second is a personalization flywheel. It is a closed loop where ideas are generated, pre\-tested, run as live experiments, and analyzed, and each result feeds the next round. Today most good ideas never get tested because experiment capacity is scarce and analysis is slow. You will own the products that change that. Working closely with the Director of Data Product, you will drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery across customer understanding, ranking, serving, and experimentation. You will partner daily with data science, ML Platform, ML engineering, product analytics, and product managers in every business unit to turn a fast\-moving, cross\-functional program into shipped, measurable results. This is a high\-visibility role tied directly to our "One App, One Customer" data strategy, our 2027 OKRs, and customer engagement, retention, and revenue. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. THE GAME PLAN Everyone on our team has a part to play * Own the backlog and delivery for one personalization product area, such as experimentation tooling or ranking inputs, and deliver it in small, shippable releases. * Work with the Director of Data Product and senior PMs to shape the personalization roadmap, recommending priorities and trade\-offs based on customer data and experiment results. * Translate broader program goals into clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and data science can plan against. * Partner with data science and ML engineering on recommendation and ranking approaches, asking questions about accuracy, latency, and cost, and turning their input into product requirements. * Work with product analytics and the experimentation platform team to define hypotheses, success and guardrail metrics, and test readouts for your area, and share what you learn with the team. * Support responsible gaming, privacy, and compliance requirements in your area by working with Legal, Compliance, and Responsible Gaming, and escalate open questions early. * Give status updates to your pod and key stakeholders, flagging risks and blockers early so issues are resolved before they affect delivery. * Escalate cross\-team conflicts and decisions outside your remit to the Director, and bring a recommendation with each escalation. * Seek and act on feedback from your manager, peers, and partners, and share knowledge with other PMs in the Product Management community. * Contribute to other Data Product initiatives as priorities evolve, keeping focus on a small number of priorities rather than parallel work. THE STATS What we're looking for in our next teammate * 3\+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner on personalization, recommendation, search, ranking, experimentation, or other data or ML\-powered products, with a record of shipping and measuring results. * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business, or related) or equivalent industry experience. A Master's degree is a plus. * Working knowledge of how recommender and ranking systems work (collaborative filtering, learning\-to\-rank, embeddings, or similar), enough to engage credibly with data scientists and ML engineers on accuracy, latency, and cost. * Exposure to personalization across varied content types (commerce, media, gaming, social feeds, payments), including cold\-start and cross\-sell, is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experimentation experience. You have designed and run A/B tests, chosen primary and guardrail metrics, and read results carefully. You know common traps such as peeking, underpowered tests, and novelty effects. * Hands\-on use of AI tools in your product and experimentation work, such as using LLMs to draft hypotheses, design tests, or speed up analysis. * Working understanding of how LLM\-based agents are built and evaluated (tools, prompts, guardrails, and evals). Experience taking an agent into production is a plus. * Product\-led mindset: comfortable questioning engineering\-led plans, using frameworks like DACI for decision clarity,  and model performance data. * Knowledge of sports, gaming, or entertainment, and/or experience in a heavily regulated industry with privacy and responsible\-use constraints, is a plus. Familiarity with Databricks, Kafka, Amplitude, Snowplow, or Xtremepush is also a plus. * Don't check all the boxes? That's okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included. validation. * Collaborate with controls teams to optimize force control, position control, and closed\-loop performance. **Precision Motion \& Mechatronics** * Design and optimize high\-performance motion systems utilizing servo motors, linear motors, encoders, air bearings, precision guideways, and advanced mechanical mechanisms. * Partner with Controls Engineering to develop integrated motion\-control and feedback systems that meet demanding dynamic performance requirements. * Support selection, integration, and qualification of sensors, actuators, and control hardware. * Drive system\-level optimization of motion profiles, positioning accuracy, repeatability, and throughput. **Structural, Thermal \& Dynamic Analysis** * Analyze and resolve vibration, resonance, stiffness, solutions that maximize precision while maintaining manufacturability, reliability, and cost effectiveness. * Establish design methodologies and best practices for precision mechanical systems. ustomers and internal teams to identify future technology requirements and performance improvements. **Technical Leadership** * Serve as a technical mentor and subject matter expert for mechanical engineering teams. * Guide engineering standards, design practices, architecture reviews, and technology development initiatives. * Influence long\-term product architecture and engineering strategy through technical leadership and innovation. * Lead complex engineering initiatives and cross\-functional projects with significant business impact. **Preferred Qualifications \& Experiences:** * understanding of Mechanical dynamics, Structural stiffness, Vibration control, Thermal stability, Precision positioning systems, and Tolerance analysis. * Experience integrating mechanical,
