jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead — Software
jobs.description: **Senior Technical Lead — Software** ==================================== The RND Group \| A Gener8 Company **Reports to:** VP/GM of Software **Location:** San Diego (West), Indianapolis (Central), or Boston (East) **Job Site:** Hybrid; remote considered for the right candidate, with travel **Revision Date:** November 4, 2026 **About Us** ------------ Since 1997, The RND Group has been a leader in FDA\-regulated software development, delivering full SDLC execution for the instruments, diagnostics platforms, and connected devices that carry our clients’ FDA submissions. That work now spans Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and a growing medical device cybersecurity practice. Now part of Gener8 — a premier engineering and manufacturing partner with a global footprint — we help life science and medical device innovators turn complex concepts into market\-ready realities. **The Role** ------------ This is a project\-starter role. We are looking for a Technical Lead who can take a new client program from a blank page to a running, well\-architected team — and do it inside an FDA\-regulated SDLC. You will own the technical front end of our engagements: sitting with the client to understand what they are really building, shaping the architecture and design, standing up the codebase and the development approach, and writing real code while the team ramps. Our clients are CTOs, VPs of R\&D, and program leaders who need someone who can hold the whiteboard, the design review, and the pull request with equal credibility. You will be that person. You will also set the pace for how we build with AI. We expect our technical leads to use AI\-assisted development, design, and documentation tools daily — and to know how to use them responsibly under design controls. What this is not: a maintenance seat on a mature codebase, or a pure people\-management role removed from the code. **What You’ll Work On** ----------------------- Our programs span the full breadth of regulated software. Any given year you could be starting projects across several of these: * **Full\-lifecycle regulated software development.** Requirements, architecture, implementation, verification and validation, and submission\-ready documentation under IEC 62304 and design controls. * **Productized IP.** Our Application Accelerator — a pre\-validated starter framework with architecture and documentation already verified — and our LIS Connector. You will know these well enough to start a program on them and extend them. * **Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).** Standalone clinical software, including AI/ML\-enabled device software functions and predetermined change control plans. * **Medical device cybersecurity.** Threat modeling, secure architecture, SBOM, vulnerability and patch management, and Section 524B premarket content — designed in from day one, not bolted on. * **Instrument, embedded, and connectivity software.** Control software, interfaces, and device connectivity for analyzers, sequencers, and point\-of\-care systems. * **Cloud, data, and platform engineering.** Regulated cloud architectures, data pipelines, and connected\-diagnostics infrastructure. * **Remediation and modernization.** Legacy system rescue and bringing inherited software into compliance. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Start projects.** Take new programs from kickoff to a running team: frame the technical scope, set up the repository, toolchain, CI/CD, and branching strategy, and establish the development plan. Get to working software early. * **Architect and design.** Own the software architecture and detailed design — decomposition, interfaces, data flows, segregation of software items, and SOUP selection. Make decisions that hold up under verification, cybersecurity review, and an FDA submission. * **Be the technical face to the client.** Lead technical discovery, design reviews, and status conversations with client engineering and R\&D leadership. Translate between what the client asked for and what they actually need, and push back when it matters. * **Write the code.** Stay hands\-on. Build the hard parts, set the coding standards by example, and review pull requests with a sharp eye for quality, testability, and traceability. * **Work inside the regulated SDLC.** Produce and own technical deliverables under IEC 62304 and our QMS — architecture and design documents, risk control implementation, unit and integration test strategy, and traceability — without letting compliance slow the team down. * **Lead with AI.** Use AI\-assisted tools for coding, design exploration, test generation, and documentation every day. Help define how our teams use AI responsibly in a regulated environment — validation of tool output, data handling, and what belongs in the design history file. * **Deliver results.** Own technical delivery against scope, schedule, and budget. Surface risks early, make the call, and land the milestone. * **Hand off and scale.** Once a program is running, build the bench behind you — mentor engineers, document the decisions, and hand off cleanly so you can start the next one. * **Support the win.** Partner with business development on technical discovery, estimates, and proposal content. Your architecture often shapes what gets sold. **What You Bring** ------------------ * **A track record of starting things.** You can point to programs you personally took from concept to a working, architected product — not just ones you joined midstream. * **Experience.** 10\+ years of professional software development, including 4\+ years as a technical lead or architect on client\-facing or multi\-team programs. * **Strong software development skills.** Deep hands\-on expertise in one or more of C\#/.NET, C\+\+, Python, or TypeScript, plus working knowledge of modern web, desktop, embedded, or cloud stacks. Solid grounding in design patterns, testing, CI/CD, and source control discipline. * **Architecture and design depth.** Experience defining architectures for instrument control, connected devices, data platforms, or cloud systems — and documenting them so others can build, verify, and maintain them. * **Regulated\-environment fluency.** Working command of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, and FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR, and what each means for how software is designed, built, and verified. Familiarity with medical device cybersecurity expectations (threat modeling, SBOM, Section 524B) is a strong plus. * **AI\-enabled.** Daily, practical use of AI coding and productivity tools, with a clear point of view on where they speed delivery and where they need human verification. Experience building AI/ML\-enabled features is a plus. * **Client presence.** Comfortable leading a design review with a client CTO, explaining trade\-offs to non\-engineers, and owning a hard conversation about scope or risk. * **Results orientation.** Self\-directed, organized, and accountable. You measure yourself by what ships. * **Technical foundation.** BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience considered. * **Travel.** 10–20% to client sites and other Gener8 locations. **What We Offer** ----------------- Competitive base salary and full benefits, with the backing of Gener8’s global engineering and manufacturing footprint behind every program you start. **Why Join Us** --------------- We operate at the intersection of cool science and precision engineering. The software we build ends up inside the instruments that diagnose disease and guide treatment — the work is real, and so are the standards it is held to. Our culture: high autonomy, intellectual rigor, and a healthy dose of wit. We work hard because the software we build matters. * *Gener8 values diversity in our workplace. Our company provides equal opportunity for employment to qualified applicants based on experience and the ability to do the available work, without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex/gender, sexual orientation, national origin, gender identity, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, ancestry, or any other status protected by law. We are committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.We are an Everify Employer.* **Company Benefits:** Health, Dental and Vision insurance; 401(k); Life insurance; STD, LTD; Flexible spending account, Health savings account; Paid time off; Employee discounts, Referral program.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **The Role:** Generate Biomedicines is seeking a principal engineer to lead the evolution of our scientific data and analytical tools. Experimental data is central to how we design, evaluate, and improve protein therapeutics. Making that data accessible, interpretable, and trustworthy is essential to connecting laboratory experimentation with computational design and scientific decision\-making. In this role, you will set the technical direction and deliver systems that connect agents with experimental data, reproducible processing, quality\-controlled results, and analysis across experiments. You will help scientists move beyond traditional workflows toward an integrated agentic experience where they can ask questions, explore evidence, and make informed decisions. You will build on Generate's agent platform, connecting agents with internal tools, data, and scientific workflows. Working closely with experimental scientists, Data Science, laboratory systems engineers, and the platform team, you will translate scientific needs into a clear roadmap and powerful software. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with responsibility for architecture, implementation, and adoption. **Location:** This role is based in Somerville, MA, with an expectation of working onsite at least three days per week. **Here's how you will contribute:** * **Define and deliver the scientific data and analytics roadmap.** Understand how scientists work today, identify the highest\-value opportunities, and turn a broad vision into focused capabilities that improve experimental analysis and decision\-making. * **Connect the experimental data lifecycle.** Design data models, interfaces, and workflows that link raw instrument outputs to samples, experimental conditions, processing methods, QC decisions, and published results. Partner with laboratory systems engineers to establish reliable handoffs from data capture into processing and analysis. * **Build reproducible processing and trustworthy results.** Work closely with Data Science and assay experts to define and implement mathematical methods, statistical analyses, normalization, and QC rules. Support versioned processing, traceable results, and controlled recomputation as methods evolve. * **Create** **agentic** **analytical experiences.** Build agent\-accessible tools and applications that help scientists retrieve data, inspect processing, visualize results, compare experiments, and explore hypotheses. Combine agent flexibility with validated computational methods and appropriate scientific review. * **Enable meaningful analysis across experiments.** Address differences in assay versions, units, experimental conditions, controls, and sample identity so scientists and computational teams can make defensible comparisons and reuse data. * **Lead through implementation and collaboration.** Make architectural decisions, build systems, guide engineering contributors, and resolve difficult integration problems. Partner with scientists and program teams to establish requirements, evaluate outputs, and drive adoption. * **Own measurable outcomes.** Assess success through reliable processing, scientific validity, time saved, and sustained use. Establish practical monitoring and feedback mechanisms, and improve workflows based on real scientific work. **The Ideal Candidate will have:** * A bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, bioinformatics, a quantitative scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Substantial experience designing and delivering scientific software or data systems, with demonstrated technical leadership across architecture, implementation, and deployment. * Strong hands\-on agentic programming skills, including Python, and experience building data\-processing pipelines, APIs, and analytical applications. * Experience developing or integrating AI agents, with sound judgment about their appropriate use, evaluation, and interaction with deterministic processing. * Experience modeling experimental data, including metadata, provenance, versioning, and data quality. Ability to balance consistent structures with the diversity of scientific workflows. * Strong grounding in mathematics, statistics, and experimental analysis to collaborate deeply with data scientists and assay experts and translate their methods into reliable software. * A track record of turning ambiguous scientific needs into a clear technical direction, prioritized deliverables, and software that people use. * Strong collaborative skills and the ability to communicate effectively with experimental scientists, data scientists, software engineers, and scientific leaders. \#LI\-HM1 **About Generate Biomedicines** We are a clinical\-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in drug design and development. We are advancing a new approach to drug creation—one grounded in the ability to design proteins with defined biological intent. By integrating machine learning with large\-scale experimentation, this approach aims to reduce the uncertainty, time, and cost associated with developing protein\-based medicines. Founded in 2018, we are advancing a growing pipeline of clinical and preclinical programs across multiple disease areas and protein modalities. By unifying computational design and clinical development within a single operating model, we translate this approach into clinical\-stage programs and are leading a shift from traditional drug discovery toward systematic drug generation. At Generate:Biomedicines, we collaborate across disciplines in new ways to invent and innovate. We bring diverse perspectives to a shared goal of delivering better medicines to patients in need, faster, guided by our values and leadership behaviors. Generate:Biomedicines is **committed to equal employment opportunity** regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. ***Recruitment \& Staffing Agencies****: Generate:Biomedicines does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Generate:Biomedicines or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by the Company's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Generate:Biomedicines and the Company will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

jobs.title: Sr. Software Test Engineer - Onsite in Burlington MA
jobs.description: How You’ll Contribute: The Senior Software Test Engineer I is a hands\-on member of the Software Test Engineering team responsible for testing and verification and validation (V\&V) of Software in a Medical Device (SiMD), Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), connected systems, and GxP\-relevant software tools. The role combines formal V\&V, exploratory, integration, and system\-level testing with opportunities to build automation capability over time. The engineer is expected to develop automation skills and contribute automated tests where they provide practical value, while collaborating with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software Test Engineering, and Quality Assurance. What You’ll Do: * Design, execute, and document software tests and formal V\&V activities, including functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, ad hoc, and non\-functional testing. * Develop test cases, formal test protocols, test reports, and requirements traceability documentation. * Execute formal test protocols and record objective evidence in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP). * Test medical\-device software, connected systems, hardware/software interfaces, and GxP\-relevant software tools. * Review requirements, specifications, and risk controls for clarity, completeness, and testability. * Identify, reproduce, investigate, document, and track software defects through resolution; analyze logs and test results to troubleshoot failures. * Set up and maintain test environments, test data, devices, and supporting tools required for assigned testing activities. * Develop automation skills and contribute automated tests or test utilities where appropriate. * Communicate test status, results, defects, technical risks, and recommendations clearly, and collaborate effectively across engineering and quality teams. How You’ll Get There: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a related technical or scientific discipline. * Five or more years of experience in software testing, software V\&V, or a closely related software testing role. * Strong hands\-on experience designing and executing software tests from requirements, specifications, risks, and system behavior. * Experience developing clear, repeatable test cases, formal test protocols, test reports, and traceability documentation. * Experience with requirements, test, defect, and version\-control tools. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Detail\-oriented and rigorous, with a disciplined approach to test execution, investigation, and documentation. * Curious and analytical, with a willingness to explore unexpected system behavior and investigate beyond the initial symptoms. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and quality teams. * Experience testing medical\-device software, SiMD, SaMD, GxP\-relevant tools, or another regulated or safety\-critical product is preferred. * Working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, or ISO 14971 is preferred. * Experience or interest in software test automation using Python, pytest, Squish, or similar tools is preferred. * This role is based in Burlington, MA, with hybrid flexibility when assigned work does not require on\-site testing or laboratory access. **Generous. Innovative. Leadership\-driven. Family\-oriented. Socially responsible.** Founded in 1998, Glaukos Corporation is an ophthalmic pharmaceutical and medical technology company focused on developing and commercializing novel therapies for the treatment of glaucoma, corneal disorders, and retinal diseases. Our global headquarters is in Aliso Viejo, California with additional locations in San Clemente, California, and Burlington, Massachusetts. **Glaukos Corporation is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer**. To ensure gTech's security and agility, the team analyzes gTech business processes to find control gaps, collaborates with stakeholders to resolve these gaps, and provides risk expertise to engineer solutions. gTech Risk Solutions Engineering is transforming from a reactive manual process led organization to a proactive engineering powerhouse. Operating as a federated security partner to Google's central security organizations, we design and build contextualized security solutions tailored specifically for the gTech business ecosystem. Our mission is upfront risk prevention through technical delivery excellence, shifting the paradigm from unsustainable "risk\-chasing" to "prevention by design." You will achieve this via gTech Risk's shift to automated prevention. You will own the overarching system design for autonomous risk identification, AI guardrails, and vulnerability auto\-mitigation. A central focus of your mandate will be architecting the security constraints for gTech's current and future operations. You will design the validation frameworks (including prompt injection resilience) for agentic platforms deployed on global configurations. You will act as the critical bridge to central teams, ensuring our local solutions conform to Google's general security policies while moving at the speed of gTech operations. The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $147000 \- $210000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design the security architecture and validation frameworks (e.g., prompt injection resilience, data flow constraints) for agentic platforms like our agentic access and vulnerability systems. * Design technical standards and automated workflows for vulnerability auto\-mitigation to ensure alignment with global SLO timelines. * Architect automated access control systems, integration templates, and data flow constraints to proactively prevent access abuse and data exfiltration, with particular focus on developing holistic mapping of agentic threat models and engineering solutions to prevent and detect before material risks manifest. * Align all technical architectures with central security design standards, serving as the primary design conduit to central infrastructure. * Design precise technical designs for the Operational Engineering (Build) team for software fulfillment. Your team will ensure that customer service level agreements and availability targets are met while maintaining environmental and safety standards, at scale. You will serve as a domain expert in critical facility systems (e.g., electrical distribution, HVAC/cooling, or control systems), provide site\-level technical direction, resolve high\-impact reliability challenges, and partner closely with facilities technicians, engineering peers, and senior leadership to deliver infrastructure. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Productivity (Remote, USA)
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40\+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open\-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation\-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career\-defining opportunity. *This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).* **The Opportunity** ------------------- ### **About our platform** Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low\-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely. The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, SDLC, security and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads. ### **About the Productivity group** We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Productivity group, which owns SDLC tooling, application security and observability, of the resources, systems and workloads used to build and run Grafana Labs products. The group enables product development through the provision of performant and feature\-rich SDLC tooling, governing the use and configuration of that tooling. We are responsible for guiding the product teams in application security good practices, reviewing product changes for security compliance and enabling security functions through self\-service automation. We also own and maintain the internal observability platform, using our own products to give visibility into cloud resource cost, usage and sustainability, and vulnerability management. You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group. We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self\-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen. ### **How we work** Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self\-service platform to do it on. Every engineer is on\-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on\-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth. * Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity. * Take platform changes from design to fleet\-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them. * Partner with the other Productivity squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours. * Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on\-call, and the ownership model between squads. * Own the  vigate ambiguity in a complex problem space. * Comfort with AI\-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI\-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow. **Bonus Points For** -------------------- * Experience across more than one of the group's areas: SDLC tooling, developer experience, application security, and observability. * Hands\-on depth in cloud infrastructure, SDLC tooling expertise, developer experience and making the right way the easy way, application security, monitoring tooling and alerting. You can challenge a threat model or a system design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to. * Building self\-service infrastructure for application teams. * Running observability for a production platform at scale. * Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure. * You've worked in or on open source, or other community\-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA" In the USA, the base compensation range for this role is $189,374 \- $227,249\. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. \#LI\-Remote * *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range \& benefits at the beginning of the process.* **Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:** * **100% Remote, Global Culture \-** As a remote\-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. * **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high\-growth, ever\-evolving environment. * **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision\-making and regular company\-wide updates. * **Innovation\-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. * **Open Source Roots** – Built on community\-driven values that shape how we work. * **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. * **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. * **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. * **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. * **In\-Person onboarding** \- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. * **Balance is Key** \- We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.* *Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.* \#LI\-Remote *For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Engineer, GTM
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- IT **Compensation** ---------------- * $153K – $210\.5K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= We're seeking a Senior AI Enablement Engineer to be the dedicated technical partner for Harvey's go\-to\-market organization — Sales, Customer Success, SDR, Legal Engineering, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations. GTM has been Harvey's most enthusiastic adopter of AI: teams have built dozens of skills, plugins, and agents on their own. That energy is an asset, but it has outrun the structure around it. Your job is to turn that energy into a focused set of workflows that GTM teams trust and use every day. This is a hands\-on technical IC role inside BizTech (Business Technology), partnering closely with GTM leaders, GTM Systems, and RevOps. You'll spend your time sitting with sellers, SDRs, and CSMs to understand how they actually work; consolidating and hardening the workflows worth keeping and retiring the ones that aren't; building the connector and MCP integrations those workflows depend on; and giving GTM a fast, clear answer when they want to try something new. The ideal candidate is a senior IC engineer who understands how a revenue team runs — pipeline, deal cycles, quota, account planning, renewals — well enough to earn credibility with a quota\-carrying rep, and who sees making Harvey's GTM team more effective with AI as the actual job. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Bring order to and extend GTM's AI footprint.** Audit the skills, plugins, and agents GTM teams have built; measure what's actually used; consolidate duplicates into well\-maintained versions; retire what isn't earning its place; ship new AI\-powered workflows. * **Be the AI tooling partner of choice for GTM teams.** Embed with Sales, CS, SDR, Legal Engineering, and Partnerships to understand their workflows from the inside — prospecting, call prep, follow\-up, account planning, pricing, renewals — and steer them toward solutions that fit how they work rather than building for its own sake. * **Own the intake for new AI features and experiments.** GTM regularly asks to try new capabilities as they ship. Partner with fellow AI Enablement Engineers to build a lightweight path for requesting, piloting, and evaluating them — success criteria up front, a timebox, and a clear adopt / wait / pass call at the end — so experimentation stays fast without leaving another trail of abandoned tools. * **Own technical governance of GTM skills and plugins.** Define publishing standards, ownership, review, and deprecation rules for the GTM side of the plugin and skill marketplace, and stand up usage and spend monitoring so adoption, cost, and staleness stay visible as adoption scales. * **Own the MCP and connector roadmap for GTM systems.** Harden and extend the integrations GTM workflows depend on — Salesforce, Gong meeting notes and call recording, Gmail and Calendar, Slack, Omni, and internal knowledge sources — with sensible read/write scoping and guardrails around anything that reaches customers or prospects. * **Build reference patterns GTM can extend.** Ship well\-structured templates and examples so GTM builders can create good workflows themselves, within guardrails, without you becoming the bottleneck for every new idea. * **Run AI vendor reviews for GTM tools.** AI sales tools pitch GTM leaders constantly. Partner with Privacy, Security, and Legal to evaluate them against a reusable framework and give a clear build / buy / pilot / pass recommendation. **What You Have** ================= * 5\+ years of software, integration, or GTM engineering experience, with at least 2 years building integrations or automation on top of GTM systems (CRM, sales engagement, conversation intelligence, CPQ, analytics). * A real understanding of how GTM teams work — the sales cycle, pipeline management, account planning, renewals and expansion — ideally from having worked inside or alongside a revenue org. You can talk to a rep about their week, not just their data. * Hands\-on experience with API integration patterns, OAuth and identity, webhook architectures, and the kind of glue work that makes enterprise systems actually talk to each other reliably. * Practical experience with LLM\-based applications and AI tooling — prompt design, agent workflows, retrieval, evaluation, or production integration of model APIs. You don't need to have trained a model; you do need to have shipped something real that depends on one. * Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent\-tool integration patterns. If you haven't shipped MCP yet, you've at minimum read the spec and built something against it. * A product mindset about internal tools. You measure adoption, talk to your users, and are as comfortable deprecating something as shipping it. * Strong communication and stakeholder\-management instincts with GTM leaders and individual contributors — you can redirect a VP's feature request toward a better solution and keep the relationship, and be the most pragmatic person in an engineering review the same afternoon. * Strong DevOps and operational fundamentals — CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, secrets management, and observability. You treat the integrations and AI tools you ship as production systems: version\-controlled, monitored, and safe to change without breaking the teams that depend on them. * Demonstrated experience applying data governance and security best practices, including to customer data and to agents that take external\-facing actions. * Comfort evaluating third\-party vendors — asking the right questions about data access and flows, reading DPAs, and translating findings into clear go/no\-go recommendations for the business. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and global environment with significant ambiguity. **Bonus Points:** * Background as a GTM Engineer, RevOps or Sales Ops engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer — ideally combined with internal tooling work. * Experience at a company where sales and CS teams adopted AI tooling at scale, and first\-hand lessons about what stuck and what didn't. * Hands\-on work with Salesforce (including custom development), sales engagement platforms, CPQ, or conversation intelligence tools, including their APIs or AI\-adjacent extensions. * Familiarity with enterprise iPaaS platforms. * Experience leading change management or enablement for a sales organization. **Compensation** ================ $153,000 \- $210,500USD ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices** **here****.** \#LI\-RB1 *Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai

jobs.title: CNC Programmer
jobs.description: **CNC Programmer** Location: Hadley Exhibits, Buffalo, NY **Position Summary** Hadley Exhibits is seeking an experienced CNC Programmer to support the production of custom exhibits, architectural millwork, specialty fabrication, and display projects. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining CNC router programs, preparing AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion models for manufacturing, and working closely with engineering, detailing, and production teams to ensure efficient and accurate CNC operations. The ideal candidate will have strong CNC programming experience, proficiency in Router\-CIM or comparable CAM software, and a solid understanding of nested\-based manufacturing. While this position is primarily focused on CNC programming, the successful candidate will also be comfortable modifying CAD files and producing simple manufacturing drawings to support fabrication requirements. **Responsibilities** * Create and maintain CNC router programs using Router\-CIM, Solid\-CIM, Advanced AutoNest, or comparable software. * Process and program 3D SolidWorks and Fusion models, along with 2D AutoCAD drawings, for CNC production. * Develop tooling, nesting, and machining strategies that maximize manufacturing efficiency and material utilization. * Work closely with engineering, detailing, project management, and manufacturing teams to prepare projects for production. * Modify and update AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion files to resolve manufacturability issues and support production requirements. * Create simple CAD drawings, shop drawings, and manufacturing documentation as needed. * Troubleshoot programming, tooling, and machining issues on the production floor. * Support continuous improvement initiatives related to CNC programming, machine utilization, workflow efficiency, and manufacturing processes. * Maintain organized program files, revisions, machine data, and manufacturing documentation. * Support programming and operation of KOMO CNC router equipment in a custom manufacturing environment. **Required Qualifications** * Minimum 3 years of CNC programming experience in a manufacturing environment. * Experience programming CNC routers using Router\-CIM, AlphaCAM, Cabinet Vision, Fusion CAM, Mastercam, RhinoCAM, EnRoute, or comparable CAM software. * Ability to learn and transition to new programming software and manufacturing technologies as needed. * Proficiency with AutoCAD. * Ability to work with SolidWorks and Fusion models, assemblies, and drawings. * Strong understanding of CNC machining processes, tooling, sheet goods, and nested\-based manufacturing. * Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and organizational skills. * Ability to work effectively with production personnel, detailers, engineers, and project managers. * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * 5\+ years of CNC programming experience. * Experience in custom millwork, architectural woodworking, exhibits, displays, cabinetry, furniture manufacturing, retail fixtures, or related industries. * Experience working directly from AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion models to create manufacturing\-ready CNC programs. * Familiarity with KOMO CNC routers and nested\-based manufacturing workflows. * Ability to make CAD modifications and create production drawings when required. * Experience improving manufacturing workflows, material yield, or machine utilization through programming and process improvements. **What Success Looks Like** * Accurate, efficient, and production\-ready CNC programs delivered on schedule. * Strong collaboration with detailing, engineering, project management, and manufacturing teams. * Minimal machine downtime related to programming errors or machining inefficiencies. * Continuous improvement in material yield, machining efficiency, program quality, and production throughput. * Well\-organized and maintainable program files, revisions, and manufacturing documentation. * Successful support of complex custom fabrication and exhibit projects from design through production. **Why Join Hadley Exhibits** * Work on unique custom exhibit, museum, visitor center, architectural millwork, and specialty fabrication projects. * Collaborate with an experienced team of designers, engineers, detailers, and manufacturing professionals. * Play a key role in driving CNC manufacturing efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives. * Opportunity to influence future CNC programming workflows, software development, and manufacturing processes. * Contribute directly to highly visible projects that are built in\-house and installed throughout North America. **Work Location: One location/In Person** *Hadley Exhibits Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws.* Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Profit sharing * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Ability to Commute: * Buffalo, NY 14207 (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Buffalo, NY 14207: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Customer Experience Lead
jobs.description: **About Hark** Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory. We're pairing that intelligence with next\-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade\-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world. To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next\-generation AI hardware together \- designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems. **About the Team** You'll be the first person our users meet when something matters, and the person who makes sure it never happens twice. As our Technical Customer Experience Lead, you own every customer's success with Hark across our app, our agent, and our devices. You'll solve the hard cases yourself, then use AI and AI coding agents to build the systems that solve the next thousand automatically. You'll sit close to engineering and product, and what you learn from customers will shape what we ship. This is a founding role: you'll define how Hark takes care of people, and eventually build the team that does it. **Responsibilities** * **Own customer outcomes end to end.** Work directly with users, get to the real root cause, and leave them better off than when they reached out. * **Build AI\-powered customer systems.** Design the triage, routing, drafting, knowledge retrieval, and automated resolution that make every answer faster and better than the last. * **Ship your own tools.** Use AI coding agents to build the scripts, integrations, dashboards, and workflows behind customer success, without waiting on engineering. * **Be the technical bridge to engineering.** Reproduce bugs, read logs, and hand engineering clear, actionable reports. * **Turn signal into product.** Spot patterns across customer conversations and turn them into product feedback, help center content, and fixes that prevent the next issue. * **Own the numbers.** Response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, with a constant loop to improve them. * **Build the function.** The playbook, tooling, escalation paths, and eventually the team, as Hark scales. **Requirements** * **Customer Experience:** 1–5 years in customer experience, customer support, or support operations, ideally at a consumer tech or software company, with hands\-on customer work. * **Genuine Care for Customers:** You care about the person on the other side and take pride in getting them to a real answer. * **AI\-First Mindset:** You use AI to raise the quality and speed of how you help customers, and you can point to ways you've already done it. * **Comfort with AI Coding Agents:** You build what you need with AI coding tools, whether that's a script, an integration, or an internal tool. * **Technical Depth:** You troubleshoot software issues, read logs, and explain technical problems clearly to both users and engineers. * **Strong Communication:** Your writing is clear, warm, and precise, and you adjust your tone for a frustrated customer, an engineer, or a leadership update. **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience building or scaling a customer function at an early\-stage startup. * Experience supporting consumer software and hardware products. * Familiarity with platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Front, and their APIs. * Experience with AI or LLM\-powered products. **Compensation** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is between $120,000 \- $170,000 annually. The pay offered for this position may vary based on several individual factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional components and benefits depending on the specific role. This information will be shared if an employment offer is extended.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Customer Success
jobs.description: **Why we're hiring** -------------------- Harper is an AI\-native commercial insurance brokerage. Our product is the operating system our own teams run on: voice AI intake, placements, instant quoting, sales, service and retention, plus the operator tools that tie them together. Each module has engineers, a forward\-deployed pod and operators who live in it every day, but not enough product ownership to decide what to build, measure whether it worked, and keep the module coherent as it scales. This hire closes that gap. Each PM becomes the single owner of a module's outcomes: its KPIs, its roadmap and the operator experience inside it. **Experience:** 5–8 years. **Scope:** Service (Customer Success) **About the role** You own a product area that spans more than one team and more than one quarter. Nobody hands you the problem list; you find the problems worth solving, decide which to bet on, and are accountable for the outcome even when the work runs through several pods. Service is the clearest example. It touches endorsements, certificates, renewals, billing and claims support, and today a lot of it runs on human effort. The Senior PM decides what gets productized, what stays operator\-owned, and in what order. ### **What you'll own** * **Outcomes, not features.** Propose the KPI set for your area and defend why those are the right targets. At least one should trace to a company top\-line number (revenue, retention, cost per policy). * **A 3–6 month roadmap** with clear bets, sequencing and kill criteria. * **Growth avenues.** Look past optimizing today's funnel: new segments, use cases, or ways to expand revenue per account. * **Cross\-team delivery.** Break initiatives into plans other people can execute; chase dependencies directly; re\-plan out loud the moment reality changes. * **Ops partnership.** Be embedded enough that operators treat you as a peer on process. Turn recurring operational pain into bets with clear ROI. * **Raising the bar.** Mentor the PM on specs and prioritization; own a stage of the PM interview loop. **Logistics** ------------- + **Compensation:** $125,000–$170,000 base \+ performance bonus \+ equity. + **Location:** San Francisco, in\-office. Based here or willing to relocate. + **Benefits:** Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks and coffee stocked; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision. **To apply:** Commercial insurance has never been rebuilt, and the gap between what frontier models make possible and what's actually shipped in this industry is the largest it will ever be. If you want to own a module that touches real customers from week one — send your resume and tell us about something you built that moved a number. Compensation Range: $125K \- $170K

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Technical Lead (Remote or Hybrid)
jobs.description: The rewards at Healogics are immense, starting with the important work we do to change patients’ lives. We also understand that meaningful work is hard work, and we are committed to supporting and compensating our employees for the tremendous service they provide. Think you are a great fit? Learn more about this role here: Healogics is the largest provider of advanced wound care services in the United States, treating more than 300,000 chronic wound patients annually across over 600 sites. With an aging society, obesity and diabetes on the rise, and an increase in surgical procedures, the number of patients with non\-healing wounds who would benefit from expert care continues to grow. The company is working to extend its differentiated quality outcomes to more patients through outpatient clinic partnerships. Healogics is seeking a Staff Engineer, Technical Lead to provide staff\-level technical and engineering leadership while directly managing and developing software engineers. This role combines staff\-level engineering, technical leadership, and engineering\-team leadership. The position is accountable for technical strategy, architecture, engineering practices, and engineering capability across an assigned product area while remaining hands\-on with critical architecture, design, code, and complex technical problems. The role leads internal engineers and external engineering partners to deliver secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software. All Healogics employees must perform their job responsibilities in accordance with Healogics and hospital policies; applicable accrediting organization requirements; federal and state regulations; and Centers for Medicare \& Medicaid Services guidelines, as applicable.* Partner with Product and Technology leadership to define technical strategy, architecture, modernization priorities, engineering standards, and delivery practices for an assigned product area. * Own technical direction across products and delivery teams, establishing architecture, reusable patterns, and engineering expectations across full\-stack applications, APIs, integrations, cloud services, and data\-enabled workflows. * Remain hands\-on with critical or complex solution design, prototyping, code review, troubleshooting, and development while delegating appropriately to engineering teams. * Build engineering capability across internal and external teams by establishing development practices, quality expectations, technical leadership patterns, knowledge\-transfer expectations, and effective use of modern engineering tools. * Partner with Product Management, Data, Interoperability, Security, Infrastructure, and other teams to evaluate technical options, dependencies, estimates, tradeoffs, sequencing, and delivery risks. * Provide technical and delivery oversight of external engineering partners, including architecture, estimates, solution and code quality, delivery risks, knowledge transfer, and adherence to Healogics standards. * Directly manage assigned software engineers, including goals, feedback, coaching, workload alignment, performance management, career development, hiring, and onboarding. * Develop software engineers through architecture collaboration, code review, technical coaching, delegation, and knowledge sharing. * Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, engineering risks, tradeoffs, progress, and recommendations clearly to executive, business, product, and technical audiences. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Required Education, Experience and Credentials:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience. * Ten or more years of progressive software engineering experience building and supporting production applications, including significant technical leadership responsibility. * Demonstrated experience leading architecture and system design, mentoring engineers, and directly managing or developing software engineers. **Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:** * Advanced software engineering, architecture, and system\-design skills across modern web applications, APIs, cloud services, integrations, and data\-enabled applications. * Strong hands\-on experience with modern full\-stack application development using technologies such as C\#/.NET or Java; React, Angular, or comparable JavaScript frameworks; RESTful APIs; SQL; NoSQL or document databases; and cloud\-based architectures using AWS, Microsoft Azure, or comparable platforms. * Experience designing and building modern data\-enabled or AI\-enabled applications; experience with capabilities such as conversational AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, natural language processing, and structured or unstructured data is preferred. * Ability to establish engineering standards and improve software quality, automated testing, maintainability, observability, security, and delivery practices. * Ability to evaluate architecture options, estimates, dependencies, risks, and engineering tradeoffs and provide clear recommendations. * Strong people\-leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to set expectations for technical quality, delivery accountability, collaboration, and professional growth. * Experience providing technical oversight of external development partners or distributed engineering teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and risks to executive, business, product, and technical audiences. * Experience using AI\-assisted software engineering tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable coding agents, with the ability to establish practices for their effective and responsible use while maintaining software quality, security, review standards, and human accountability. * Preferred: Experience with healthcare technology, provider\-facing applications, clinical workflows, EHR ecosystems, HL7 or FHIR, clinical decision support, Databricks, or comparable data and AI platforms. \#LI\-RS1 The base salary for this position generally ranges between $140,000\-$180,000 annually This range is an estimate, based on potential employee qualifications: education, experience, geography as well as operational needs and other considerations permitted by law. If you are a current employee, to submit a job application, you need to apply as an internal candidate in Workday via the “Jobs Hub”.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Requirements The Lead Software Engineer develops information systems by designing, developing, and installing software solutions. Drives all aspects of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including producing specifications and determining operational feasibility. This role requires expertise in business continuity, disaster recovery, Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, and process automation. The candidate must have a strong grasp of emerging technologies, platforms, and applications, with the ability to customize them for enhanced security and efficiency. They will also create documentation for administrative processes supporting the infrastructure. ***Principal Duties and Responsibilities:*** * Assist in technical leadership initiatives for the infrastructure, ensuring integration with Microsoft 365\. * Assist in implementing and monitoring security protocols like single sign\-on (SSO) and multifactor authentication to strengthen system defenses. * Contribute to automation efforts for infrastructure provisioning and management using Azure and other tools. * Participate in monitoring system health and performance, with a focus on enhancing security posture. * Support the administration and optimization of Active Directory and Azure Active Directory environments. * Learn to utilize tools such as Intune and Autopilot for endpoint management and process automation. * Contribute to developing and maintaining operating system backup solutions for system and disaster recovery. * Assist in documenting implementations and ensuring alignment with best practices. * Support the team in defining the long\-term direction, roadmaps, and standards for technical solutions. * Provide input for recommending cloud\-based solutions to improve operations, security, and minimize failures. * Assist in identifying single points of failure and areas lacking resiliency within the cloud infrastructure. * Support technology evaluation and reengineering efforts, contributing to process improvement. * Participate in managing projects from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. * Provide updates on workload and project status to management. * Assist in troubleshooting and problem\-solving efforts. * Stay informed about Azure features, services, and security trends. * Contribute to developing and maintaining automation frameworks for cloud enablement tools. ***Additional Duties and Responsibilities:*** * Update knowledge and develop professionally on a continuing basis. Participate in internal and external training and development opportunities as required. * Perform other duties as may be necessary to fulfill the responsibilities of this role. * Fully complies with all applicable enterprise policies and procedures. Acts in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as outlined in training materials, including but not limited to Bank Secrecy Act. Responsible for reporting suspicious activity to the AML/CFT team. ***Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:*** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field. * Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, Intune, and Autopilot. * Demonstrated knowledge in business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. * Proficiency in cybersecurity, particularly in zero trust security methodologies, with relevant certifications preferred. * Ability to create detailed documentation and data flow diagrams. * Strong project management skills and the ability to lead and collaborate on multiple projects. * Excellent communication skills and a team\-oriented mindset. * In\-depth knowledge of Azure, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and automation tools. * Strong documentation and diagramming skills to convey complex information clearly. * Preferred certifications include: + Azure Administrator Associate AZ\-104Azure Solutions Architect Expert AZ\-305 + Azure Security Engineer Associate AZ\-500 + Azure Network Engineer Associate AZ\-700 + Identity and Access Administrator Associate SC\-300 ***Working Conditions:*** Work is performed in a pleasant office environment with minimal chance for personal injury. jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** We are a company where **people matter**. We are **family driven**. We are **financially strong**. And we are looking for problem\-solvers to join our growing team. **BENEFITS** * Up to 10% Retirement Contribution * $600 per Year Wellness Incentive * Two Weeks Starting Paid Time Off * Medical, Dental, and Vision \- *Eligible* f*irst day of the month following hire date.* ***JOIN A TOP WORKPLACE \-*** *https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=7nlFHnnfvhk* **DATA INTEGRATION ENGINEER** The Data Integration Engineer is a detail\-oriented, systems\-minded professional who designs, builds, and supports the pipelines that move data between our business systems and Snowflake. This role is based in Brookfield, WI. The primary purpose of this position is to deliver reliable, efficient, and well\-structured enterprise data. Using Matillion as our primary ETL platform, this person will become the expert in our data flows from Infor M3 into Snowflake and will simplify them to improve how reliably and efficiently we move data. As we expand Snowflake with data from integrated systems such as Bluejay TMS, Maximo, and Salesforce, this role will select the right integration approach, whether MuleSoft, APIs, or another method, and structure the data for consumption by business users for reporting and by AI agents. This is an AI\-forward team, and this role is central to preparing AI\-ready data through semantic layers and evaluations that support the Model Context Protocol (MCP). ***Primary responsibilities include:*** Build and Support Matillion ETL Pipelines: * Design, build, monitor, and support ETL pipelines using Matillion, including orchestration, scheduling, dependencies, and deployment. * Become the team's expert on all existing ETL data flows, including the core Infor M3 to Snowflake integrations, their dependencies, and their business purpose. * Simplify and consolidate data flows to optimize pipeline reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability. * Troubleshoot data issues across the full pipeline, from source system through semantic layer. Integrate New Systems into Snowflake: * Develop and maintain data pipelines between systems such as ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, APIs, and Snowflake. * Onboard data from integrated systems such as Bluejay TMS, Maximo, and Salesforce. * Evaluate and select the right integration method for each source, including Matillion, MuleSoft, direct APIs, or other approaches, based on reliability, efficiency, and supportability. * Implement data quality checks, reconciliation processes, monitoring, logging, and error handling. Model and Structure Data in Snowflake: * Design and maintain staging, transformation, and curated data structures within Snowflake. * Develop reusable data models, views, and semantic layers. * Define appropriate data grain, relationships, dimensions, facts, measures, and business definitions. Prepare Trusted Data for BI and AI: * Build and manage data flows that deliver trusted enterprise data to Power BI, AI solutions, applications, and other consumers. * Create semantic layers and write evaluations that prepare data for AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Provide the trusted data foundation needed for BI, analytics, Copilot/AI, agents, and natural\-language querying. Partner, Document, and Govern: * Partner with business analysts and BI/reporting resources to translate business requirements into scalable data models. * Document source\-to\-target mappings, lineage, transformation logic, and business definitions, and support governance around shared enterprise data definitions and semantic models. * Establish engineering standards for Matillion, Snowflake, SQL, Git/source control, and deployment practices. **REPORTING STRUCTURE** * This position reports to the Sr. Manager \- Applications **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered. * 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or data integration. * Hands\-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines with Matillion or a comparable tool (e.g., Fivetran, Informatica, SSIS, or Azure Data Factory). * Strong SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse. * Solid understanding of dimensional modeling (facts, dimensions, grain) and data warehouse design. * Experience integrating data through REST APIs, middleware such as MuleSoft, or other integration platforms. * Experience with Git/source control, orchestration, and deployment practices for data pipelines. * Openness to AI tools such as Copilot Studio, Cowork, and Snowflake Coco, and interest in preparing data for AI agents. * Proven problem\-solving skills, including the ability to trace data issues across multiple systems to root cause. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical designs. * Conscientious work style with high attention to detail, accuracy, and thorough documentation. * Experience with ERP data, ideally Infor M3, preferred. * Familiarity with Salesforce, Maximo, transportation management system (TMS), or Power BI data preferred. * Experience building semantic models, writing AI evaluations, or working with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) preferred. **ADDITIONAL BENEFITS** Benefits and perks include 401k and profit sharing, medical/dental/vision/life insurance, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance, legal services insurance, scholarship awards for children of employees, summer picnic, community giving events, free family wellness coaching including nutritionist and fitness coach. **WANT TO STAY CONNECTED? FIND US ON SOCIAL MEDIA** * LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/hydrite\-chemical\-co\- * Facebook: facebook.com/hydrite * YouTube:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=Bs\_493NR8RI Learn more about Hydrite on our website: www.hydrite.com/careers Privacy Notice for California Residents: https://www.hydrite.com/Legal/Privacy\-Notice\-for\-Employees.htm

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description We are seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to build technology solutions that help public health programs operate more effectively. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working directly with users, understanding complex operational problems, and turning them into reliable software that delivers measurable value. As an embedded member of a cross\-functional team, you will partner with program staff, technical assistance providers, product teams, engineers, and client stakeholders. You will help uncover needs, shape solutions, build and test them with users, and take successful capabilities into production. The role combines full\-stack software engineering, workflow automation, data integration, and applied AI in an environment where requirements evolve as teams learn. You will be successful if you are equally comfortable writing production code, talking with users, working through ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical decisions. **Responsibilities** ==================== **Discover and define:** Work directly with program teams, client stakeholders, and end users to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for technology, and translate loosely defined problems into practical technical solutions. **Prototype and build:** Design and build across the full stack, including user experiences, application services, APIs, relational data models, integrations, workflows, dashboards, and reporting. Move quickly from problem definition to working prototypes and iterate with real user feedback. **Apply AI where it adds value:** Build AI\-assisted capabilities such as summarization, structured extraction, classification, and workflow support. Preserve appropriate human review and account for reliability, privacy, data governance, and responsible use. **Deploy and improve:** Move successful capabilities into reliable production environments with maintainability, security, error handling, traceability, testing, and operational support in mind. Observe usage, diagnose issues, and improve solutions based on feedback. **Scale what works:** Turn lessons from program\-specific implementations into reusable platform capabilities, technical patterns, and components. Surface gaps between platform capabilities and real\-world needs and feed those insights back to product and engineering teams. **Communicate clearly:** Explain technical options, feasibility, tradeoffs, and constraints to technical and non\-technical audiences. Support demonstrations, walkthroughs, and hands\-on sessions with users and stakeholders. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** * 3 years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful full\-stack development experience. **Additional Qualifications** * Strong programming skills and experience building modern web applications with JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable technologies. * Experience with relational databases, APIs, external services, and production software delivery. * Ability to work directly with users and stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to deliver iteratively when requirements are incomplete or changing. * Experience with version control, code review, testing, and collaborative software development practices. **Preferred** * Client\-facing, embedded, consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering experience. * Experience integrating LLM capabilities into applications, including summarization, structured extraction, classification, evaluation, or AI\-enabled workflows. * Experience building multi\-step workflows, stateful applications, or human\-in\-the\-loop processes. * Experience with case management, workflow, grant management, or program management systems. * Cloud\-native development, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, or production operations experience. * Experience with government technology environments, sensitive data, data governance, privacy, or responsible AI. * Interest or experience in health, public health, rural health, or public\-sector program delivery. * Professional use of AI\-assisted software engineering tools. **How You’ll Work and What Success Looks Like** =============================================== This role sits at the intersection of engineering, users, and real\-world operations. You will not simply receive a backlog of fully defined requirements. You will work with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to accomplish, determine the right technical approach, and move from idea to working software. Some problems will require traditional engineering; others may benefit from workflow automation, data integration, or AI. In your first six months, success means developing a strong understanding of the program and its users, building trusted workin ities that address meaningful operational needs. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with deep data platform expertise and is passionate about building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data systems using modern engineering practices. This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70\-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Birmingham, AL; Louisville, KY; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO.
