escalate nonconforming work and potential design impacts. * Coordinate with structural engineers and design teams to resolve field conditions, dimensional conflicts, constructability issues, and technical questions; track RFIs and actions through closure. **Construction Management, Schedule \& Quality** * Track structural work against the project schedule and look\-ahead plans; identify delays, access constraints, trade conflicts, and material or design issues that may affect critical\-path activities. * Support daily reports, progress measurement, quantity verification, schedule updates, issue logs, constraint logs, and short\-interval planning for structural scope. * Support quality\-control implementation, inspection and test plans, concrete and steel testing, survey verification, weld and bolt inspections, punch lists, deficiency tracking, and closeout documentation. * Confirm that current approved drawings, specifications, equipment data, and work packages are available to field personnel; identify superseded or conflicting information. * Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable records of inspections, photographs, redlines, RFIs, NCRs, test reports, daily reports, meeting minutes, and structural closeout information. **Safety, Commissioning \& Turnover** * Champion Jacobs BeyondZero® safety culture; participate in site safety observations, pre\-task planning, toolbox talks, and coordination of safe work practices with contractors and subcontractors. * Support construction readiness, structural completion, equipment installation readiness, commissioning interfaces, punch\-list resolution, turnover, and operational handover activities. * Participate in constructability reviews, coordination meetings, lessons learned, and continuous\-improvement initiatives focused on safe, high\-quality data\-center and advanced\-manufacturing delivery. * Promote Jacobs’ culture of safety, quality, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion in all interactions with project teams, contractors, clients, and partners Here's what you'll need **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience) * Typically, 5\-10 years \+ of experience in site engineering, field engineering, structural construction, construction management, or technical project delivery for complex facilities. * Experience supporting structural construction on Data Center, Advanced Technology, Semiconductor, industrial, mission\-critical, or similarly complex facility projects; hyperscale experience is preferred. * Working knowledge of design\-build, EPCM, or owner’s\-engineer delivery models and the interfaces among engineering, construction, commissioning, and client teams. * Working knowledge of construction documents, structural drawings and specifications, RFIs, submittals, inspections, quality records, daily reports, schedule tracking, and document\-control practices. **Ideally, you'll have** * PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI certification preferred or in progress * Professional Engineer (PE), Structural Engineer (SE), Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT), or comparable credential preferred; PE/SE licensure is not required unless assigned project duties require it. * Master’s degree in engineering, Project Management, or Construction Management * Experience on hyperscale cloud (AWS, Azure, Google, Meta), advanced semiconductor, or advanced manufacturing programs. * LEED AP BD\+C, CEA, or DBIA credential — differentiates on sustainability\-driven and Design\-Build pursuits * Familiarity with structural codes and standards, including IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, AWS, OSHA, and client construction standards. **Why Jacobs** Jacobs’ Data Center \& Advanced Manufacturing practice is among the fastest\-growing practices in the firm, delivering programs for hyperscale cloud providers, colocation operators, and semiconductor fab owners across the US and globally. Posted Salary Range: Minimum 90,000\.00 Posted Salary Range: Upper 160,000\.00 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has a U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full\-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock. The base salary range for this position is $90,000\.00 to $160,000\.00\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on November 16, 2026\. This position will be open for at least 3 days. We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. The engineer brings hands\-on AI engineering expertise to ask the right questions, review designs, guide technical decisions, and help teams navigate data access, model selection, secure and cost\-effective architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC) requirements, and governance and oversight requirements. Success is measured by the capability and independence of business builders and the quality of business\-owned solutions—not by the volume of solutions personally developed. jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Jarrod Smart Construction (JSC) and Smart Commercial Construction (SCC) are building an AI capability that starts with their own information and repeatable work. The business decides what to automate and what success looks like. This role turns those requirements into working technology. You will connect our systems and data, build and maintain AI agents and the MCP connections they depend on, and make sure the result is secure and usable. You will work for both companies, so you need to be comfortable serving two teams with different platforms and a shared Microsoft 365 environment. **What****you****will****do** ============================= * Meet with each team to understand the process, the information it needs, and who reviews the output, then translate that into technical requirements and a build plan. * Build and maintain AI agents and automations for repeatable work such as proposals and estimates, selections tracking, schedule and daily\-log summaries, change orders, and billing and closeout. * Design, build, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and connectors that let agents securely read from and, where approved, write to our systems: Microsoft 365, Ressio, JobTread, and Adaptive. * Integrate systems and data using APIs, exports, and workflow tools where MCP is not available, so agents work from accurate, current information. * Configure and administer Microsoft 365 Copilot, including permissions, data access, and separation between the two companies inside the shared tenant. * Organize and document our domain of knowledge: where key information lives, how clean it is, and how an agent can reach it safely. * Implement the governance the business sets: approved tools, access and privacy controls, human\-review steps in each workflow, usage and cost visibility, and a clear way to shut a workflow off. * Train staff on the tools you deliver, and keep documentation, prompts, and how\-to guides current. * Evaluate new AI tools and MCP\-enabled integrations and recommend what to adopt, wait on, or skip. **Required****qualifications** ============================== * 2 to 3 years of experience building automations, integrations, or AI\-enabled workflows in a business setting. * Hands\-on experience building or using MCP servers or comparable tool\-calling and agent integrations, and a solid understanding of how agents connect to business systems. * Experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Power Automate) and with Copilot or a comparable AI assistant. * Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and data connectors, and scripting skill in Python or JavaScript (or Power Platform). * Practical experience with large language models: prompting, building agents, and knowing their failure modes, such as made\-up answers and data leakage. * Sound judgment on security, privacy, and permissions when systems and people overlap, especially two companies in one tenant. * Clear communicator who can gather requirements from non\-technical people and explain technical work in plain language. **Preferred** ============= * Experience in construction, design\-build, or another project\-based business. * Familiarity with construction or accounting platforms (JobTread, Ressio, Adaptive or similar). * Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, or similar low\-code and cloud tooling. * Background in analytics, data cleanup, or business systems administration. **Our****systems** ================== Microsoft 365 and Copilot (shared by both companies), Ressio (JSC), CoConstruct moving to JobTread (SCC), and Adaptive for accounts payable (both). **You****will****do****well****here****if****you** ================================================== * Start small, ship, then watch how it performs and grow it, rather than chase the biggest project. * Keep humans at the helm and treat AI like a smart intern: give it context, review everything, and have a person sign off. * Enjoy learning how the business actually runs and building what the teams need. **What****we****offer** ======================= We offer a good work environment with room to grow, competitive pay, paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401k with company match! In addition, we offer Health Insurance, Dental, Vision, Life/Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Accident, and Critical Illness. *Compensation**and**details**will**be**discussed**with**candidates.* \#hc273721

jobs.title: Opto-Mechanical Design Engineer (Precision Mechanism Design)
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market\-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high\-volume manufacturing. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. * Design, build, prototype testing the next generation broad band plasma (BBP) Wafer inspection opto\-mechanical assemblies. * Collaborated development with core suppliers. * Sustain current broad band plasma (BBP) product lines with manufacturing division. * Work with system, optical, electrical and software engineer to derive the subsystem requirements and conduct design reviews. * CAD Modeling: Cero experience preferred * Precision mechanism development: actuator selection, tolerance analysis, lifetime evaluation, optics mounting, alignment \& adjustment design, etc * CAE: thermal \& structural simulation, flow analysis is a plus (ANSYS experience preferred) * Qualify and release the mechanism design, provide support for onsite manufacturing. **Minimum Qualifications** Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $95,000\.00 \- $161,500\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-CA\-Milpitas\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Use of AI Statement** At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. **Equal Opportunity Statement** KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. knowledge of wireless test and measurement systems. * Customer\-facing experience on complex technical projects; experience leading technical investigations. * Exposure to 5G\-Advanced, NTN, Open RAN or 6G technologies. **Ideal Candidate:** * Combines deep wireless protocol expertise with strong hands\-on software development skills, enjoys solving difficult technical problems, and is comfortable working directly with customers and R\&D teams.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Growth
jobs.description: **Quick Summary** ----------------- Shape how Kin speaks to homeowners and move them from first click to customer through high\-impact positioning, integrated cross\-channel campaigns, and landing page tests. **Who we are** -------------- Kin makes life simpler, more affordable, and better for homeowners — especially in the places where climate risks, rising costs, and outdated systems make it harder. We start with smarter homeowners insurance and expand to everything homeowners need to thrive. Using data, technology, and thoughtful human support, we’re building products that are clear, fair, and help homeowners feel confident — so homeowners aren’t left behind when they need help most. Founded in 2016, Kin is a remote\-first employer with Kinfolk across more than 35 states. We serve customers in 14 states (and counting). Our disciplined growth, strong customer satisfaction, and focus on long\-term sustainability fosters outstanding growth, attracts marquee investors, and earns recognition and accolades, including: * Built In Chicago's Best Places to Work, Midsize Companies (2021\-2026\) * Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers (2026\) * Inc. 5000 Fastest\-Growing Private Companies * Forbes’ Fintech 50 (2023\-2026\) * Great Places to Work Certified (May 2024\-May 2027\) Most importantly, we’re building Kin to be a place where people do meaningful work with real impact — for our customers, our communities, and each other. We're excited to tell you more about how you can contribute to our rapid growth, strong unit economics, profitability, and excellent customer ratings. To learn more about how we work and what we’re building, visit kin.com and see how we work. **The opportunity** ------------------- We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help Kin win specific homeowners in specific markets, and to show what great integrated marketing looks like here. Our marketing technology foundation is largely in place: a headless CMS behind kin.com, an experimentation platform, behavioral analytics, and a customer data platform. What’s missing is the strategy layer on top: who we’re going after, what we say to them, and how that story carries from the ad to the landing page to the sales conversation. Early pilots showed that sharper messaging alone can meaningfully lift lead conversion. This role exists to turn insights like those into campaigns that ship, get measured, and scale. You’ll sit on the Growth product team and partner closely with Marketing’s channel owners, creative, and Marketing Analytics. You’ll set campaign strategies and have the responsibility of creating buy\-in for them. You’ll also work alongside the teams that own our marketing technology, so your time goes to strategy, messaging, and conversion, with hands\-on involvement in marketing systems when your campaigns need it. **Your responsibilities** ------------------------- * Lead high\-impact, cross\-channel campaigns each quarter, from the campaign brief and audience insight through messaging, channel plan, testing budget, KPIs, and scaling investment after a win, carrying one consistent story from ad to landing page * Define positioning and messaging by product and state, partnering with product owners, UX research, marketing, and sales to find the stories that convert * Identify and size priority audience segments, such as first\-time homebuyers or Spanish\-speaking homeowners in growth markets, and define the data, routing, and experience each segment needs to be activated * Own landing page content and messaging strategy on kin.com, including expanding existing consumer tools, and run focused A/B testing programs on copy, page sequencing, and the lead capture form * Build fast learning loops: launch small, read results quickly, kill what isn’t working without attachment, and share what you learned so the next test is smarter * Define what each campaign and test needs to measure, and work with Marketing Analytics, RevOps, and engineering so the right events and audiences exist before launch * Use AI tools to speed up research, message variants, and test readouts, while keeping the audience insight and judgment human **Success in this role** ------------------------ In your first 6–12 months at Kin, success is less about checking boxes and more about the impact you create. You’ll use your skills and judgment to take ownership of meaningful work, improve how we operate, and help move Kin’s mission forward. Along the way, you’ll deliver outcomes that make a real difference for both Kinfolk and the homeowners we serve. By the end of your first year, you should feel confident in your role, trusted as an owner, and proud of the progress you’ve helped make. * Several integrated campaigns have launched against defined audiences, with measurable lifts in lead conversion and lead\-to\-customer conversion traced back to them * Clear, tested positioning exists for our core products and priority states, and channel teams are using it in their ow on\-birthing parents **Growth \& Development** * Career mobility and internal growth opportunities across the organization * Professional development budgets for certifications, conferences, and learning available, subject to management approval **How we work** --------------- We don’t just hire for skills. We hire for alignment. Kinfolk bring diverse perspectives, but we’re united by a shared set of values that shape how we work and how we show up for each other and our customers. **Run through walls, together** \- Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. We assume the best in each other and challenge ideas, not intentions. We show up, work hard, and play to each other's strengths — because that’s how great teams win. **Raise the bar. Drop the ego** \- Attitudes are contagious. Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. Like professional sports teams, we win by working in sync. We show up, work hard, and play to each other’s strengths. **Act like an owner** \- We are owners, fully accountable for achieving Kin’s mission. That requires positive, proactive, big\-picture thinking well beyond our job descriptions. Ask questions, Take ownership. Do the right thing, even when it‘s hard. Because when Kin thrives, so do you. And so do our customers. **Operate lean. Deliver more** \- We build efficiency into everything we do. Each dollar we save gets reinvested to deliver more to our customers: better pricing, more products, and new innovations. We work smarter by relentlessly prioritizing and using technology, including AI, to multiply our impact. Lean is about focus, not deprivation. Lean isn't a limitation — it's our competitive advantage. **Keep asking ‘What if?’** \- We value curiosity. To make insurance better for our customers, we experiment. We embrace insights. And we base decisions on data rather than assumptions. We see setbacks as opportunities for growth and are always learning and improving. Both individually and as a company. **Where we work** ----------------- We are a remote\-first company with offices in Chicago, IL and St. Petersburg, FL where teams can come together for collaboration. For Sales Agents and Customer Service Agents: These roles sit in any of the following 32 states: AL, AZ, CO, FL, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, and WI. For all other positions, these roles can sit in any of the following 41 states: AL, AR, AZ, CA (exempt only), CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NE, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, and WI. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full\-time in one of the states listed above. For remote technical positions located in Canada, we are only able to hire individuals who reside in Ontario. Applicants must be able to live and work full\-time in Ontario to be considered. State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift. **EEOC statement** ------------------ Kin is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We don't just accept difference – we honor it, nurture it, and celebrate it. We don’t discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Kin welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require accommodation, please contact us by sending an email to careers@kin.com Compensation Range: $139K \- $166\.5K

jobs.title: Scheduler / CAD Programmer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The CAD Programmer is responsible for converting customer\-generated geometry or drawings into the correct file format using CAD software. This role involves utilizing nesting software to generate programs for CNC equipment and troubleshooting specific applications as needed. The position reports directly to the Operations Manager. **Job Responsibilities** * **CAD and CNC Software Use:** Operate CAD software and CNC manufacturer’s programming software to create and manage engineering drawings and NC files. * **Drawing Interpretation:** Interpret third and first\-angle orthographic projections, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, and customer drawings/specifications to create precise engineering drawings * **Coordination:** Facilitate production and technical communications between customers, sales, and production teams * **File Management:** Import CAD files into nesting software to generate NC files for CNC equipment. Identify appropriate applications (e.g., laser, oxyfuel, plasma, punching) as needed * **Nesting:** Optimize material utilization and production efficiency by nesting parts on sheets or blanks * **Programming and Documentation:** Program CNC equipment and document revisions as required * **Tooling and Fixtures Design:** Assist with the design of tooling and fixtures * **Equipment Understanding:** Maintain a thorough understanding of the equipment used for processing * **Efficiency Improvements:** Provide input on efficiency improvements and conduct cost\-benefit analyses of new tooling and application considerations * **Inventory Management:** Maintain an inventory list of tooling and cutting parameters * **Program File Maintenance:** Keep program files and setup sheets organized and up\-to\-date * **Additional Duties:** Perform other related duties as assigned to support department goals **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 2\+ years of practical CAD programming experience in an industrial manufacturing environment. * **Education:** Two\-year technical degree in Computer Programming, Computer\-Aided Design, or equivalent experience. * **Software Proficiency:** + AutoCAD + Pronest + Ncell systems + Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access, Visio) * **Physical Examination:** Ability to pass a physical examination for vision, hearing, and mobility * **Reliability:** Demonstrated reliable work history * **Attention to Detail:** Must be detail\-oriented with a strong focus on precision and quality in all tasks **Compensation** $50,000 \- $60,000 #### **Experience** Required* AutoCAD Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Sr. Oracle APEX Developer
jobs.description: ***Position Summary*** The Senior Oracle APEX Developer will design, develop, and support Oracle APEX applications that replace legacy Oracle Forms modules as part of the Company's ERP modernization initiative. This role will deliver complex modules, review converted and AI\-assisted code, and share knowledge with developers in Mexico. The role covers the full scope of Custom ERP support, maintenance, and development, from break\-fix and enhancements to projects that redesign existing modules and reports or build new ones. The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Oracle APEX and PL/SQL coding skills, works independently on complex assignments, and is interested in adopting AI\-assisted development. This is a hybrid role, working in our Alpharetta Headquarters 3 days a week. ***Key Responsibilities*** Oracle APEX Development (5\+ years) * Design, develop, and maintain Oracle APEX applications supporting core ERP business processes, leveraging the most appropriate Oracle APEX capabilities and features to meet business and technical requirements. * Implement secure authentication and authorization, including Single Sign\-On (SSO) with Microsoft Entra ID. * Develop and tune SQL and PL/SQL packages, views, and materialized views in environments with tables containing up to 30 million records. * Design data models and relational database structures for new and redesigned modules. * Integrate REST APIs using ORDS, REST Data Sources, and APEX\_WEB\_SERVICE. AI\-Assisted Development (Emerging Practice) * As the team adopts AI\-assisted development, use approved AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) to help write, refactor, test, and document SQL, PL/SQL, APEX and JavaScript. * Use AI agents for integration and API work (ORDS, REST, JSON), performance tuning, and legacy code analysis. * Act as a primary reviewer of AI\-assisted changes from other developers. * Contribute to agent context: business glossary, rule catalog, and coding standards. * Write automated tests (utPLSQL, Playwright, API tests) with AI help. * Explain and defend every change submitted in code review, whether AI\-generated or not. * Follow safe AI practices: approved tools only, and no credentials or production data in prompts. Custom ERP Support, Maintenance \& Development * Resolve break\-fix issues and deliver system enhancements across APEX, APEX Office Print, Jasper Reports, PL/SQL database logic, and ORDS. * Design and build major changes to existing modules and reports, and new modules and functionality, for Custom ERP projects. * Serve as a senior escalation point for production incidents, including root cause analysis and permanent fixes. * Gather requirements from business users and deliver changes through Development, UAT, and Production under the Company's change management process. * Work within Agile delivery practices (Scrum or Kanban). Conversion Support * Review Oracle Forms to APEX modules delivered by the conversion partner and resolve defects and gaps. * Work with developers in the US and Mexico to stabilize converted modules after go\-live. ***Required Qualifications*** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of Oracle development experience, including 4\+ years of hands\-on Oracle APEX development. * Strong experience with Oracle APEX 22\.x or newer, with broad knowledge of its capabilities and the judgment to select the right features for each business and technical requirement. * Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, including performance tuning in environments with tables containing up to 30 million records, with the ability to write, debug, and optimize code independently without AI tools. * Strong data modeling and relational database design skills. * Experience implementing authentication and authorization, including Single Sign\-On (SSO) with Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience with ORDS, REST APIs, JSON, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. * Experience supporting production Oracle applications, including break\-fix and enhancements. * Experience working in Agile teams (Scrum or Kanban). * Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, the APEX 26\.1 workflow: APEXlang, VS Code with the SQL Developer extension, SQLcl and Git. * Strong written and verbal English communication skills. ***Preferred Qualifications*** * Hands\-on experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar). * Experience with Oracle Forms modernization or migration projects. * Experience with utPLSQL, Playwright, CI/CD, and OCI. * Experience in steel, metals, distribution, manufacturing, or ERP environments. * Experience with APEX Office Print and Jasper Reports. **Core Competencies** * Ownership from design through production. * Analytical thinking and sound technical judgment. * Collaboration and knowledge sharing. * Customer and user focus. ***Success Measures*** * APEX modules delivered according to project milestones. * Quality, performance, and test coverage of delivered applications. * Timely delivery of incident fixes, enhancements, and project changes. * Timely and thorough reviews of AI\-assisted changes. * Positive feedback from business users and technical leads. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!** **Job Overview** ---------------- The Senior IT Data \& Solutions Engineer plays a pivotal role in enabling enterprise\-wide data and reporting capabilities across Komatsu. This role focuses on designing, building, and supporting data\-centric solutions that span multiple business domains, including (but not limited to) Digital Transformation (DX), ERP, Customer Experience, Aftermarket, Finance, and Operations. The successful candidate will leverage Komatsu’s enterprise data platforms—primarily Palantir Foundry for data management and transformation, and Power BI for analytics and visualization—to drive business insights, operational efficiency, and strategic decision\-making. This role requires a strong technical foundation, business acumen, and a collaborative mindset to enable cross\-functional data initiatives that align with organizational priorities, while ensuring scalability, performance, and data governance compliance. **Key Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and transformation workflows leveraging Palantir technologies and other enterprise tools. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into actionable data solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. * Implement best practices in data management, governance, and security, ensuring integrity and compliance across the enterprise landscape. * Optimize performance of data platforms through tuning, automation, and continuous improvement of Palantir and Power BI environments. * Provide advanced data modeling and analytical solutions that enable predictive insights and AI/ML use cases. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Palantir\-based data systems, maintaining high system reliability and availability. * Partner with business analysts, data scientists, and functional teams to ensure data accessibility, quality, and usability across business domains. **Qualifications/Requirements** ------------------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. * 5\+ years experience in data engineering, BI development, or data platform management (preferably Palantir Foundry, Power BI, Azure). * Strong understanding of ETL processes, data modeling, and performance optimization techniques. * Hands\-on experience with data governance, metadata management, and data security principles. * Familiarity with machine learning models, APIs, and automation frameworks is a plus. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and in cross\-functional teams. * Individual contributor working with Komatsu teams and vendor partners to deliver enterprise data capabilities. * Collaborates with business analysts, data scientists, and application teams to ensure data consistency and scalability. * Contributes to data architecture and design reviews, aligning with enterprise standards and long\-term strategy. * Continuously researches and adopts emerging tools and technologies in BI, data engineering, and AI domains. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Hiring Range** At Komatsu, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. This role pays $145,000\. The actual offer will consider a wide range of factors, including experience and location. **Company Benefits** Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well\-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment. * Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc. * 401k and/or employee savings programs * Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays) * Employee and family assistance programs * Disability benefits * Life insurance * Employee learning and development programs **Diversity \& Inclusion Commitment** At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences and contributions. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. **Company Information** Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com. **EEO Statement** Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **What is Krevera?** Krevera is a fast growing startup with serious market traction bringing the latest AI driven quality analytics to the plastics manufacturing industry with the goal of reducing scrap, downtime, and labor costs in American factories. We build flexible AI\-powered vision systems that are deployed in factories across the country. Our deep\-learning pipelines detect anomalies, diagnose root causes, and feed insights back to injection\-molding machines and robotics so that quality issues are fixed automatically. We have revenue, clients, and are scaling rapidly. We are looking for new engineers to join our company as we grow into 2026\. If you are looking to jump into a fast paced environment with strong mentorship, Krevera is the place to be. **Why Krevera?** ● **Collaborative, fun, innovative culture:** Enjoy a startup environment where teamwork and creativity thrive, whether brainstorming ideas, playing occasional video games over lunch, or taking company walks. ● **Real impact:** Your work will directly shape our technology, culture, and growth from day one. ● **Front\-row seat to AI in manufacturing:** Help define a market that’s just beginning to explode. ● **Momentum:** We have 100\+ systems in our fleet across the US, scaling is the biggest challenge now! **About the Role** As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will help expand our online platform and deliver new features from start to finish working across our stack. The products you will be working on allow our clients to interact with near real\-time manufacturing data coming out of our AI analysis pipeline from our deployed systems in the field. As an early addition to the team, your technical talent will influence the quality and structure of our stack, directly providing value to customers. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ● Develop features from scratch by following the full software development cycle from taking initial requirements before development, to gathering feedback post\-deployment ● Be proficient with git and best development practices ● Have a growth mindset and be open to learning new technologies in other areas of our product development ● Ask questions about and improve our current codebase A qualified candidate for this role will have a bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar with at least 2 years of experience. **Required skills include** ● Experience with Vue3 (and Typescript) ● Experience with Python and the major libraries we use: FastApi \+ Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and Pytest ● Experience with SQL databases and distributed query engines (such as Trino) ● Experience with Linux Operating Systems ● Experience with AWS ● Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes ● Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and in a codebase) ● Comfortable working around our office dogs **Desired skills include** ● Experience with the Agile framework, and Jira specifically ● Experience with Rust and/or C\+\+ ● Experience in architecting distributed systems We are looking for someone who is excited to learn and work in a startup environment. This role is on\-site in our Waltham office, but we are flexible when circumstances arise that might necessitate occasionally working from home. Join us if you are excited about joining a growing team and expanding your technical skills. **Logistics** ● **Location:** On\-site, Waltham, MA. ● **Compensation:** Competitive salary \+ meaningful equity. ● **Benefits:** Health insurance, dental, vision, and 401(k). ● **Start date:** ASAP – we’re moving fast. Pay: From $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Python: 2 years (Preferred) * SQL: 2 years (Preferred) * Linux: 2 years (Preferred) * AWS: 2 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Waltham, MA 02452 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description: Since its founding in 1937, Krispy Kremes focus has remained the same \- making fresh doughnuts using our founders original recipe. The brands iconic Hot Light lets consumers know when doughnuts are being made in the shop so they can stop in and enjoy them hot, right off the line. Krispy Kremes Data Integration Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining data integration solutions, creating robust data integration pipelines that connect B2B systems, enterprise applications, and multiple cloud data platforms. You will be working closely with internal and external business partners, database administrators and application developers to implement data integration solutions that are scalable, reliable, and efficient. **A TASTE OF WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:** * Maintain and update integration applications, ensuring their operational readiness. * Collaborate closely with other team members, business analysts, and stakeholders to understand data requirements and implement effective integration solutions. * Clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Assist end\-users and other teams with data integration\-related queries and challenges. * Ability to work on multiple parallel efforts and adjust focus based on business needs * Adhere to security and data governance standards, policies, and procedures. * Work to evolve legacy solutions toward a modern, cloud\-based data architecture. * Develop and implement canonical data models to standardize data representation across multiple systems. * Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of best\-in\-class technologies. * Monitor data quality, troubleshoot issues, and optimize integration processes to achieve high\-quality, reliable data flow. * When data discrepancies or errors arise, they will work closely with the team to diagnose and address them promptly. * Identify and resolve gaps between business requirements and existing solutions. * Help to shape the organizations data integration practices by providing insights and recommendations to ensure the delivery of high quality and supportable solutions. **YOUR RECIPE FOR SUCCESS:** * *Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and relational databases.* * *Experience in creating context and sequence diagrams to depict data pipelines.* * *Strong knowledge of design patterns to create reusable, maintainable, and efficient data processing solutions.* * *Knowledgeable in utilizing third party Rest APIs for integration of external data.* * *Strong proficiency in full stack of ETL/ELT technology tools including SQL Server, Snowflake, Python, SSIS, and Azure Data Factory.* * *5\+ years related working experience.* * *Understanding of Snowflake Data Cloud data ingestion, transformation methods, error handling, and data sharing is a plus.* * *Proven history of delivering highly scalable solutions and integrations.* * *Experience in the Retail and/or Restaurant (QSR) industry is strongly preferred.* * *Ability to function in a mixed technical environment, leveraging both SaaS and custom in\-house developed solutions.* * *Strong written and verbal communication skills.* * *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job and are not the official job description for the position. jobs.title: Senior Digital Product Manager – AI, Case Management & Workflow Automation
jobs.description: Overview: We are seeking a technically oriented, outcome\-driven Senior Technical Product Manager to define and deliver AI\-enabled products, intelligent case management capabilities, workflow automation solutions, and enterprise data integration capabilities supporting digital transformation initiatives across the U.S. Postal Service (USPS), Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), and General Services Administration (GSA). This role focuses on improving operational efficiency, reducing administrative burden, eliminating costly process defects, and modernizing complex service workflows through intelligent automation, AI\-assisted decision support, data\-driven product design, enterprise technology integration, and secure data interoperability across agencies. The Senior Technical Product Manager will own the product strategy and roadmap for assigned automation, intelligent service, and data integration capabilities, translating operational challenges and business requirements into scalable technical solutions. This includes enabling seamless data exchange between agency systems, integrating disparate enterprise platforms, improving data accessibility, and establishing interoperable solutions that support cross\-agency collaboration and coordinated service delivery. This leader will partner closely with software engineering, AI and data science, enterprise architecture, data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver capabilities from discovery through implementation and continuous optimization. The ideal candidate combines strong technical product management skills with experience in workflow automation, case management, enterprise platforms, data integration, system interoperability, or operational process improvement. Experience in shipping, supply chain, logistics, retail operations, or complex service delivery is beneficial. The successful candidate thrives in ambiguity, uses data to guide decisions, anticipates delivery risks, and relentlessly pursues measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, data accessibility, and service quality. Travel is required based on business needs, including engagements in the National Capital Region and other relevant federal health locations. Responsibilities: Define AI \& Automation Product Strategy* Develop product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for AI\-enabled services, workflow automation, case management, operational efficiency, and enterprise data integration capabilities. * Identify high\-value automation opportunities by analyzing operational bottlenecks, manual processes, recurring defects, service delays, administrative burden, and fragmented data environments. * Translate mission objectives and business priorities into prioritized product investments with clearly defined outcomes and measurable value. * Evaluate opportunities for AI\-assisted intake, intelligent routing, document processing, case summarization, knowledge retrieval, workflow orchestration, data integration, and decision support. * Identify opportunities to improve data sharing and interoperability across USPS, VA, GSA, and other federal agency systems. * Balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation cost, operational risk, and readiness when prioritizing initiatives. * Establish product principles that support scalability, interoperability, responsible AI use, data accessibility, and long\-term maintainability. * Own Technical Product Requirements \& Roadmaps * Translate complex business processes and operational requirements into technical product specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and prioritized backlogs. * Own the product roadmap and feature prioritization for assigned automation, intelligent workflow, and enterprise data integration capabilities. * Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define integrations, APIs, data requirements, system dependencies, interoperability standards, and implementation approaches. * Define product requirements for integrating disparate agency systems, enterprise applications, databases, and data platforms. * Establish requirements for standardized data exchange, API\-based integrations, data mapping, data transformation, and cross\-system information synchronization. * Participate in technical discovery, solution design, backlog refinement, sprint planning, testing, release planning, and post\-launch optimization. * Evaluate trade\-offs involving build versus buy, legacy system constraints, scalability, reliability, performance, data architecture, and integration complexity. * Identify and resolve technical and operational dependencies that threaten product delivery or expected business outcomes. * Modernize Case Management \& Service Workflows * Lead product initiatives to simplify and automate workflows from initial intake through routing, processing, resolution, and case closure. * Identify opportunities to improve case triage, document collectio eting priorities. * Strong stakeholder management, written and verbal communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments and influence cross\-functional teams without relying solely on formal authority. Preferred Qualifications* Experience supporting USPS, VA, GSA, other federal agencies, or government technology modernization initiatives. * Experience with cross\-agency data interoperability, federal data\-sharing initiatives, enterprise data integration, or interagency information exchange. * Experience defining product requirements for API integrations, enterprise service buses, integration platforms, middleware, data pipelines, or cloud\-based data exchange solutions. * Familiarity with data architecture, enterprise data platforms, master data management, metadata management, data catalogs, data standards, and data governance frameworks. * Experience integrating legacy systems with modern enterprise applications and cloud\-based platforms. * Experience with AI\-enabled products, generative AI, intelligent document processing, machine learning, decision\-support systems, or automation platforms. * Familiarity with workflow orchestration, robotic process automation, APIs, system integrations, enterprise data platforms, and legacy modernization. * Experience in case management, service operations, shipping, logistics, retail, supply chain, inventory management, or high\-volume transaction environments. * Familiarity with responsible AI practices, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, AI evaluation, model monitoring, and risk management. * Understanding of federal privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility, records management, data governance, and applicable AI governance requirements. * Experience applying Agile, Lean, process improvement, or operational excellence methodologies. * Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership through business cases, quantitative analysis, and value realization reporting. Success Measures* Reduced manual processing effort and administrative burden. * Shorter end\-to\-end processing and case resolution times. * Improved automation completion rates and reduced exception handling where appropriate. * Lower defect rates, rework, and avoidable operational costs. * Improved data quality, workflow reliability, and first\-time\-right processing. * Improved interoperability and secure data exchange between USPS, VA, GSA, and other agency systems. * Increased integration of disparate enterprise applications, databases, and legacy systems. * Reduced data silos, duplicate data entry, manual data transfers, and data reconciliation activities. * Increased availability, consistency, accuracy, and accessibility of shared data across authorized agency environments. * Improved reliability, performance, and scalability of enterprise data integrations and API\-based services. * Increased adoption and effectiveness of AI\-assisted tools among intended users. * Demonstrable business value and mission impact from automation, data integration, and interoperability investments. * Successful delivery of prioritized technical product capabilities. * Appropriate performance, monitoring, oversight, privacy, security, and risk controls for AI\-enabled and integrated enterprise products. Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified or otherwise sensitive government information, as required by the position. Target salary range: $130,000 \- $190,000 ***Disclaimer:*** The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances. jobs.description: LTA Research builds and flies next\-generation airships. Our proof\-of\-concept aircraft, Pathfinder 1, is the largest aircraft flying today, and we operate it as a working test platform to push airship technology forward: moving cargo and people to places without roads, runways, or ports, including disaster relief when infrastructure is cut off. Weight matters in every decision we make. This senior role owns mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems from concept through flight test, with a central part in developing the hydrogen propulsion system for our next aircraft. ### **Responsibilities** * Own mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems for flight and ground equipment end\-to\-end, from requirements definition through concept, analysis, detailed design, qualification, and flight test, and mentor junior engineers along the way. * Support the design, build, and qualification of gaseous and liquid hydrogen systems (storage, distribution, conditioning, and venting), including ground test articles and test infrastructure, and contribute to design FMEA and hazard analysis. * Size and verify designs with first\-principles hand calculations, backed by finite element analysis and thermal and fluid simulation where warranted, and correlate analysis against test data. * Produce fabrication\-ready drawings with GD\&T per ASME Y14\.5, select commercial components, and work directly with manufacturing engineers, machine shops, and suppliers on design for manufacturability and assembly. * Define component and subsystem test requirements and work closely with our test engineering team to plan and execute them, staying hands\-on through hardware build, instrumentation, test runs, and data analysis. * Present designs in cross\-departmental reviews and resolve non\-conformances and failures through root cause analysis. * Fully onsite role, with occasional travel between LTA sites and to supplier and test locations. No shift work. ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering with 5\+ years of professional experience in the mechanical or aerospace industries. * Proficiency with SolidWorks (or similar), PDM/PLM tools, GD\&T, and traditional manufacturing processes. * Strong engineering fundamentals in mechanics of materials, thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid dynamics, with demonstrated ability to size and verify designs by hand calculation. * Demonstrated experience taking mechanical structures, thermal management systems, and fluid systems from concept through test. * Demonstrated experience designing highly loaded, lightweight structural components (composite or metallic). * Hands\-on R\&D, prototype, or test experience, including hardware build, instrumentation, and data acquisition; able to work in lab, shop, and test settings, including occasional lifting and work around pressurized systems. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. * Experience with hydrogen, cryogenic, or other high\-pressure fluid systems, including hydrogen material compatibility and applicable codes and standards (NFPA 2, CGA). * Experience with system\-level heat integration and thermal optimization, improving how heat is managed and used across interconnected systems. * Experience developing weight\-critical flight hardware, ideally carried through flight test. * Experience with system safety analysis (FMEA, hazard analysis) for pressurized or flight\-critical systems. ### **What We Offer!** * Relocation assistance * Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan (100% premium paid for individuals, \~70% for dependents) * Company\-paid life, AD\&D, long\-term disability, and short\-term disability insurances * Parental leave * Generous PTO \+ 10 paid holidays * 401(k) matching up to 6% * Lunch and snacks provided every day, including accommodations for all dietary restrictions * Monthly wellness stipend * Monthly cell phone stipend * Yearly education stipend to obtain certifications or take classes in your field * Fun events, swag, and the occasional airship ride * An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and the most talented experts from different fields ### **Compliance Requirements** * Criminal background check clearance * Drug test clearance wherever applicable The base salary range for this role is $135,000 \- 160,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Data Scientist** **Job Location:****Seattle, WA (Remote)** **About LatentView** LatentView Analytics is a global data analytics and AI solutions company that partners with Fortune 500 and high\-growth clients to turn data into competitive advantage. Our teams combine deep technical expertise with business context to ship measurable outcomes — not just models and dashboards — across industries. **Job Role** : We are looking for an experienced Data Science Lead – Marketing Effectiveness Measurement with strong expertise in data science, statistical modelling, advanced analytics, and marketing measurement. The candidate will lead a team of data scientists and analytics professionals, partnering with clients and business stakeholders to translate business objectives into analytical solutions and actionable insights. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in statistical modelling, machine learning, marketing effectiveness measurement, campaign analytics, experimentation, and performance optimization. Familiarity with regression\-based modelling, Bayesian techniques, Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), incrementality measurement, and causal inference is desirable. The role involves leading end\-to\-end analytical initiatives, defining modelling approaches, ensuring high\-quality delivery, and translating analytical outcomes into business recommendations. Experience with Python\-based data science libraries, cloud platforms, and scalable data engineering workflows is also expected. **Required Skills** * 7–10\+ years of experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, or related fields, including 2–3 years in technical leadership or team management. * Strong client\-facing experience with excellent requirement\-gathering, communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills. * Hands\-on expertise in Python, SQL, and PySpark for data analysis, statistical modelling, and large\-scale data processing. * Strong understanding of statistical analysis, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, validation, and performance evaluation. * Experience in marketing effectiveness measurement, campaign analytics, marketing ROI/ROAS, channel performance, and business KPI evaluation. * Knowledge of regression, predictive modelling, time\-series analysis, and machine learning. Exposure to Bayesian modelling and MMM is an advantage. * Understanding of A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, hypothesis testing, incrementality measurement, and causal inference. * Experience with Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Stats models, Scikit\-learn, and PyMC. * Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and data/ML platforms such as Databricks, AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI. * Ability to integrate data engineering pipelines with data science workflows to deliver scalable and reproducible analytical solutions. * Experience in leading and mentoring a team of 3–4 data scientists, data engineers, or analytics professionals. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to communicate complex analytical findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience in leveraging AI assisted tools to improve productivity and operational efficiency. 1\. Client Engagement and Business Partnership * Engage with clients, marketing stakeholders, and business leaders to understand business objectives, analytical requirements, and measurement challenges. * Translate business requirements into analytical problem statements, modelling approaches, and actionable delivery plans. * Define measurement objectives, success metrics, KPIs, and appropriate analytical methodologies in collaboration with stakeholders. * Present analytical findings, model outcomes, and business recommendations to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Manage stakeholder expectations, communicate delivery progress, and proactively address risks and dependencies. 2\. Data Science Leadership \& Marketing Effectiveness * Lead and mentor a team of 3–4 data science and analytics professionals, providing technical direction, guidance, and delivery oversight. * Drive end\-to\-end analytical initiatives, from problem definition and data exploration to model development, validation, and deployment. * Develop and implement statistical and machine learning models to evaluate marketing performance, identify key business drivers, and support data\-driven decisions. * Apply regression, predictive modelling, time\-series analysis, and other statistical techniques to measure marketing effectiveness and business outcomes. * Develop measurement frameworks for marketing ROI/ROAS, channel performance, campaign effectiveness, and incremental impact. * Apply A/B testing, controlled experimentation, hypothesis testing, and causal inference to evaluate campaign performance. * Leverage Bayesian modelling and Marketing Mix Modelling techniques where appropriate to evaluate marketing contributions and quantify uncertainty. * Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations for marketing optimization, investment allocation, and business growth. * Establish analytical standards, reusable modelling frameworks, and best practices to ensure model reliability, interpretability, and scalability. * Manage priorities, project timelines, risks, and dependencies to ensure high\-quality delivery. 3\. Cloud Platforms and Data Engineering * Guide the development of scalable data pipelines and analytical workflows using Python, SQL, and PySpark. * Leverage cloud ecosystems such as AWS, Azure, and GCP for data processing, analytics, and machine learning. * Work with platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI. * Ensure seamless integration between data engineering, statistical modelling, and machine learning workflows. * Establish best practices for data quality, model versioning, experiment tracking, and deployment. 4\. AI\-Enabled Productivity and Innovation * Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve data science productivity, coding efficiency, and documentation. * Identify opportunities to automate analytical processes and reporting workflows. * Explore emerging AI and machine learning capabilities to enhance analytical methodologies and business solutions. **Base pay range**: USD $144,000 – USD $ 166,500 annually. This range reflects Base salary only — it excludes Incentive and benefits — and is a good\-faith estimate for this level and location that may vary based on experience, skills, and where the role is performed. **Communication**: This role requires fluent spoken and written English to communicate directly with client stakeholders — a job\-related requirement of the client\-facing work itself, not of any candidate's background or origin. Job Snapshot Updated Date 16\-11\-2026 Job ID J\_6346 Location Seattle, Washington, United States Experience 7 \- 10 Years Employee Type Permanent

Since then, we have been an industry leader in guaranteeing you get the best sleep possible. As an Engineering Manager\-Machinery you will have the opportunity to consistently plan and direct the engineering department to produce the highest quality documentation and designs by meeting all established documented specifications and must actively strive to continuously improve the process used. (Computers, software\-CAD packages, documentation packages, control development software.) * Understand drawings. (Able to read blueprints, understand dimensioning and tolerances, and understand geometric tolerances.) * Understand Bill of Material structures * Understand machine design both mechanical and electrical. * Understand manufacturing processes. * Able to interface with manufacturing to produce a machine / part. * Able to conceptualize machines and control schemes. * Able to put together and give presentations. * Understand enterprise computing and network strategies. * Able to interface with upper management. * Able to interface with customers. * BS degree in respective field with minimum 6 years’ experience in the field. **Things we consider a plus:** * Bedding industry automation experience. **What to Do Next** Now that you’ve had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available. **Our Values** Our values speak to our shared beliefs and describe how we approach working together. * Put People First reflects our commitment to safety and care of each other, learning and development, and creating an inclusive environment of mutual respect, empathy and belonging. * Do the Right Thing focuses us on acting with honesty and integrity, delivering the results the right way, taking pride in our work, and speaking the truth – good or bad. * Do Great Work…Together occurs when we engage without hierarchy, collaborate as a team, embrace challenges, and work for the good of all of us. * Take Ownership and Raise the Bar demonstrates our responsibility to add value and make a difference, challenge the status quo and biases to make things better, foster innovative and creative solutions to drive impact, and explore new perspectives and embrace change. This is a hands\-on applied engineering role for an experienced LLM practitioner who owns AI features end to end and helps set technical direction for the team. You'll work directly with the VP of Organizational Intelligence, the AI team lead, and the Senior Staff Engineer, AI – leading agentic workflows, document intelligence, and retrieval systems, mentoring junior engineers, and helping shape the shared AI platform every Lendistry product team relies on. **Lendistry: Who We Are** We’re proud to be the nation’s largest minority\-led, tech\-savvy lender for small businesses and commercial real estate. As a certified Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) and Community Development Entity (CDE), our mission is all about creating economic opportunities and fueling growth for small business owners and their communities. Join us as we pave the way with innovative financing and financial education! **What You’ll Be Doing** As a Senior AI Engineer, you'll lead delivery across Lendistry's AI products, always starting from a clear understanding of the business problem you're solving: * Document intelligence pipelines that read loan applications, tax returns, and financial statements with full audit trails. * Underwriting copilots that surface risk signals and policy checks in real time for underwriters. * Borrower\-facing conversational AI for applications, decisions, and loan management. * Shared AI platform components – prompt registry, tool\-calling, evaluation, and inference routing – used by every product team. * An evaluation and observability layer that makes AI reliability measurable, not just assumed. **LLM Systems \& Document Intelligence** * Own end\-to\-end LLM features – from the first business conversation through design, deployment, and production operation – across origination, underwriting, servicing, and borrower experience. * Lead agentic workflows and RAG systems: LLMs that plan, call tools, retrieve, and iterate across multi\-step lending tasks with human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Lead document\-processing pipelines that extract structured data from loan applications and other unstructured financial documents using OCR and LLM\-based extraction. * Build validation, confidence scoring, and audit trails that make AI outputs safe for regulated, high\-stakes lending decisions, and diagnose agentic failure modes before they recur. **Platform, Evaluation \& Reliability** * Help shape the shared AI platform – prompt registry, evaluation harness, and inference routing – and design evaluation and observability (golden sets, LLM\-as\-judge scoring, cost/latency monitoring) that make AI quality measurable. * Treat cost and latency as first\-class engineering constraints through model\-tier routing, caching, and token budgeting. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Meet regularly with product, credit, underwriting, and platform engineering to understand their challenges, translate * them into reliable AI designs, and explain trade\-offs in plain language. * Partner with the AI team lead and Senior Staff Engineer to ship reliable features, mentor engineers through reviews and pairing, and lead proof\-of\-concept work that validates new use cases quickly. **AI\-Assisted Development Practice** * Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) daily as part of the standard development loop, and help lead adoption of emerging agentic tools across Lendistry engineering. * Follow established human\-in\-the\-loop review criteria for when to trust cross multiple steps, and autonomously complete multi\-stage tasks with appropriate safeguards and audit trails. * Hands\-on experience with fine\-tuning and adaptation — LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, or preference tuning — and with rigorous evaluation of model outputs rather than demo\-driven validation. **Engineering \& Platform Skills** ---------------------------------- * Strong LLM tooling fluency, with the judgment to build custom when needed. * Production experience turning unstructured data (documents, forms, scans) into structured, reliable outputs. * Cloud and deployment depth, evaluation discipline to catch LLM\-specific failure modes before production, and experience exposing AI capabilities as reliable internal APIs. **Security \& Regulated\-Industry Awareness** --------------------------------------------- * Working knowledge of LLM security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration, output filtering) and discipline around PII and sensitive financial data – redaction, minimization, and keeping it inside Lendistry's trust boundary. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in fintech, lending, banking, healthcare, or another regulated industry. * Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight models, or with document\-understanding models and OCR tooling. * Background in NLP tasks (NER, classification, semantic similarity), or building shared AI platforms used by multiple product teams. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading design reviews; B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or equivalent experience. **Why You'll Love Working Here:** * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Generous Paid Time Off * Birthday Day Off * 12 Paid Company Holidays * 401(k) Match * FSA and HSA * Paid Life Insurance * Paid Disability Insurance * Pet Insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Professional Development Courses * In Office Provided Snacks and Drinks * Gym Facilities (LA \& Tustin/CEC Offices) * In Office Engagement Activities **Compensation Range** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is **$139,600 \- $180,800** annually. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include any variable compensation elements. **Physical Requirements** This is a stationary position that requires frequent sitting (approximately 95%), repetitive wrist motions, grasping, speaking, listening, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus. It also may require occasional standing, lifting, carrying of 20lbs or less, walking, kneeling, bending/stooping, twisting, pulling/pushing, and reaching above the shoulder. This is a hands\-on applied engineering role for an experienced LLM practitioner who owns AI features end to end and helps set technical direction for the team. You'll work directly with the VP of Organizational Intelligence, the AI team lead, and the Senior Staff Engineer, AI – leading agentic workflows, document intelligence, and retrieval systems, mentoring junior engineers, and helping shape the shared AI platform every Lendistry product team relies on. **Lendistry: Who We Are** We’re proud to be the nation’s largest minority\-led, tech\-savvy lender for small businesses and commercial real estate. As a certified Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) and Community Development Entity (CDE), our mission is all about creating economic opportunities and fueling growth for small business owners and their communities. Join us as we pave the way with innovative financing and financial education! **What You’ll Be Doing** As a Senior AI Engineer, you'll lead delivery across Lendistry's AI products, always starting from a clear understanding of the business problem you're solving: * Document intelligence pipelines that read loan applications, tax returns, and financial statements with full audit trails. * Underwriting copilots that surface risk signals and policy checks in real time for underwriters. * Borrower\-facing conversational AI for applications, decisions, and loan management. * Shared AI platform components – prompt registry, tool\-calling, evaluation, and inference routing – used by every product team. * An evaluation and observability layer that makes AI reliability measurable, not just assumed. **LLM Systems \& Document Intelligence** * Own end\-to\-end LLM features – from the first business conversation through design, deployment, and production operation – across origination, underwriting, servicing, and borrower experience. * Lead agentic workflows and RAG systems: LLMs that plan, call tools, retrieve, and iterate across multi\-step lending tasks with human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Lead document\-processing pipelines that extract structured data from loan applications and other unstructured financial documents using OCR and LLM\-based extraction. * Build validation, confidence scoring, and audit trails that make AI outputs safe for regulated, high\-stakes lending decisions, and diagnose agentic failure modes before they recur. **Platform, Evaluation \&
