cost/latency monitoring) that make AI quality measurable. * Treat cost and latency as first\-class engineering constraints through model\-tier routing, caching, and token budgeting. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Meet regularly with product, credit, underwriting, and platform engineering to understand their challenges, translate * them into reliable AI designs, and explain trade\-offs in plain language. * Partner with the AI team lead and Senior Staff Engineer to ship reliable features, mentor engineers through reviews and pairing, and lead proof\-of\-concept work that validates new use cases quickly. **AI\-Assisted Development Practice** * Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) daily as part of the standard development loop, and help lead adoption of emerging agentic tools across Lendistry engineering. * Follow established human\-in\-the\-loop review criteria for when to trust cross multiple steps, and autonomously complete multi\-stage tasks with appropriate safeguards and audit trails. * Hands\-on experience with fine\-tuning and adaptation — LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, or preference tuning — and with rigorous evaluation of model outputs rather than demo\-driven validation. **Engineering \& Platform Skills** ---------------------------------- * Strong LLM tooling fluency, with the judgment to build custom when needed. * Production experience turning unstructured data (documents, forms, scans) into structured, reliable outputs. * Cloud and deployment depth, evaluation discipline to catch LLM\-specific failure modes before production, and experience exposing AI capabilities as reliable internal APIs. **Security \& Regulated\-Industry Awareness** --------------------------------------------- * jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Link Logistics Real Estate (“Link”) is a leading operator of warehouses and business parks, specializing in last\-mile logistics real estate. Established by Blackstone in 2019, the company connects consumption, technology, and the supply chain across its portfolio, which spans half a billion square feet. We leverage our scale, proprietary data and insights, and foundational focus on sustainability to drive success for our customers’ businesses and deliver value for our stakeholders. We put our people, customers, and communities first and find ways to make a conscious, positive impact where we live and work. Every day, we work to reinvent and lead our industry forward by thinking bigger and challenging the status quo. We're hiring a hybrid **ML/Backend Engineer** to own the intelligence layer of Link's Analytics Engine. This is the connective tissue role: you'll design the pipelines that bring disparate real estate data to life, build the knowledge graphs and retrieval systems that make that data queryable by LLMs, and architect the backend services that surface insights to investment teams in real time. You won't be handed a spec. You'll talk to investment analysts and asset managers, identify where analytical leverage is lost today, and build systems that close that gap — often combining classical ML, graph\-based reasoning, and LLM\-native workflows in the same solution. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Knowledge Graph \& Retrieval — Design graph\-based data structures encoding relationships across markets, assets, tenants, and transactions. Build retrieval pipelines (RAG, hybrid search, structured queries) that give LLMs accurate, contextually rich grounding. * LLM Workflow Automation — Develop rule\-based and agentic LLM workflows that automate investment analytical tasks. Own prompt engineering, eval frameworks, and production reliability. * Data Pipelines — Build ETL/ELT workflows that ingest, normalize, and enrich large\-scale internal and third\-party datasets (property records, leasing data, macro signals, alt data). Every dataset should have a clear owner, update cadence, and quality SLA. * Data Trust \& Provenance — Build systems that make data trustworthy by design: lineage tracking from source to insight, confidence scoring on derived outputs, and clear attribution so analysts always know where a number came from and how fresh it is. Treat a bad comp or stale signal as a production incident. * Backend API Layer — Develop and maintain APIs and services that expose ML outputs and structured data to front\-end applications. Prioritize low\-latency, reliability, and clean contracts with the application team. * Collaboration — Work directly with investment and asset management teams to understand analytical needs and iterate quickly. Treat analyst trust as a first\-class product requirement. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 4\+ years in ML engineering, backend engineering, or a role spanning both * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-powered applications in production — RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, eval frameworks * Strong Python skills; comfortable owning backend services and APIs end\-to\-end * Experience with knowledge graphs or graph databases (Neo4j or similar) * Proficiency building data pipelines at scale (Spark, Databricks, or equivalent) * Deep sensitivity to data provenance — a track record of building systems that create analyst trust, not just claim it $185,000 \- $235,000 represents the presently anticipated base compensation pay range for this position at Link. Actual pay may vary based on various factors, including but not limited to location and experience. Link provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Robotics Software Engineer** **Location:** Gainesville, FL · On\-site **Type:** Full\-time **PERFECT IT IN SIMULATION. PROVE IT ON THE ROBOT** Skin cancer kills 15,000 Americans a year. Not because it cannot be caught early, but because the imaging technology clinicians have access to was not designed to catch it. Lumijes is building the platform that changes that: a system combining robotics, multi\-spectral photonic imaging, and clinical AI to expose what conventional 2D snapshots leave hidden beneath the surface. Our cobots work inches away from patients and medical staff, so every motion has to be precise, smooth, and safe. We are hiring a Robotics Software Engineer to join our Simulation and Control software team and build and refine the virtual worlds where that motion is designed and tested: the digital twins, kinematics, and trajectory pipelines that get it right before code ever touches physical hardware. Then you will take those models onto the real cobot, tune its motion operations, and make sure it moves exactly the way the simulation said it would. **WHAT YOU'LL BUILD:** You will sit at the center of our sim\-to\-real loop. Your work speeds up our development cycle and decides how confidently we can put a robot next to a patient. * Digital twins: import and configure 3D CAD models into physics simulators, and define joint limits, link properties, and mass properties. * Virtual sensors: model camera, force/torque, and proximity sensors inside simulated environments. * Kinematics and trajectories: implement and test forward and inverse kinematics (FK/IK) and trajectory generation algorithms. * Workspace analysis: identify singularities, reachability constraints, and joint torque limits, and use simulation to find imaging sensor coverage limits or excess angles during motion. * Collision avoidance: develop and evaluate routines that protect patients and equipment. * Automated testing: run rigorous simulation tests to catch edge\-case bugs, and maintain regression suites for robot motion control software. * Sim\-to\-real transfer: move simulation motion models onto the physical cobot, map its full range of motion, and compare real test bed data against virtual metrics until they match. * Imaging collaboration: work with our imaging software team to improve cobot operation in challenging orientations so the imaging head can support every movement it needs. * Documentation: document simulation tests and code modules to support medical device software compliance standards. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:** We want engineers who trust the math, test everything, and are not satisfied until the real robot matches the simulation. * B.S. or M.S. in Robotics, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering (robotics focus), Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Science. * A solid foundation in C\+\+ and/or Python, with clean code practices. * Practical ROS / ROS 2 experience, whether through academic projects, internships, or your own repositories. * Experience authoring custom BehaviorTree.cpp nodes or using the MoveIt Pro Developer Platform. * Hardware abstraction: configuring ros2\_control, writing URDF/XACRO files, and integrating 6\-DOF or 7\-DOF arms such as Universal Robots, Kinova, Franka, Fanuc, or KUKA. * Familiarity with physics simulators like NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, Gazebo, Webots, or MuJoCo. * A strong baseline in linear algebra, rigid\-body dynamics, and robot kinematics (Denavit\-Hartenberg parameters, quaternions). * Rigorous attention to detail, strong documentation habits, and a safety\-first mindset. **NICE TO HAVE:** * Experience or internships with commercial cobot arms such as KUKA LBR Med, Fairino, Rainbow Robotics, Universal Robots, or Franka Emika. * A basic understanding of medical device software life cycle standards such as IEC 62304\. * Experience with Git version control and CI/CD testing pipelines. **WHO THRIVES HERE:** We move fast by design. We do not speculate; we prototype, test, and learn. There is no approval committee reviewing your technical decisions and no six\-month roadmap insulating you from accountability. You own your models, your code, and your outcomes. The people who love working here are the ones who cannot let a trajectory go until it is smooth, safe, and repeatable. They find meaning in work that is genuinely difficult and genuinely consequential, and they get uncomfortable when things slow down for reasons they can control. **READY TO SHOW US WHAT YOU CAN DO?** Apply directly through Indeed, or take it a step further and email us at joinus@lumijes.com with examples of your work. Skip the generic application. Tell us about something you have made move: a simulation you built, a motion planning problem you solved, or a time the real robot did not match the model and how you closed the gap. A link to a repo, project, or demo video is welcome. What you can do matters more to us than what your résumé says you might be able to do. **lumijes.com** Application Question(s): * This position is located in Gainesville, FL. Are you living in this area currently or planning to move soon? * Do you have any experience with Moveit Pro? Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real\-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post\-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real\-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real\-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. **About the Role** ------------------ Frontier models learn to do real work inside RL environments, and those environments get built in Studio. Studio is the product thousands of domain experts use to design, generate and verify RL environments, for the labs behind the models you use every day. We're building the next generation platform for the agentic creation of RL environments, which every leading model is born out of. As a Fullstack Product Engineer on the Studio Platform team, you'll own the Studio user journeys end\-to\-end: the React frontend used daily by thousands of expert contributors and internal Strategic Project Leads, and the backend services powering data pipelines and delivery of outputs to customers. You'll also build and maintain the foundational layer that Mercor depends on to rapidly deploy new data types and task formats across the company. Four distinct stakeholders — AI labs, SPLs, expert contributors, and engineers— rely on what you build. This is a role for someone who cares equally about engineering craft and product impact: shipping scalable, reliable systems and intuitive interfaces that make everyone who touches Studio faster and more effective. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Design how experts and agents work together.** Agents draft the tasks, environments and graders, and experts steer and correct them. Your job is to make steering fast and reviewing easy. * **Build the environment workbench.** Create the agentic framework that experts use to author every environment in Studio. * **Make long agent runs easy to follow.** An expert should be able to understand a three\-hour run in three minutes. * **Turn new environment types into configuration.** When a customer asks for something new, it should ship in a day without an engineer writing code. * **Make quality visible.** Build the agentic QC views that show what failed and why, and let people fix it where they find it. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of fullstack engineering experience building and shipping production software. * You love to live in the product experience. You’ve built interfaces that create enjoyable visual experiences from complex data. * You go all the way down the stack. You’re comfortable designing the schema, the API and the background job behind the screen you’re building. * You’ve shipped products before. You have about five years of building production software, ideally where you own a product area end to end. * You build with AI. Coding agents are part of how you work, and you care about building the best agentic collaboration experience. * You turn unsolved problems into a plan. You can take a vague problem from a user or partner team, find the first principles issue, and explain the tradeoffs clearly. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building tooling for data labeling, annotation, or human\-in\-the\-loop AI workflows. * Background in design systems, developer\-facing APIs, or internal platform engineering. * Exposure to AI tools, LLM\-powered products, or real\-time data and visualization. * Experience at top\-tier tech companies or fast\-scaling startups. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- * Your impact compounds on a massive scale. Experts are paid per task, so a fast experience directly drives the bottom line when the effects are felt across hundreds of thousands of users. * The feedback loop is tight. Features ship daily, and feedback loops are swift and efficient. * You see the frontier early. You watch how the newest models fail before the public does. **Benefits:** ------------- * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited paid vacation and sick days * Parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free mental health services * $200 monthly wellness reimbursement * $1\.5K monthly meal stipend * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * Free Equinox membership * Up to $15K relocation bonus Mercor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Further, Mercor prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation based on any combination of protected characteristics. This Policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, discipline, termination, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** Hey! We’re Molg We’re building robotic systems that make electronics manufacturing circular. We work with hyperscalers and leading electronics manufacturers to automate how hardware is designed, manufactured, disassembled, repaired, reused, and recovered. Using robotics, computational design, and AI, our systems turn today’s e\-waste into resilient, data\-driven supply chains—and change how electronics are made in the first place. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:** Join a talented cross\-functional team of software, mechanical, electrical, and robotics engineers to develop and own the firmware that brings Molg’s robotic microfactory systems to life. As a Firmware Engineer, you will: * Design, develop, and maintain firmware for embedded systems across Molg’s robotic platforms — including motor controllers, sensor interfaces, actuators, and custom PCBs. * Own the full firmware development lifecycle: requirements gathering, architecture design, implementation, testing, and deployment to production hardware. * Write robust, real\-time firmware in C/C\+\+ targeting bare\-metal and RTOS\-based environments (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar). * Develop and maintain drivers for communication protocols including CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS\-485, and Ethernet to support reliable hardware integration. * Collaborate closely with electrical engineers to bring up new hardware, validate schematics, and debug hardware/firmware interactions at the board level. * Build and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) test frameworks to validate firmware behavior in automated CI/CD pipelines. * Partner with robotics and software engineers to define clear firmware/software interfaces and ensure reliable communication between embedded systems and higher\-level control stacks. * Instrument firmware for observability — logging, telemetry, and diagnostics — to support production monitoring and rapid field debugging. * Contribute to firmware architecture decisions as Molg’s system complexity grows, balancing performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Participate in design reviews and bring a hardware\-aware perspective to cross\-functional technical discussions. You’ll have the opportunity to build alongside an incredible team, develop innovative solutions, and grow in a fast\-paced environment that values autonomy and impact. **WHO YOU ARE:** * 5\+ years of professional firmware or embedded systems engineering experience, with a track record of shipping firmware on real hardware. * Expert\-level proficiency in C and C\+\+; experience with Python for tooling, test automation, or scripting is a strong plus. * Deep experience with microcontrollers and microprocessors (STM32, ESP32, NXP, TI, or similar); comfortable working with datasheets and reference manuals as primary sources of truth. * Hands\-on experience with RTOS development — task scheduling, interrupt handling, memory management, and real\-time constraints. * Solid understanding of common embedded communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet) and how to debug them with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes. * Comfortable reading schematics and working directly with hardware — you enjoy getting to the root of hardware/software interaction issues. * Experience writing automated firmware tests, ideally in HIL or SIL environments; familiarity with pytest, Robot Framework, or similar testing tools is a plus. * Strong debugging skills — you can navigate a system from application layer down to the register level when needed. * Excellent communicator with a bias toward documentation and clean, maintainable code. * Ability to work in\-person at Molg HQ in Sterling, VA. **WHO WE ARE:** We spend our days building robotic systems, developing complex assembly intelligence software, and designing the next generation of circular products for our customers. Given the importance of working hands\-on with physical systems, the majority of our team is in\-person collaboratively working in our industrial space in Sterling, VA, down the road from the largest data center market in the world. Our facility includes a variety of robots, CNC milling machines, 3D printers, and all the tools needed to build and test our products. It is important to us that anyone on our team that is interested in learning how to use our various pieces of equipment and machinery is taught and can gain the skills and appreciation for making physical things. **THINGS TO KNOW:** * We’re a hands on collaborative team with big ambitions, and there’s a good amount of context\-switching. We expect people to be autonomous and drive their own work to completion. * We are scrappy and looking to build a great sustainable company for years to come. * As a growing company and startup, priorities may shift as customer or business requirements change. We strive to empower individuals with context and decision\-making power to meet this need.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mytra:** We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry \- moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e\-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy. **About the role** ------------------ The orchestration team builds the backend software that manages all of the work that needs to happen in a Mytra system: what every bot should work on, when, how and in what sequence; in addition to tracking the current state of the system and all of the work requests. We are constantly solving dynamically changing multi\-agent path finding and task allocation problems against a live fleet. We are looking for someone smart, hungry, and genuinely excited by algorithmic and optimization problems, with solid backend fundamentals. This person will help define the behavior of our robotics fleet to make our system as optimized as possible. **Problems we solve:** ---------------------- * Multi\-agent path finding at fleet scale. Collision\-free, time\-feasible trajectories, where every bot's path may intersect and constrain every other's. * Task assignment under precedence constraints. Which bot does what, in what order, when the work has dependencies. * Storage and retrieval strategy. Where a payload should be stored based on a variety of metadata, and what to move out of the way to reach one that's buried. * Continuous replanning. Re\-prioritizing and adapting to new or canceled work without stalling the fleet. * State truth and reconciliation. Mapping where everything is in the physical world in our digital twin; automating recovery when the physical and digital worlds differ; recovery from spills, maintenance zones, network drops, and more unpredictable problems! * Observability. Making a planning cycle legible enough to debug. * WMS integration. Mapping a customer's model of their work onto our system \- and then using that data to optimize their deployment of the Mytra system. **Ideal Candidates** -------------------- * Genuinely like algorithmic and optimization problems. Search, scheduling, routing, constraint solving, graph problems; these are the kind of thing you choose to think about, and you have chased some of them down before. * You've written backend software that other people depended on: a service, an API, something with a database behind it. * You've worked directly with relational databases, particularly SQL or Postgres. * You can own a defined piece of work end to end from general direction rather than daily supervision. * You find answers on your own: you can identify ambiguity, know which questions to ask, and are proactive about getting answers quickly. * You learn fast, and you want to! * You are proficient in Go (or similar backend languages), or can be productive in it quickly. * You are adept at using AI tools to work more efficiently, but are aware of where those tools have shortcomings. You validate their output rather than trusting it inherently. * 2\+ years of production experience. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Helpful, not required: any exposure to multi\-agent path finding, task allocation, constraint problems, or other search based algorithms; Warehouse automation or AMR fleet management; working with a relational database at scale; experience with NATS or other message pub/sub tools; participated in an on call rotation for a live system with real customers **A Final Note:** ----------------- If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last **Benefits Include:** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier VCs * Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents * 401(k) plans and employer\-subsidized life insurance * Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table * Generous PTO and company\-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together * Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity * Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity * Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit * Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases * Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters **Pay Notice** -------------- Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change. ***This role requires on\-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.*** ***Pay Range for this position is:*** $145,000 \- $175,000 USD

jobs.description: **Job Summary** Procurement Engineer – Advanced Manufacturing Machine Time Inc. \| Nicholasville, KY Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site Schedule: Day Shift Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and technical capabilities Build the Future of Advanced Manufacturing Advanced technology. Complex challenges. Opportunities to make an impact. Machine Time is expanding, and we're looking for a Procurement Engineer who wants to grow with us. We're investing in advanced 5\-axis machining technology, expanding our manufacturing capacity, and preparing for our next phase of growth with a larger facility. Our focus is on becoming a leading precision manufacturing partner for the aerospace, space, defense, and other high\-performance industries. As our capabilities grow, we're building the supplier relationships, purchasing systems, and manufacturing processes needed to support increasingly complex projects. We're looking for someone who understands that great procurement is about more than purchasing parts and materials. It's about finding solutions that make manufacturing possible. You'll work directly with engineering, operations, quality, production, and suppliers to ensure the materials, components, and outside services needed to manufacture precision parts are available, compliant, and delivered when needed. This is an opportunity to take ownership, solve technical challenges, develop strategic supplier relationships, and help shape the future of our procurement operations. What You'll Be Working On Our team manufactures complex precision components using modern 3\-, 4\-, and 5\-axis CNC technology. As our Procurement Engineer, you'll help connect engineering requirements, supplier capabilities, and production needs. Your responsibilities will include: Source and procure raw materials, hardware, tooling, components, and outside processing services. Interpret engineering drawings, material specifications, customer requirements, and manufacturing documentation to determine purchasing requirements. Identify, evaluate, and develop suppliers capable of supporting complex precision manufacturing. Request and evaluate supplier quotations, comparing technical capabilities, pricing, lead times, and delivery commitments. Negotiate pricing, purchasing terms, and delivery schedules while maintaining quality and compliance requirements. Coordinate outside processing services such as anodizing, plating, heat treating, nondestructive testing, and specialized coatings. Collaborate with estimating and engineering to obtain accurate material and outside processing costs for customer quotations. Issue, track, and manage purchase orders to support production schedules and customer commitments. Monitor supplier performance and proactively address shortages, delays, and delivery risks. Work with quality personnel to resolve supplier nonconformances, documentation issues, and corrective actions. Ensure purchased materials and services meet applicable drawing, specification, certification, and traceability requirements. Support supplier qualification, approval, and ongoing performance evaluation. Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, and documentation within our digital ERP systems. Identify opportunities to reduce procurement costs, improve lead times, strengthen supplier relationships, and streamline purchasing processes. Support continuous improvement initiatives that make our manufacturing operations more efficient and scalable. We believe procurement should be proactive, technically informed, and closely connected to manufacturing—not simply a process of submitting purchase orders. What Success Looks Like You'll play a direct role in helping Machine Time manufacture challenging parts and deliver on its commitments. Success in this position means: Production has the materials and outside services it needs when they're needed. Suppliers understand our technical requirements and consistently meet expectations. Material and processing costs are competitive, accurate, and well understood. Purchasing decisions support quality, traceability, and customer requirements. Potential supply chain problems are identified and addressed before they affect production. Supplier relationships become stronger and more capable as the company grows. Procurement processes become more efficient, reliable, and scalable. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, communicates clearly, and enjoys finding solutions to difficult problems. What We're Looking For The ideal candidate combines technical understanding with organization, communication, and commercial judgment. Minimum Qualifications Two or more years of experience in manufacturing procurement, technical purchasing, sourcing, manufacturing engineering, or a related field. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, materials, and supplier capabilities. St e management, and corrective actions. Familiarity with material certifications, traceability, and counterfeit material prevention. Experience with technical estimating, manufacturing cost analysis, or RFQ development. Experience using manufacturing ERP systems and digital procurement workflows. Familiarity with Paperless Parts or similar manufacturing quoting platforms. Experience negotiating supplier agreements and developing long\-term purchasing relationships. Technical degree in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management, or a related discipline. A technical degree is valuable, but demonstrated manufacturing knowledge, problem\-solving ability, and relevant experience are equally important. You don't need to check every preferred qualification to be considered. We're interested in what you can contribute today and how you can grow with our company. What Makes This Opportunity Different? You'll have the opportunity to influence how an expanding advanced manufacturing company operates. At Machine Time, procurement works directly with the people responsible for estimating, programming, machining, inspecting, and delivering our products. That means you'll see how your decisions affect the manufacturing process—and have opportunities to improve it. As we expand our equipment, facilities, production capacity, and customer relationships, you'll help develop the supplier network and purchasing systems needed to support that growth. We're looking for someone who wants to do more than maintain an existing process. We want someone who brings ideas, challenges inefficiencies, builds relationships, and helps us become a stronger manufacturing organization. Compensation \& Benefits Competitive Compensation Based on Experience Compensation will reflect technical knowledge, manufacturing experience, supplier management capabilities, and the ability to work independently. Health \& Insurance 80% employer\-paid Anthem health insurance premiums. 100% employer\-paid dental and vision insurance premiums. Optional employee\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance. Optional employee\-paid life, accident, cancer, and critical illness insurance. Paid Time Off \& Holidays **Salary of 50,000 \- 65,000** 40 hours of PTO after completing the introductory probationary period. 80 hours of annual PTO after one year of service. 120 hours of annual PTO after five years of service. Eight paid holidays annually, separate from PTO. Additional Benefits Employee\-funded 401(k) retirement savings plan. Paid parental leave for eligible employees. $150 safety footwear credit after the probationary period. $150 prescription safety glasses credit after the probationary period. Opportunities for professional development and advancement in manufacturing procurement, supplier management, and operations. Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable company policies. Why Machine Time? We're building something bigger than a traditional machine shop. Our vision is to create a manufacturing environment where advanced technology, skilled people, and continuous improvement come together to deliver exceptional results. We're investing in the equipment, facilities, systems, and people needed to support the next generation of precision manufacturing. We want our employees to be part of that progress—not simply watch it happen. Our mission is to Make Manufacturing Sexy by challenging outdated perceptions of manufacturing and demonstrating what's possible when talented people have the tools, technology, and opportunities to succeed. If you're looking for an opportunity to apply your technical knowledge, develop supplier relationships, solve challenging problems, and help build a stronger manufacturing organization, we'd like to hear from you. Join Machine Time and help build what's next. Machine Time Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Data Science
jobs.description: Job Description Position Summary We aspire to be the premier research\-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. The Cyber Applied AI team is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build detection and investigation analytics over enterprise security data. The work is statistical: finding unusual behavior in very high\-volume network and endpoint telemetry, measuring similarity between security events, correlating alerts from multiple sources into unified incidents mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK, and turning threat intelligence into structured, usable data. The person in this role takes an analytical method from idea through validation and into production, and owns the data pipelines that feed it. This is a senior individual contributor role for a data scientist who also engineers. The person in it designs the method, builds the pipelines and services that run it, deploys it on Azure or AWS, and keeps it in production. That includes applied AI work: building AI\-driven analysis systems that use Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools over security data stores to automate investigation and shorten triage, and exposing results through APIs and automated reporting. Responsibilities * Build and maintain statistical anomaly detection over network telemetry at the scale of billions of records per day, using behavioral baselines, percentile thresholds (p95/p99\), new and rare entity detection, and feature engineering. * Design correlation frameworks that use IDF weighting, entity similarity metrics, and MITRE ATT\&CK mappings to aggregate EDR and other security telemetry into unified security events. * Implement these methods as production workflows in Azure Data Explorer using KQL functions and materialized views. * Evaluate detection and correlation methods with defined metrics (precision, recall, false positive rate, time to triage), validate them against labeled incidents and analyst feedback, and monitor for drift once in production. * Build pipelines that extract CVEs, indicators of compromise, and other structured intelligence from unstructured sources such as security news and vendor reporting. * Design AI\-driven security analysis systems that use MCP tools against Azure Data Explorer and threat intelligence services to automate investigations and reduce triage time. * Turn analytical methods into repeatable detection and investigation workflows with automated reporting. * Design and operate the data pipelines that feed the analytics, including batch and streaming ingestion on AWS (S3, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, Kinesis) and Azure. * Write ETL/ELT transformations in Spark and Python for large cybersecurity datasets. * Identify where a purpose\-built analytical system can replace a commercial product and build it when the economics justify it. Qualifications Required * Bachelor's degree in data science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. * At least 5 years building statistical or machine learning methods and engineering them into production systems, including the data pipelines, cloud services, and APIs around them. * Hands\-on experience with statistical anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or similarity\-based correlation on datasets in the hundreds of millions of records or larger. * Experience with security telemetry (network, endpoint/EDR, cloud, or identity) and familiarity with the MITRE ATT\&CK framework. * Strong Python and SQL. Working experience with an analytics query language such as KQL and with Spark or PySpark. * At least 3 years building data pipelines on Azure or AWS, including both batch and streaming ingestion. * Able to explain a method and its limits to engineers, analysts, and managers. Preferred * Master's degree in data science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field and at least 5 years of experience * Production experience with Azure Data Explorer, KQL functions, and materialized views. * Experience extracting structured intelligence (CVEs, IOCs) from unstructured text. * Experience building AI\-driven analysis systems with LLM applications, AI agents, or MCP tools (for example Microsoft Foundry) over security data. * Experience with AWS data lake tooling: S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, Kinesis. * Computer vision or deep learning work with PyTorch. * A record of replacing a commercial tool with an in\-house analytical solution and measuring the savings. * Experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated industry. **Required Skills:** Business Intelligence (BI), Database Design, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Science, Data Visualization, Machine Learning (ML), Software Development, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Waterfall Model **Preferred Skills:** Current Employees apply HERE Current Contingent Workers apply HERE **US and Puerto Rico Residents Only:**   affirmative action requirements for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: At Moss Utilities, we specialize in underground utility installations across the DFW Metroplex. Our project experience includes commercial, single\-family residential, multi\-family residential, and public works infrastructure. Founded in 2016, Moss Utilities carries forward a family legacy in Dallas\-Fort Worth utility construction dating back to the early 1900s. As an Employee\-Owned company (ESOP), every team member has a stake in our shared success and the future we’re building together. **Forward Deployed Engineer** **Position Overview** Moss Utilities is seeking a hands\-on Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Technology team. This role is designed for a software engineer who wants to work side by side with the people building our projects, not behind a ticket queue. In this position, you will spend time in the office, in the yard, and on job sites learning how our crews, superintendents, estimators, and project managers get work done. You will find where time is lost to paperwork, spreadsheets, and disconnected systems, then build software, integrations, data tools, and AI solutions that make their work faster, safer, and more accurate. You will own each solution from start to finish discovery, design, development, rollout, training, and ongoing support. **Responsibilities** **Field Discovery \& Problem Solving** * Meet with field supervisors, superintendents, project managers, estimators, and office staff to understand how work is performed. * Visit job sites and the equipment yard to observe daily workflows, paperwork, and handoffs firsthand. * Map how information moves between crews, the office, and our business systems. * Identify manual processes, duplicate data entry, and spreadsheet workarounds that slow teams down. * Determine whether a problem is best solved with a process change, system configuration, custom software, or AI. * Measure current performance before building so results can be proven after launch. **Software Development \& Systems Integration** * Build web applications, mobile\-friendly tools, and internal apps for field and office teams. * Connect our business systems, including accounting, estimating, project management, equipment, HR, and safety platforms. * Develop prototypes quickly, test them with real users, and turn successful ones into dependable tools. * Design interfaces that work for crews on phones and tablets, including in areas with limited connectivity. * Write clean, tested, documented code using version control and code review. * Create reusable components that speed up future projects. **Applied AI, Data \& Automation** * Use Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, and similar platforms to build practical solutions for Moss Utilities teams. * Develop AI tools that search and summarize plans, specifications, OSHA standards, and equipment manuals. * Automate routine tasks such as daily reports, timecards, material tracking, and document processing. * Build data pipelines and dashboards connecting project, equipment, safety, and productivity metrics. * Design AI solutions with human review and accuracy checks before they reach the field. * Work with Learning \& Development and Safety to support training and knowledge tools. **Deployment, Training \& Support** * Roll out new tools to pilot crews first, then expand across field operations. * Train field and office employees on new tools in person, on site, and through quick\-reference guides. * Help non\-technical employees feel confident using digital tools and AI applications. * Monitor tools after launch, fix issues quickly, and gather feedback for improvements. * Follow company security standards and protect project, employee, and customer data. * Report results to leadership in clear, plain language. **Qualifications** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * 2–5 years of professional software development experience. * Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a similar programming language. * Experience building web applications, APIs, and integrations between systems. * Strong SQL and database skills. * Experience using Generative AI tools and prompt engineering. * Strong communication and problem\-solving skills. * Comfortable working directly with field crews and supervisors on active job sites. * Bilingual English/Spanish. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to job sites across the DFW Metroplex. **Preferred** * Experience in construction, utilities, or another field\-based industry. * Experience building applications with large language models, including retrieval and document processing. * Experience with construction or ERP software such as Viewpoint, HCSS, Procore, or similar platforms. * Experience creating dashboards or data visualizations (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Experience building mobile or offline\-capable applications. **What You Get from Working at Moss** * An incredible culture built on our core values. * Competitive pay and solid benefits. * Onsite amenities include fitness centers, basketball and pickleball courts, and personal training. * Opportunities for professional growth and long\-term career development. * Employee Ownership: as an ESOP company, your hard work directly contributes to the value you build. **Benefits Offered** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Life insurance, short\-term disability, accident \& critical illness plans. * Multiple health plan options. * 401(k) with company match. * Paid time off and paid holidays. * Employee ownership through our ESOP program. **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer Committed to maintaining a Drug\-Free Workplace. We participate in E\-Verify, and all applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.**

jobs.title: Edge Kubernetes Solution Architect
jobs.description: **About NCR VOYIX** **NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Edge Kubernetes Solution Architect** ====================================== **Atlanta, Georgia • Professional Services • Customer\-facing technical leadership** **Help shape the future of technology in retail.** Work with leading retailers to design and deliver Edge Kubernetes\-based containerized solutions across complex, distributed store environments. **About NCR Voyix Edge** At NCR Voyix, we're changing how retailers deploy and manage technology across their stores. NCR Voyix Edge is our Kubernetes\-based platform designed for retail environments. It enables retailers to centrally manage and operate containerized applications deployed across hundreds or thousands of locations, while simplifying the infrastructure required within each store. **The Opportunity** We're looking for an **Edge** **Kubernetes Solution Architect** to join our Professional Services team and help customers successfully adopt this technology. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing architecture role. You'll understand customer environments, design the right end\-to\-end solution and lead implementation from discovery through pilot and production rollout. We're not looking for someone who already knows every technology we use. We're looking for strong technical foundations, experience with modern infrastructure or application platforms, confidence working with customers, and the curiosity and ability to learn. **What You'll Do** **Lead customer engagements** * Own the technical solution across customer Edge engagements, from discovery and architecture through deployment and transition to operations. * Act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through architecture choices, dependencies, risks and deployment strategy. * Work directly with customer infrastructure, application, networking and security teams. * Coordinate technical delivery across Professional Services, Solution Architecture, Product and Engineering. * Create practical solution designs, implementation plans, runbooks and technical documentation. * Communicate recommendations clearly to engineers, architects, programmer stakeholders and executives. **Design and guide implementation** * Design end\-to\-end Kubernetes\-based solutions for geographically distributed retail environments. * Help customers onboard, migrate and operate containerized applications on NCR Voyix Edge. * Implement repeatable deployment patterns, automation workflows and operational practices. * Guide decisions covering infrastructure, networking, storage, security and observability. * Lead technical troubleshooting across applications, platforms and infrastructure. * Support pilots and proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate the solution in the customer's environment. **Improve the platform and delivery approach** * Build lab and proof\-of\-concept environments to solve real customer challenges. * Translate deployment experience and customer feedback into actionable input for Product Management and Engineering. * Capture lessons learned and turn them into reusable standards, tools and implementation practices. * Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across the Professional Services organization. * Stay current with Kubernetes, cloud\-native technologies, Edge computing and retail technology. **What We're Looking For** We're primarily looking for someone who is technically strong, comfortable leading customer conversations and motivated by solving difficult problems. * Experience designing, delivering or supporting complex enterprise technology solutions in a customer\-facing role. * The ability to explain technical subjects clearly to technical and business audiences. * Practical knowledge of Kubernetes and/or container technologies such as Docker. * Strong foundations in Linux, infrastructure, virtualization, cloud or cloud\-native platforms. * A good understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, including IP networking, DNS, DHCP, routing and firewalls. * Experience troubleshooting issues that span multiple systems and technology domains. * Some experience with automation, scripting or infrastructure tooling. * Confidence influencing stakeholders and bringing multiple technical teams together. * A willingness to learn and become a subject matter expert in NCR Voyix Edge. **You don't need to tick every box.** If you have strong experience in Kubernetes, **Technologies You May Work With** Kubernetes • Linux • Containers • Docker • Helm • Git • GitOps • Bash • Python • Cloud platforms • Virtualization • Networking • Observability Experience with all of these is not expected. Experience with one or more is valuable, and we will help you develop knowledge in areas that are new to you. **Nice to Have, but Not Essential** * Knowledge of distributed infrastructure or Edge computing architectures. * Experience operating Kubernetes in a production environment. * Familiarity with Helm, Flux or other Kubernetes deployment tooling. * Public cloud experience with Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or AWS. * Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic or OpenTelemetry. * Experience in retail, hospitality or another large multi\-site environment. * Experience helping enterprise customers through infrastructure or application modernization. **What Success Looks Like** Success in this role is not about knowing every technology on day one. It is about becoming someone customers trust when undertaking significant technology change. You'll be able to understand a complex environment, define a practical solution, bring together the right people and technologies, and lead the implementation through to a successful production outcome. Over time, you'll become an expert in NCR Voyix Edge and play an important role in helping retailers deploy the next generation of applications across their stores. Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job **EEO Statement** Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment. **Statement to Third Party Agencies** To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes *“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”*

jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA is searching for a world\-class engineer in graphics and AI to join our neural graphics product team. If you agree with us that the most exciting thing about the AI revolution is applying it to solve real problems, this team will be an excellent fit for you! We are passionate about applications in generative AI, gaming, augmented reality, user\-generated content, computer vision, and other areas, with the goal of improving visual fidelity, gameplay, or other domains within the gaming and pro\-visualization markets. Working with other teams throughout the company, you will productize promising research, as well as develop new features through your own work. **What you'll be doing:** * Use AI for solving product problems in gaming and other interactive experiences. * Build upon the latest research to create new models and invent new ways of applying AI to advance neural graphics and gaming. * Create prototypes to demonstrate real\-life applications of your ideas and to accelerate productization. * Keep up with the latest AI/DL research and collaborate with diverse teams (both internal and external to NVIDIA), including AI/DL researchers, hardware architects, and software engineers. Participate in technology transfers to and from teams across NVIDIA. * **What we need to see:** * Master's in computer science/engineering, Machine Learning, AI, and related fields (or equivalent experience) * 8\+ years of machine learning / deep learning research or work experience * Knowledge of application areas such as real\-time computer graphics, CV, and game development. * Expertise with programming systems such as Python, C\+, CUDA, and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. Very strong programming skills. A proven track record of delivering complex products and technologies spanning multiple teams and functional areas. * Intelligent machines powered by AI computers that can learn, reason, and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Image recognition and speech recognition — GPU deep learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason, and solve problems. The GPU started out as the engine for simulating human imagination, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Now, NVIDIA's GPU runs deep learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots and self\-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and artificial intelligence come together in our architecture. Two modes of the human brain, two modes of the GPU. jobs.title: 2027-2028 Computer Science & Robotics Engineering Teacher
jobs.description: **Start date: August 2027** **Mission** The mission of Neighborhood Charter Schools is to empower every scholar to discover their unique potential and develop the knowledge, character, and courage to shape a better future for themselves, their communities, and the world. Through an exceptional, rigorous, and inclusive K\-12 education, we cultivate scholars who lead with LIGHT, equipping them to think critically, embrace lifelong learning, and lead with purpose. We foster a community where every scholar, including autistic children and scholars with IEPs, belongs, every difference is celebrated, and every learner is empowered to thrive. *Every Learner. Every Pathway. Every Chance to Thrive.* **About Neighborhood Charter Schools** Neighborhood Charter Schools (NCS) is a public charter school network rooted in Harlem and the Bronx, serving students in an intentionally designed, inclusive learning community. NCS is built on a simple but powerful belief: every child deserves to be known, valued, and supported as their full self. Our schools operate as a true neighborhood model, grounded in deep relationships with families and a commitment to belonging for every student. What distinguishes NCS is an inclusive\-by\-design approach. Classrooms, schedules, and supports are intentionally built to serve high\-functioning autistic students, multilingual learners, students with IEPs, and general education students together. Inclusion is not a program or an add\-on—it is the foundation of how our schools function and how students experience learning every day. As NCS expands from a K–8 network to a K–12 system, the launch of its first high school marks a defining moment for the organization. The high school represents an opportunity to extend NCS’s inclusive, neighborhood\-based model through adolescence, creating continuity, care, and high expectations over time. The Founding High School Principal will play a central role in shaping this next chapter and bringing the NCS high school vision to life. To learn more about NCS, please visit https://ncschools.org/ncs\-high\-school/ **The Opportunity** NCS is launching its first high school, serving Harlem and the Bronx and opening in August 2027\. The Founding Computer Science \& Robotics Engineering Teacher builds the school's computing and engineering pathway from the ground up, starting with an introductory course for every 9th grader and growing into AP Computer Science Principles, AP Computer Science A, and hands\-on courses in artificial intelligence and robotics. This teacher ensures every scholar, including those with IEPs and autistic scholars, sees themselves as a technology creator and leaves NCSHS ready for college\-level computing and engineering. **Reporting Structure** This teacher reports to the Assistant Principal of Culture \& Electives (APC) and works closely with the AP of STEM, special education staff, the Light Leader for their grade team, and the Director of College \& Career Readiness (DCCR). Beginning in Year 3, day\-to\-day coaching shifts to the Electives Department Head. **The Founding Role: How It Grows From Year 1 to Year 4** NCSHS opens with 9th grade and adds a grade each year. The computer science program grows with it. * **Year 1 (SY 2027\-28\):** Teach an introductory computer science, AI, or robotics engineering course to all 9th graders. Set up the classroom, devices, robotics equipment, and platforms, and help design the four\-year course sequence. * **Year 2 (SY 2028\-29\):** Add a 10th grade course that builds toward AP readiness (for example, web design or programming foundations). Launch a computer science club or after\-school offering in partnership with the After\-School Coordinator. * **Year 3 (SY 2029\-30\):** Launch AP Computer Science Principles for 11th graders. Use data from Years 1 and 2 to place scholars and build AP supports, in partnership with the AP/Advanced Coursework Lead. * **Year 4 (SY 2030\-31\):** Launch AP Computer Science A and lead a full 9\-12 pathway, including connections to internships, summer programs, and college majors with the DCCR. **What You'll Do** *Duties below reflect the role at full build\-out in Year 4 (SY 2030\-31\).* **Curriculum and instruction** * Teach 6 sections, or 4 sections plus 1\-2 duties, using a rigorous, standards\-aligned curriculum, including AP Computer Science Principles, AP Computer Science A, and/or courses in artificial intelligence and robotics engineering * Build and refine unit plans, projects, and assessments aligned to the NYS Computer Science and Digital Fluency Standards and the College Board AP frameworks * Plan lessons that make computing accessible to every scholar, using accommodations, modifications, and universal design, in partnership with special education staff **Data and scholar achievement** * Design and give assessments that measure mastery, and use the data to adjust instruction and reteach * Own AP pass rates and course mastery for your sections, and keep the gradebook accurate and current * Flag scholars who are struggling academically or behaviorally and bring them to Light Team (MTSS) as needed **Culture and community** * Build a joyful, high\-expectations classroom using NCSHS culture systems and the Code of Conduct, with consistent recognition and consequences * Communicate regularly with families about progress, celebrations, and concerns * Participate in Grade Team meetings, school\-wide events, and NCSHS traditions **Program building and professional growth** * Maintain the classroom, devices, robotics equipment, and software accounts, and partner with Operations on technology needs * Grow scholar interest in computing and engineering through clubs, robotics competitions, and partnerships with organizations and colleges * Take part in weekly coaching, data meetings, and professional development, including summer PD before the school year begins * Other responsibilities as assigned **Who You Are** * A mission\-aligned builder, committed to the NCS inclusive model and energized by launching something new * Bachelor's degree required (Master's preferred); 2\+ years of teaching experience, ideally in an urban public or charter school * Strong command of computer science, artificial intelligence, or robotics engineering content, including programming in Python, Java, or a similar language; experience teaching AP Computer Science or robotics is highly desirable * NYS certification in Computer Science preferred. Candidates holding a CE, CEAS, or Standard Certification in Engineering Technology are encouraged to apply, as are candidates working toward certification * Experience supporting scholars with IEPs and autistic scholars, and a belief that every scholar can master rigorous content * Reflective, data\-driven, and eager for feedback **Compensation** * Competitive salary commensurate with experience, based on the NCS teacher salary schedule, with a range of $76,000\-$136,200 (SY 27\-28\). The starting salary for NYS\-**certified teachers is $82,000\.** * Comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, and dental insurance, a competitive retirement plan, and parental leave. * Laptop provided KXCsWmu6NF

jobs.title: AI Perception Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Location:** United States, Remote **Type:** Full\-time **Travel:** Approximately 10%, including quarterly onsite meetings at a Nextpower California office and visits to solar farms or test sites **Reports to:** Senior Director, Robotics \& Autonomy **About Nextpower** =================== Nextpower is a global leader in intelligent solar tracker and software solutions, optimizing solar power plant performance worldwide. Our Robotics and Autonomy team develops and deploys robotic inspection systems for live and under\-construction solar sites. Construction environments can be busy, crowded, and constantly changing, with active equipment and people requiring careful coordination. Once a site is operating, it may be remote and quiet, with robots working for long periods in open, sun\-exposed conditions and little or no human presence. Our systems combine mobility, perception, embedded computing, autonomy, and cloud intelligence to increase inspection capacity, improve safety, and scale operations. We are seeking an AI Perception Engineer II to build, deploy, and own computer vision and perception software for robotic inspection. You will develop models for object detection, recognition, tracking, classification, segmentation, and fault detection, and own the robot\-side software nodes that run those models in deployed systems. You will also build cloud\-assisted workflows that use APIs to route compute\-intensive analysis to cloud services when appropriate. **Role Overview** ================= This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building, deploying, testing, and improving AI models and perception software on real systems. You will own perception nodes running on the robot, optimize models for embedded or GPU\-based hardware, and connect robot\-side processing with cloud APIs for additional compute and analysis. When a model identifies a potential fault or uncertainty, you will work with the mission management system to trigger targeted data collection, such as additional images, viewpoints, or sensor measurements, so the system can improve the inspection result. You will work closely with the autonomy and reliability leads and the broader engineering team to deliver a working system and contribute to the inspection roadmap. You will visit test and operating sites to understand inspection conditions, observe how people work, collect representative data, and investigate system behavior. The perception system must perform across very different environments: dynamic construction sites with people, vehicles, and frequent changes, as well as remote, quiet operating sites exposed to sun and dust, where robots may work for long periods without nearby human support. The role combines computer vision and machine learning with strong software engineering and practical robotics integration. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Computer Vision and Model Development** * Develop, train, and evaluate computer vision models for object detection, recognition, tracking, classification, segmentation, and inspection fault detection. * Prepare datasets, review labels, identify data gaps, and work with inspection specialists to improve training data quality. * Build and maintain repeatable model training and evaluation pipelines, including model and dataset versioning. * Apply probability, statistics, and sound experimental methods to model development and evaluation. **Benchmarking and Testing** * Build benchmarks that measure model performance across fault classes, equipment, sites, and capture conditions. * Analyze false positives, false negatives, and other model errors to identify causes and prioritize improvements. * Test model and software changes as part of the release process. Document results, limitations, and release evidence. **Deployment and Field Validation** * Optimize and deploy models to embedded or GPU\-based hardware, and profile performance on target systems. * Own and maintain perception and inspection software nodes that run on the robot, including their interfaces, performance, health reporting, and integration with the wider system. * Build robot\-to\-cloud workflows that use cloud\-based APIs to route compute\-intensive inference or analysis when appropriate, while accounting for connectivity, latency, bandwidth, and degraded\-operation behavior. * Integrate model results with mission management so detected faults, low\-confidence results, or data gaps can trigger targeted collection of additional images, viewpoints, or sensor measurements. * Develop and evaluate sensor\-fusion approaches using vision, lidar, GPS, IMU, and, where applicable, multispectral data to improve inspection context and fault assessment. * Visit construction and operating sites to observe inspection workflows, collect representative data, and evaluate perception performance in busy, changing environments and remote, sun\-exposed sites. **Software Delivery and Team Execution** * Write mai ability, statistics, benchmarking, and model evaluation. * Experience developing maintainable software, writing automated tests, debugging deployed systems, and testing integrated software or model changes for release. * Experience using Git\-based workflows, including creating pull requests, participating in code reviews, and addressing review feedback. * Experience documenting technical work, breaking it into trackable tasks in Jira or a similar system, communicating progress, and presenting results clearly. * Ability and willingness to test systems on physical robots and travel to test or operating sites * Coachable and collaborative, with the ability to take technical feedback, apply it to your work, and contribute effectively on a fast\-moving engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience using cloud\-based APIs or distributed compute workflows to scale model inference, analysis, or training while coordinating with edge systems. * Experience developing software for mobile robots, including ROS or ROS2 nodes, sensor interfaces, and deployed robot workflows. * Experience with autonomy concepts such as motion planning, localization, and state estimation, and how perception outputs support those capabilities. * Experience with simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL), hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), test\-driven development, or other rigorous methods for validating robotics and machine learning systems. * Experience with semi\-supervised learning that combines simulated and real\-world data. * Experience creating or using photorealistic simulation environments and log\-replay systems to generate, reproduce, and evaluate perception scenarios. * Experience building learning pipelines from human demonstrations, observations, or inspection decisions. * Familiarity with experiment tracking and dataset or model management tools, such as MLflow. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, such as Cursor, Codex, or similar coding agents, to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation while independently validating the output and maintaining ownership of code quality. * Experience with solar equipment, industrial inspection, construction, or other visual quality applications. **Join Us** =========== Join a fast\-moving team building technology that will change how solar sites are inspected. Nextpower is an industry leader, and our robotics team is putting capable robots to work in real environments, from active construction sites to remote solar farms. You’ll see your work move from data and models into deployed systems, where better perception can improve inspection quality, expand operating capacity, and help people focus on the hardest decisions. We’re excited to bring on an engineer who is curious, coachable, and eager to keep growing. You’ll have opportunities to deepen your technical skills, take on broader ownership, and contribute to the team’s direction as the work and your capabilities develop. Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure. Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. **We are Nextpower** ====================
