jobs.title: AI Claims Engineer
jobs.description: **About notch** Notch builds AI for complex, high\-stakes operations. Our platform helps insurance companies move work across customer conversations, documents, and enterprise systems \- with governance, traceability, and human oversight built in. The AI Workforce takes on repeatable tasks, while the AI Workspace gives professionals a connected place to investigate, prepare, and decide. We began inside insurance operations, so we know that real transformation demands more than a great demo: it has to work against actual business rules, real exceptions, and real\-world pressure. Notch has raised $45 million to date, including a $30 million Series A in 2026\. **About the role** This is a new kind of insurance role: part claims expert, part workflow designer, part product partner, and part trusted customer advisor. You won't spend your day adjusting claims or writing production code. You will work with adjusters, claims leaders, and the Notch team to find the work that slows a claim down, design a better approach, and test whether AI can carry it out safely and reliably. You know why the details matter: a police report can contradict the FNOL, a missing photo can stall a decision, and a seemingly simple claim can become a sensitive exception. Your job is to bring that practical judgment into the way our product is built, deployed, and improved. The goal is not just fewer touches \- it is better information and better decisions, with the adjuster in control. **Compensation:** $125,000\-$175,000 base salary \+ plus equity and benefits. **What you'll do** * **Understand the real workflow \-** Work alongside carriers, TPAs, and claims teams to map the journey from FNOL through triage, investigation, documentation, escalation, and resolution. Spot bottlenecks, manual handoffs, and avoidable rework. * **Turn expertise into working AI \-** Translate claims procedures, authority limits, coverage considerations, service standards, and exception rules into clear workflows for Notch's AI Workspace and AI Workforce. * **Design practical use cases \-** Shape experiences such as voice\-based FNOL, document intake and summarization, claim\-file preparation, missing\-information follow\-up, QA review, and next\-best\-action support. * **Test like a claims professional \-** Create realistic scenarios and evaluate outputs against source documents. Challenge missing facts, ambiguous coverage, conflicting evidence, incorrect escalation, and misleading recommendations before customers rely on them. * **Guide customers from pilot to adoption \-** Join discovery sessions, workshops, demos, pilots, and training. Help claims teams understand when to trust automation, when to review it, and where people must retain authority. * **Be the voice of claims inside Notch \-** Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to explain the difficult edge cases and translate customer feedback into product improvements. * **Prove and repeat the value \-** Measure improvements in handling time, file completeness, touches per claim, quality, and policyholder experience. Document patterns and playbooks we can reuse across customers. Requirements: **What you'll bring** * You have worked in claims long enough to know what looks straightforward on a process chart and what actually happens on a busy claims desk. You are ready to improve that work, not just do more of it. * Around 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in P\&C claims adjusting, claims operations, claims quality, or a closely related insurance function. * Strong familiarity with claim intake, documentation, triage, coverage review, escalation, communication, and the controls that make a claim defensible. * The judgment to distinguish a useful AI recommendation from an answer that merely sounds convincing. * Genuine curiosity about AI and software. You do not need to be a developer, but you want to learn how systems behave, how to test them, and how to improve them. * Clear communication with both insurance professionals and technical teams. You can explain an operational issue precisely without drowning people in jargon. * Comfort with ambiguity, customer conversations, and hands\-on iteration; a bias for taking ownership and making a workflow better each time. **The extras we love** * Experience with Guidewire, Duck Creek, or other claims management systems; claims transformation or vendor implementation projects. * Exposure to commercial or specialty claims, bodily injury, complex property losses, SIU referrals, CAT operations, or claims QA/audit. * Experience building process maps, test scenarios, SOPs, no\-code workflows, or internal tools. **Why this role matters** Instead of working one claim at a time, you will help shape how thousands of claims are handled. You will make AI useful to the people who carry the responsibility: reducing administrative work, strengthening the record, and giving adjusters more time for the judgment and empathy no system can replace. **Interested?** We would love to hear how you would improve a workflow you know from the inside.

Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. #### **The Opportunity** Are you a C\# engineer who enjoys building reliable, high\-performance software and is excited about the possibilities of AI? We’re looking for a Software Engineer II – AI \& C\# to join our team and help build and enhance PDI’s market\-leading POS and back\-office solutions. This role is a great opportunity for an experienced software engineer who has strong C\#/.NET fundamentals and wants to expand their hands\-on experience with artificial intelligence. You do not need prior production AI experience. We’re looking for solid engineering skills, curiosity, and a desire to learn. You’ll work as part of an agile engineering team designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise software while helping introduce practical AI capabilities into our products. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product owners, UX, QA, SRE, and operations to deliver scalable solutions that solve real business problems. ### **What You'll Do** * Build C\#/.NET applications: Design, develop, test, and maintain features across our POS and back\-office applications, including APIs, services, and SQL\-backed data layers. * Bring AI into our products: Help integrate capabilities such as LLM\-powered assistants, intelligent search, and AI\-driven reporting and insights into existing platforms. * Develop your AI expertise: Gain practical experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), helping move successful prototypes into production. * Support AI quality and safety: Develop test cases, evaluate AI outputs, and help identify accuracy, privacy, security, and payment\-data considerations before solutions reach customers. * Use AI to engineer smarter: Leverage AI coding assistants responsibly to improve development productivity and code quality while sharing effective practices with the broader team. * Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Operations to translate retail and fuel workflows into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Own your work: Take features from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. * Mentor others: Support junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.Contribute to the Agile team: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, planning, estimation, and continuous improvement efforts. * Keep learning: Stay current with evolving development frameworks, cloud technologies, and AI tools and apply what you learn to real customer problems. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of software development experience in a software product development environment. * Strong hands\-on experience with C\# and .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Web APIs. * Working knowledge of SQL, preferably SQL Server. * Exposure to AI/ML concepts through professional experience, coursework, certifications, or personal projects. * Some experience experimenting with technologies such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or generative AI tools. Production AI experience is not required. * Experience with Git, Postman, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar development tools. * Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices. * Familiarity with at least one public cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments, including PowerShell and bash. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an ability to work through complex technical challenges. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and a willingness to collaborate, mentor, and share knowledge. * A self\-motivated, curious mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and deliver in a fast\-paced environment. ### **Nice to Have** Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required: * Angular or other modern JavaScript frameworks * Python * Delphi * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Embeddings and vector databases * AI evaluation or testing frameworks * Retail or convenience\-store technology * Point\-of\-sale (POS) systems * Payments, EMV, or PCI environments * Forecourt/fuel systems * Wholesale or logistics technologies This is an opportunity to build on your existing software engineering experience while developing skills in one of the fastest\-moving areas of technology. wipe and securely prepare laptops and other devices for re\-use or disposal; configure and prepare devices to be shipped to new or existing users * Assist with IT asset and inventory management, including tracking equipment entering and leaving the Data Centre Follow documented processes and maintain accurate records of work completed, and assist with other hands\-on IT and Data Centre tasks as required * **Requirements** * Between 1 and 3 years of experience in on\-premises IT environments. * Understanding and experience with computer hardware and networking * Confidence working with laptops, desktops and other IT equipment * A basic understanding of network concepts such as IP addresses, switches, network ports and Ethernet connectivity * An interest in learning more about servers, networking and Data Centre infrastructure * The ability to follow technical instructions and documented processes carefully * Good organization, attention to detail and problem\-solving skills * A willingness to ask questions and escalate when something is outside your knowledge or experience. * Good communication skills and a helpful, service\-focused attitude with the ability to work collaboratively with engineers and IT teams who may be based remotely **Preferred Requirements** * Experience in any of the following would be useful, but is not essential: * Data Center experience/exposure. * Working in an IT Help Desk, Service Desk, or desktop support environment * Server or network rack installation and cabling * Laptop imaging, configuration or device management * IT asset management * Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 * Working with a ticketing system such as Jira CompTIA A\+, Network\+ or similar entry\-level IT certifications * **Benefits** This role offers an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across a broad range of technologies and environments. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Systems Integration
jobs.description: ### **Build the Path Forward** At Path Robotics, we're building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI\-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world, closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field\-ready AI that is risk\-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real\-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking Robotics Software Engineers who thrive on making big, complex systems work together in the real world. We currently have **experienced and senior** openings on the team. Our robots combine industrial hardware, real\-time C\+\+ control, ROS, cloud services, and the latest machine learning research. This team ties all of it into one reliable product and scales it from a few cells to dozens of systems running in production on customer factory floors. You'll write the drivers, ROS nodes, deployment tooling, and telemetry that make that possible. You'll be hands\-on with the robots, bringing systems up, debugging them, and working with factory technicians to keep them running. ### **What You'll Do** **Experienced:** * **Write drivers for robotic and industrial hardware.** Build and maintain the drivers that connect our software to robot controllers, sensors, cameras, PLCs, and other industrial equipment, behind clean, reliable interfaces. * **Ship software to the fleet.** Package software in Docker, and build and improve the deployment, configuration, and update tooling that gets it onto dozens of robots reliably. * **Get research onto the robot.** Help integrate and deploy new machine learning models and features from our research teams onto real robotic hardware. * **Bring up and support systems on the factory floor.** Install, test, and troubleshoot systems with factory technicians, including networking and connectivity issues, and turn what you learn into fixes in the code. * **Write solid, tested code.** Contribute unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and help keep CI/CD healthy. **Senior:** * **Connect the full stack.** Own the integration layer across modern C\+\+, Python, ROS 1/2, Docker, AWS, web services, and industrial robot controllers, so that new capabilities reach the robot cleanly and reliably. * **Get research into production.** Partner with our machine learning and research teams to package, deploy, and run new learning\-based models on real robotic hardware. * **Scale from a handful of cells to a fleet.** Build the deployment, configuration, and update infrastructure that takes development and demonstration systems to dozens of robots in production. * **Architect large systems.** Organize and design how large numbers of robotic hardware and software components fit together: interfaces, ownership boundaries, versioning, and deployment. * **Build consensus across teams.** Work with hardware, controls, perception, ML, cloud, and field operations teams to understand their needs, propose integration solutions, and bring stakeholders to agreement. * **Mentor engineers.** Provide technical leadership and help experienced engineers grow their system design skills. ### **Who You Are** * A Bachelor's in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years (Experienced) / 6\+ years (Senior) building software in modern C\+\+ (Python a strong plus), with hands\-on work on robots or other physical hardware. * Experience with ROS 2\. * Familiarity with ROS, DDS, gRPC, and other communications middleware. * Comfortable with multithreading, concurrency, and debugging systems\-level behavior on real hardware. * Fluent developing and operating software on Linux, with Git. * You enjoy hands\-on work and are willing to spend time on the factory floor with the robots. * **Senior:** A track record of shipping and supporting industrial robotic systems in production. Experience writing drivers or hardware interfaces, deploying containerized software with Docker on AWS or similar platforms, and handling telemetry, remote management, networking, and security for deployed systems. Experience designing large systems of robotics hardware and software, and comfort leading cross\-team technical discussions to a decision. ### **Why You'll Love Working Here** * Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team * Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total) * 401(k) retirement plan through Empower * Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team! ### **Who We Are** At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path\-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Cybersecurity Products)
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE** Perplexity is building cybersecurity products where agents do the security work, not just assist with it. Our security team already runs agents on our own environment every day, across finding vulnerabilities, testing our defenses, securing our cloud, and responding to threats. Now we're turning that work into products for customers, and we expect those products to span application security, offensive testing, cloud security, detection and response, and areas we haven't picked yet. We're looking for a hands\-on Software Engineer to build these products end to end, from the security logic and agent workflows to the integrations and product surfaces customers use. You'll ship to design partners and enterprise customers quickly, and you'll work directly with the security engineers who do this work internally, so what we build is grounded in real codebases, real environments, and real attackers. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build security products from zero to one across domains such as application security, penetration testing and offensive security, cloud security, and detection and response. * Build agents that do real security work: review code and find vulnerabilities, test applications and infrastructure like an attacker, assess cloud configurations, and investigate threats, then validate findings and recommend or apply fixes. * Build the systems underneath: multi\-tenant services, data pipelines, and secure execution environments that run against customer code, cloud accounts, and telemetry. * Build integrations with the tools customers already use: source control and CI/CD, cloud providers, identity providers, security tools, ticketing, and chat. * Ship the product surfaces customers use: APIs, dashboards, onboarding, and workflows that fit how security and engineering teams actually work. * Hold the product to the same standard we hold ourselves: strong tenant isolation, least privilege, safe handling of customer secrets and data, and tight controls on any agent that acts in a customer environment. * Define how we measure quality (finding accuracy, false positive rate, exploitability, time to fix, cost) and use it to drive improvements. * Work directly with design partners and customers, and help decide which security problems we should build products for next. **QUALIFICATIONS** * 4\+ years of experience as a software engineer building production systems, with meaningful time spent on security products, security data platforms, or security engineering with heavy software development. * Proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or Rust) and experience owning production services end to end. * Hands\-on depth in at least one security domain, such as application security, penetration testing or offensive security, cloud security, or detection and response, and curiosity to work across the others. * Experience integrating with security\- or developer\-relevant systems such as source control, CI/CD, cloud provider APIs, identity providers, scanners, or SIEMs. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and building secure, multi\-tenant SaaS. * Comfortable working directly with customers and shipping pragmatic improvements quickly in an ambiguous, early\-stage product area. * Bonus: experience building LLM\-powered agents, evaluation frameworks, or tool\-using automation for security or other high\-stakes domains. * Bonus: experience at a security product company (AppSec, pentesting, cloud security, detection and response) or on an internal security platform at scale.

jobs.title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Team** It’s an exciting time in technology, and that buzz is felt throughout PetSmart! We are continuing to grow at a faster pace and we want to continue to provide best\-in\-class experiences for pets and pet parents. Our **Technology team**has 6 different departments: Information Security, Service Delivery, Business Enabling Systems, eCommerce \& Marketing Technology, Data and Stores, Services \& Supply Chain. Whether it’s online or in our stores, the work that the IT team does is instrumental in PetSmart’s success. We have a strategic and actionable plan underway and are looking for associates who are just as excited about it as we are. **About the Location** This role is remote within Costa Rica. Primary working hours align with Mountain Standard Time (MST) in Phoenix, Arizona. On\-site attendance is required as needed and during visits by company vice presidents; there is no fixed on\-site schedule. Participation in a rotating on\-call schedule is required, providing 24/7 coverage for one week, currently estimated at approximately once per month. Additional after\-hours work may be required based on business needs. Opportunities to work voluntarily on holidays will be offered. **About the Job** The Sr. Site Reliability Engineer leads reliability practices for PetSmart’s Point of Sales/Cash Register (POS) systems, integrations, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) workloads, and supporting custom applications. The role drives monitoring and observability, incident response, recurring\-problem prevention, and operational improvements. This engineer provides technical guidance and mentorship and contributes occasional development and code reviews to improve service reliability and maintainability. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Lead monitoring and observability across POS applications, integrations, store\-device signals, cloud workloads, and vendor\-hosted services; develop actionable dashboards and alerts. * Lead reliability practices, service health measurement, and coordination of recovery across systems, partnering with application engineers on application\-level fixes. * Provide Tier 3 incident response, coordinate technical diagnosis and recovery with internal teams and vendors, and communicate service impact and recovery progress. * Lead root cause analysis, identify recurring failure patterns, and drive corrective actions that prevent incidents and reduce operational risk. * Automate repetitive operational work and improve health checks, troubleshooting procedures, and incident runbooks. * Improve recovery readiness and identify monitoring work for application engineers; guide implementation and validate that resulting monitoring supports reliable operations. * Support GCP workloads using Kubernetes, Apigee, Cloud SQL, service mesh, Pub/Sub, and Gemini AI, including service health, dependencies, and reliability across combinations of these services. * Contribute occasional application development, operational tooling, and code reviews, partnering with application engineers on reliability and maintainability improvements. * Establish monitoring and incident\-response standards, mentor engineers, and capture operational knowledge to strengthen team capability. * Review and approve releases with senior application engineers, assessing monitoring, operational readiness, recovery procedures, and reliability risks. * Support Salesforce as part of the team’s application portfolio. Use ServiceNow as the primary incident management and ticketing system, and Jira and Confluence for project management, work tracking, and documentation. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Experience leading production reliability, observability, incident response, root cause analysis, and operational improvements for business\-critical applications. * Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent cloud platform. * Working development experience with C\#/.NET and scripting or automation, sufficient to diagnose application issues, build tooling, and review code. * Experience with APIs, SQL databases, and messaging or event\-broker platforms such as RabbitMQ, Google Pub/Sub, or equivalent technologies. * Experience building or operating monitoring and alerting solutions such as Splunk, Site24x7, or comparable tools. * Ability to guide technical teams, mentor engineers, document procedures, and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical partners. **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Direct GCP experience and familiarity with applications using React/JavaScript, Node.js, or MongoDB. * Experience with retail or POS systems, including NCR, and third\-party integrations. * Experience with service\-level indicators and objectives, recovery validation, and reducing repetitive operational work. **About Technology Operations** =============================== This role is part of Technology Operations, which keeps PetSmart’s systems within our area of responsibility reliable, available, and running efficiently so store and home office associates can do their work. You will navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and help teams move issues toward resolution. At times, you will contribute to discussions about unfamiliar systems or problems, ask focused questions, and coordinate assigned issues with guidance from experienced team members. You will work with internal teams and external partners with urgency. Restoring service may require occasional work outside regular hours, including evenings, weekends, and participation in the required on\-call rotation. **About the Culture** Our associates are the heart of Team PetSmart. Together, we’re building the best team in retail through our values\-based culture, connection, and teamwork. Our goal is to create a culture where associates learn and grow together, thrive as effective teams and challenge each other to be the best they can be. Our Costa Rica office offers outstanding amenities in a fun and rewarding workplace including: * You will be able to bring your pets to work! * Free access to UltraPark gym facility * Learn more about \#Life AtPetSmart here: https://www.lifeatpetsmart.com/life\-at\-petsmart/ * Check out Associate stories and share in some celebrations at PetSmart: https://www.blog.lifeatpetsmart.com/ * Will have medical, dental \& vision benefits for all associates * Offer paid time off including holidays and discretionary days PetSmart provides an equal opportunity for all associates and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: ML Infra Engineer, Compute
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Physical Intelligence is bringing general\-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically\-actuated devices of the future. **The Team** ------------ The ML Infrastructure team supports and accelerates PI’s core modeling efforts by building the systems that make large\-scale training reliable, reproducible, and fast. You will work closely with ML Infra (training systems), data platform, and research teams to ensure compute scheduling is never the bottleneck. **About the Role** ------------------ Physical Intelligence builds general\-purpose AI for the physical world. Training our models requires orchestrating thousands of accelerators across a heterogeneous fleet of GPU and TPU clusters — spanning different hardware generations, cloud providers, and cluster topologies. Today, researchers often need to know which cluster to target, what resources are available, and how to configure their jobs accordingly. That doesn't scale. We need a scheduling and compute layer that makes the right placement decision automatically — routing jobs to the best cluster based on availability, hardware fit, cost, and priority — so researchers can focus entirely on the science. This role owns that problem end\-to\-end: the scheduling systems, the placement logic, the cluster management layer, and the operational tooling that keeps it all running. This is not cloud DevOps. It's not about standing up clusters and walking away. It's a systems role for people who care about intelligent resource allocation, utilization, fault tolerance, and making large\-scale distributed training seamless. **In This Role You Will** ------------------------- * Own Intelligent Job Scheduling and Placement: Design and build multi\-tenant scheduling systems that automatically place training jobs on the best available cluster based on hardware requirements, topology, availability, cost, and priority. Support fair resource sharing across teams and projects with quota management, priority tiers, and preemption policies. Abstract away cluster differences so researchers submit jobs without needing to know where they will land. * Scale Multi\-cluster Orchestration: Build the control plane that manages the job lifecycle across diverse clusters (mixed GPU/TPU, multi\-generation hardware, on\-prem/cloud) and enables seamless job migration, failover, and re\-scheduling. * Optimize Accelerator Utilization and Efficiency: Monitor and optimize GPU/TPU utilization across the entire fleet. Implement priority, preemption, queueing, and fairness policies that balance research velocity with cost efficiency. * Ensure Scaling and Stability: Implement fault detection, automatic recovery, and resilience for long\-running multi\-node training jobs. Manage health checking, node management, and scaling to thousands of accelerators. * Support Inference and Robot Deployment: Extend scheduling and orchestration to inference workloads, including deploying models to edge devices on physical robots. * Enhance Observability and Developer Experience: Build the dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and debugging tools necessary for researchers to understand job status and for the team to ensure high scheduling quality and cluster reliability. **What We Hope You'll Bring** ----------------------------- We’re intentionally flexible on exact background, but strong candidates usually have: * Strong software engineering fundamentals * Experience building or operating job scheduling / resource management systems at scale * Experience with large\-scale compute clusters (GPU and/or TPU) * Familiarity with schedulers and orchestration systems (SLURM, Kubernetes, GKE, K3S, or internal equivalents) * Comfort reasoning about resource allocation, bin\-packing, priority scheduling, and multi\-tenancy * Understanding of how ML training workloads behave — long\-running, multi\-node, sensitive to stragglers, topology\-dependent * A bias toward owning systems end\-to\-end, from design to operation * Enjoy working closely with researchers and unblocking fast\-moving projects **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building multi\-cluster or federated scheduling systems * Experience with TPU infrastructure (GCP TPU slices, Multislice, GKE) * Background in cluster resource managers (Borg, YARN, Mesos, or custom schedulers) * Linux systems engineering, networking, and infrastructure\-as\-code * NCCL/collective communication and topology\-aware placement * Experience with capacity planning and cloud cost optimization at scale * Familiarity with JAX, PyTorch, or similar ML frameworks at the runtime/systems level Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you. **About the Role:** As a member of the Product and Engineering team at PitchBook, you will be part of a team of big thinkers, innovators, and problem solvers who strive to deepen the positive impact we have on our customers and our company every day. We value curiosity and the drive to find better ways of doing things. We thrive on customer empathy, which remains our focus when creating excellent customer experiences through product innovation. You will own meaningful pieces of the platform end\-to\-end, from design through production, and be a trusted technical voice who raises the bar for the engineers around you. You work autonomously, bring opinions to design discussions, and use AI as a core part of how you build. **Primary Job Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and operate secure, reliable backend the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors * Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested **Skills and Qualifications:** 1 or more years experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) and prompt and context engineering in a professional environment * Authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship now or in the future * Ability to work onsite in Seattle daily **Preferred** * Experience with AWS and/or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Spring Boot and RESTful API design * Strong testing discipline and a security\-first mindset * Experience owning production services end\-to\-end, including CI/CD, observability, SLOs, and on\-call * Track record of technical leadership: writing design docs, mentoring engineers, and driving work across teams * Sound judgment in applying AI to engineering work: verifying, testing, and securing AI\-generated code before it ships * Familiarity with the Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC): building and evaluating LLM and agent features (RAG, tool calling, MCP), evals, observability, guardrails, and responsible AI practices * Knowledge of identity and security standards such as OAuth 2\.x, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM * Distributed systems experience (Kafka, PostgreSQL, eventual consistency, idempotency) * Excellent written and verbal communication **Benefits \+ Compensation at PitchBook:** Physical Health * Comprehensive health benefits * Additional medical wellness incentives * STD, LTD, AD\&D, and life insurance Emotional Health * Paid sabbatical program after four years * Paid family and paternity leave * Annual educational stipend * Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement * CFA exam stipend * Robust training programs on industry and soft skills * Employee assistance program * Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days Social Health * Matching gifts program * Employee resource groups * Subsidized emergency childcare * Dependent Care FSA * Company\-wide events * Employee referral bonus program * Quarterly team building events Financial Health * 401k match * Shared ownership employee stock program * Monthly transportation stipend * *Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.* Compensation * Annual base salary: $175,000\-$215,000 * Target annual bonus percentage: 10% **Working Conditions:** At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in\-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can't be replicated remotely. jobs.title: Engineer - Product Development
jobs.description: **Product Development Engineer** Are you an engineer who enjoys turning customer challenges into innovative packaging solutions? Do you thrive in a hands\-on development environment where you can take products from concept through commercialization? ProAmpac is looking for a **Product Development Engineer** to lead product development efforts supporting our Orlando, FL and Huntley, IL facilities. In this role, you will transform customer requirements and new business opportunities into flexible packaging solutions that meet performance, quality, cost, and manufacturing objectives. You’ll work closely with customers, suppliers, Operations, Quality, Procurement, and cross\-functional teams to drive new product development, qualification, testing, scale\-up, and commercialization activities. You'll also help improve existing products, materials, and manufacturing processes while supporting innovation and technology advancement. production. **WHY YOU WILL WANT TO WORK HERE** * Lead packaging innovation projects from concept through commercialization and directly influence customer success. * Partner with customers, suppliers, manufacturing teams, and technical experts to develop new flexible packaging solutions. * Drive research, testing, qualification, and scale\-up activities that translate ideas into commercially successful products. * Gain exposure to material technologies, manufacturing processes, sustainability initiatives, and intelligent packaging platforms. * Participate in new business opportunity development and play a key role in bringing innovative packaging structures to market. * Work across multiple facilities and business functions while building expertise in product development, process improvement, and commercialization. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Lead new business opportunity onboarding and customer needs assessments to define critical\-to\-quality requirements and develop packaging structures aligned with site capabilities. * Manage product development projects through commercialization, tracking milestones, delivery dates, risks, and resource requirements. * Collaborate with Quality to design trials and quality plans intended to prevent nonconformances. * Develop trial plans, fit\-for\-use testing methods, acceptance criteria, and validation procedures. * Lead production trials and scale\-up efforts, troubleshoot processing issues, analyze results, and recommend commercialization strategies. * Evaluate and support new raw materials and processing technologies. * Lead secondary\-source qualifications, alternate material qualifications, film internalization initiatives, and cost reduction projects. * Maintain bills of materials, specifications, run sheets, quotations support documentation, and system records. * Support sustainability initiatives, intelligent platform launches, market platform development, and technology transfer activities. * Provide technical support to Regulatory, Operations, and Quality teams regarding products, materials, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement efforts. **WHAT YOU NEED / JOB REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required, preferably Chemical Engineering. * Solid working knowledge of product development processes and related manufacturing operations. * Experience using Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Visio, Teams, and Outlook. * Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and protect confidential and sensitive information. * Exceptional time management and organizational skills. * Strong project management skills. * Ability to communicate effectively through verbal, written, and presentation formats with executive leadership, staff, and internal and external customers. * Ability to exercise sound judgment, identify problems and needs, and develop solutions and options. * Excellent interpersonal skills. * Self\-confident, self\-motivated professional who thrives in a challenging, fast\-paced environment. **HELPFUL, BUT NOT REQUIRED** * 1\-2\+ years of flexible packaging experience. * Lidding experience. If you're an engineer who enjoys product development, experimentation, commercialization, and collaborating across functions to create innovative packaging solutions, we encourage you to apply. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on new products, customer success, and the future of flexible packaging innovation. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** The salary range for this position is **$70,000 to $85,000 per year**, commensurate with experience, education, and internal equity. Providing creative packaging solutions, industry\-leading customer service and award\-winning innovation to a diverse global marketplace. We are guided in our work by five core values that are the basis for our success: Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, Involvement and Impact. The safety and health of our team is our top priority. jobs.description: **Data Center Engineers (Design \& Infrastructure \- Multi\-Discipline)** **Multiple Locations:** Houston, TX, Washington, DC **Company:** Fortune 500 Energy Company **Role Overview** We are looking for Data Center Engineers to play a critical role in the conceptualization, design oversight, and optimization of critical infrastructure systems that keep our data centers running reliably, efficiently, and sustainably. These roles bridge the gap between high\-level building architecture and the complex mechanical, cooling, and piping networks required to support next\-generation compute loads. You will collaborate with cross\-functional design, construction, and operations teams to review schematics, enforce engineering standards, and drive innovation in thermal management and infrastructure resilience. **Responsibilities** **Building Design \& Spatial Planning** * **Architectural \& Structural Collaboration:** Partner with structural engineers and architects to define spatial requirements, floor loading capacities, and structural zoning for heavy mechanical equipment (e.g., chillers, cooling towers, pumps). * **Egress \& Safety Design:** Ensure data hall and mechanical gallery layouts comply with local building codes, life safety requirements, NFPA standards, and physical security boundaries. * **Scalability Planning:** Design modular, scalable infrastructure frameworks that allow for seamless concurrent maintainability and future capacity expansions without disrupting live environments. **Cooling \& HVAC Systems** * **Thermal Management Design:** Develop and evaluate cooling topologies appropriate for varying high\-density environments, including CRAH/CRAC units, Hot/Cold Aisle Containment, Chilled Water Loops, Evaporative Cooling, and Direct\-to\-Chip Liquid Cooling. * **Psychrometric \& Airflow Optimization:** Utilize Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) analysis to evaluate data hall airflow patterns, eliminate hot spots, and maximize economizer hours. * **Environmental Control:** Design and monitor precise HVAC control strategies for humidity, filtration, and pressurization within the white space and support galleries. **Hydronic \& Piping Schematics** * **Schematic Development:** Author, review, and approve critical mechanical diagrams, including Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), piping schematics, and flow diagrams for condenser and chilled water systems. * **Hydronic Calculation:** Perform or validate hydraulic calculations for pump sizing, pipe friction losses, thermal expansion, water hammer mitigation, and system volume requirements. * **Redundancy \& Topology Verification:** Ensure piping architecture meets strict uptime standards (e.g., Tier III/IV or N\+1/2N topologies) with proper isolation valve placement for concurrent maintenance. **Requirements \& Qualifications** **Education \& Experience** * **Bachelor’s Degree** in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * **Minimum of 4–6\+ years** of direct experience in the design, engineering, or operation of mission\-critical facilities (Data Centers, Cleanrooms, or High\-Tech Manufacturing). **Technical Skills** * **Software Proficiency:** Advanced capability with AutoCAD, Revit (BIM), and CFD modeling tools (e.g., 6SigmaRoom, Future Facilities). * **Standards \& Codes:** Deep working knowledge of ASHRAE TC 9\.9 (Thermal Guidelines for Data Processing Environments), ASME piping codes, NFPA standards, and local building/mechanical codes. * **Systems Expertise:** Comprehensive understanding of central plant designs, variable speed pumping, water treatment regimes, and Building Management Systems (BMS/EPMS) sequences of operation. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $175,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

For more information, please visit www.resilience.com The Cyber Security Engineer II is a senior, hands\-on engineer who independently leads complex threat hunting, detection engineering and vulnerability management work across multiple areas of the business, determining priorities, resources and timelines with partner teams. The role hunts for threats, root\-causes what the SOC escalates, and engineers and hardens security controls across endpoint, identity, network, on\-premises infrastructure and cloud. The role pairs threat hunting and detection engineering with proactive control hardening and vulnerability management, working primarily in KQL and XQL across Defender XDR and Cortex XDR. It reports to the Cyber Security Lead, oversees the technical work of the managed SOC partner, and influences infrastructure, network, cloud and site IT teams on security decisions in a regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. **Job Responsibilities** ======================== **Threat Detection \& Response** * Conduct triage and root\-cause analysis on escalations from the SOC, including endpoint, identity, email and cloud alerts, correlating identity, endpoint, network and directory data to attribute activity to a person, a device and a network path. * Shape the threat hunting program: recommend hunt priorities based on threat intelligence and business risk, and lead proactive threat hunting across endpoint, identity, network and cloud telemetry using KQL and XQL, and convert confirmed hunts into durable detections. * Build custom detections and tune existing analytics so that what reaches people is worth their time; own detection quality, setting detection and escalation standards for the managed SOC partner and reviewing its performance against them. * Design and operate AI\-assisted investigation workflows that enrich, correlate and draft verdicts, with jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: Our data is at the core of our mission. As a Data Engineer at Rivian, you will have an opportunity to learn, build and create data solutions that help Rivian leverage data to be the best at producing the vehicles and software that keep the world adventuring. You will work across engineering teams in various different areas of the business, from Sales, Commercial, People and HR, Facilities, Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing. As a data engineer, you will help us build AI ready data, and help us build and rebuild foundational data in the business areas that help us most to run our business successfully and get our latest vehicle, the R2, in the hands of consumers across the US. You will ingest, standardize, and enrich data with the latest best practices in data modeling, batch/microbatch/real\-time data, and AI ready data practices. You will help us build rich context aware data, meta data, dimensional models and data model knowledge graphs for automation and agent use. This position will be located in Atlanta, GA and report to our Sr. Director of Data. * Build strong partnerships with data engineers, software engineers working on front line and back end systems, business partners building and maintaining functions across Rivian. * Contributing to and shaping data engineering pipelines, tables and platform tools to make the Rivian landscape what it needs to propel into the future. * Design, build and contribute to building a data engineering function that makes strong decisions on building batch data pipelines, and building real\-time data pipelines, and when to use either. * Help build strategic self\-service capabilities that enable analysts across different areas to build for the future, and help us achieve our mission. * Work with the business to help understand their current and future needs for data, and to unlock capabilities to help them be more efficient. * Translate business needs into requirements that you can use to help build a data landscape that goes beyond what the business is asking for and looks to help Rivian scale. * Use various AI models, and agents to both unlock productivity and capability for the business * Build AI ready semantic data, including data such as knowledge graphs to enable the business lines to build their own efficiencies in using AI. * Look across various domains, and build cross domain functionality and knowledge into enterprise data. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence or a higher degree (Masters or Phd) is a plus. * 8\-12 years experience building data\-foundation, backend, or data engineering systems, someone other engineers naturally look to for direction. * Proficient with writing well structured functional and object oriented code \- ideally in Spark and Python. * Experience with most modern data stacks end\-to\-end: ingestion, processing, storage, and serving. You're comfortable making decisions on when to batch data, stream data, or microbatch data and you know the tradeoffs of each. * Experience with the latest in AI and agentic technologies as they apply to data engineering, and when to utilize each model or branded model for an optimal outcome. * Experience working in a cloud environment, and know how to implement CI/CD components and pipelines. You are also curious about the platform components and how to optimize your pipelines to work with these. * Comfortable in complex and fast paced business spaces, prioritizing your own impact and you know how to apply agile and other methodologies to help create transparency, prioritization and efficiency to your work.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Our data is at the core of our mission, and the Data Platform team is the central nervous system for petabytes of data from our connected vehicles, manufacturing lines, and supply chain. As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will own and scale the infrastructure that data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and AI builders rely on every day. You will manage our Databricks environments as code, enforce enterprise governance, and write the software that automates our platform, working across Sales, Commercial, People and HR, Facilities, Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing. We think of the platform as a product: our customers are the engineers and analysts who build on it. You will treat the platform as software, building the observability, self\-service access, cloud automation, and abstractions that help get the R2 into the hands of consumers across the US and make our data ready for AI. You will also play a critical role in controlling cost and keeping our architecture flexible enough to use alternative compute engines when it makes sense. This role will be located in Atlanta, GA and report to our Sr. Director* Build strong partnerships with data engineers, software engineers, security, cloud infrastructure, and business partners who depend on the platform. Deliver projects end to end within the roadmap and architecture set by Staff engineers. * Manage our Databricks environments as code at petabyte scale across multiple AWS accounts, with Terraform modules for workspaces, Unity Catalog metastores, cluster policies, and AWS networking/identity (VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, IAM roles, KMS). * Build observability for the platform and the data on it: monitoring, alerting, lineage, data quality, and dashboards for reliability, performance, and cost. * Build self\-service capabilities that let engineers and analysts request access, create environments, and deploy pipelines safely, with automation for workspace lifecycle, onboarding, and access audits. * Automate cloud and Databricks configuration with infrastructure as code, Databricks Asset Bundles, and CI/CD (such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) following GitOps workflows and multi\-tier deployments (dev, staging, prod) with zero\-downtime updates. * Build abstractions, Go/Python libraries, CLI tools, and templates that make secure, tested, cost\-aware patterns the easy path. Treat the platform strictly as a software product. * Own the reliability and security of your components: meet SLOs, respond to incidents, find the root cause, and improve systems so issues do not repeat. * Own platform cost: alert on Databricks System Tables to track DBU consumption, enforce cluster policies, right\-size compute, tune Spark and Delta workloads, and work with data teams to root out inefficient workloads. Provide the cost data that feeds chargeback models. * Implement governance and security with Unity Catalog: row and column level security, ABAC, automated lineage, identity provider sync, and secret rotation. * Keep our data open: use open formats (Delta Lake, with UniForm and Apache Iceberg interoperability) to preserve long\-term flexibility, and recommend where open architecture is more sustainable. * Use AI models and agents to increase your productivity and help the business use data * 8\+ years in software engineering, data infrastructure, platform engineering or SRE * Databricks in depth: 3\+ years managing production environments through Terraform and the APIs and SDKs, not the UI, with deep knowledge of Unity Catalog, System Tables, compute policies, and Asset Bundles. * Apache Spark internals and tuning, and the tradeoffs between batch, microbatch, and streaming at multi\-petabyte scale. * Strong AWS experience: IAM, S3, KMS, VPC peering, subnets, security groups, and cost management. * Terraform (preferred), Databricks Asset Bundles, CI/CD, GitOps, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and zero\-downtime infrastructure updates across multi\-tier environments (dev, staging, prod), tested and reviewed like any other code. * Observability and governance: metrics, logs, alerting, SLOs, RBAC and ABAC, lineage, auditing, encryption, and secret management. * Open table formats and distributed data systems such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Kafka, and columnar stores. * Experience building internal developer tools, APIs, or CLIs, and applying agile methods to create transparency and prioritization. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent experience. A higher degree is a plus. * Experience with data transform

jobs.title: RF/DSP Systems and Software Engineer - Journeyman

You will own the technical execution of a small form factor RF product line, from hardware and RF validation to delivery and customer support. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Discovery
jobs.description: **Who we are:** At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia. Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast\-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees. Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us. **Meet the Discovery team** Discovery owns how pet parents find Rover in the first place: SEO, answer\-engine visibility, and the landing page engine behind our city, service and brand pages. When someone searches for pet care in their neighborhood, our work decides whether Rover shows up and whether the page they land on helps them book. We're a cross\-functional team of full\-stack and WordPress engineers in Seattle and Barcelona, working with product, design, marketing and data science. Right now we're expanding our landing pages into new brands and locales, so the problems run across services, content and international markets. If you want to own a major acquisition channel and measure your impact in real traffic and bookings, we'd love to hear from you. ### **We're looking for someone who** * Takes large, ambiguous problems and turns them into a technical plan the team can execute, writing the design docs and making the tradeoffs explicit. * Leads projects end to end, from scoping through shipping and measuring the result in production, and brings other engineers along by delegating work and reviewing it. * Works across team boundaries, partnering with other teams on shared services such as search, geo routing and content systems. * Uses AI tools to move fast on well\-defined work, so time is spent on the harder judgment calls. * Sets a high bar for code quality through clear, well\-tested code and thoughtful reviews. * Owns their team's production health: monitoring, alerting, and responding when something breaks. * Mentors less experienced engineers and helps them grow. * Shows Rover's core values, acts with integrity, and helps build a diverse, equitable and inclusive team. ### **Your qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience. * Solid full\-stack experience: you've shipped production features end to end, across backend services (ideally Python and Django) and a modern frontend (ideally React and TypeScript). Other stacks are welcome if you've done real work on both sides. * Experience building and scaling customer\-facing web applications, including frontend performance and server\-side rendering. * A track record of leading technical projects that involved more than one engineer. * Solid relational database and schema design skills. * An observability mindset: you instrument services with logging, metrics, tracing and alerts, and you care how a system behaves after deploy. * Strong testing habits: automated unit and integration tests are part of how you ship. * AI\-native development: coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) are part of how you work every day. You hand them well\-scoped tasks, review what they produce as carefully as a teammate's PR, and know when to write the code yourself. A note on qualifications: great candidates don't always match every requirement. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every item, we still encourage you to apply.### **Nice to have** * SEO experience: technical SEO, structured data, site performance, or search\-engine and answer\-engine visibility. * Experience with internationalization and multi\-locale sites. * Experience with edge caching on platforms like Cloudflare Workers, including cache key design, warming, invalidation, and safely caching pages that vary by language, experiment, or user state. * Experience with content platforms or headless CMS setups, such as WordPress. * Distributed systems patterns: async task queues (Celery, RabbitMQ), caching (Memcached, Redis), event\-driven architectures. * Pushing AI\-assisted development further: custom workflows, automating repetitive work, going beyond code completion. ### **Compensation:** * In the greater Seattle area the first\-year salary range is $140,761\-$169,903\. Additionally, Rover offers benefits to full\-time employees. * The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process. At Rover, we’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, while doing our jobs better than ever before. We believe the best business outcomes come from a diverse set of perspectives and we’re committed to promoting an inclusive, inventive, and fun environment with amazing employees. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Rover is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, military or veteran status, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status, genetic predisposition, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. We are committed to work with you to look for reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. \_

This position combines a software development foundation with cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to help engineering teams build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably. The role also contributes to scalable cloud network architecture, self\-service tooling, network\-aware CI/CD pipelines, and integrated developer platform capabilities that standardize software delivery across the organization. **Duties and Responsibilities, as They Align to Ryan’s Key Results** **Key Responsibilities** **People** * Champion a DevOps culture focused on an automation\-first mindset, continuous improvement, collaboration, and transparency. * Partner with development teams to improve reliability, performance, and deployment practices. **Client** **Internal Developer Portal (IDP)** * Architect and implement an Internal Developer Portal to provide self\-service infrastructure, application templates, and deployment workflows. * Enable “golden paths” for engineering teams to accelerate onboarding and reduce cognitive load. * Integrate the IDP with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and observability platforms. * Maintain service catalogs, documentation standards, and ownership metadata. * Continuously improve developer experience through feedback and platform enhancements. **Value** **Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Platform Engineering** * Design, implement, and maintain fully automated CI/CD pipelines for Java, .NET, and Node.js applications. * Build standardized deployment workflows across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure environments. * Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates within pipelines. * Establish reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to enforce best practices. * Optimize build and deployment performance, reliability, and observability. **Cloud and Infrastructure Automation** * Design and manage cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure using infrastructure as code, with Terraform required. * Build reusable Terraform modules and enforce governance through policy\-as\-code. * Implement secure, scalable networking and cloud\-native architecture patterns. * Ensure high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness. **DevOps and Platform Best Practices** * Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for both infrastructure and applications. * Integrate DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management. * Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives to evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and automation processes. **Required Qualifications** * 10 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering. * Demonstrated evolution from software development into cloud infrastructure and automation. * Six or more years of hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools, such as Harness, CloudBees, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, and modern software delivery practices. * Deep development expertise in Java and/or Node.js application environments. * Strong hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including networking, serverless, and other managed cloud infrastructure. * Advanced proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure as code principles. * Experience designing scalable cloud\-native architectures. * Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server Availability Groups. * Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies. * Experience with automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation. * Strong understanding of secure software delivery, Git branching strategies, and DevSecOps practices. * Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Experience leading tec rtal, such as Harness IDP, Port, or a similar platform. * Experience implementing platform engineering concepts and developer self\-service models. * Familiarity with service mesh, application programming interface (API) gateways, or cloud\-native networking. * Experience implementing security automation and compliance guardrails. * Knowledge of observability platforms, including Datadog, Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK), and cloud\-native tools. * Experience in multicloud or hybrid cloud environments. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, mathematics, information systems, or a related technical field. **Certificates and Licenses** * Valid driver’s license required. * AWS and/or Azure certifications preferred; professional\-level or specialty certifications preferred. * Additional certifications in DevOps, Kubernetes, or cloud technologies are a plus. **Supervisory Responsibilities** This position has no supervisory responsibilities. **Work Environment** * Standard indoor working environment. * Occasional long periods of sitting while working at a computer. * Position requires regular interaction with jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.description: Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Job Type: Full\-time Work Location: In person \- Erin, Tennessee (Candidates must be local to Tennessee. No relocation fees will be provided.) **Job Description:** Rye Engineering, PLC is seeking a qualified Civil Engineer to join our engineering team. This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in Erin, Tennessee. **Job Overview:** We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Civil Engineer to assist our engineering staff with the planning, design, and development of primarily water and wastewater infrastructure projects. **Experience in hydraulic water modeling is required for this position.** This role requires a strong understanding of civil engineering principles and the ability to work collaboratively with engineers and engineering technicians throughout various stages of project development. **Duties:** * Assist engineering staff with the planning, design, and analysis of water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including water distribution systems, wastewater collection systems, pump stations, and related facilities. * Perform hydraulic water modeling and analysis to evaluate existing systems and support proposed improvements. * Prepare and review engineering calculations, technical drawings, specifications, and project documentation. * Collaborate with senior engineers and engineering technicians throughout the design and development of projects. * Utilize engineering software, including AutoCAD, Civil 3D, hydraulic modeling programs, and GIS, as applicable, to support engineering design and analysis. * Assist with the preparation of engineering reports, cost estimates, permitting documents, and construction plans. * Coordinate with internal project teams to maintain project schedules and meet design requirements. * Participate in occasional client meetings and project site
