jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer
jobs.description: SACO Polymers is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer to serve as the dedicated technical security resource for a multinational manufacturing organization. This individual contributor role works directly with the Director of Information Technology to protect both corporate IT systems and the operational technology (OT) that supports production. The Cybersecurity Engineer owns the configuration and effectiveness of the company's security controls, leads security monitoring and incident investigation, and drives vulnerability remediation by identifying, prioritizing, planning, and tracking fixes carried out by infrastructure, application, and OT personnel. The security program is aligned with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2\.0 and related NIST guidance, including NIST SP 800\-82 for OT security. Because SACO operates production facilities, security decisions must balance risk reduction with safety, uptime, and business continuity. The Cybersecurity Engineer is the organization's dedicated security resource and is expected to work with a high degree of technical ownership. This role directly configures and maintains security tools and controls. For remediation work on servers, endpoints, applications, and OT systems, the role identifies the issue, defines the fix, sets the priorit, and tracks completion; the responsible technical team(s) carry out the changes. The Director of Information Technology sets strategic direction and priorities and works alongside this role on security architecture, risk decisions, and roadmap planning. The Cybersecurity Engineer turns that direction into practical, sustainable technical security practices and is expected to bring forward risks and improvement ideas proactively. ### **What You'll Be Doing:** ### **Security Engineering and Controls (NIST CSF: Protect)** * Design, configure, and maintain enterprise security controls across identity, endpoint, network, cloud, and application environments. * Manage endpoint detection and response, device security management, and related endpoint protections. * Develop and maintain application control and software execution restriction policies, including staged rollout to production environments. * Maintain identity and access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, and privileged access protections. * Develop and maintain security baselines and configuration standards mapped to NIST SP 800\-53 controls and CIS Benchmarks. * Build scripts and automation to improve the consistency and efficiency of security operations. ### **Security Operations and Incident Response (NIST CSF: Detect, Respond, Recover)** * Serve as the primary point of contact for the external security monitoring and response provider, reviewing escalated alerts and directing follow\-up. * Lead technical investigations, including scoping, containment coordination, remediation planning, and documentation of findings. * Maintain incident response procedures and playbooks aligned with NIST SP 800\-61 Rev. 3, including OT\-specific scenarios. * Support recovery planning and periodic incident response exercises with IT and business stakeholders. * Monitor the effectiveness of deployed controls and recommend improvements. ### **Vulnerability and Remediation Management (NIST CSF: Identify)** * Run the enterprise vulnerability management process, from scanning and intelligence review through prioritization and verification. * Prioritize vulnerabilities by severity, known exploitation, business impact, and operational constraints. * Define remediation plans and timelines, assign them to the responsible technical teams, and track progress to completion. * Monitor patch compliance against established timelines, using NIST SP 800\-40 Rev. 4 as the reference for enterprise patch management practice. * Document risk exceptions and escalate items that exceed agreed risk tolerances to the Director of IT. * Produce metrics on vulnerability exposure, remediation progress, and compliance. ### **Governance, Risk, and Program Improvement (NIST CSF: Govern, Identify)** * Partner with the Director of IT to maintain the cybersecurity roadmap and periodic NIST CSF 2\.0 maturity assessments. * Translate roadmap objectives into technical projects with clear scope, owners, and milestones. * Support risk assessments, audits, policy development, and customer or insurer security questionnaires. * Evaluate the security of third\-party applications, service providers, and OT vendors. * Stay current on threats, vulnerabilities, and security practices relevant to manufacturing. ### **Collaboration** * Act as the technical cybersecurity authority for infrastructure, application, service desk, and plant technical personnel. * Coordinate security work across multiple facilities, business units, and regions. * Communicate risks, recommendations, and project status clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Maintain accurate technical documentation, procedures, and implementation records. ### **Operational Technology (OT) Security** * Maintain an inventory of OT assets, network connections, and remote access paths at production facilities, in partnership with plant and engineering personnel. * Assess OT security risks and recommend controls consistent with NIST SP 800\-82 Rev. 3, *Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security*. * Plan and monitor network segmentation between corporate IT and plant networks, including secure remote access for vendors and integrators. * Adapt endpoint protection, application control, and patching approaches for systems where uptime, vendor support, or safety limits standard practice. * Coordinate OT\-related incident response with plant leadership so containment actions do not create safety or production risks. **What You Need to Succeed:** **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of practical experience and industry\-recognized cybersecurity certifications. * Five or more years of IT experience, including at least four years of hands\-on security engineering or security operations. * Demonstrated experience configuring and managing enterprise endpoint protection, identity security, and access controls. * Experience running or materially supporting a vulnerability management program, including risk\-based prioritization and remediation tracking. * Experience investigating security incidents and coordinating response with internal teams or an external monitoring provider. * Working knowledge of enterprise networking, firewalls, Windows and Linux operating systems, virtualization, and cloud security concepts. * Working knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and how to map technical controls to it. * Understanding of how security in manufacturing or other operationally sensitive environments differs from standard corporate IT, especially around uptime and change control. * Ability to write clear technical procedures, remediation plans, and status reporting. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently as the organization's dedicated security resource. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Hands\-on experience securing industrial control systems, plant networks, or other OT environments. * Familiarity with NIST SP 800\-82 and the ISA/IEC 62443 series of OT security standards. * Experience implementing application allowlisting or application control in a production environment. * Experience with SIEM platforms, managed detection and response services, and security query languages. * Scripting and automation experience (for example, PowerShell or Python). * Experience with cloud security architecture and identity protection platforms. * Experience performing NIST CSF maturity assessments or mapping controls to NIST SP 800\-53\. * Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, GIAC (for example, GCIH or GICSP), Security\+, or CySA\+. **Why You’ll Love Working Here:** * **Room to Grow:** This position offers career advancement opportunities as you learn and grow with us. * **Team\-Oriented Environment:** You’ll work in a safety\-focused, collaborative, and supportive team. **What We Offer:** * **Competitive Pay and Benefits:** Includes health, dental, 401(k), paid time off, etc.. * **Job Stability:** Join a company that's growing and rewards your dedication and hard work. * **Training and Development:** Get the tools and support you need to succeed and advance in your career. **Ready to Start Your Next Adventure?** If you're looking for a rewarding role with great pay and benefits, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and take the next step in your career with us.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Design and Drafting - DC
jobs.description: **Role Overview** FläktGroup is seeking a commercially aware Electrical Engineer to lead the electrical design for our Tier 1 Data Center projects. In this role, you will be the technical bridge between our Data Center clients and our manufacturing floor. You will interpret rigorous "Owner Project Requirements" (OPR) from these tech giants, translate them into actionable manufacturing drafts (HV/LV), generate drawings and generate precise Bills of Materials (BOMs) to ensure our custom cooling units meet their exact specifications. As an Electrical Engineer – Design and Drafting \- DC, you’ll develop and document electrical systems for industrial and manufacturing applications. You’ll create electrical schematics and designs, coordinate project schedules, and support testing and troubleshooting from concept through implementation. Apply your electrical engineering expertise and CAD (computer\-aided design) skills to produce clear, build\-ready documentation. **Key Responsibilities** Hands\-On CADD Design \& Drafting (Core Function) · Schematic Development: personally develop detailed, multi\-page electrical schematics from scratch using AutoCAD Electrical or EPLAN. You own the drawing package from concept to "As\-Built." · 3D Panel Layouts: Create physical layouts of control panels (MCPs) to ensure all VFDs, PLCs, and wire ducts fit within the enclosure while maintaining thermal clearances and UL spacing. · Database Management: Build and maintain the FläktGroup "Smart Block" library (symbols, part numbers, macros) to speed up future drafting and ensure standardization across projects. Hyperscale Application Engineering · Spec\-to\-Draft Translation: Read complex engineering specifications and translate them directly into your electrical drawings. · Grounding \& Noise: Design and draft specific grounding schemes (HRG vs. Solidly Grounded) and EMI/RFI filtering layouts required by hyperscale server halls. HV/LV Panel Design · Mixed\-Voltage Architecture: Design and draft enclosures that safely house both High Voltage (480V) power distribution and Low Voltage (24V) controls. Your drawings must clearly show physical separation barriers, SCCR calculations, Electrical Panel 508A. · Wire \& Cable Scheduling: Generate automated "From\-To" wire lists and cable schedules from your CADD software to guide the production team on the shop floor. · Strong electrical/controls documentation skills (I/O lists, wiring diagrams, P\&IDs) and familiarity with NEC best practices (U.S.). **BOM \& Component Engineering** · BOM Generation: Extract the Bill of Materials (BOM) directly from your schematics into the ERP system. · Supply Chain Validation: When a specified part (e.g., a specific Schneider Breaker) is out of stock, you must engineer the alternative (ABB/Siemens), update the CADD drawing, and validate the technical fit. **Required Qualifications** · Preferred Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE). · 5\+ years in Electrical Design/Application Engineering, specifically within the Data Center or Custom HVAC market. · Expertise in AutoCAD, Inventor Electrical OR EPLAN (Mandatory). · Proficiency in Arc Flash Analysis tools (SKM/ETAP) Technical Mastery: · Deep familiarity with Hyperscale Data Center Standards (Open Compute Project, etc.). · Expert knowledge of SCCR calculations, NEC, UL 508A, and NFPA 70E. · Ability to design for both HV (Power) and LV (Controls). · Capable of prioritizing tasks, co\-ordinating and delivering the project on time · Panel OEM: Background in a custom panel shop where "Engineer\-to\-Order" is the daily standard. · Flexibility for travel within the U.S. up to 30% **Why Join us?** With more than a century of history and technical expertise, we have established a strong record of international operational excellence as the premier HVAC OEM in EMEA. Now, following our recent acquisition by Samsung Electronics, we are poised to combine our proven technological capabilities with Samsung’s AI platforms to set a new industry benchmark and deliver innovative solutions to our customers. As we expand and progressively integrate products and services to maximize synergies and strengthen our position as the leading HVAC equipment provider in the global data center marketplace, we invite those energized by growth, complexity, and the opportunity to transform the future of data center project execution to join us! EEOC Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Employee discount * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. Our mission is to empower teams with actionable intelligence by streamlining data sharing, ensuring regulatory compliance, maintaining data integrity, and optimizing costs at every level. This role is focused on building foundation for deploying AI\-enabled use cases across company operations. #### #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Contribute to the design, implementation, automation, maintenance, and operational support of enterprise\-scale cloud data platforms leveraging Databricks, AWS cloud services, and modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. * Lead the design, development, optimization, and operational management of Implement BI dashboards to visualize Trends and Forecasts. * Design and implement data infrastructure components, ensuring high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance. * Design, train and deploy ML models. * Implement monitoring solutions to proactively identify and address potential issues. * Collaborate with security teams to ensure the data platform meets industry standards and compliance requirements. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and business partners to ensure robust and reliable systems. **Location \& Travel jobs.title: Founding backend engineer, data platform and fleet infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Sentis** Sentis is capturing the most accurate state of the human body. We bring all the data a hospital has on a patient into one place. Health AI is only as good as the data it learns from, and most of that data is never captured today. We build at the intersection of physical AI and healthcare. We’re live in US ICUs and scaling from single units to full hospitals. **The role** You own the backend: the platform that takes in data from every node, stores it and makes it usable for training, and the infrastructure that keeps a fleet of devices inside hospitals updated and under control. The tech exists and runs today, so you don’t start from zero. Your job is to challenge all of it with the team and make it as smart and as scalable as it can be, from first principles. We have no ego about what’s there. If you want to change something, change it. It’s yours. **What you’ll do** * Build and run backend services in Go on Postgres, from architecture to on\-call. * Own our AWS infrastructure in Terraform, serverless where it fits. * Build ingestion for per\-second clinical data from every node, with no loss when a hospital network drops. * Store terabytes of time\-series data cheaply and make it easy to export for model training. * Run the fleet: provisioning, device identity, staged OTA updates with automatic rollback, and remote access. * Build logging, tracing and alerting across cloud and devices. * Build in the controls for HIPAA and SOC 2: encryption, audit trails, access control, and deletion per hospital and patient stay. **How we build** Agentic development is a requirement for this role. It only works if you understand backend and infrastructure principles very deeply, and can read, write and judge code yourself. * You write the specs, repo instructions and tests that let agents ship good code. * You run several agents in parallel and review what they produce. * You read every line that touches patient data or device updates yourself. * You decide the architecture. The agents don’t. **You might be a fit if** * You’ve built something hard and can show it: a product from nothing, a system others said couldn’t ship on that timeline, or open\-source work. * You work like a founder. You’ve been a technical founder or first engineer, or you’ve owned a system the same way. * You have 3\+ years shipping production backend software, with on\-call for your own system. * You write production Go, or Rust, Java or Kotlin and you’ll switch fast. * You understand distributed systems deeply and have run them under real load. * You know AWS and Terraform in depth, including serverless infrastructure. * You’ve built data pipelines where losing or duplicating data wasn’t an option. * You’ve worked with IoT or connected devices before. * Agentic development is how you work every day. * Bonus: you’ve run a device fleet in production, with OTA updates and remote management. * Bonus: clinical data, HIPAA or SOC 2\. * You’re based in the US and can work here without visa sponsorship. * You'reopen to traveling with us to clients in the US and if needed, globally **How we work** This role is in person in San Francisco. We’re high pace, high agency and low ego. We hire very good people and then get out of their way. You work freely, you make your own calls, and you get whatever tools you need to do your best work. **Next steps** An intro call, a technical deep dive on a real Sentis problem, and a conversation with both founders. Send us the hardest thing you’ve built and what made it hard. A link or five sentences is enough.

jobs.title: AI Strategist New
jobs.description: **About Smartcat** ------------------ Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises. We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high\-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one. Our platform combines generative AI, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale. Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year\-over\-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us. Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time. #### **WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM** This role is ideal for someone who loves AI, thinks in systems, and enjoys building practical solutions that drive measurable impact. You’ll be one of our first AI Strategists, building custom AI solutions from scratch for Smartcat’s largest strategic customers. You’ll work in a pod with a dedicated Strategic Account Executive and Technical Account Manager, and sometimes a Forward Deployed Engineer. You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you do need real fluency with modern AI tools, fast experimentation, and a builder’s instinct. You’ll engage senior executives to define where AI creates value, then build the agents and workflows that deliver it, and bring customer insights back to Product. #### **MISSION** Design and build custom AI workflows and agents from scratch for Smartcat’s strategic customers, translating each customer’s ambiguous business problems into working, scalable, measurable AI solutions that drive adoption and expand the relationship. #### **OUTCOMES** * Partner with business leaders and technical teams at strategic customers to scope high\-value AI use cases and align on success metrics, from the sales cycle through delivery * Identify where AI workflows can deliver ROI, efficiency, and competitive advantage, and build the business case with the account team * Design, build, and deploy new custom AI solutions and agents for customers, going beyond reconfiguring existing workflows * Work with structured and unstructured customer data, including vector databases, MCP, and RAG, and build agents that combine semantic and keyword search across customer knowledge bases and content * Own customer engagements end to end, from ideation through delivery, ensuring long\-term adoption and measurable business outcomes * Work as part of a customer pod with the Strategic Account Executive, Technical Account Manager, and Forward Deployed Engineer * Train and empower customer teams to use and iterate on the AI workflows you build, and drive onboarding and change management so solutions become part of their day\-to\-day operations * Act as the voice of the customer, surfacing needs, patterns, and insights that inform Smartcat’s product roadmap * Contribute playbooks, reusable solution patterns, and case studies, and help drive AI\-first thinking across the team #### **HOW YOU’LL RAMP** **By Day 30:** * Learn Smartcat’s platform, AI agent capabilities, and the types of AI workflows customers already run * Meet your pod partners (Strategic Account Executives, Technical Account Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers) and understand how each role contributes * Get oriented on your assigned strategic accounts: business goals, key stakeholders, current workflows, and open opportunities * Get set up with the team’s AI tooling and development environment **By Day 60:** * Join customer conversations with the account team to scope AI use cases and define success metrics * Build and test a first custom AI solution or agent for a live customer opportunity * Document the use case, approach, and expected business impact **By Day 90:** * Own a customer engagement from scoping through delivery, with a working solution in the customer’s hands * Run enablement or training for the customer’s team and support their adoption * Bring customer feedback and reusable patterns back to Product and the wider team #### **WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED** * Experience in a customer\-facing AI, solutions, consulting, or technical role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise environments * A track record of building AI\-powered workflows, agents, or automations that solved real business problems, not just integrations * An AI\-first way of working: real hands\-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, Cline, or similar (“vibe coding”), used as the default way you build, test, and solve problems * Hands\-on experience building with Python, along with AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor, or Cline; SQL or data analysis is a plus * Familiarity with vector databases, MCP, RAG, and agent design * Comfort with the command line, basic Linux administration, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) * The ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable AI solutions, and to drive projects end to end * Comfort engaging both technical stakeholders and senior executives, and translating between the two, with strong communication and collaboration skills * A customer\-centric mindset, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to business value * Experience delivering solutions in complex enterprise organizations while operating comfortably in a fast\-moving startup environment * A builder mentality: bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create structure where none exists * Experience with change management and customer enablement * Leading cross\-functional initiatives or teams is a nice to have * Flexibility to travel for customer engagements **Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far** ------------------------------------------------------- * **A global, connected team** We’re a team of 200\+ people across 30\+ countries, working together through a hub\-and\-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote\-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer\-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally\-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact. * **Be part of an AI Native Organization** We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision\-making and free people to focus on strategy and high\-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation. * **Innovating a $100 Billion industry** Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI\-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high\-quality results, at a fraction of the cost. * **Join the rocketship to scale\-up 10x and beyond together** We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post\-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product\-market fit and high\-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here. * **Smartcat Culture Code****: Where Diversity Meets High Performance** At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

jobs.title: VP, Head of Engineering, Advertising
jobs.description: Engineering Engineering Leadership Permanent New York Our mission on the Advertising Product \& Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators. Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, investing in the technology and capabilities that enable advertisers to reach audiences, deliver relevant experiences, and achieve measurable business outcomes across audio, video, and beyond. As our advertising business evolves, the scale, intelligence, reliability, and efficiency of our technology platform will be fundamental to our ability to compete and grow. This is an opportunity to shape the future of a sophisticated advertising technology platform, advancing real\-time decisioning, machine learning, AI, and engineering excellence while building the technical foundation for a significantly larger business. We are looking for an exceptional engineering executive who combines deep technical and architectural judgment, experience leading at scale, strong commercial instincts, and the ability to build outstanding engineering organizations. What You'll Do * + Set the engineering strategy and architecture. Define the long\-term technical vision, investment priorities, and target architecture for Spotify’s advertising platform — balancing near\-term delivery with future scale. Own build\-versus\-buy decisions, technical debt prioritization, and the transformation required to get from where we are to where we need to be. + Scale our advertising technology. Lead engineering across Ads Manager, Spotify Ad Exchange, ad serving, programmatic integrations, data infrastructure, and machine learning\-based optimization. + Raise the bar on platform reliability. Advance standards across availability, latency, delivery accuracy, data quality, observability, incident management, and production resilience. + Advance intelligent advertising. Develop capabilities across real\-time decisioning, auctions, bidding, targeting, relevance, pacing, pricing, and optimization to improve advertiser outcomes, monetization, and listener experience. + Fundamentally rethink how we develop and operate technology through AI. Redesign engineering workflows — not just adopt tools into existing processes — to deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and speed across development, testing, debugging, and operations. + Partner across the Advertising leadership team. Work closely with Product, Data Science, and Commercial leadership to connect technical investments to customer value and business growth. Bring engineering perspective to major business decisions. + Build and develop the engineering organization. Attract exceptional technical leaders, strengthen succession, and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. Who You Are * + You have 15\+ years of engineering experience, including 5\+ years leading large, multilayered engineering organizations (200\+ engineers) within global technology businesses. + You have a deep expertise in advertising technology and large\-scale real\-time systems, including ad serving, auctions, bidding, targeting, optimization, and measurement. + You have a track record of designing, scaling, and materially improving high\-volume, low\-latency, data\-intensive platforms, with strong architectural judgment and operational discipline across reliability, observability, and incident management. + You have experience with large\-scale ML systems and their application to real\-time decisioning, pricing, optimization, and marketplace performance. You have personally led the use of AI to fundamentally reshape how engineering teams build and operate — not just introduced tools, but changed the work itself. + You have demonstrated experience personally leading significant technology and organizational transformations — re\-platforming, restructuring, or modernizing at scale — with clear before\-and\-after outcomes you can point to. + You have the ability to connect engineering decisions to business outcomes — advertiser value, platform economics, speed to market, and revenue growth. + You have experience building high\-performing engineering organizations: attracting senior technical talent, developing leaders, and establishing succession pipelines. + You are a collaborative leader with the conviction to challenge assumptions across Product, Data, and Commercial teams while building alignment. + You combine long\-term strategic vision with a pragmatic, results\-oriented approach to execution. Where You'll Be * + New York is the preferred location for this role. + We are open to considering exceptional candidates based elsewhere, with the expectation of 30% travel to support leadership collaboration, customer engagement, and business priorities. These ranges may be modified in the future. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward\-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Front End)
jobs.description: **Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.** **Why you'll love this role** Our Technology Team is on a mission to build the next\-generation e\-commerce platform for the next generation of customers. We create world\-class, innovative experiences and products that give our users access to the world's most\-coveted products and unlock economic opportunities by turning reselling into a business for anyone. Our team uses cutting\-edge technologies that handle massive scales globally. Supply Chain Engineering builds the systems that get products from sellers to buyers: tracking, logistics, and the verification workflows that make sure every item meets StockX standards. We're looking for a frontend engineer to build the interfaces that power these experiences, from delivery tracking to the tools our operations and verification teams use every day. You'll be primarily focused on the frontend (React, TypeScript, Next.js), but our team owns its services end to end. You'll also have the chance to debug, troubleshoot, and contribute to our Node.js/TypeScript backend services when the work calls for it. We think this makes our frontend engineers better, and we'll support you in getting up to speed. In this role, you'll make our supply chain experiences a delight for our users across the world and help make our supply chain more efficient. You'll have room to take on more ownership as experience grows. Our technical stack comprises various systems and services built on AWS. On the frontend, we use TypeScript, React, and Next.js. On the backend, we use Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, GraphQL, CircleCI, Harness, Kubernetes, Kafka, DynamoDB, and Aurora DB (Postgres). **What you'll do** * Build and ship complex, data\-heavy user interfaces in React, TypeScript, and Next.js for customers and internal operations teams. * Partner with product, design, program managers, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, recommend technical approaches, and push back on scope when it's the right call. * Break down features into well\-scoped components and contribute to design discussions, with growing ownership of the design as you build experience. * Write and maintain automated tests, and help improve our CI/CD pipelines and release practices. * Integrate with REST and GraphQL services, and when issues cross the frontend/backend boundary, dig in: trace them, debug them, and contribute fixes to our Node.js services. * Help keep what we ship healthy in production: willingness to take part in our regular on\-call rotation, monitor production health (we use Datadog), and respond to production issues with urgency. * Contribute to team standards, share what you learn, and keep stakeholders informed when issues arise. **About you** * 3\-5 years of professional software engineering experience, with most of it on the frontend. * Strong experience with React and TypeScript, including state management (such as Zustand or Redux) and building complex UIs. * Solid grounding in web fundamentals: performance, accessibility, security, and internationalization. * Experience integrating with REST and/or GraphQL APIs. * Hands\-on experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. We use GitHub, Kubernetes, Harness, and LaunchDarkly. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs and challenge scope constructively. * Comfort reading and debugging backend code (JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js, or a similar language like Java, C\#, or PHP) and a willingness to contribute to it. * Experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) in your development workflows. **Nice to have** * Experience with using Datadog (APM, RUM, metrics) or similar observability tools. * Experience with AWS or another cloud provider and with data storage, particularly Postgres, Redis, and DynamoDB. * Experience in Supply Chain domains (warehouse or transportation management systems, carrier integrations, brand protection). *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.* *Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.* **About StockX** StockX is proud to be a Detroit\-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high\-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real\-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off\-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry\-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time.* *StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment.*

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure & Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About SHP** Strategic Healthcare Programs (SHP) is a leader in analytics and performance management solutions for the post\-acute healthcare market. Since 1996, we have helped more than 7,000 organizations nationwide, including home health agencies, hospices, skilled nursing facilities, and hospitals, and turn clinical and operational data into real\-time intelligence that improves patient outcomes. We are a SaaS company headquartered in Santa Barbara, CA, and a subsidiary of Roper Technologies (NYSE: ROP). We are not just building software. We are building tools that help caregivers deliver better care to patients when it matters most. If that mission resonates with you, keep reading. **The Opportunity** We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure \& Systems Engineer who wants to own the infrastructure that keeps SHP running and is just as willing to roll up their sleeves alongside the team. You will be a key contributor within IT Operations, responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of primarily on\-premises enterprise infrastructure, and you will partner closely with IT leadership, development teams, and business stakeholders to support and enhance enterprise systems. You will report directly to the Director of IT and work collaboratively across departments. This is a full\-time, on\-site position at the Headquarters Office in Santa Barbara, CA. If you are the type of person who sees a ticket queue backing up and jumps in to help, then goes back to solving the root cause so it does not happen again, you will thrive here. **How This Role Works** This is not a siloed role. Your primary focus is senior\-level infrastructure and systems engineering, but you are part of one IT team. You will help the IT Support Specialist and Service Desk team remediate ticket queues and support ticket intake, and you are expected to step in at any level, from Service Desk through senior engineering, whenever the team needs help. Front\-line support is not the primary focus of the role, but when it is needed you will be asked to switch roles and help your teammates. **Where your time goes** **Primary focus** Engineering, administering, securing, and improving enterprise infrastructure and systems, including VMware, Microsoft platforms, networking, identity, Microsoft 365, and business applications. **Service Desk partnership** Helping the IT Support Specialist and Service Desk team remediate queues and support ticket intake in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, serving as an escalation point and backup at any support tier. **Switching roles when needed** Moving between Service Desk and senior engineering duties as priorities change, without waiting to be asked. **Documentation and knowledge base** Following the same documentation standards as the Service Desk: every fix becomes a repeatable article, runbook, or SOP in Confluence. **Team collaboration** Staying in constant contact with IT staff through Microsoft Teams so everyone knows what is happening and what matters most. **What You Will Do** **Engineer and Run the Infrastructure** You will own the on\-premises backbone that SHP depends on, keeping it stable, patched, monitored, and ready to scale. Engineer, administer, and support enterprise infrastructure environments (primarily on\-premises) including VMware and Microsoft platforms Manage enterprise network infrastructure including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and perimeter security Monitor system performance and proactively resolve infrastructure issues Perform patching, vulnerability remediation, and system hardening Provide advanced troubleshooting across systems, servers, and network infrastructure **Own Identity, Microsoft 365, and Collaboration** Secure, well\-structured access is the foundation of everything else. You will design it and keep it clean. Design and maintain identity and access management systems (Active Directory, permissions, account lifecycle) Administer Microsoft 365, Exchange, and collaboration platforms (Teams, VoIP) **Support the Business Applications** The business runs on its applications, and you will help keep them healthy and connected. Support enterprise applications, SQL environments, and business systems Provide application support for core business platforms, including CRM, ERP, and HRIS systems Support, monitor, and troubleshoot integrations and workflows between business applications Support the deployment, administration, and ongoing operation of AI agents used within the business and IT environment **Keep Service Moving** Great infrastructure means little if people cannot get help quickly. You will strengthen the service desk and step in when it matters. Operate and continuously improve IT service management processes and workflows Help the IT Support Specialist and Service Desk team remediate ticket queues and support ticket intake in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, serving as an escalation point and backup at any support tier Work flexibly across roles; this ot an afterthought. Maintain documentation, SOPs, and operational standards for infrastructure and systems Follow Service Desk documentation and knowledge management standards: contribute to and maintain the IT knowledge base in Confluence, and turn recurring fixes into repeatable articles, runbooks, and how\-to guides **Stay Secure and Audit\-Ready** SHP operates in a regulated healthcare data environment, and you will help us prove that our controls work. Support SIEM, logging, and security monitoring initiatives Conduct quarterly internal system and security audits Lead and support annual SOC and cybersecurity audit preparation, assessment, and remediation Support compliance initiatives and regulatory audit requirements **Lead, Mentor, and Partner** You will lead by doing, raise the bar for the people around you, and work well with vendors and stakeholders. Lead IT infrastructure and operational projects including planning, execution, and reporting Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders Mentor and support the IT Support Specialist and other junior IT staff Participate in on\-call rotation Other duties as assigned **What You Bring** * You have been deep in enterprise infrastructure, and you are also a teammate who helps wherever the team needs it. Specifically: * Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience * 5–8\+ years of enterprise infrastructure/systems engineering experience * Strong experience with VMware, Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 * Strong understanding of enterprise networking concepts * Experience with scripting/automation (PowerShell preferred) * Experience supporting business applications such as CRM, ERP, and HRIS platforms, including integrations and workflow automation * Familiarity with AI agents and supporting their deployment and operation in a business environment * Experience with monitoring tools and SIEM platforms * Experience supporting audits, compliance, and security remediation * Experience working a ticket queue in an ITSM platform (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus or comparable) and writing and maintaining knowledge base documentation (Confluence preferred) * Willingness and ability to work across support tiers, including stepping into Service Desk duties when needed, with a collaborative, team\-first approach * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment **Bonus Points** * These are not requirements, but they signal strong alignment with the role and the environment you will be stepping into. Preferred certifications: * Microsoft Certifications (Azure, Microsoft 365, Identity \& Security) * VMware (VCP or equivalent) * Cisco (CCNA or equivalent) * CompTIA (Security\+, Network\+) * Security certifications (CISSP, CySA\+, or equivalent) * ITIL, PMP, or equivalent project/service management certifications **Why SHP?** We are a mission\-driven SaaS company where your work has a direct impact on healthcare quality. You will join a team that values smart, curious people who care about doing great work, helping each other, and constantly improving how we operate. * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision) * 401(k) with company match and employee stock purchase plan * Generous PTO, paid holidays, and a genuine commitment to work\-life balance * A team and culture where you can do meaningful work while growing your career **Pay** $125,000 – $165,000 per year, depending upon experience. **Location** This is a full\-time on\-site position at the Headquarters Office in Santa Barbara, CA. *This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.* Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Data Center Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Switch** At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder \& CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world. We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity. **The Role: Regional Data Center Electrical Engineer** ------------------------------------------------------ As a Regional Data Center Electrical Engineer at Switch, you will be part of a world\-class team that operates in excellence, delivering mission\-critical solutions that redefine what's possible in AI, cloud and enterprise data center needs. Your work will directly impact the future of technology and the sustainable growth of the Internet. In this role you will support and optimize the operations of the critical infrastructure supporting IT loads in Switch Data Centers, including power, water, and cooling systems. You are also involved in developing solutions for continuous improvement in system performance and utilization, managing utility resourcing, capacity management, change management, efficiency, root cause analysis, design feedback, condition\-based maintenance, end\-of\-life management, and various other data center lifecycle programs. Additionally, you are an on\-site equipment and system expert, directly supporting continuous improvement, optimization, operations, and capital projects, and may also coordinate efforts globally. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Actions (CA) documentation for equipment failures, including electrical critical systems. * Directly support operational teams as the subject matter expert for issue resolution, event response, and complex procedural review, including ad\-hoc training and critical equipment support. * Perform availability, capacity, efficiency, and sustainability analyses for the electrical critical systems in the Switch data centers in your region. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation solutions. * Monitor and interpret data center performance trends for continuous improvement and capital projects. * Develop innovative solutions for Switch data centers, then function as the owner of conceptual designs for existing data center upgrades that improve capacity, availability, efficiency, and sustainability. * Provide performance feedback of innovative Switch infrastructure solutions to Design Engineering. * Function as resident engineer for construction and retrofit projects for critical environments. * Interface with internal data center operations team, data center design engineering team, field engineering team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in delivered services. * Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g., Operations, Commissioning, Construction, and Engineering). * Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Innovators \& Builders – You see challenges as opportunities and thrive in uncharted territories. * High\-Performance Thinkers – You have a relentless drive for excellence and a passion for pushing the envelope. You thrive in high impact environments where execution is key. * Integrity\-Driven Leaders – You operate with honor, responsibility, and purpose, recognizing that the energy you put out into the world will return to you. * Tech Pioneers – You understand the power of technology to change the world and want to be at the forefront of that transformation. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * A Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or higher with a certification as a Professional Engineer (PE) preferred. * An understanding of electrical and mechanical systems that may be employed in a data center environment. This may include electrical feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, power systems, ATS/STS units, PDU units, air handling units, cooling towers, pumps, and fire suppression systems. * Ability to interpret P\&IDs, wiring diagrams, schematics, Sequence of Operations, submittals, and MEP drawings packages. * Strong Outlook, Publisher, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills. * An understanding of data analysis methodologies, statistical techniques, and business acumen. * Excel in analyzing datasets and providing strategic guidance to leadership. * Ability to analyze and implement solutions for problem resolution. * Easily able to work well under pressure while also being flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient. * Leadership skills that promote team development and support the Switch Culture. * A strategic mindset with the ability to balance long\-term vision with operational execution. ### **Why Switch?** * A Culture of Karma – We are self\-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward\-thinking environment. * Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development. * Flexibility \& Remote Opportunities – Whether in\-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive. * Career Stability \& Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities \& advancement in a stable, growing company. * Generous Benefits Package \- Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more! ### **Join Us \& Make a Difference** This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you. Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together. **Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice** Your privacy rights may vary by location. Learn more in our Switch Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.switch.com/applicant\-and\-candidate\-privacy/ to understand how Switch collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information during the recruiting process. **Safe Hiring Notice** Legitimate Switch recruiting emails come from switch.com. Current opportunities are posted on https://switch.com/careers and the official Switch LinkedIn Company page https://www.linkedin.com/company/switch\-data\-centers/. Switch will never ask you to pay fees, purchase equipment, send money, cash a check, or transfer funds as part of recruiting. Personal information is collected only through approved Switch systems. If you suspect recruiting fraud, stop communicating with the sender and review FTC guidance https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/what\-do\-if\-you\-were\-scammed. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Switch is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. **Accommodations** Switch provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If you need an accommodation, contact careers@switch.com. Switch also considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable law. **Recruitment Agencies** Switch does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies without a current written agreement. Switch is not responsible for fees related to unsolicited submissions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Core Systems & Platform Services
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** We are looking for Software Engineers to join our Platform Services team who will build and improve systems that are critical to the performance of the Symbotic platform. Our team orchestrates vertical lift cells, which control how packages move between robots and input/output stations. The systems you work on will operate in real time and directly impact throughput, efficiency, and reliability in production environments. We want you to apply if you succeed in ambiguity and can identify problems and their corresponding solutions. We are looking for: * Strong problem\-solvers who enjoy understanding how complex systems behave * Curious and proactive engineers who yearn to learn and improve things around them * Curious people to work on systems where software interacts with the physical world You’ll work alongside experienced engineers while taking on meaningful ownership. **What we do** We are the Platform Services team responsible for orchestrating vertical lift cells, a critical control point in how packages move through the system. We build services that coordinate lift behavior in real time, focusing on efficiency and performance. This includes solving optimization problems around movement and flow, where incremental improvements have measurable system impact. We also develop shared platform services used by multiple teams, working at the intersection of distributed systems and physical automation. **What you’ll do** * Contribute to building and maintaining core services for lift orchestration and platform systems. * Write production\-quality code in C\# / .NET (and related technologies). * Help improve system performance, reliability, and observability. * Work with senior engineers to debug and resolve production issues. * Learn to reason about real\-time system behavior and distributed interactions. * Use data and metrics to understand and improve system performance. * Contribute ideas and take ownership of features or improvements. **What you’ll need** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related. * 0–3 years of professional software engineering experience. * Experience with hardware\-adjacent systems (robotics, automation, etc.). * Initiative to identify problems and create solutions. * Strong fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, and problem\-solving. * Experience in one or more programming languages (C\#, Java, Python, etc.). * Interest in systems programming, distributed systems, or real\-world applications. * Willingness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. **Our environment** * Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. * The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi\-weekly basis. \#LI\-JH1 \#LI\-Hybrid **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $93,000\.00 \- $136,400\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

jobs.title: Contract Full-Stack Developer – Short-Term Project
jobs.description: Contract Full\-Stack Developer – Code Cleanup \& Maintenance (Short\-Term Project) **Company:** Synergy Insurance Affiliates (SIA) **Job Type:** Contract / Temporary **Experience Level:** Mid\-to\-Senior **Project Duration:** Short\-term engagement (approximately a few weeks) **Job Overview** Synergy Insurance Affiliates is seeking an experienced Mid\-to\-Senior Full\-Stack Developer for a short\-term contract project focused on code cleanup, optimization of code quality, and improving the maintainability of an existing production platform. Our internal platform is a live system used daily by our agents to manage offices, customers, policies, and dialer/lead workflows. This engagement is strictly focused on improving the quality and maintainability of the existing codebase. This is not a platform rebuild, redesign, or new feature development project. All existing functionality and system behavior must remain unchanged. We are looking for a detail\-oriented developer who can work carefully within an established codebase, follow existing development processes, and communicate effectively with our current development team. Key Responsibilities * Review and evaluate the existing codebase to identify opportunities for cleanup and improved maintainability. * Remove unnecessary console.log statements, debug logs, and commented\-out experimental or debugging code. * Identify and remove unused code, imports, and other unnecessary elements. * Replace loosely defined any types with stricter, more appropriate TypeScript types wherever it is safe to do so. * Develop and implement tests that document and verify the platform's current behavior. * Ensure all cleanup work preserves existing functionality without introducing unintended changes. * Identify potential bugs, inconsistencies, or areas of concern and communicate findings to the existing developer before taking action. * Document any areas intentionally left unchanged, including the reasoning behind those decisions. **Technical Requirements** Candidates should have experience working with production applications and familiarity with the following technologies: **Frontend** * React 18 * Vite * Apollo Client * TanStack Query **Backend** * NestJS microservices * Apollo Federation GraphQL Gateway * REST APIs alongside GraphQL **Database** * MongoDB Atlas **Infrastructure – Familiarity Only** General awareness of the following AWS services and infrastructure is beneficial. No infrastructure modifications are required as part of this engagement. * AWS Region: us\-east\-2 * Amazon Cognito * Amazon ECS/ECR * AWS Lambda * Amazon SQS * AWS Amplify * Traefik Development Workflow \& Expectations To maintain the stability and integrity of our live production platform, all development work must follow our established review and approval process. * All work must be completed on dedicated feature branches. * Every pull request will be personally reviewed by our existing developer. * No changes may be merged into the main branch without explicit approval. * All proposed modifications must remain within the agreed\-upon scope of code cleanup and maintenance. * Any potential bugs or concerns must be communicated and reviewed before changes are made. Project Deliverables Upon completion of the engagement, the developer will be expected to provide: * A cleaned\-up codebase with unnecessary console.log statements and commented\-out debugging code removed. * Removal of unused code and imports. * Replacement of any types with stricter TypeScript types where appropriate and safe. * Tests verifying that existing platform functionality and behavior remain unchanged. * A brief written summary identifying any areas intentionally left untouched, along with the reasoning behind those decisions. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a mid\-to\-senior full\-stack developer who has experience maintaining and improving established production applications. We are particularly interested in someone who: * Has strong attention to detail and takes a careful, methodical approach to code maintenance. * Is comfortable navigating and working within an existing, complex codebase. * Understands the importance of preserving functionality in a live production environment. * Can distinguish between necessary code cleanup and changes that would affect product behavior. * Respects established development processes, code review requirements, and project boundaries. * Communicates clearly and proactively when encountering potential issues or decisions requiring additional input. * Can work independently while collaborating effectively with an existing developer. About the Opportunity This is a **short\-term contract opportunity** intended for an experienced developer who can efficiently improve code quality and maintainability without disrupting a live production system. The project has a clearly defined scope, an established technical environment, and an existing developer responsible for reviewing and approving all changes. Pay: From $40\.00 per hour Expected hours: 24\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Systems Integration & Automation Engineer (IT & AI)
jobs.description: *Des Moines, IA (100% On\-Site) \| Pay: $75,000 – $90,000 / year \+ Benefits* **If your idea of a great tech job is sitting in an ivory tower writing code while a separate team handles the messy reality of physical infrastructure, keep scrolling. You’d hate it here.** We are a growing, $10M\+ multi\-entity blue\-collar business that runs on real\-world execution. In a business our size, you don't get to live in just one narrow lane. You are the technical utility player. That means you will reset a password, provision a new workstation, and fix a dropped router \- *and* you will use that same day to build automated data pipelines, connect APIs, and deploy internal AI tools. You manage the guts, and you build the future. **What You’ll Actually Be Doing** **1\. Managing the Guts: IT Infrastructure \& Support (40%)** * Yes, you own the fundamentals. When an employee forgets their password, a branch router drops offline, or a new hire needs a workstation imaged, you are the one who fixes it. * You administer and secure our cloud environments (Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace) across multiple legal entities, manage user permissions, and configure DNS/email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) so our comms don't break. * You keep the digital house running smoothly so our field crews and back\-office teams can work without friction. **2\. Building the Future: Automations \& Integrations (40%)** * You live in tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, and custom webhooks. When data needs to move between our ERP, CRM, and accounting software, you build the pipeline so nobody has to type it twice. * You look at manual, repetitive administrative tasks across our regional branches and think, *"I can automate that by Friday."* Then you build it, test it, and deploy it. **3\. Pushing the Frontier: Practical AI Tools (20%)** * You experiment with LLMs, prompt engineering, and document parsers to build smart internal tools—like automated estimate parsers, scheduling assistants, and internal knowledge bases tied directly to company data. **Who You Actually Are** * **A True Utility Player:** You don't think basic IT tasks are "below you." jobs.description: At TE Connectivity, we help build the technologies that keep the world connected. The Digital Data Networks department is seeking an experienced Staff R\&D Product Engineer to lead the development of embedded software, firmware, applications, and data platforms for next\-generation intelligent power products. This role is responsible for designing and delivering software solutions that bring advanced monitoring, diagnostics, analytics, and device management capabilities to active power products used in AI, hyperscale data center, industrial, and other high\-power applications. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in embedded software and firmware development with strong knowledge of sensing technologies, power systems, data analytics, and connected device architectures. This individual will collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to transform product telemetry into actionable intelligence while enabling differentiated intelligent power solutions for customers worldwide. **Role and Responsibilities** ----------------------------- **Embedded Software \& Active Device Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software and firmware for microcontrollers, sensor ICs, and intelligent power devices. * Develop device drivers, bootloaders, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), and real\-time applications using bare\-metal and RTOS architectures. * Create tools and processes for device configuration, calibration, diagnostics, firmware updates, and secure lifecycle management. * Lead software architecture, communication interface implementation, code reviews, and technical mentoring to deliver reliable and scalable solutions. **Sensing, Monitoring \& Diagnostics** * Develop real\-time monitoring algorithms for electrical, thermal, and electromagnetic measurements in power products. * Implement signal processing, calibration, fault detection, event logging, alarm handling, and diagnostic capabilities. * Partner with cross\-functional engineering teams to define sensing architectures and measurement requirements. * Develop predictive monitoring solutions that improve reliability while balancing cost, manufacturability, and system constraints. **Data Management \& Analytics** * Design and develop data acquisition systems, databases, APIs, dashboards, and analytics platforms for product telemetry. * Establish data models, traceability frameworks, retention strategies, and data quality standards across development and production environments. * Create analytics solutions for performance trending, failure analysis, predictive maintenance, and continuous product improvement. * Integrate monitoring platforms with edge, cloud, manufacturing, and enterprise systems while ensuring cybersecurity and data integrity. **Test, Validation \& Product Development** * Develop automated test and data acquisition software supporting product validation, characterization, and manufacturing testing. * Integrate software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment, including power analyzers, oscilloscopes, electronic loads, and thermal chambers. * Execute software verification and validation activities including unit, integration, regression, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and system testing. * Support product development from concept through production launch by troubleshooting hardware\-software interactions and validating performance. **Customer \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Work with customers and stakeholders to define technical requirements and intelligent power system solutions. * Translate business and product needs into software specifications, architectures, interfaces, and development roadmaps. * Collaborate with Electrical, Mechanical, Thermal, Manufacturing, Quality, Test, Product Management, and Customer Engineering teams. * Support documentation, design reviews, product integration, deployment activities, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications. **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Minimum 8 years of experience developing embedded software, firmware, connected devices, monitoring systems, industrial software, or data\-driven engineering applications. * Proven experience leading software development projects from concept through production deployment and lifecycle support. * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems and Python for test automation, analytics, tooling, and software development. * Experience delivering software solutions that interface directly with sensors, hardware devices, laboratory equipment, or industrial systems. * Experience collaborating across global,  ge multiple complex technical projects and competing priorities independently. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to mentor and guide other engineers while promoting disciplined software development practices. * Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to continuous learning in embedded systems, intelligent power products, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies. * Self\-driven focus on advancing intelligent power solutions through innovative development, validation, and optimization methodologies. **Other Information** --------------------- **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with data center power architectures, busbars, power shelves, 48V or 54V power distribution systems, high\-voltage DC systems, or high\-current cable assemblies and connectors. * Familiarity with PMBus, Redfish, OCP specifications, BMC integration, and other power management standards. * Experience developing condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, AI/ML analytics, or digital twin solutions. * Experience developing web applications, dashboards, cloud\-native platforms, edge computing solutions, and containerized deployments. * Knowledge of functional safety, product cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and software quality practices for connected products. * Experience supporting product development, manufacturing process development, production testing, and customer deployment activities in a global environment. * Understanding of low\-frequency circuit behavior and power system characteristics. * Proven success delivering intelligent monitoring and connected\-device solutions throughout the full product lifecycle. **ABOUT TE jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: ### **About TEGNA** TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news. We are looking for a **Data Scientist** to help build the data science and applied AI capabilities behind TEGNA's content platform, the systems that turn a high volume of news and media content into insight, enrichment, and better experiences for millions of users. You'll work with large, messy, text\-heavy datasets and use NLP and large language models to turn them into production solutions that make content more discoverable, better organized, and more useful to editorial, product, and audience teams. You'll partner with engineering and cloud teams on how models and LLM\-based services are deployed, monitored, and operated in production. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and evaluate data science solutions that apply NLP and LLMs to content problems such as classification, tagging and taxonomy, entity extraction, summarization, similarity and recommendation, and semantic search. * Develop LLM\-powered solutions, including prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings and vector search, and fine\-tuning where it is warranted, with a pragmatic eye on cost, latency, and quality. * Own evaluation. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part\-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance. Our 401(k) program offers full, part\-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% \- 80% of their pay on a pre\-tax basis to TEGNA's 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one. Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor's appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health. TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. * Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. We are investing heavily in AI\-assisted development, modern cloud\-native services, and flexible, modular architecture patterns that let our teams innovate quickly while delivering high\-quality, high\-impact products for our users. ### **Benefits:** TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part\-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.
