jobs.title: Assistant Town Engineer
jobs.description: **TOWN OF SOUTHINGTON** **Job Description:** **ASSISTANT TOWN ENGINEER** ================================================ Department(s): Engineering Reports To: Town Engineer Employment Status: Full\-Time; 35 hours, 8:30am – 4:30pm Salary: $108,083 \- $118,427 Union: UPSEU Local 424\-Unit 11 Summary: Step into a high\-impact, senior\-level role driving complex civil engineering projects and managing a full\-service municipal engineering office. Reporting directly to the Town Engineer with considerable professional autonomy, you will apply advanced engineering principles to oversee everything from initial project plans and site surveys to cost estimates and final construction inspections. In this dynamic position, you will rely on your expert judgment to solve infrastructure challenges while leading and mentoring a multidisciplinary team of engineers, surveyors, inspectors, and administrative staff. Essential Job Functions:* Supervises, coordinates and participates in the administration, survey, design and construction of a variety of public works projects within the Town’s Right of Way and on Town property. * Supervises the preparation of specifications, estimates and proposals. * Consults with private engineers, developers, attorneys, and others relative to public infrastructure and private development projects. * Gives advice on engineering problems and acts as a technical resource, providing solution recommendations and alternatives. * Reviews design proposals, estimates and bids for accuracy and compliance with Town and State standards. * Schedules work, makes changes in assignments and staffing as deemed necessary to meet deadlines or accomplish objectives. * Reviews applications, excavation, and sewer permits. * Reviews and responds to resident complaints * Keeps records and prepares reports. * Acts as Town Engineer in his or her absence. * Prepares and applies for federal and state grants. * Performs related work as required. * Presents engineering proposals to interested groups and organizations. * Manages public communication activities regarding Engineering Division projects, including but not limited to, the development of webpage content, public notifications and public information sessions. * Develops meeting agendas and minutes as required * Investigates and assigns work related to public complaints * Ability to attend meetings outside of standard operating hours * Attends Planning \& Zoning meetings. Also attends Wetlands, Public Works, Apple Harvest Festival, and Sewer Committee as needed. * Performs inspections as required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:* Thorough knowledge of the principles and practices of civil engineering as applied to the construction, planning and design of a variety of public works projects. * Considerable knowledge of applicable codes, ordinances * Considerable knowledge of regulations and standards governing public works engineering. * Knowledge of effective principles and techniques of supervision and office management. * Ability to apply approved engineering methods and standards to the design and construction of a variety of public works projects. * Ability to perform technical research work and to recommend solutions on difficult engineering problems. * Ability to supervise professional and non\-professional staff. * Ability to plan and organize engineering activities. * Ability to present ideas clearly, orally and in writing. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others. * Ability to draft and design using Carlson Civil3D with AutoCAD * Knowledge of GIS (ESRI and ArcGIS Online) * Proficiency in MS Office, and Google Suite Work Environment: Work is performed primarily in a standard business office setting; however, field site visits and inspections are required. Following initial training, one day of hybrid work per week may be permitted. Work performance and deliverables are subject to administrative review by the Town Engineer through regular conferences and examination of reports and studies. The office environment presents standard risks requiring customary safety precautions, such as maintaining safe work practices with equipment, preventing trips and falls, and adhering to fire regulations. Outdoor field work involves site inspections with exposure to varying temperatures, seasonal weather conditions, and active construction sites. Duties require significant walking and/or standing, some of which may be on uneven ground. Routinely conducts site inspections outdoors requiring mobility to inspect sites which may include walking through fields, woods, river areas, and construction sites. May require the use of protective clothing or gear. May work in confined or restricted areas. May occasionally involve incidental exposure or physical harm. Must be able to reach/bend/push/pull/lift objects weighing up to 15 pounds. Must be mobile and able to perform moderately difficult manipulative skills such as writing, using a keyboard and/or calculator with accuracy. Able to sit and stand for prolonged periods of time. Able to perform tasks with eye\-hand coordination. Must be able to see objects closely as in reading and preparing documents or reports. Able to read plans, review drafts, maps or diagrams and read from a computer monitor. Ability to see objects far away as in driving. Ability to differentiate colors as in architectural plans. Able to hear normal sounds with some background noise and to communicate orally in the English language with other Town employees, architects, developers and the public face to face, one to one settings or using a telephone. May have interactions with agitated individuals. Must be able to concentrate on fine details with some interruption. Needs to attend to task/function for more than 60 minutes at a time. Able to understand and relate to specific ideas, generally several at a time and to understand and relate to the theories behind several related concepts. Able to remember multiple tasks/assignments given to self and others over a long period of time. May be exposed to dust and electro\-magnetic radiation as in computer screens. Minimum Qualifications: Graduation from college with a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or related engineering science, and five (5\) years of progressively responsible experience in the practice of civil engineering; or an equivalent combination of education and training. jobs.title: Customer Value Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI\-native organizations. We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks, insurers and fintechs, and we're looking for a **Customer Value Engineer** to own a portfolio of our North American customers from New York. As a Customer Value Engineer at Taktile you work with our customers to maximize the value they get from the platform. Our Customer Value Engineering team manages about 70% of Taktile's revenue, so this is one of the most customer\-facing and commercially important roles in the company. You will partner with Taktile's Sales and Solutions teams and make sure our customers get value from Taktile throughout their entire lifecycle. You will report directly to the head of Customer Value Engineering and be the first dedicated CVE hire in North America, working alongside our CVE teams in EMEA and LATAM. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own a portfolio of around 15 customers, with average contract values ranging from $100K\-$300K annually, plus a small number of additional accounts you support as needed. * Keep customers on the platform and grow them: you are measured on minimizing churn and driving account expansion. * Orchestrate renewals and handle the hard commercial conversations, such as churn risks and discount requests, while keeping the relationship strong. * Find and develop new use cases with customers, from credit underwriting to fraud, KYC/KYB and AI agents, working on both the business case and the technical approach. * Build relationships with executive stakeholders and with the core users of Taktile in each customer team, together with our Solutions Engineers. * Bring what you learn from customers back to our product and engineering teams, so that Taktile keeps solving their real business problems. **About you** ------------- * **Personable:** people enjoy working with you. You build trust quickly with risk teams, engineers and executives, and customers look forward to your calls. * **Organized:** you manage many accounts, projects and timelines at once, and you keep internal and customer stakeholders informed without being chased. * **Commercially confident:** you are comfortable in difficult conversations about renewals, pricing and churn, and you can hold your position while keeping the relationship intact. * **Experienced:** you have 2\+ years of account management or customer success experience at a B2B SaaS startup, ideally one selling into a regulated industry such as financial services, insurance or healthcare. * **Curious and customer\-centric:** you want to understand how your customers' businesses work and how Taktile can help them make better decisions. * **Team player:** you enjoy working closely with Sales, Solutions, Support, Product and Engineering. **Ideal, but not required** --------------------------- * Domain knowledge of financial services, such as banking, lending, insurance or payments. * Technical fluency: you are comfortable talking through APIs, data and integrations with engineers, and you know the basics of SQL or Python. * Experience running renewals or expansion against a target. * We are not looking for a pure consulting background. We want someone who has owned customer relationships at a software company. **Your first year and beyond** ------------------------------ * Your first quarter is for ramping up: learning the platform, meeting your customers and building an account plan for each of them. * From your second quarter, you own your portfolio's renewal and expansion results. * As you grow, you can take on larger, more strategic accounts, or move toward supporting proofs of concept or deployment on enterprise accounts. **Our offer** ------------- * A self\-development budget you can use for conferences, books or classes. * Work from our New York office 3 days a week. Travel to our twice\-yearly company\-wide meetings around the world. * Make an impact and shape an early\-stage company. * A flat hierarchy: work with and learn directly from the founding team. Your opinions and ideas are welcome, especially when they challenge the status quo. * Learn from experienced mentors, such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog and UiPath. * The equipment of your choice, including a home office set\-up. **Our Stance** * We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply * We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears **About Us** Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control. By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision\-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve. Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision\-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry. We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast\-growing startups and enterprise leaders. Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath \- we’re building a world\-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI\-driven decision\-making in financial services. Compensation Range: $150K \- $210K

jobs.title: AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology & Knowledge Graph
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Hartford, CT Category: Data Engineering Employment Type: Full time, Remote Job Ref: R2627817\-168 AVP Data Engineering \- GE05AE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The **AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology \& Knowledge Graph** is an executive\-facing leadership role accountable for defining, building, and driving enterprise adoption of the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, and knowledge graph. This leader establishes the governed business meaning, context, and relationships that power trusted analytics, AI, agentic experiences, and decision automation across Small Business, Middle \& Large Business, and Global Specialty. Operating at the intersection of commercial P\&C insurance, business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, the role translates complex insurance domain knowledge—submissions, quotes, accounts, policies, coverages, exposures, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance—into production\-ready semantic assets consumable by people, data products, LLMs, and agents. Ontology Strategy, Build \& Adoption * Own the vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, context graph, and knowledge graph. * Lead the design and execution of an enterprise\-scale semantic layer that standardizes business meaning and enables trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases. * Define and operationalize ontologies modeling core commercial insurance concepts and relationships: customers, business profiles, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, exposures, risks and locations, claims, producers, and portfolio performance. * Establish canonical vocabularies, metric definitions, business rules, and taxonomies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured data sources and across all three markets. * Define and enforce standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, versioning, and ontology reuse across delivery teams. * Drive adoption by embedding semantic models into data products, analytics, AI pipelines, APIs, and activation layers; measure and report adoption and business value. * Move capabilities from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise production, prioritizing high\-value use cases such as submission triage, risk appetite, clearance, pricing and underwriting insights, portfolio management, and cross\-sell. AI \& Data Engineering * Enable semantic\-first AI and agentic analytics, ensuring LLMs and agents consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships. * Lead implementation of AI data pipelines integrating structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data (e.g., submissions, loss runs, schedules, broker correspondence) to support AI and agentic solutions. * Operationalize ontologies through knowledge graphs, metadata services, data APIs, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and production data platforms in partnership with AI Data Architects and Engineers. * Design and oversee scalable real\-time and batch d nderwriting approach, account complexity, and data needs. * Familiarity with core insurance concepts and measures: exposures and rating bases (payroll, sales, TIV, vehicles), class codes (NAICS/SIC), insured locations, account rounding, hit/quote/bind ratios, written and earned premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, retention, and rate change. * Familiarity with industry data standards and reference models such as ACORD, ISO, and NCCI. Skills \& Experience Leadership \& Communication * Exceptional executive presence with proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts simply and persuasively to C\-suite, line\-of\-business heads, and board\-level audiences. * Strong executive influence, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; track record of building cross\-functional coalitions and driving enterprise\-wide adoption without direct authority. * Proven ability to frame investment cases, value metrics, and decisions for senior leadership. * Ability to lead in a lean, agile, fast\-paced environment using Scaled Agile principles. Semantic, Ontology \& Knowledge Graph * Deep expertise in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale. * Hands\-on mastery of RDF, OWL 2, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards; familiarity with labeled property graphs and query languages such as Cypher or GQL. * Experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs on platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Spanner Graph. * Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLMs, RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks. * Strong understanding of context\-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, semantic interoperability, and AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability. Data \& AI Engineering * Mastery of data engineering and architecture, including lakehouses, data integration, data domains, data products, data APIs, real\-time streaming, and conversational BI. * Experience implementing scalable AI\-driven data systems supporting agentic solutions (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A). * Technical expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, LLM optimization, RAG architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Vertex AI, Postgres, OpenSearch, Pinecone). * Hands\-on experience with multi\-cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake. * Strong grounding in data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, privacy, and security. Education, Experience, Certifications and Licenses * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years in data engineering, data architecture, and large\-scale data ecosystems, including 8\+ years of hands\-on semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph work. * 7\+ years in senior leadership roles managing complex data and AI portfolios, with direct engagement with executive and line\-of\-business leadership. * 5\+ years in commercial Property \& Casualty insurance; experience across Small Business, Middle Market, or Specialty strongly preferred. * Industry designations such as CPCU, AINS, or AU are a plus. **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. jobs.title: Java AS400 Engineer - Remote | 15+ years
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Role: Senior Java Engineer – AS400 \& Application Development** **Duration: Longterm** **Location: NJ\-based, Hybrid** **Engagement: Multi\-application support and project delivery** **Visa: Any Visa is fine** Role Summary: We are looking for a senior Java engineer with deep L3 and L4 support experience and extensive hands\-on work on the IBM i (AS400\) platform. The role combines production support, complex solution development, and architectural input across multiple business applications. You will resolve escalated incidents, drive root cause analysis, enhance existing systems, and contribute to project delivery in a structured ITIL\-governed environment. Key Responsibilities: * Provide L3 and L4 support for business\-critical applications: troubleshoot escalated incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent fixes. * Design, develop, and deploy complex Java\-based solutions and integrations, including those that interface with IBM i / AS400 systems. * Contribute to solution design and architecture: review technical designs, recommend patterns, and guide modernization and integration decisions. * Support and enhance multiple applications concurrently, prioritizing effectively across incidents, problems, changes, and project work. * Participate actively in projects from requirements and design through build, testing, deployment, and hypercare. * Manage incidents, problems, changes, and service requests in ServiceNow in line with ITIL processes and SLAs. * Plan and track work in JIRA (stories, tasks, defects, sprints, boards, dashboards). * Perform code reviews, enforce coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers. * Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and support handover material. * Collaborate with business users, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, and vendor teams; communicate status and risks clearly to stakeholders. * Participate in on\-call or shift rotations and major incident bridges as required. Required Qualifications: * 15\+ years of total IT experience, with strong Java development and support experience. * Proven L3 and L4 support background: complex defect analysis, code\-level fixes, performance tuning, and vendor escalation handling. * Extensive hands\-on experience on the AS400 / IBM i platform. * Experience writing complex solutions and some level of architecture experience (solution design, integration design, technical leadership). * Demonstrated ability to support multiple applications at the same time and engage in project work. * Full understanding of ITIL: incident, problem, change, release, and knowledge management, SLAs, and major incident handling (ITIL v3/v4 certification preferred). * Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow (SNOW) for ITSM and JIRA for work management. * Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Technical Skills **Core Java and frameworks** * Java 8 / 11 / 17\+, OOP, multithreading and concurrency, collections, streams, JVM tuning and memory management * Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Batch, Spring Cloud * Hibernate / JPA, MyBatis, JDBC * Jakarta EE (Servlets, JSP, EJB, JMS), legacy Struts exposure a plus **Web services and integration** * REST and SOAP web services, JSON / XML, Swagger / OpenAPI * Messaging: JMS, Apache Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ * Integration patterns, ESB / middleware exposure (Oracle SOA/OSB, MuleSoft, or similar) * Microservices architecture, API gateway concepts, OAuth2 / JWT **IBM i / AS400** * IBM i (AS400\) architecture, DB2 for i, libraries, objects, and job management * RPG / RPGLE, CL, COBOL awareness; reading and troubleshooting legacy code * JT400 / JTOpen toolkit, JDBC to DB2 for i, data queues, program calls, and Java\-to\-RPG integration * Batch job scheduling, spool file handling, and performance analysis on IBM i * Modernization approaches: API enablement, service wrapping, and incremental refactoring **Databases** * DB2, Oracle, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL; advanced SQL, stored procedures, query tuning and indexing **Build, DevOps, and quality** * Maven / Gradle, Git, Bitbucket / GitHub / GitLab, Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD * JUnit, Mockito, integration testing, SonarQube / code quality tools * Docker; Kubernetes and cloud (AWS / Azure / OCI) exposure a plus * Application servers and web servers: WebLogic, WebSphere, Tomcat, JBoss, Apache / Nginx **Monitoring and troubleshooting** * Log analysis, thread and heap dump analysis, profiling and performance tuning * Monitoring and APM tools such as Splunk, ELK, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or New Relic **Service management and delivery tools** * ServiceNow (incident, problem, change, knowledge, reporting), JIRA, Confluence * ITIL\-aligned processes, SLA and KPI reporting, RCA and problem record documentation Preferred Qualifications * ITIL Foundation or higher certification; Oracle or Java certifications * Experience in retail, publishing, distribution, or ERP\-integrated environments * Exposure to Agile / Scrum and hybrid support\-plus\-project delivery models * Experience modernizing or migrating legacy platforms * Experience working with onshore/offshore delivery teams Soft Skills * Strong ownership and accountability for production stability * Calm and structured under major incident pressure * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and business audiences * Ability to mentor and influence without formal authority * Self\-driven, able to context\-switch across applications and priorities **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Engineer II, Detection Engineer
jobs.description: **We are** an American luxury lifestyle brand, founded in 2004\. Anchored in the casual elegance of American sportswear, Tory’s design philosophy is defined by effortless silhouettes, innovative materials, eclectic juxtapositions of color, and the tension of past and present. The collections include ready\-to\-wear, handbags, footwear, accessories, jewelry, home and beauty. Empowering women is the company’s guiding principle, expressed through Tory’s collections and reflected in the company culture as well as the work of the Tory Burch Foundation. Established in 2009, the Foundation provides women entrepreneurs in the United States with access to capital, education and community. **You are** seeking a work environment where people are encouraged to dream, explore, discover and, as important, laugh together. If you’re prepared to work hard, create impact, and have fun while doing it, we would love to have you join \#TeamTory. Apply today! **Life @ToryBurch is Special Because:** When you join us, you’re joining a global, purpose\-led company on an exciting growth journey with an amazing culture and great benefits. Our culture is welcoming and inclusive * \- everyone is empowered to make a difference. * We have the best team in the world and believe in paying competitively and rewarding for high performance. * Your overall well\-being is important to us; we offer generous benefits to help you take care of your mental and physical health, create financial security, and achieve wellness in all areas of your life. * We love seeing our employees wear our beautiful collections. You’ll receive a generous employee discount and access to exclusive sample sales. * We are invested in your professional growth – you’ll have access to free executive coaching on\-demand. * We believe in the importance of giving back and you’ll have many opportunities to do just that through the Tory Burch Foundation and paid volunteer days. **This Role is Tailor\-Made for You Because:** You are a hands\-on cybersecurity professional who thrives in threat detection, incident investigation, threat hunting, and cyber defense operations. You serve as an internal Tier 2 and Tier 3 escalation resource after our managed security services provider (MSSP) completes initial monitoring, alert triage, and first\-line response activities. You take ownership of complex investigations, validate and extend findings, coordinate operational handoffs, and help drive incidents through containment, remediation, recovery, and closure. In this role, you will serve as the primary operational liaison with our MSSP for escalations, case coordination, collaborative investigations, and continuous improvement of detection and response processes. You will proactively hunt threats, evaluate detection effectiveness, validate security telemetry coverage, and identify visibility gaps that could affect the organization’s ability to detect and respond to emerging threats. You will work closely with the Senior Manager, Threat Management \& Detection Engineering and security engineering teams to prioritize, track, and remediate detection, telemetry, and visibility gaps.**A Day in the Life:** A day in the life is… atypical. You may be: * Act as an internal Tier 2 and Tier 3 escalation point for security alerts and incidents following initial monitoring, triage, and first\-line response by our MSSP. * Validate investigation findings, perform deeper technical analysis, determine scope and impact, and coordinate containment, remediation, recovery, and follow\-up actions with internal teams. * Serve as the day\-to\-day operational liaison with our MSSP for incident handoffs, evidence exchange, case coordination, escalation decisions, collaborative analysis, and service\-quality feedback. * Perform hands\-on investigations across endpoint, identity, email, cloud, network, application, and data security telemetry using SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and related security technologies. * Conduct proactive, hypothesis\-driven threat hunts based on threat intelligence, observed adversary behavior, emerging techniques, environmental changes, and known control gaps. * Translate investigation and threat\-hunting findings into recommendations for improved detections, alert tuning, response procedures, and security controls. * Monitor and validate the security telemetry required for effective detection and response, including source availability, parsing, normalization, timeliness, retention, and investigative usefulness. * Identify and document gaps in telemetry coverage or detection visibility, assess their operational impact, and raise them to the Senior Manager and appropriate security engineering teams for prioritization and remediation. * Partner with security engineering and technology teams to troubleshoot telemetry gaps and validate that corrective changes restore the required visibility. * Support detection tuning and validation to reduce false positives, improve alert fidelity, and keep escalatio * Hands\-on experience investigating security activity using SIEM, EDR, SOAR, identity, email, cloud, network, and application security telemetry. * Strong understanding of incident investigation, evidence collection, scoping, containment, remediation coordination, recovery, and post\-incident analysis. * Experience conducting proactive threat hunts and translating findings into improved detections, monitoring requirements, response actions, or control enhancements. * Working knowledge of adversary tactics and techniques, including practical use of frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK. * Ability to assess whether security telemetry is complete, timely, normalized, and useful for investigation, and to clearly document gaps and remediation requirements. * Experience collaborating with managed security services providers and internal engineering teams, supported by strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple investigations and priorities while maintaining accurate case documentation and effective stakeholder communication. **Why You'll Want to Join Our Team:** Our Technology team has a clear mission: use technology to enable the business to operate efficiently while driving growth and profitability. We envision, we strategize, we engineer, we design, we build, we test, we support, and we serve. Our tools and systems impact every customer and every member of our team every day and our role is to make each engagement seamless and rewarding. As we build our in\-house engineering teams, we are focused on further modernizing our platforms, leveraging our data analytics capabilities and creating a transformational customer experience. Come join us!**How We Work Together** * Adaptable – We change before we have to * Entrepreneurial – We own it * Collaborative – There’s no “I” in Tory * Client \& Brand Focused – We put ourselves in Tory’s shoes * Live the Values – We show up for each other * Functional Expertise – We’re constantly learning and growing **\#TeamTory Values** We show up with honesty \& kindness, act with integrity \& compassion, work with passion \& humility and lead with excellence \& humor. **Compensation Range** The compensation range for this position is 120,000\.00 USD \- 150,000\.00 USD. Our offer will be based on your relevant experience and work location. **Benefits Information** We offer a generous set of benefits to help you take care of your health, create financial security, and achieve wellness in all areas of your life. Here are highlights of key benefits available to all eligible Tory Burch team members. ### **E****qual Employment Opportunity Statement** Tory Burch LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to an individual’s age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy) or sexual orientation, gender expression, military status, marital status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, disability or membership in any other protected class under applicable law. Likewise, we will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Ordinance No. 184652\. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment. **Disability Accommodation** Tory Burch is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require assistance or an accommodation with the hiring process, please contact thetalentteam@toryburch.com.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands\-on Lead Software Engineer to drive end\-to\-end solution delivery for major retail platforms, and to make AI\-augmented engineering the way our teams build. In this role, you will own hands\-on implementation (feature development, technical design, code reviews), engagement leadership (client\-facing technical lead, trade\-off decisions, mentoring), and operational ownership (delivery sign\-off, post\-release support) of high\-impact solutions, translating business requirements into working software you help build. You will also be the engineering authority on how AI is used across the delivery lifecycle: designing agentic workflows, setting guardrails, measuring impact, and bringing the team along. You will drive Dual\-Track Agile processes, using AI to compress the Discovery Track (rapid prototyping and feasibility validation) and to raise quality, traceability, and measurable outcomes in the Delivery Track. The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer who codes daily and treats AI agents as a core part of their toolchain. You have moved beyond personal use of AI assistants to building repeatable, governed, measurable AI workflows that other engineers adopt, from analysis and design to testing, documentation, and code generation, while bringing the technical leadership to drive client engagements forward. You will mentor teams, make critical technical trade\-offs, and take full accountability for delivery sign\-off and post\-release support. This role requires strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations), cloud\-native development experience, and deep fluency with generative and agentic AI tools to accelerate delivery while preserving code quality and architectural integrity. You will have the judgment to know when AI output can be trusted and when it cannot, and you will be a key driver of engineering excellence, ensuring solutions are both innovative and operationally robust. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and operate AI/agentic workflows across the software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, prototyping, code generation, test\-case creation, specification drafting, code review, documentation, and automated validation, and use them in your own daily development. * Define team standards for AI\-assisted development: prompt and context practices, reusable agent skills and instructions, repository conventions, and review expectations for AI\-generated code. * Establish guardrails for responsible AI use, including IP and licensing, secrets and data handling, security review of generated code, and client contractual constraints, and ensure ethical compliance across the team. * Build evaluation and validation around AI output (automated tests, specification conformance, static analysis, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints) so that speed gains do not erode quality. * Define and report metrics on AI impact, such as cycle time, review turnaround, defect escape rate, test coverage, rework, and cost per outcome, and use them to decide where AI helps and where it does not. * Evaluate, pilot, and recommend AI tools, models, and integrations (IDE assistants, CLI agents, MCP servers, internal automation), considering cost, security, and vendor risk. * Build internal tooling and automation on LLM APIs where it removes recurring toil, such as PR summarization, test generation, release notes, and defect triage. * Own end\-to\-end solution delivery across Discovery and Delivery Tracks, personally building validated prototypes, contributing to formal designs, decomposing work into deliverables, and shipping accepted technical implementations. * Drive the Discovery Track under Dual\-Track Agile by writing AI\-accelerated working prototypes and demoing solutions to validate feasibility and align stakeholders before full implementation. * Translate discovery outcomes into delivery backlog items and partner with implementation teams to ensure design intent, code quality standards, and non\-functional requirements are preserved throughout delivery. * Contribute to technical design across products and integrations: produce ADRs, OpenAPI interface contracts, data models, sequencing diagrams, migration/rollback plans, and traceability matrices that serve as implementation inputs for both engineers and AI agents, partnering with architects on broader governance. * Serve as the primary technical lead in client engagements: facilitate workshops, present technical solutions, make trade\-off decisions, drive approvals, and explain AI\-assisted delivery credibly to client stakeholders. * Personally implement critical components and complex features in modern retail platform stacks, set the bar for code quality through your own work, and review and approve deliverables from implementation teams, including AI\-generated changes. * Apply and reinforce engineering standards, reusable integration patterns, and non\-functional requirements ( n enterprise or client\-facing setting. * Experience building internal developer tooling or MCP servers that integrate AI with Jira, GitLab, Jenkins, or Confluence. * Expertise in formal or machine\-readable specifications (OpenAPI, UML\+OCL, TLA\+, or equivalent) to guide implementation and enable automated validation of AI output. * Experience leading Dual\-Track Agile processes, managing both Discovery and Delivery Tracks, and translating discovery outcomes into actionable backlog items. * Strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations) is highly desirable. * Certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent cloud credentials. * Strong understanding of advanced security best practices and compliance requirements in enterprise systems. * Experience contributing to platform strategy, reusable assets, and API\-first designs. **About Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions** Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion\-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self\-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? These are just a few examples of our in\-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader. The nature of retail is changing quickly, so if you share our 'Together Commerce' vision of a seamless two\-way, participatory shopping experience, let's get together to drive the new economy. jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Individual will lead and manage teams of AI\-native engineers who deliver production AI solutions with and for Lines of Business. complex, unscoped AI solutions that extend beyond the confines of a team, and establish AI\-native engineering best practices and standards.**What Will You Do?** * Lead teams of AI\-native engineers and emerging leaders while role modeling Travelers' leadership behaviors. * Lead Applied AI engagements, from sustained strategic initiatives requiring deep discovery and architecture ownership to rapid field engagements embedded with Lines of Business that validate feasibility through working prototypes. * Partner with Line of Business leaders to identify, prioritize and shape high\-value AI direction for when to apply non\-deterministic, AI\-enabled design patterns versus traditional deterministic approaches, based on risk tolerance. * Establish AI\-native engineering practices across teams, including spec and plan workflows, autonomy matched to risk, guardrails, evaluation before changes ship, and accountability standards so engineers own AI\-assisted output as the accountable author. * Drive a systems thinking approach and efficiencies across the delivery lifecycle, using emerging tools and practices to optimize flow of value and remove systemic impediments. * Provide strategic direction into overall quality needs and expand automation, including testing, proactive alerting, and resiliency/reliability, and ensure operational resilience through vulnerability management, monitoring, disaster recovery and incident response. * Build AI\-native capabilities across multiple teams, assess skill gaps, drive an AI learning strategy, and set the learning example for others. * Build collaborative relationships with key leaders and peers across the organization (i.e. Team Leaders, CoEs) to ensure the best use of overall resources, and present recommendations that influence executive decisions on AI investment and technology direction. * Develop a robust talent and leadership pipeline, providing technical leadership, mentorship, feedback and unique development opportunities to each team member. * Perform other duties as assigned. Ideal Candidate Competencies * Eight years of related work experience plus four years of team leadership experience. * AI\-Native Engineering \- Experience establishing AI\-native practices at an organizational level, including spec\-and\-plan workflows, context engineering, deterministic guardrails, evaluation suites that gate changes, living convention files and skills that encode policy, and parallel work streams sized to what one person can review. * Delivery \- Advanced delivery skills including the ability to take AI solutions into production with evaluation, monitoring and human review, assess engineering strategies across an organization, and ensure the quality, production readiness and continued health of systems that meet nonfunctional requirements. * Domain Expertise \- Demonstrated track record of applied AI and machine learning expertise, combining traditional ML with LLM\-based approaches, consulting on business priorities, and t p. Required Skills and Experience * Proficiency in Python, with experience in additional languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java. * Hands\-on experience across front\-end, mid\-tier, back\-end and systems layers, with enough depth to review and challenge designs. * Hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services, containerization and orchestration including Kubernetes, RESTful APIs and microservices, and CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Production experience leading the design and delivery of agentic workflows, LLM integrations, or AI\-powered automations, including evaluation, monitoring and human review of AI outputs. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools as the accountable author, with complete ownership of outputs. * Applied machine learning experience including model selection, fine\-tuning, and evaluation in production environments. Preferred Skills and Experience * Experience with Terraform, MongoDB or comparable NoSQL data stores, and Temporal or comparable workflow orchestration tools. * Experience with LLM evaluation methods, including designing evaluation datasets and measuring model performance in production. * Experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, or RAG architectures. * Exposure to MCP server configurations or multi\-agent frameworks. * Experience with ML observability, drift detection, observability tooling or distributed tracing in production environments. * Familiarity with zero\-trust security principles or secure\-by\-design development practices in enterprise AI systems. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 7 additional years of software engineering experience. * 2 years of technical leadership experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. **Employment Practices** Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. This work reflects a sustained organizational commitment to developing these capabilities as a core part of how care is delivered and supported. The purpose of UCSDH’s applied AI efforts is grounded in the quadruple aim, using AI\-enabled technologies to simultaneously expand access to care, improve clinical and operational outcomes, enhance quality and safety, and support a better experience for both patients and care teams. A key focus is leveraging real\-time data, predictive, generative, and hybrid models, and increasingly automated interventions to demonstrably achieve impact at scale across the health system. Central to this strategy is the Mission Control vision, which brings together real\-time data and applied AI–driven decision support to provide system\-wide insight and action across the care continuum, including population health. jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team** The Data Platform Engineering team (Part of Upstart's Decisioning \& Data) provides developer tools, frameworks, and scalable data infrastructure as shared services across Upstart. The team's primary objective is to provide Data Analysts, ML scientists, and Software Engineers access to high\-quality data and developer tools to create business metrics and training data for respective product verticals. You will join the Data Production Experience (PX) team, which owns Upstart’s Lakehouse (Databricks) infrastructure. This is the platform that Machine Learning, Analytics, and Software Engineering teams use to build the training data and metrics behind our lending, fraud, and pricing models—enabling growth and reducing risk across our business verticals. As a Senior Data Platform Engineer joining this team, you will focus on: * **Lakehouse Infrastructure and Security**: Own the Databricks platform across multiple environments, including a newly launched regulated environment (Upstart Bank). Responsibilities include expanding infrastructure as code for new Lakehouse features, enforcing a no\-click\-ops policy, establishing disaster recovery, implementing least\-privilege and attribute\-based access controls (e.g., based on data classification), ensuring environment isolation, and resolving other known security risks. * **Compliance**: Close control gaps and automate evidence gathering for OCC, SOX and SOC audits across access management, change management, and data quality. * **Cost and usage efficiency**: Reduce Databricks and AWS spend through accurate cost attribution, waste detection, and platform\-level optimizations (e.g., compute rightsizing, improving pruning, migrating to Graviton and spot instances, Delta Lake Archival). **How you’ll make an impact** * Evaluate and adopt new technologies, including open\-source lakehouse alternatives, to expand platform capabilities. * Improve developer efficiency and infrastructure reliability by working with cross\-functional stakeholders like Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Analytics, Compliance, and Security. * Improve Lakehouse security, usage efficiency, and observability by collaborating closely with the Data Engineering and Security teams. * Evangelize good coding and engineering best practices while uplifting fellow engineers and mentoring junior team members. * Help break down complex projects and requirements into quarterly commitments and sprints. * Own Lakehouse infrastructure components end to end, from technical requirements and design through rollout and production support. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or data platform engineering. * Hands\-on experience operating a lakehouse or big data platform (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg). * Hands\-on experience with AWS (e.g., IAM, S3, EC2, EKS), Python, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK), CI/CD, and Kubernetes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience implementing security and compliance controls in audited environments (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, GDPR, GLBA, OCC), including access management, encryption, and change management. * Experience reducing cloud or data platform costs through usage analysis, cost attribution, and infrastructure optimization (e.g., Graviton o accelerate infrastructure development and operations. * Familiarity with distributed systems, data architecture design, and big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Lakehouse, Databricks) **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $166,900—$230,900 USD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer – Equipment Design & Manufacturing Automation
jobs.description: **About the Position** WATT Fuel Cell is growing, and we're looking for a **Mechanical Engineer** who enjoys being involved in more than just the design side of engineering. We develop and manufacture solid oxide fuel cell systems, and a big part of this position is helping us improve how we build them. *Some days you'll be working in SolidWorks designing a fixture or modifying a piece of equipment. Other days you'll be on the production floor troubleshooting a mechanical issue, working with technicians, or figuring out how to make a process more efficient.* **We're looking for someone who is comfortable doing both.** This isn't a position where you'll spend every day behind a desk, and it's not strictly an equipment maintenance role either. **We need someone who can recognize a problem, develop a solution, and help put that solution into practice.** **What You'll Be Doing** * Design and improve manufacturing equipment, fixtures, tooling, and mechanical assemblies. * Work with our production team to troubleshoot equipment issues and identify opportunities for improvement. * Develop mechanical designs in SolidWorks and create drawings for fabrication and assembly. * Help build, assemble, test, and modify equipment. * Support improvements to automated and electromechanical manufacturing systems. * Work with sensors, actuators, controls, and other mechanical or electrical components. * Evaluate equipment performance and help resolve recurring production issues. * Coordinate with technicians, vendors, and other engineers on equipment projects. * Support new equipment installations and modifications to existing systems. * Document designs, testing, and changes as needed. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field. * Experience with mechanical design and 3D CAD software, preferably SolidWorks. **Experience with any of the following would be a plus:** * Custom equipment or test system design * Manufacturing automation * Fixture and tooling design * Motion control systems, sensors, or actuators * Thermal or mechanical analysis * Machining, fabrication, or prototyping * LabVIEW, PLCs, or equipment controls * High\-temperature equipment or thermal systems *You don't need previous fuel cell experience. A strong mechanical background, good problem\-solving skills, and a willingness to learn are more important to us.* **A Little About Working at WATT** We're a smaller manufacturing company, and that comes with *some advantages and some challenges*. You'll get to work on different projects, collaborate with people across departments, and have a **direct impact on our manufacturing processes**. It also means *priorities can change*, *equipment doesn't always cooperate*, and sometimes the best solution requires *rolling up your sleeves and figuring things out*. *We don't expect someone to know everything walking in.* **We do want someone who's curious, willing to ask questions, and comfortable taking ownership of their work.** **Benefits** * Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees * Paid vacation and sick time * Paid company holidays * Employee referral bonus program * Opportunities for professional growth **Interested?** We'd like to hear about the projects you've worked on, especially anything you've designed, built, tested, or improved yourself. If this sounds like the kind of engineering work you enjoy, we'd be happy to have a conversation. **Apply through Indeed to be considered.** Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Are you able to be on site daily? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a **Data Engineer to support our office based in Seattle, Washington.** **About the Role** Weyerhaeuser’s Data \& Analytics team is looking for a Data Engineer to build and operate the data platform that powers reporting, analytics, and AI across the enterprise. This hands\-on role focuses on building scalable, reliable, well\-governed pipelines that move data. We invest heavily in template\- and metadata\-driven patterns, so onboarding a new source is a configuration exercise, not a net\-new build. We expect engineers to use AI as a force multiplier — both in how we build the platform (LLM\-assisted development, testing, and documentation) and in what we deliver from it (AI\-ready data products grounded in well\-modeled sources). This role partners closely with source\-system owners, analytics engineers, data scientists, and data analysts. It’s well suited for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, has strong opinions about data quality and pipeline reliability, and is energized by building scalable foundations rather than one\-off integrations. Responsibilities Ingestion \& Integration * Design and maintain ingestion pipelines that move data from SAP, relational databases, flat files, REST APIs, message queues, and SaaS applications into our data lake/Snowflake. * Extend our metadata\-driven and template\-driven ADF pipeline frameworks so onboarding a new source is a configuration exercise — schema mapping, validation, and config, not handwritten pipelines. * Develop Python\-based Azure Functions for custom ingestion logic, REST API integrations, paging/retry handling, and schema reconciliation. * Implement reliable full and incremental data load patterns — watermarking, CDC, late\-arriving data, and replayable backfills. * Design, develop, and support our geospatial ETL tool data pipelines that ingest, transform, and complex location\-based data from enterprise, operational, and third\-party sources for analytics and reporting. Modeling \& Transformation * Land and preserve history of raw data in the Azure data lake or Snowflake (bronze), then build dbt models that conform, deduplicate, standardize, and enrich it into clean silver datasets. * Partner with analytics engineers and data analysts to build dimensional models and semantic views that enable AI\-ready datasets. Orchestration \& Reliability * Orchestrate end\-to\-end workflows in Azure Data Factory — dependencies, parameterization, retries, dynamic parallelism, and error handling for complex multi\-source pipelines. * Build monitoring, alerting, and own incident response — triage, root\-cause analysis, and backfills, including occasional off\-hours coverage for critical loads. * Tune pipelines and Snowflake workloads for performance and cost Data Quality, Security \& Governance * Implement data quality rules — schema validation, completeness, freshness, business\-rule checks, and anomaly detection — wired into pipelines. * Apply security and compliance best practices and contribute to lineage, metadata, and catalog efforts. Platform \& Engineering Practices * Partner with Data Platform Engineers on Terraform\-managed cloud resources, and CICD pipelines. * Drive engineering best practices — version control, testing, documentation, observability, and document pipelines, schemas, contracts, and runbooks so the platform is supportable by the broader team. * Mentor junior engineers, contribute to design reviews, and help evaluate new tools and patterns. Contribute to code reviews. AI Enablement * Skilled in the use of AI assistants and LLM\-powered tools to accelerate development, generate and improve tests, and produce or maintain documentation. Collaboration * Partner with analytics engineers, data analysts, and data scientists to translate requirements into reliable raw data pipelines they can model into downstream products. * Communicate technical concepts and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Qualifications** * What You’ll Have Required * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or equivalent experience * 4\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience building and operating production data pipelines from internal and external sources * Strong proficiency in Python (readable, maintainable) ad SQL. * Production experience with a cloud\-based ingestion and orchestration platform — Azure Data Factory and Azure Functions preferred, though comparable tools (Fabric Pipelines, AWS Glue/Step Functions, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, etc.) are acceptable — including parameterized, dynamic, and metadata\-driven pipeline patterns. * Production experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework, including building and choosing across materialization patterns (views, tables, incremental, ephemeral, snapshots), test coverage, documentation, and history preservation. * Production experience with Snowflake or similar data platform: loading patterns, role\-based  nstrated experience ingesting from a variety of sources: relational databases, SAP, flat jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. **Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.** Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. **For everyone, everywhere.** More about **our mission** and **what we offer**. **Job Description** Wise is building the infrastructure for money with a clear ambition: to become the everyday account people rely on, whether they're managing money at home or across borders. Customers should be able to receive their salary, pay bills, earn on their balances, and move money internationally—all from a single account that is simple \& transparent. As a Software Engineer on the North America Account team, you'll work on products that customers interact with every day. You'll own meaningful problems from discovery through production, improving the reliability and experience of receiving money, expanding access to local account capabilities, evolving our interest offering, and building the platform that powers Wise's everyday account experience in North America. Your work will directly influence customer growth, engagement, trust, retention, and the value customers receive from holding money with Wise. **Qualifications*** Demonstrate proficient knowledge and hands\-on expertise in Java. * Bring a strong product mindset, connecting engineering decisions to customer outcomes such as account adoption, customer engagement, reliability, trust, and long\-term value. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of impactful projects, from understanding customer problems and shaping solutions through implementation, rollout, measurement, and ongoing operational excellence. * Build and evolve highly available backend services using Java, Spring Boot, relational databases, microservices, and well\-designed APIs. * Design resilient distributed systems with thoughtful approaches to asynchronous processing, data consistency, observability, scalability, security, and operational reliability. * Work closely with Product, Design, Operations, Compliance, Treasury, and other engineering teams to deliver solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory requirements, and technical excellence. * Write maintainable, well\-tested software while continuously improving engineering practices, operational tooling, and service health. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to a variety of audiences and contribute to collaborative decision\-making across teams. * Raise the engineering bar by mentoring teammates, providing constructive feedback, reviewing designs and code, and reducing operational and knowledge silos across the team. **Additional Information** For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs. Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: SCADA Controls Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Woodard \& Curran is an employee\-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet. Woodard \& Curran is seeking a dynamic, client\-focused SCADA Automation \& Controls Engineer to join our team, supporting projects in the Rye Brook, NY area. In this role, you’ll work with municipal and industrial clients on water, wastewater, and remediation projects focused on automation and control systems. You’ll have the opportunity to work on complex, integrated SCADA solutions, supporting projects from planning and design through implementation and startup. Working alongside project managers, technical managers, engineers, and operations staff, you’ll gain hands\-on experience while taking increasing ownership of technical deliverables and client solutions. This role offers a strong combination of technical growth, autonomy, client impact, and career advancement. This position involves regular travel to job sites, typically within driving distance, to support project startups, meetings, and client needs. **Who are we looking for:** The successful candidate will join a collaborative team delivering medium\-to\-large SCADA implementation projects for municipal and industrial water and wastewater clients. Projects may be standalone or part of larger multidisciplinary solutions. We’re looking for someone with strong technical and communication skills who can effectively manage responsibilities within project scope, schedule, and budget. As your experience grows, you’ll have opportunities to take on greater project ownership, expand your technical expertise, and develop into larger technical and client leadership responsibilities. **Offering Flexible Hybrid** work schedule consisting of office, remote, and onsite work based on project needs. **Travel:** Regional travel up to 80%. * Follow all required safety procedures and protocols. **What you will need to succeed:** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; * 2–3 years of experience in control system integration; jobs.title: Data Scientist, Bellwether, X
jobs.description: Software EngineeringMountain View, CA **About X, the Moonshot Factory** X is a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup. **About the Team:** Our team – Bellwether – operates at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and pressing issues with enterprise customers, governments, and more. We focus on severe weather manifestations of climate change, such as wildfires, and aim to use a wide range of data and analytics to better understand and predict what these events could mean for communities and businesses across the globe. We do this through the detection and classification of the features and patterns of the natural and built worlds, the application of cutting\-edge machine learning, and the redesign of the full geo\-ML workflow. This work extends into development and production\-level work as well, as Bellwether also has a number of products that are live with customers. The result: tools and models that allow a range of industries to better leverage earth observation insights. **About the Role:** We are looking for a **Lead Data Scientist** to build and unify the data infrastructure that powers our model training pipelines for Project Bellwether. In this role, you will lead the effort to construct a comprehensive multimodal data corpus—integrating geospatial, imagery, sensor, and operational feeds—that serves as a strategic moat for pre\- and post\-disaster response and resilience. Your primary focus will be designing automated ingestion pipelines for complex multimodal datasets, establishing rigorous data quality validation frameworks, and managing dataset versioning to support continuous machine learning training loops. You will bridge the gap between operations, remote annotation teams, and machine learning engineers to ensure our disaster\-response models are trained on reliable, high\-fidelity, and well\-structured data. **How you will have 10X impact:** * Architect and build automated ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) data pipelines to aggregate, clean, and harmonize data from disparate sources, databases, and operational ingestion flows. * Implement DataOps practices, including data quality monitoring, automated schema validation, and anomaly detection to catch corrupt or mislabeled data early. * Standardize and integrate third\-party annotation workflows and remote labeling feeds into unified datasets ready for model training. * Design and maintain dataset versioning and storage systems to allow reproducible machine learning experiments and seamless data retrieval. * Partner with ML engineers and operations teams to turn geospatial, imagery, and sensor metadata into structured training features. * Lead the end\-to\-end development of multimodal machine learning models, driving innovation from research and dataset architecture to production deployment for pre\- and post\-disaster response. * Define product and data strategy around the multimodal data corpus, leveraging proprietary datasets as a strategic moat for AI\-driven disaster resilience tools. * Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize model performance, scalability, and integration into existing product workflows. * Establish best practices for MLOps, including model versioning, automated testing, and performance tracking to ensure reliable and high\-quality deployments. * Help hire and grow the data science function, setting the technical bar and culture as the team scales. * Design, build, and maintain robust data ontologies and taxonomies to systematically organize, categorize, and integrate complex geospatial and multimodal datasets. **What you should have:** * Education: Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * Data Engineering \& Architecture: 7\+ years experience building scalable data pipelines, managing relational and non\-relational databases, and unifying fragmented data storage systems. * Modern Python Proficiency: Expertise in Python and data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, or SQL). * Data Quality \& DataOps: Practical experience implementing automated data validation, quality control frameworks, and dataset versioning practices. * ML Data Lifecycle Understanding: Hands\-on experience structuring datasets specifically for machine learning workflows, including handling annotations, metadata tracking, and training set curation. **It’d be great if you also had these:** * Pipeline Design \& Ingestion: Construct automated ELT/ETL pipelines to aggregate, clean, and integrate complex geospatial, satellite image, and telemetry streams into unified repositories at scale and large volume. * Quality Governance \& DataOps: Deploy comprehensive data validation systems, schema checks, and anomaly monitoring to ensure machine learning components rely on robust, high\-fidelity information. * Versioning \& Tracking: Maintain structured dataset versioning infrastructure to enable reproducible model testing and efficient retrieval of operational features. * Workflow \& Label Integration: Harmonize external labeling pipelines and annotation feeds into streamlined, model\-ready training assets. * Cross\-Functional Strategy: Partner with software engineers, data scientists, and operational stakeholders to convert complex sensor attributes into targeted features for prediction pipelines. * Geospatial Data: Experience working with geospatial data (good knowledge of data sources and formats), GIS tools, and spatial analytics libraries (e.g., GDAL, GeoPandas, Rasterio, Shapely, Zarr, COGs…). The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $207,000 \- $311,000 \+ bonus \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, or benefits. **An Equal Opportunity Workplace** ---------------------------------- At X, we don't just accept difference \- we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
